AI.motivation: 以往关于AI相关的线上参与的实证研究与群体层面传播动力学的数学建模之间缺乏联系，理解不同在线社群对AI相关事件的反应及其潜在机制对于研究信息传播和社会对AI的接受度日益重要。
AI.method: 收集并组织Bluesky的经验活动数据划分用户群体，使用以DeepSeek R1发布为案例研究，并在两种互补的分组方案（AI相关社群与学术学科）下，拟合带有外生参与项的网络化SIR型模型，以量化内生网络驱动传播和直接外部响应的相对强度。
AI.result: 研究发现，跨群体的强直接事件响应并不一定与强网络驱动传播相吻合，揭示了若仅通过聚合活动可能会被掩盖的不同参与模式。
AI.conclusion: 强烈的外部事件直接响应并不一定伴随着强烈的网络驱动传播，这揭示了传统聚合活动可能掩盖的独特参与模式。
AI.translation: 社交媒体日益塑造着日常生活，既是讨论重大事件的主要场所，也是线上集体行为蔓延至现实世界活动的空间，而人工智能（AI）同样在全社会变得越来越具有影响力。因此，了解不同的在线社群如何对AI相关事件做出反应，以及厘开这种参与发展背后的机制，对于研究信息传播和社会的AI接受度变得越来越重要。我们的工作弥补了AI相关在线参与的实证研究与群体层面传播动力学的数学建模之间有限的联系。我们开发了一个框架，将经验性的Bluesky活动收集并组织成不同的用户群，然后使用基于网络的动力学模型来研究其参与背后的机制。我们以DeepSeek R1的发布为案例研究，采用了两种互补的分组方案：AI相关社群和学术学科。对于每个群组，我们拟合了一个增强了外生参与项的基于网络的易感-感染-恢复（SIR）型模型，从而量化了内生网络驱动传播与直接外部响应的相对强度。在各个群组中，我们发现对事件的强烈直接响应并不一定与强烈的网络驱动传播相吻合，这揭示了如果仅靠聚合活动可能会被掩盖的独特参与模式。
AI.summary: 该研究旨在弥合AI在线参与的实证研究与数学建模之间的差距，通过结合Bluesky平台的经验数据与改进的SIR模型，以DeepSeek R1发布为案例，分析了不同社群和学科群体对AI话题的参与机制。研究发现，直接外部响应与网络传播强度并不总是正相关，展现了复杂的群体参与动力学。
AI.keywords: 社交媒体, 人工智能, 群体动力学, 传播模型, 蓝天（Bluesky）
AI.comments: 该论文结合了经验数据分析与数学建模（改进的SIR模型），通过以DeepSeek R1发布为案例，深入研究了不同线上社群和学科群体对AI话题的参与动力学，揭示了内生网络传播与外生直接响应之间的差异，对理解人工智能的社会接受度具有重要参考价值。

title: In-Context Learning for Robots: Methods and Applications
comments: 100 pages, 26 figures, 25 tables. Project page: https://jethrojames.github.io/awesome-robots-icl/ ; Code and literature: https://github.com/JethroJames/awesome-robots-icl
summary: General-purpose robots must infer what a new task requires and translate that understanding into appropriate physical action. In-context learning (ICL) for robots supports this process by using demonstrations and interaction to direct existing competence with neural parameters held fixed during deployment. We organize this literature review around the interfaces connecting contextual evidence to execution, distinguishing four families: context-conditioned policies, geometric demonstration transfer, world-model-based control, and skill- and agent-based execution. Comparing these interfaces clarifies their transfer assumptions and the roles of training, correspondence, and memory in making context useful. Across manipulation and navigation, we examine how these mechanisms preserve taught requirements as objects, environments, and execution conditions change. This analysis links method design to evaluation practices that distinguish responsiveness to teaching, physical transfer, and benefits from retained experience. The resulting agenda connects compositional task acquisition and faithful transfer with physical recursive self-improvement, in which experience improves the ability to learn subsequent tasks.
comment: 100 pages, 26 figures, 25 tables. Project page: https://jethrojames.github.io/awesome-robots-icl/ ; Code and literature: https://github.com/JethroJames/awesome-robots-icl

AI.title_translation: 机器人上下文学习：方法与应用
AI.tldr: 本文对机器人上下文学习（ICL）进行了全面的文献综述，将相关方法分为四大接口家族，分析了其传输机制、应用场景及评估实践，指出了通往物理递归自我改进的研究方向。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人必须推断新任务的需求并将这种理解转化为适当的物理动作。现有的上下文学习（ICL）通过在部署期间保持神经参数固定，利用示范和交互来指导现有能力，亟需对这一文献进行系统性的组织、分类以及对其传输假设和评估实践的澄清。
AI.method: 组织并归纳了现有的机器人上下文学习文献，将连接上下文证据与执行的接口分为四大家族：上下文条件策略、几何示范迁移、基于世界模型的控制以及基于技能和智能体的执行，并将其与评估实践相结合进行分析。
AI.result: 文章明确了不同接口在应对对象、环境和执行条件变化时如何保持教学要求，并建立了一个将方法设计与评估实践（区分教学响应性、物理传输和保留经验的益处）相连接的研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 通过将上下文证据与执行机制的接口进行分类和比较，该文献综述澄清了机器人上下文学习的传输假设、训练、对应关系和记忆机制，为未来实现组合式任务获取、忠实传输以及物理递归自我改进奠定了路线图。
AI.translation: 通用机器人必须推断新任务的需求，并将这种理解转化为适当的物理动作。机器人上下文学习（ICL）通过在部署期间保持神经参数固定，利用示范和交互来指导现有能力，从而支持这一过程。我们将这篇文献综述组织在连接上下文证据与执行的接口周围，区分了四个家族：上下文条件策略、几何示范迁移、基于世界模型的控制、以及基于技能和智能体的执行。比较这些接口阐明了它们的传输假设，以及训练、对应关系和记忆在使上下文发挥作用中的角色。在操作和导航领域，我们研究了这些机制如何在对象、环境和执行条件发生变化时保持所教导的需求。该分析将方法设计与评估实践联系起来，评估实践区分了对教学的响应性、物理传输以及保留经验带来的好处。由此产生的议程将组合式任务获取和忠实传输与物理递归自我改进联系起来，在递归自我改进中，经验提高了学习后续任务的能力。
AI.summary: 本文对机器人上下文学习（ICL）的方法与应用进行了系统的文献综述。文章将上下文证据与执行之间的接口分为四大类：上下文条件策略、几何示范迁移、基于世界模型的控制以及基于技能和智能体的执行。通过对这些接口的比较，厘清了其传输假设、训练、对应关系及记忆机制的作用，探讨了在操作和导航任务中如何应对环境变化，并提出了一个连接任务获取、 faithful 传输与物理递归自我改进的研究议程。
AI.keywords: 机器人学, 上下文学习, 任务泛化, 策略学习, 世界模型
AI.comments: 该论文系统性地梳理了机器人上下文学习（ICL）的方法与应用，通过四大核心接口分类，为实现机器人的通用任务泛化与递归自我改进提供了清晰的分析框架。创新点在于将上下文证据与执行机制进行了结构化分类，并深入探讨了其传输假设和评估实践。

title: Persistence Forcing: Exploiting Feature Specialization in Pixel-Space Diffusion
summary: Pixel-space diffusion Transformers (DiTs) directly operate on high-dimensional visual data, yet their hidden representations typically undergo uniform refinement across depth. Natural images, however, are inherently organized at different levels of granularity. Global structure can often be represented compactly, whereas local textures and fine details require richer representations. Motivated by this, we introduce heterogeneous refinement in pixel-space DiTs, assigning different feature groups distinct refinement budgets across depth. Consequently, an ordered feature specialization emerges: sparsely refined features predominantly encode global visual structure, whereas more frequently refined features increasingly specialize toward localized, high-frequency details. We refer to these two groups as persistent and active features, respectively. Building on this emergent specialization, we introduce Persistence Forcing (PerF), which explicitly exploits this persistent--active feature organization for pixel-space image generation. This enables persistent features to continuously condition actively refined features, allowing stable global information to guide the ongoing refinement of finer visual details. During generative sampling, this interaction further induces a meaningful guidance direction that promotes coherent global structure and naturally complements classifier-free guidance. On ImageNet $256\times256$, PerF-L achieves FID of $1.91$, approaching $1.86$ of JiT-H with only half the parameters, while PerF-H further achieves FID of $1.63$ and $1.76$ on ImageNet $256\times256$ and $512\times512$, respectively.

AI.title_translation: 持久强迫：利用像素空间扩散中的特征专业化
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为Persistence Forcing的新方法，通过利用像素空间扩散模型中自然出现的特征专业化（全局结构与局部细节的分离），在大幅减少参数量的同时显著提升了图像生成质量。
AI.motivation: 像素空间的扩散Transformer（DiTs）通常对隐藏表示进行统一的深度细化，但自然图像在不同粒度层面上具有结构差异（全局结构紧凑，局部纹理丰富），现有方法未能充分利用这种自然的多级组织特性。
AI.method: 引入像素空间DiT中的异构细化（heterogeneous refinement），为不同特征组分配不同的深度细化预算，从而产生持久特征和活跃特征的分离，并在此基础上提出Persistence Forcing (PerF)机制，让持久特征持续条件化活跃特征。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256x256上，PerF-L仅用一半的参数就达到了1.91的FID（接近JiT-H的1.86），而PerF-H在ImageNet 256x256和512x512上分别取得了1.63和1.76的FID。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的Persistence Forcing (PerF) 方法能够有效利用像素空间扩散模型中的特征分工，实现高质量的图像生成，在ImageNet数据集上取得了优异的FID性能。
AI.translation: 像素空间扩散Transformer（DiTs）直接对高维视觉数据进行操作，但其隐藏表示通常在深度上经历统一的细化。然而，自然图像本身是在不同的粒度级别上组织的。全局结构通常可以紧凑地表示，而局部纹理和精细细节需要更丰富的表示。受此启发，我们在像素空间DiT中引入了异构细化，为不同深度的不同特征组分配不同的细化预算。因此，出现了有序的特征专业化：稀疏细化的特征主要编码全局视觉结构，而更频繁细化的特征则越来越多地专门针对局部的高频细节。我们将这两组特征分别称为持久特征和活跃特征。基于这种涌现的专业化，我们引入了持久强迫（PerF），它明确地利用这种持久-活跃特征组织来进行像素空间图像生成。这使得持久特征能够持续条件化活跃的细化特征，从而使稳定的全局信息能够指导精细视觉细节的持续细化。在生成采样期间，这种相互作用进一步诱导出一个有意义的引导方向，从而促进相干的全局结构，并自然地补充了无分类器引导。在ImageNet 256x256上，PerF-L实现了1.91的FID，接近JiT-H的1.86，而参数量仅为其一半；而PerF-H在ImageNet 256x256和512x512上分别进一步实现了1.63和1.76的FID。
AI.summary: 该论文针对像素空间扩散Transformer中缺乏特征分化的局限性，提出了异构细化策略，促使特征自然分化为编码全局结构的“持久特征”和编码局部细节的“活跃特征”。基于此，作者开发了Persistence Forcing (PerF)方法，通过持久特征持续引导活跃特征的细化，显著提升了图像生成质量，并在ImageNet基准测试中取得了优异的FID分数。
AI.keywords: Pixel-space diffusion Transformers, Feature specialization, Heterogeneous refinement, Persistence Forcing, Image generation
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地利用了像素空间扩散Transformer中隐式出现的特征专业化现象，通过提出的“Persistence Forcing”方法，在保持较低参数量的同时实现了与大规模模型相媲美的图像生成质量。这为理解和优化高维视觉生成模型提供了新的视角。

title: CoDimRecon: Agentic Reconstruction of Sim-Ready 3D Scenes with Deformable Curves, Surfaces, and Volumes
summary: Reconstructing simulation-ready 3D scenes from real-world observations enables robotics, gaming, and immersive applications, yet existing methods largely assume rigid objects. This leaves an important gap for deformables, whose simulation-ready geometry depends on dimensionality (curves, surfaces, or volumes) and whose behavior may require models beyond elasticity. We present CoDimRecon, an agentic framework that reconstructs editable scenes containing rigid, articulated, and deformable objects from multi-view RGB observations. Scene-level geometric priors ground scale and layout, while object-level generated meshes guide the agent toward detailed, compact geometry; articulated rigid objects are decomposed into movable parts with explicit joints. For deformables, category-wise agent sessions reconstruct curves as centerlines with radii, surfaces as manifold shells with thickness, and volumes as watertight solids for volumetric meshing. Reusable simulator skills initialize compatible physical models and parameters, while agent-guided behavioral tests expose mismatches and trigger targeted revisions of motion, geometry, numerics, or material modeling. On evaluated Replica and ScanNet++ scenes, CoDimRecon achieves competitive compositional reconstruction accuracy while additionally producing deformable assets for rod, shell, and solid simulation. We further demonstrate robot interactions across all three representations, including a controlled paper-folding case in which behavioral testing motivates plastic bending.

AI.title_translation: CoDimRecon：基于可变形曲线、表面和体积的仿真就绪3D场景智能体重建
AI.tldr: CoDimRecon是一个基于智能体的框架，能够从多视角RGB图像中重建包含刚性、铰接式和可变形物体的仿真就绪3D场景，并通过行为测试优化其物理属性。
AI.motivation: 现有的仿真就绪3D场景重建方法主要假设物体是刚性的，无法满足可变形物体（其几何形状依赖于维度，且行为可能超越弹性）的需求，因此需要一个能够统一重建刚性、铰接式和可变形物体并具备物理行为修正能力的框架。
AI.method: 提出名为CoDimRecon的智能体框架，利用场景级几何先验和对象级生成网格重建刚性、铰接式和可变形物体；针对可变形物体采用分类智能体会话重建曲线、曲面和体积；利用可重用模拟器技能初始化物理模型，并通过智能体引导的行为测试触发几何、运动、数值或材料建模的有针对性修正。
AI.result: 在评估的 Replica 和 ScanNet++ 场景中，CoDimRecon 实现了具有竞争力的组合重建精度，同时生成了用于杆、壳和实体模拟的可变形资产，并成功演示了多种机器人交互（包括受控的纸张折叠案例）。
AI.conclusion: CoDimRecon能够有效重建包含刚性、铰接式和可变形物体的仿真就绪3D场景，并通过行为测试实现物理模型的迭代优化，在Replica和ScanNet++数据集上表现出色的重建精度。
AI.translation: 从真实世界的观察中重建仿真就绪的3D场景，可赋能机器人、游戏和沉浸式应用，然而现有方法大多假设物体是刚性的。这给可变形物体留下了一个重要的空白，因为它们的仿真就绪几何形状取决于维度（曲线、表面或体积），且其行为可能需要超越弹性的模型。我们提出了CoDimRecon，这是一个智能体框架，它从多视角的RGB观测中重建包含刚性、铰接式和可变形物体的可编辑场景。场景级的几何先验奠定了尺度和布局的基础，而对象级生成的网格则引导智能体走向详细、紧凑的几何形状；铰接式刚性物体被分解为带有显式关节的可动部件。对于可变形物体，按类别划分的智能体会话将曲线重建为带半径的中心线，表面重建为带有厚度的流形壳，体积重建为用于体积网格划分的水密实体。可重用的模拟器技能初始化了兼容的物理模型和参数，而智能体引导的行为测试则暴露出不匹配之处，并触发对运动、几何、数值或材料建模的有针对性的修正。在评估的Replica和ScanNet++场景中，CoDimRecon实现了具有竞争力的组合重建精度，同时还为杆、壳和实体模拟生成了可变形资产。我们进一步展示了跨所有三种表示的机器人交互，包括一个受控的纸张折叠案例，其中行为测试激发了塑性弯曲。
AI.summary: 论文提出了CoDimRecon，一个基于智能体的框架，用于从多视角RGB观测中重建包含刚性、铰接式和可变形物体（曲线、曲面、体积）的仿真就绪3D场景。通过场景几何先验、对象级网格生成以及由行为测试驱动的物理模型迭代修正，该框架能够生成高精度的可编辑3D资产并支持复杂的机器人交互仿真。
AI.keywords: 3D场景重建, 仿真就绪, 智能体框架, 可变形物体, 多视角RGB观测
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种基于智能体（Agent）的3D场景重建框架CoDimRecon，首次将可变形物体（曲线、曲面、体）的物理仿真准备度与刚性、铰接式物体结合起来，并通过行为测试驱动模型修正，对机器人交互和仿真具有重要意义。

title: Preferent Compression Bounds Are Tight
comments: 14 pages, 6 figures, to appear at the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)
summary: The lack of rigorous safety and performance certificates remains a key bottleneck to the deployment of modern learning-based methods. Sample compression has recently emerged as a powerful tool for deriving such certificates, with particularly sharp bounds available for algorithms satisfying a so-called preference property -- also known as stability in the learning theory literature. These bounds find direct application across domains as different as the Scenario Approach, Pick-to-Learn, and Support Vector methods. However, whether they are tight has remained an open problem. In this paper we resolve this question affirmatively and show that the state-of-the-art bound for preferent compressions is provably tight. We establish this by exhibiting an explicit construction based on the uniform distribution and order statistics that attains the bound in the limit. Along the way, we also provide a considerably shorter and more accessible proof of this bound, requiring only elementary counting arguments and no infinite-dimensional duality.
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, to appear at the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)

AI.title_translation: 偏好压缩界限是紧致的
AI.tldr: 本文证明了偏好压缩（样本压缩的一种）的现有理论界限是紧致的，并提供了一个更简单的证明。
AI.motivation: 现代基于学习的方法缺乏严格的安全性和性能证书，而样本压缩是推导此类证书的强大工具。尽管偏好压缩（稳定性）具有尖锐的界限，但这些界限是否紧致长期以来一直是一个未解之题。
AI.method: 通过展示一个基于均匀分布和顺序统计量的显式构造，在极限情况下达到了该界限，并使用了只需基础计数论证的更简短的证明方法。
AI.result: 正面回答了该公开问题，证明了偏好压缩的最新技术水平界限在可证明意义上是紧致的，并提供了一个更简短、更易理解的证明过程，无需无限维对偶性。
AI.conclusion: 偏好压缩的现有最新界限在极限情况下是可证明紧致的，并且可以通过更简单、基于基础计数论证的方法来证明。
AI.translation: 缺乏严格的安全性和性能证书仍然是部署现代基于学习方法的主要瓶颈。样本压缩最近已成为推导此类证书的强大工具，对于满足所谓偏好属性（在学习理论文献中也称为稳定性）的算法，具有特别尖锐的界限。这些界限在场景方法、Pick-to-Learn和支持向量方法等不同领域找到了直接应用。然而，它们是否紧致仍然是一个未解之题。在本文中，我们以肯定的方式解决了这个问题，并证明了偏好压缩的最新界限是可证明紧致的。我们通过展示基于均匀分布和顺序统计量的显式构造来实现这一点，该构造在极限下达到了该界限。在此过程中，我们还提供了该界限的一个相当更短、更容易理解的证明，仅需要基础的计数论证，而不需要无限维对偶性。
AI.summary: 该论文解决了偏好压缩界限紧致性的公开问题，证明了现有的最新界限在极限下是紧致的，并提供了一个基于基础计数论证的更简短的证明。
AI.keywords: 样本压缩, 学习理论, 紧致界限, 偏好属性, 稳定性
AI.comments: 该论文解决了学习理论中关于偏好压缩界限是否紧致的长期公开问题，通过构造显式例子证明了现有界限在极限情况下是紧致的，同时极大地简化了证明过程，对保证基于学习的方法的安全性具有重要意义。

title: SAKI: Skill Assembly and Kinematic Imitation from Human Videos for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
summary: Learning from human videos offers a promising route to acquiring diverse manipulation skills. Extending this capability beyond tabletop settings to long-horizon mobile manipulation requires adapting and composing demonstrated interactions across changing scenes and robot configurations. We present Skill Assembly and Kinematic Imitation (SAKI), a framework connecting human-video skill acquisition, cross-demonstration assembly and closed-loop whole-body execution. SAKI prepares reusable object-centric skills that preserve task-critical interactions while allowing transfer paths to adapt. Given a goal and supplied task dependencies, it selects and orders skills, binds their object roles to the current scene, and carries scene estimates and robot configuration between successive skills. Whole-body kinematic imitation generates coordinated base, arm and gripper motion. During execution, persistent object estimates maintain task references across viewpoint changes, while visual feedback updates remaining trajectories. Real-robot experiments demonstrate skill reuse across layouts and the composition of independently demonstrated interactions into continuous mobile tasks, including tidying and wiping. Ablation results show that task-conditioned reference preparation substantially improves long-horizon task completion with whole-body optimisation and visual feedback held fixed. Check https://aus.bot/research/saki/ for video demos!

AI.title_translation: SAKI：用于长周期移动操作的人类视频技能组装与运动学模仿
AI.tldr: 本文提出了SAKI框架，利用人类视频进行技能获取和组装，实现了长周期的机器人移动操作。
AI.motivation: 将从人类视频中学习操作技能的能力从桌面场景扩展到长周期的移动操作，需要适应并组合跨多变场景和机器人配置的交互。
AI.method: 提出SAKI框架，包含可重用、以对象为中心的技能准备，根据任务依赖关系选择和排序技能，绑定对象角色，并通过全身运动学模仿（协调底座、手臂和夹爪运动）及视觉反馈在执行过程中保持任务引用和更新轨迹。
AI.result: 真实机器人实验证明了技能在不同布局间的重用性，以及将独立演示的交互组合为连续移动任务（如整理和擦拭）的能力；消融实验表明任务条件参考准备显著提高了长周期任务的完成率。
AI.conclusion: SAKI框架成功实现了从人类视频到长周期移动操作机器人的技能转换与组合，通过任务条件参考准备和全身优化显著提升了任务完成率。
AI.translation: 从人类视频中学习为获取多样化的操作技能提供了一条有前景的途径。将这一能力从桌面场景扩展到长周期的移动操作，需要适应并组合跨越不断变化的场景和机器人配置的演示交互。我们提出了技能组装与运动学模仿（SAKI）框架，它将人类视频技能获取、跨演示组装和闭环全身执行连接起来。SAKI准备可重用的、以物体为中心的技能，这些技能在保持任务关键交互的同时允许转移路径进行适应。给定目标和提供的任务依赖关系，它选择并对技能进行排序，将其物体角色绑定到当前场景，并在连续的技能之间传递场景估计和机器人配置。全身运动学模仿生成协调的底座、手臂和夹爪运动。在执行过程中，持久的物体估计在视点变化时保持任务引用，而视觉反馈则更新剩余的轨迹。真实机器人实验证明了跨布局的技能重用，以及将独立演示的交互组合成连续的移动任务（包括整理和擦拭）。消融结果表明，在保持全身优化和视觉反馈不变的情况下，任务条件参考准备显著改善了长周期任务的完成情况。请访问 https://aus.bot/research/saki/ 查看视频演示！
AI.summary: 本文介绍了SAKI（技能组装与运动学模仿）框架，该框架通过连接人类视频技能获取、跨演示组装与闭环全身执行，实现了长周期的移动操纵任务，有效支持技能重用与多步骤复杂任务的完成。
AI.keywords: Mobile Manipulation, Human Videos, Skill Assembly, Kinematic Imitation, Long-Horizon Tasks
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种名为SAKI的框架，能够从人类视频中学习并组装可重用的技能，实现长周期的移动操作。其创新点在于将技能获取、跨演示组装和闭环全身执行有机结合，展示了在复杂场景（如整理和擦拭）中的强大泛化能力。

title: TORQUE: Optimizing What (not) to Quantize Before and After Rotation
summary:
Uniform random rotations are an effective preprocessing step for quantization: they make normalized coordinate distributions approximately Gaussian, enabling the use of codebooks optimized offline. We introduce TORQUE, a framework that improves on previous quantization works that use random rotations by jointly optimizing how many and which coordinates to preserve at high precision both before and after rotation, under a fixed overall expected bit budget.
  Intuitively, before rotation, preserving large input coordinates at high precision can reduce overall error by preventing the rotation from spreading their values across many coordinates. Likewise, after rotation, preserving a small fraction of the largest-magnitude coordinates at high precision allows the remaining values to be quantized more accurately using codebooks optimized offline for the resulting truncated Gaussian distribution.
  We derive a quantization error upper bound and prove that top-$k$ pre-rotation retention minimizes it for each $k$. This reduces the search over coordinate subsets to an optimization over $k$, enabling a fast optimizer that uses offline codebooks and parallel parameter selection for practical implementation. We demonstrate an improved tradeoff between reconstruction accuracy and storage cost through numerical evaluation under the Gaussian model and experiments on nearest-neighbor retrieval, KV-cache compression, and activation compression.

AI.title_translation: TORQUE：优化旋转前后的量化选择（或不量化）
AI.tldr: TORQUE是一个通过联合优化旋转前后高精度坐标保留来改善量化性能的新框架，实现了更好的精度与存储权衡。
AI.motivation: 虽然均匀随机旋转是量化的有效预处理步骤，但现有的方法未能在固定的总体期望比特预算下，最优地决定旋转前后应该保留多少以及哪些坐标采用高精度。
AI.method: 引入TORQUE框架，联合优化旋转前后的高精度坐标保留，推导量化误差上界并证明预旋转top-k保留的最优性，开发基于离线码本和并行参数选择的快速优化器。
AI.result: 数值评估和多项实验（最近邻检索、KV缓存压缩和激活压缩）表明，TORQUE在重建精度和存储成本之间取得了更好的权衡。
AI.conclusion: TORQUE通过在旋转前后联合优化坐标保留策略与推导误差上界，显著提升了基于随机旋转的量化性能，在多个应用场景中实现了更优的精度与存储折中。
AI.translation:
均匀随机旋转是量化的有效预处理步骤：它们使归一化坐标分布近似为高斯分布，从而能够使用离线优化的码本。我们介绍了 TORQUE，这是一个改进以往使用随机旋转的量化工作的框架，它在固定的总体期望比特预算下，通过联合优化旋转前和旋转后保留高精度坐标的数量和哪些坐标，来提升量化效果。
直观地说，在旋转之前，以高精度保留大的输入坐标可以通过防止旋转将其值分散到许多坐标中来减少整体误差。同样，在旋转之后，以高精度保留一小部分最大幅度的坐标，可以利用针对由此产生的截断高斯分布离线优化的码本，更准确地量化其余值。
我们推导了量化误差上界，并证明了对于每个 $k$，前 $k$ 个预旋转保留使该上界最小化。这把对坐标子集的搜索简化为对 $k$ 的优化，从而实现了一个快速优化器，该优化器使用离线码本和并行参数选择以用于实际实现。我们通过高斯模型下的数值评估以及在最近邻检索、KV 缓存压缩和激活压缩方面的实验，证明了重建精度与存储成本之间改进的权衡。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TORQUE框架，通过在均匀随机旋转的前后联合优化高精度坐标的保留策略，在固定比特预算下提升了量化性能。论文推导了误差上界并证明了预旋转top-k保留策略的最优性，设计了高效的优化算法，并在多项压缩任务中验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 量化, 随机旋转, 误差上界, 坐标保留, 压缩
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出在旋转前后联合优化高精度保留的坐标数量和选择，突破了传统随机旋转量化的局限。通过推导量化误差上界并证明前k个预旋转保留的最优性，实现了高效的优化算法。在最近邻检索、KV缓存压缩和激活压缩等任务中验证了其优越的重建精度与存储成本权衡。

title: Multi-Class, Multi-Tier Network Intrusion Detection: A Comprehensive and Reproducible Benchmark
summary: Machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) have dominated Intrusion Detection System (IDS) research in recent years. Unfortunately, many existing studies have produced inflated results and unreliable benchmarks due to critical oversights and mistakes in the ML and DL pipeline, from data collection and labeling to feature engineering and model training and evaluation. CIC-IDS2017 is a standard benchmark for network intrusion detection. Still, many published results on this dataset are difficult to compare due to labeling errors, inconsistent flow extraction, potential leakage, and performance evaluation metrics dominated by benign traffic. In this paper, we present a comprehensive benchmark with corrected PCAP-level labeling and a complete evaluation pipeline with diverse ML models. We evaluate eleven tabular classifiers at three nested levels: binary attack detection, nine-class attack-family attribution, and fifteen-class fine-grained classification. A soft-voting ensemble of Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM obtains the best fine-tier macro-F1 of 0.955, with coarse and binary macro-F1 scores of 0.980 and 0.999, respectively. We further conducted a feature selection study based on an analysis of feature importance. This comprehensive benchmark pipeline is configurable and open-source, enabling new feature extraction and model plugins for new datasets. Future work should use this pipeline as a reference point for richer features, rare-class analysis, and model generalization towards new datasets and attack classes.

AI.title_translation: 多类别、多层次网络入侵检测：一个全面且可复现的基准
AI.tldr: 本文针对现有网络入侵检测基准不可靠的问题，提出了一个纠错后的、多层次分类的全面开源基准与评估流水线。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于机器学习和深度学习的网络入侵检测系统（IDS）研究由于数据收集、标签错误、特征工程、模型训练及评估中的疏漏，导致结果虚高且基准不可靠，迫切需要一个全面且可复现的基准。
AI.method: 使用修正后的PCAP级标签和完整的评估流程，在三个嵌套级别（二分类、九分类攻击族群、十五分类细粒度分类）上评估了十一个表格分类器，并采用随机森林、XGBoost和LightGBM构建了软投票集成模型，同时进行了基于特征重要性的特征选择研究。
AI.result: 由随机森林、XGBoost和LightGBM组成的软投票集成模型在细粒度分类上取得了0.955的宏F1分数，在粗粒度和二分类上分别达到了0.980和0.999的宏F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了一个经过纠错和标准化的综合网络入侵检测基准及开源流水线，为未来更可靠、可比的IDS研究奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 近年来，机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）在入侵检测系统（IDS）研究中占据了主导地位。不幸的是，由于ML和DL流水线中从数据收集、标注到特征工程、模型训练与评估等环节的严重疏忽和错误，许多现有研究产生了膨胀的结果和不可靠的基准。CIC-IDS2017是网络入侵检测的标准基准。尽管如此，由于标注错误、不一致的流提取、潜在的数据泄露以及被良性流量主导的性能评估指标，该数据集上的许多已发布结果很难进行比较。在本文中，我们提出了一个综合基准，具有纠正后的PCAP级标签和包含多样化ML模型的完整评估流水线。我们在三个嵌套级别上评估了十一个表格分类器：二分类攻击检测、九分类攻击族群归属以及十五分类细粒度分类。随机森林、XGBoost和LightGBM的软投票集成模型在细粒度层面上获得了0.955的最佳宏F1分数，粗粒度和二分类的宏F1分数分别为0.980和0.999。我们进一步基于特征重要性分析进行了特征选择研究。这一全面的基准流水线是可配置且开源的，能够为新数据集启用新的特征提取和模型插件。未来的工作应将该流水线作为参考点，用于更丰富的特征、稀有类分析以及模型向新数据集和攻击类别的泛化。
AI.summary: 该论文针对现有网络入侵检测中因数据处理和评估缺陷导致结果不可靠的问题，提出了一个基于修正后CIC-IDS2017数据集的综合基准及可配置的开源评估流水线，通过多级分类和集成模型实现了卓越的检测性能。
AI.keywords: 网络入侵检测, 机器学习, 深度学习, 基准测试, 特征选择
AI.comments: 该论文指出了现有网络入侵检测研究中普遍存在的数据集处理和评估错误，并基于CIC-IDS2017提出了一个经过修正的、可复现的综合基准及评估流程，具有很高的实用价值和开源贡献。

title: SAGE: A Statistical Acceptance Gate for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents increasingly self-evolve by editing a persistent skill document that encodes their workflow, tool-use rules, and decision logic. This loop has two steps, an optimizer that proposes a candidate edit and a gate that accepts or rejects it. Prior work has concentrated on the optimizer, while the gate still follows a naive rule that keeps any edit which improves an aggregate validation score. We show that this rule fails in two ways. First, it admits permanent regressions, since an edit can raise the average while breaking items the skill already solves. Second, it is vulnerable to the Optimizer's Curse, since the best observed score on a finite and noisy validation set is upward biased. To solve the above two limitations, we propose a statistical acceptance gate for self-evolving agents (SAGE). Compared with previous work, SAGE has two contributions. First, SAGE proposes a per-item paired comparison that evaluates the current skill and the edited skill on identical validation items, which exposes regressions that an aggregate score hides and penalizes them asymmetrically. Second, SAGE also employs a one-sided paired test that commits an edit only when its wins are statistically reliable against its losses, and it abstains otherwise. SAGE is a conservative refinement of the standard gate that recovers the baseline exactly at a boundary setting. It commits only a subset of the baseline's edits, filtering out those whose gains are unreliable or purchased by breaking already-solved items. Across five benchmarks and four backbone LLMs under an equal-budget protocol, SAGE lowers the regression rate in 19 of 20 settings and matches the baseline in the remaining one, for example from 36.5% to 0% on LiveMath and from 42.8% to 0% on OfficeQA with DeepSeek-V4. SAGE also attains the highest final score in all 20 settings, raising LiveMath from 34.15 to 48.78.

AI.title_translation: SAGE：自进化智能体的统计接受门控
AI.tldr: SAGE 是一种新型的统计接受门控机制，通过配对比较和统计检验解决了大模型自进化智能体中的性能退化和优化器诅咒问题，大幅降低了退化率并提升了最终性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的自进化智能体通常使用简单的规则（保留任何提高聚合验证分数的编辑）作为接受门控，这种做法存在两大缺陷：一是会引入永久性退化（损害已解决的问题），二是容易受到优化器诅咒的影响（有限且有噪声的验证集上观测到的最优分数向上偏置）。
AI.method: 提出了 SAGE（Statistical Acceptance Gate）方法，包含两点核心贡献：一是进行基于项的配对比较，评估当前技能与编辑后技能在相同验证项上的表现，并对退化进行不对称惩罚；二是采用单侧配对检验，仅在胜负具有统计学显著性时才提交编辑，否则放弃。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试和四个骨干大模型下，SAGE 在 20 个设置中的 19 个降低了退化率（例如在 DeepSeek-V4 下的 LiveMath 从 36.5% 降至 0%，OfficeQA 从 42.8% 降至 0%），且在所有 20 个设置中都获得了最高的最终分数（例如将 LiveMath 从 34.15 提升至 48.78）。
AI.conclusion: SAGE 是一种针对大模型自进化智能体的统计接受门控机制，通过严谨的配对比较和统计检验，有效防止了永久性退化和优化器诅咒，显著提升了智能体自进化的稳定性和最终性能。
AI.translation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体越来越多地通过编辑编码其工作流、工具使用规则和决策逻辑的持久技能文档来进行自我进化。这一循环包含两个步骤：提出候选编辑的优化器，以及接受或拒绝该编辑的门控。先前的研究主要集中在优化器上，而门控仍然遵循朴素的规则，即保留任何提高总体验证分数的编辑。我们发现该规则在两个方面失效了。首先，它允许永久性退化，因为编辑可能会在提高平均值的同时破坏技能已经解决的项目。其次，它容易受到优化器诅咒的影响，因为在有限且带噪声的验证集上观察到的最佳分数具有向上的偏差。为了解决上述两个局限性，我们提出了自进化智能体的统计接受门控（SAGE）。与以前的工作相比，SAGE 有两个贡献。首先，SAGE 提出了按项进行的配对比较，在相同的验证项上评估当前技能和编辑后的技能，这暴露了聚合分数隐藏的退化，并对其进行了非对称惩罚。其次，SAGE 还采用了一项单侧配对检验，仅当编辑相对于其损失的胜率在统计上可靠时才提交编辑，否则放弃。SAGE 是标准门控的保守改进，在边界设置下完全恢复了基线。它只提交基线编辑的一个子集，过滤掉那些收益不可靠或通过破坏已解决项目换来的编辑。在五项基准测试和四个骨干 LLM、采用等预算协议下，SAGE 在 20 个设置中的 19 个降低了退化率，并在其余一个中与基线持平，例如在使用 DeepSeek-V4 的 LiveMath 上从 36.5% 降至 0%，在 OfficeQA 上从 42.8% 降至 0%。SAGE 还在所有 20 个设置中获得了最高的最终得分，将 LiveMath 从 34.15 提高到 48.78。
AI.summary: 论文提出了 SAGE（自进化智能体统计接受门控），用于解决现有自进化智能体中接受门控机制的退化和优化器诅咒问题。通过每项配对比较和单侧配对检验，SAGE 能够有效过滤掉不可靠或以牺牲已有解法为代价的编辑，在多个基准测试中显著降低了退化率并提高了智能体的最终表现。
AI.keywords: Self-Evolving Agents, Large Language Models, Acceptance Gate, Statistical Testing, Skill Optimization
AI.comments: 该论文针对大模型自进化智能体中的接受门控（Acceptance Gate）机制进行了创新研究，指出了传统基于聚合分数的简单门控规则在防止性能退化和克服优化器诅咒方面的缺陷。提出的 SAGE 方法通过基于项的配对比较和单侧配对检验，有效降低了退化率并提升了最终性能，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Neural networks for spectral optimization
summary: Given a functional dependent on the spectrum of a differential operator, we address the problem of finding a domain which optimizes this functional. PDE solvers might be used to tackle this optimization. It is however computationally expensive. We propose two neural network models which learn the spectrum directly from the geometry of the domain and can be used to optimize the domain from one or more eigenvalues. We investigate two representations. The first encodes the domain through Fourier coefficients and a light MLP, which is efficient on star-shaped geometries, achieving a precision of 0.2\%. Through a rescaling of the coefficients the designed models satisfy the scaling law of the eigenvalues. Additionally, averaging the outputs of the trained surrogates over rotations and reflections induces invariance for these transformations. The second is a model that takes the landscape function, the indicator function and the gradient of the landscape function. A Gram-Schmidt process produces orthogonal eigenfunctions as output of the model along with the associated eigenvalues. The landscape model reaches 1\% mean relative error on the first ten eigenvalues, compared with 4\% for an FNO model. Replacing the landscape by an SDF worsened both prediction and optimization errors. The trained model also generalizes from synthetic shapes to domains given as classical image dataset. The resulting surrogates of both approaches recover classical spectral optima such as the disk for the first eigenvalue or the conjectured minima of higher eigenvalues. This confirms that our models produce accurate differentiable estimates of eigenvalues, which can be used in shape optimization problems involving spectral quantities.

AI.title_translation: 用于谱优化的神经网络
AI.tldr: 本论文提出两种神经网络模型直接从几何形状学习微分算子的谱，高效解决了传统PDE求解器计算成本高的问题，并在谱优化中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 传统的偏微分方程（PDE）求解器在解决依赖于微分算子谱的域优化问题时计算成本高昂，因此需要开发更高效的替代方法。
AI.method: 提出了两个神经网络模型：第一个使用傅里叶系数和一个轻量级多层感知机（MLP），适用于星形几何形状；第二个利用景观函数、指示函数及其梯度，并通过施密特正交化过程输出正交特征函数及相关特征值。
AI.result: 第一个模型在星形几何上实现了0.2%的精度，并满足特征值的缩放定律；第二个模型在前十个特征值上达到了1%的平均相对误差，优于FNO模型的4%，并且能够成功恢复经典的谱最优解。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发了基于神经网络的微分算子谱预测与优化方法，具有高效、准确和良好的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 给定一个依赖于微分算子谱泛函，我们解决寻找优化该泛函的域的问题。PDE求解器可用于处理此优化，但计算成本高昂。我们提出了两个神经网络模型，它们直接从域的几何形状学习谱，并可用于根据一个或多个特征值优化域。我们研究了两种表示方法。第一种通过傅里叶系数和一个轻量级MLP对域进行编码，这在星形几何上是高效的，达到了0.2%的精度。通过对系数进行重新缩放，设计的模型满足特征值的缩放定律。此外，对旋转和反射的训练代理输出进行平均，可诱导这些变换的不变性。第二种模型采用景观函数、指示函数和景观函数的梯度。Gram-Schmidt过程产生正交特征函数作为模型的输出以及相关的特征值。与FNO模型的4%相比，景观模型在前十个特征值上达到了1%的平均相对误差。用SDF代替景观会使预测和优化误差恶化。训练好的模型还可以从合成形状推广到作为经典图像数据集给出的域。这两种方法的替代方案都恢复了经典的谱极值，例如第一个特征值的圆盘或更高特征值的猜想最小值。这证实了我们的模型产生了准确的特征值可微估计，可用于涉及谱量的形状优化问题。
AI.summary: 论文提出了两种神经网络模型，用于直接从域的几何形状学习谱，从而实现高效的形状谱优化，克服了传统PDE求解器计算代价高的缺点，并在多个基准测试中展现出高精度和良好的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 神经网络, 谱优化, 偏微分方程, 形状优化, 特征值
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将神经网络应用于微分算子谱优化中，通过避免传统PDE求解器的高计算成本，实现了高效的几何优化。提出的两种模型在精度和泛化能力上均表现出色，能够恢复经典的谱极值形状。

title: Improving scalable oversight with co-trained monitors
summary: Worker-monitor setups are a promising approach to AI oversight, but training workers against fixed monitors can incentivize monitor evasion. We study whether this failure mode can be avoided by co-training the monitor alongside the worker, and explore both supervised and self-supervised approaches. In the supervised setting, we prove a characterization: monitoring is possible with vanishing error and query rates exactly when the class of possible monitor functions has finite Littlestone dimension. This connects worker monitoring with an established literature on adversarial online learning. For self-supervision, we propose a co-training procedure based on test-time distillation: the monitor uses additional test-time compute to generate training labels, then trains its standard-compute policy on those labels. For majority-vote labels, we give a finite-sample sharpening guarantee under adaptive worker distributions with action coverage, that shows that the monitor's verdicts converge to its initial modal verdicts. We stress-test the former in code-security settings where the worker is trained adversarially to fool the monitor. Our results suggest that adaptive monitors are better at keeping pace with evolving worker strategies, while fixed monitors are more vulnerable to evasion.

AI.title_translation: 通过联合训练监督者改进可扩展监督
AI.tldr: 通过联合训练监督者与工作者（采用监督和自监督方法），可以有效防止工作者对固定监督者的规避，从而提升AI可扩展监督的效果。
AI.motivation: 传统的“工作者-监督者”设置中使用固定监督者容易促使工作者寻找方法来规避监督，因此需要研究通过联合训练监督者来避免这种失效模式。
AI.method: 提出在监督和自监督设置下联合训练监督者的方法：在监督设置中，利用有限Littlestone维数刻画监控可行性；在自监督设置中，提出基于测试时蒸馏的联合训练程序。
AI.result: 理论上证明了在监督设置下当且仅当监督函数类的Littlestone维数有限时可以实现趋近于零的错误率和查询率；自监督设置下的多数表决标签给出了有限样本尖锐化保证；在代码安全设置的压力测试中表明自适应监督者能更好地应对演化的工作者策略。
AI.conclusion: 自适应的联合训练监督者能够更好地跟上不断演化的工作者策略，从而有效克服固定监督者容易被规避的局限性。
AI.translation: 工作者-监督者设置是AI监督的一种有前景的方法，但针对固定监督者训练工作者会激励监督者规避行为。我们研究了是否可以通过与工作者同时联合训练监督者来避免这种失效模式，并探讨了监督和自监督的方法。在监督设置中，我们证明了一个特征：当且仅当可能监督函数类的Littlestone维数有限时，以趋近于零的错误率和查询率进行监控才是可能的。这连接了工作者监控与已建立的对抗在线学习文献。对于自监督，我们提出了一个基于测试时间蒸馏的联合训练程序：监督者使用额外的测试时间计算来生成训练标签，然后在其标准计算策略上训练这些标签。对于多数表决标签，我们在具有动作覆盖的自适应工作者分布下给出了有限样本尖锐化保证，表明监督者的裁决收敛到其初始的模态裁决。我们在工作者被对抗性训练以欺骗监督者的代码安全设置中对后者进行了压力测试。我们的结果表明，自适应监督者在跟上不断演化的工作者策略方面表现更好，而固定监督者更容易受到规避的影响。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了通过联合训练监督者来改进可扩展AI监督的方法，探讨了监督和自监督设置。在监督设置中证明了基于有限Littlestone维数的监控可行性条件，在自监督设置中提出了基于测试时蒸馏的程序，并通过代码安全性测试表明自适应监督者比固定监督者更不易被规避。
AI.keywords: AI监督, 联合训练, 监督者规避, 对抗在线学习, 测试时蒸馏
AI.comments: 该论文将AI可扩展监督（Scalable Oversight）与对抗在线学习（Adversarial Online Learning）理论结合，探讨了通过联合训练（Co-training）监督者来解决固定监督者容易被工作者规避的问题。创新点在于提出了有限Littlestone维数的理论刻画以及基于测试时蒸馏的自监督联合训练方法。

title: PowerZooJax: A JAX-based Power System Benchmark for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Power system operation is a safety-critical sequential decision-making problem, making it a natural testbed for reinforcement learning (RL). However, existing RL environments for power systems are often narrow in scope and computationally limited by CPU-based simulation workflows, making large-scale evaluation difficult. We introduce PowerZooJax, a JAX-based benchmark suite for RL in power system operation. It provides five constrained Markov decision process tasks spanning generation, transmission, distribution, distributed energy resources, and data center microgrid. By rewriting power flow, economic dispatch, market clearing, and device dynamics as JAX computation graphs, PowerZooJax keeps the entire training and evaluation loop on the GPU. Experiments show substantial speedups over CPU-based simulations and demonstrate standardized evaluation of policy returns, safety violations, and out-of-distribution stress conditions. Our open-source benchmark is available at: https://github.com/powerzoojax/PowerZooJax.

AI.title_translation: PowerZooJax：一个基于JAX的电力系统强化学习基准测试平台
AI.tldr: PowerZooJax是一个基于JAX的GPU加速电力系统强化学习基准，大幅提升了仿真与训练速度并支持多场景标准化评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的电力系统强化学习环境范围狭窄，且受限于基于CPU的仿真工作流，导致计算效率低下，难以进行大规模评估。
AI.method: 将潮流计算、经济调度、市场出清和设备动力学重写为JAX计算图，将整个训练和评估循环保持在GPU上运行，并设计了涵盖五个约束马尔可夫决策过程的任务。
AI.result: 实验表明，与基于CPU的仿真相比，该框架实现了大幅的速度提升，并能够对策略回报、安全违例和分布外压力条件进行标准化评估。
AI.conclusion: PowerZooJax通过GPU加速和丰富的任务场景，有效解决了现有强化学习电力系统环境计算受限和范围狭窄的问题，为该领域提供了一个高效、可扩展的标准化评估平台。
AI.translation: 电力系统运行是一个安全关键的序列决策问题，这使其成为强化学习（RL）的天然测试平台。然而，现有的电力系统RL环境通常范围狭窄，且受限于基于CPU的仿真工作流，使得大规模评估变得困难。我们推出了PowerZooJax，这是一个用于电力系统运行RL的基于JAX的基准测试套件。它提供了五个跨越发电、输电、配电、分布式能源和数据中心微电网的受限马尔可夫决策过程任务。通过将潮流计算、经济调度、市场出清和设备动力学重写为JAX计算图，PowerZooJax将整个训练和评估循环保持在GPU上。实验显示，与基于CPU的仿真相比，该方法实现了大幅的速度提升，并展示了对策略回报、安全违约和分布外压力条件的标准化评估。我们的开源基准可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/powerzoojax/PowerZooJax。
AI.summary: PowerZooJax是一个基于JAX的电力系统强化学习基准测试套件，它通过将仿真和训练全流程置于GPU上运行，实现了大幅的速度提升，并提供了五个涵盖发电、输电、配电、分布式能源和数据中心微电网的约束马尔可夫决策过程任务。
AI.keywords: PowerZooJax, 强化学习, 电力系统运行, JAX, GPU加速
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地利用JAX框架将电力系统仿真推向GPU，解决了现有CPU基准在规模和速度上的限制，对于推进强化学习在安全关键的电力系统优化中的应用具有重要意义。

title: Slip Wall Boundary Conditions in Curved Domains for Finite Element ALE Hydrodynamics
summary: We present a high-order finite element arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian (ALE) method for hydrodynamics with slip-wall boundary conditions on analytically curved domains. The method combines distinct Lagrangian, remesh, and remap phases while preserving the geometric features of curved boundaries and allowing tangential motion of boundary nodes. In the Lagrangian phase, we use weak boundary condition enforcement to impose the slip-wall condition without freezing tangential motion. In the mesh optimization phase, we adapt TMOP (target-matrix optimization paradigm) to analytic walls by replacing selected boundary coordinate degrees of freedom with curve or surface parameters. The Newton solve then moves boundary nodes tangentially with respect to the prescribed geometry while carrying the drift introduced by the Lagrangian phase. In the remap phase, we transfer the solution from the old mesh to the optimized mesh by a conservative advection-based remap over pseudo-time. We present numerical results in two and three dimensions demonstrating the method on high-order curved meshes and showing that it preserves boundary fidelity while producing the expected hydrodynamic solution features.

AI.title_translation: 有限元ALE流体力学曲域滑移壁面边界条件
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对曲域中有限元ALE流体力学的高阶滑移壁面边界条件处理方法，能够完美保持边界几何特征并模拟真实的流体运动。
AI.motivation: 传统的有限元ALE方法在处理曲边界的滑移壁面条件时，往往难以同时保持几何特征的高保真度并允许边界节点的自由切向运动，因此需要开发一种能够在曲域中精确施加滑移壁面条件的高阶ALE方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种高阶有限元ALE流体力学方法，结合了拉格朗日阶段的弱边界条件施加、基于TMOP（目标矩阵优化范式）并适应解析壁面的网格优化阶段，以及基于保守对流的伪时间重映射阶段。
AI.result: 二维和三维的数值实验结果表明，该方法能够有效保持边界保真度，并准确复现预期的流体力学解的特征。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种适用于曲边界的高阶有限元ALE流体力学滑移壁面边界条件处理方法，通过拉格朗日、网格优化和重映射三阶段的协同配合，成功实现了边界几何保真与流体切向运动的统一。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于流体力学的高阶有限元任意拉格朗日-欧拉（ALE）方法，该方法在解析曲域上具有滑移壁面边界条件。该方法结合了独特的拉格朗日、重新网格化和重映射阶段，同时保持了曲边界的几何特征并允许边界节点的切向运动。在拉格朗日阶段，我们使用弱边界条件强制施加滑移壁面条件，而不冻结切向运动。在网格优化阶段，我们通过用曲线或曲面参数替换选定的边界坐标自由度，将TMOP（目标矩阵优化范式）适应于解析壁面。然后，牛顿求解器使边界节点相对于规定几何形状进行切向移动，同时承载拉格朗日阶段引入的漂移。在重映射阶段，我们通过基于伪时间的保守平流重映射，将解从旧网格传输到优化网格。我们展示了二维和三维的数值结果，证明了该方法在高温高阶曲网格上的有效性，并表明它在保持边界保真度的同时产生了预期的流体力学解特征。
AI.summary: 该文提出了一种用于流体力学的高阶有限元任意拉格朗日-欧拉（ALE）方法，专门用于处理解析曲域上的滑移壁面边界条件。该方法通过弱边界条件施加、适配解析壁面的TMOP网格优化以及保守对流重映射三个阶段，实现了边界几何高保真与节点切向运动的完美结合，并在二三维数值算例中验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 任意拉格朗日-欧拉方法, 高阶有限元, 滑移壁面边界条件, 曲边界, 目标矩阵优化范式
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将高阶有限元ALE方法扩展到了具有解析曲边界的滑移壁面边界条件问题中，通过结合TMOP网格优化与弱形式边界条件施加，有效保持了几何边界的高保真度，在二维和三维流体力学数值模拟中展现了极高的准确性与鲁棒性。

title: What if automating AI R&D triggers an intelligence explosion?
summary: In contrast to even a year ago, AI systems now write most of the code inside the companies that build them. As more of the AI research and development (R&D) pipeline is automated, could AI progress radically accelerate in an "intelligence explosion," where years of advances are compressed into months or less? Preliminary evidence suggests that it could. In this work, we assess this evidence, analyze an intelligence explosion's potential impacts, and propose policy responses. AI systems are on track to automate most AI R\&D work within a few years, and possibly all of it. If this triggers an intelligence explosion, it could dramatically bring forward AI's benefits, but also pose extreme risks: capabilities growth could accelerate far beyond what society can keep up with, humanity could lose control over superhuman AI systems, and checks on power within and between states, companies, and branches of government could be severely eroded. Although there remains much uncertainty about these possibilities, the high stakes warrant serious further attention. Policymakers should urgently obtain more visibility into the automation of AI R&D, develop ways to steer and constrain an intelligence explosion, and prepare society to adapt to an intelligence explosion's impacts.

AI.title_translation: 如果自动化人工智能研发引发智能爆发会怎样？
AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI研发自动化可能引发的“智能爆发”及其带来的巨大收益与极端风险，并呼吁政策制定者紧急采取应对措施。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统在AI构建公司内部编写大部分代码，AI研发流水线日益自动化，作者旨在探讨这是否会引发“智能爆发”并评估其潜在影响与政策应对。
AI.method: 评估初步证据，分析智能爆发的潜在影响，并提出相关的政策应对建议。
AI.result: AI系统有望在几年内自动化大部分乃至全部AI R&D工作；若引发智能爆发，将加速AI收益但也带来极端的安全、失控和权力失衡风险。
AI.conclusion: AI研发自动化可能引发智能爆发，带来巨大收益的同时也伴随着失控和安全等极端风险，政策制定者亟需采取行动进行监测、引导和应对。
AI.translation: 与甚至一年前相比，人工智能系统现在编写了构建它们的公司内部的大多数代码。随着更多人工智能研发（R&D）流水线的自动化，人工智能的进展会不会在“智能爆发”中急剧加速，将数年的进展压缩到数月甚至更短？初步证据表明它是可能的。在这项工作中，我们评估了这些证据，分析了智能爆发的潜在影响，并提出了政策应对措施。人工智能系统有望在几年内自动化大部分人工智能研发工作，甚至可能全部自动化。如果这引发了智能爆发，它可能会极大地提前人工智能的好处，但也带来极端的风险：能力增长可能会加速到社会无法跟上的地步，人类可能会失去对超人人工智能系统的控制，国家、公司和政府部门内部及之间的权力制衡可能会遭到严重侵蚀。尽管关于这些可能性仍有很大不确定性，但高风险值得我们给予认真的进一步关注。政策制定者应紧急获得对人工智能研发自动化的更多能见度，开发引导和约束智能爆发的方法，并为社会适应智能爆发的影响做好准备。
AI.summary: 本文评估了AI研发自动化可能引发“智能爆发”的初步证据，分析了其对社会带来的巨大收益与极端风险（如失去对超人AI的控制等），并呼吁政策制定者紧急采取措施以监测自动化进程、约束智能爆发并做好社会适应准备。
AI.keywords: 人工智能研发, 自动化, 智能爆发, 风险治理, 政策响应
AI.comments: 本文探讨了一个极具前瞻性和紧迫性的议题——AI研发自动化可能引发的智能爆发。文章不仅指出了这一趋势的技术现实和潜在的极端风险，还提出了具体的政策应对建议，对人工智能治理具有重要的参考价值。

title: GeoWind2Plan: Mission-Time 3D Urban Wind Prediction for Energy-Efficient UAV Planning
comments: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight). 31 pages. Code and dataset: https://github.com/DUAL-Xiao/GeoWind2Plan/
summary: In urban low-altitude flight, buildings reshape ambient wind into spatially varying 3D flow, making unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) energy depend on local wind exposure as well as path length. However, building-resolved wind information is rarely available when a mission must be planned. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) can produce high-fidelity urban flow fields, but each simulation is tied to a fixed inflow boundary condition and can take hours to days, which is incompatible with urban UAV missions that typically last minutes to tens of minutes. We present GeoWind2Plan, a geometry-to-wind-to-planning framework for mission-time 3D urban wind prediction and energy-efficient UAV planning. Given only a background wind vector, 3D building geometry, and a start-goal pair, GeoWind2Plan transforms the building geometry into a reference-wind frame, predicts mission-relevant 3D wind patches with a localized geometry-conditioned neural operator, stitches them into a queryable local wind field, and optimizes a feasible 3D path and speed profile using a physically grounded UAV energy model. Rather than pursuing CFD-perfect reconstruction, GeoWind2Plan targets decision-useful wind prediction: trajectories are planned with predicted wind and evaluated under high-fidelity CFD wind. Across held-out urban domains, wind speeds, and mission wind-angle regimes, GeoWind2Plan performs corridor-localized wind inference in about 3 seconds, compared with roughly 8 hours for CFD. Under CFD evaluation, trajectories planned with GeoWind2Plan reduce energy by 6.9%, 12.7%, and 4.5% in tailwind, headwind, and crosswind missions relative to wind-agnostic planning, recovering 87.9%, 85.7%, and 75.0% of CFD-reference savings. These results show that fast, corridor-localized 3D urban wind prediction can make wind-aware UAV energy planning practical at mission time.

AI.title_translation: GeoWind2Plan：任务时间3D城市风预测，实现无人机节能规划
AI.tldr: GeoWind2Plan是一个框架，可以在任务时间内快速（3秒）预测城市3D风场，并基于此为无人机规划节能路径，显著优于不考虑风的规划，并接近CFD参考的节能效果。
AI.motivation: 城市低空飞行中，建筑物使风场复杂多变，影响无人机能耗。然而，任务规划时通常缺乏精细的建筑级风信息。计算流体力学（CFD）可以提供高精度风场，但模拟耗时过长（数小时至数天），与无人机任务（数分钟至数十分钟）的时效性不符。
AI.method: GeoWind2Plan框架在给定背景风向量、3D建筑几何和起止点的情况下，将建筑几何转换为参考风坐标系，利用局部几何条件神经算子预测与任务相关的3D风场，将其拼接成可查询的局部风场，并使用基于物理的无人机能耗模型优化可行的3D路径和速度剖面。其目标是提供对决策有用的风预测，而非追求CFD级别的完美重建。
AI.result: GeoWind2Plan在约3秒内完成局部风场推断，而CFD需要约8小时。在CFD评估下，GeoWind2Plan规划的轨迹在顺风、逆风和侧风任务中分别比不考虑风的规划减少能耗6.9%、12.7%和4.5%，恢复了CFD参考节能的87.9%、85.7%和75.0%。
AI.conclusion: 快速、局部化的3D城市风预测能够使风感知无人机节能规划在任务时间内变为现实和实用。
AI.translation: 在城市低空飞行中，建筑物将环境风重塑为空间变化的3D气流，使得无人机（UAV）的能量消耗不仅取决于路径长度，还取决于局部风暴露。然而，当需要规划任务时，通常难以获得建筑级别的风信息。计算流体力学（CFD）可以生成高保真度的城市流场，但每次模拟都与固定的入流边界条件相关联，并且可能需要数小时到数天，这与通常持续数分钟到数十分钟的城市无人机任务不兼容。我们提出了GeoWind2Plan，一个从几何到风再到规划的框架，用于任务时间3D城市风预测和节能无人机规划。在仅给定背景风向量、3D建筑几何和起止点的情况下，GeoWind2Plan将建筑几何转换为参考风框架，利用局部几何条件神经算子预测与任务相关的3D风场，将其拼接成一个可查询的局部风场，并使用基于物理的无人机能量模型优化可行的3D路径和速度剖面。GeoWind2Plan并非追求CFD的完美重建，而是致力于提供对决策有用的风预测：轨迹在预测风下规划，并在高保真CFD风下进行评估。在保留的城市区域、风速和任务风角区域中，GeoWind2Plan在大约3秒内执行走廊局部风推断，而CFD大约需要8小时。在CFD评估下，与不考虑风的规划相比，使用GeoWind2Plan规划的轨迹在顺风、逆风和侧风任务中分别减少了6.9%、12.7%和4.5%的能量，恢复了CFD参考节能的87.9%、85.7%和75.0%。这些结果表明，快速、局部化的3D城市风预测可以使风感知无人机节能规划在任务时间内变得实用。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了GeoWind2Plan框架，旨在解决城市无人机任务中缺乏实时3D风场信息导致的能耗问题。该框架利用建筑几何和背景风，通过局部几何条件神经算子快速预测任务相关的3D城市风场（约3秒），并基于此优化无人机路径和速度，以实现节能飞行。实验结果表明，GeoWind2Plan规划的路径显著减少了能耗，并能有效接近CFD模拟下的最优节能效果，证明了其在任务时间内进行风感知无人机规划的实用性。
AI.keywords: 城市风预测, 无人机规划, 神经算子, 节能, 任务时间
AI.comments: GeoWind2Plan的创新性在于将深度学习（几何条件神经算子）与物理模型相结合，实现了城市3D风场的快速预测，克服了传统CFD方法耗时长的缺点，使其能够应用于对时效性要求高的无人机任务规划。其重要性在于为无人机在复杂城市环境下的节能飞行提供了实用的解决方案，对提升无人机续航能力和任务效率具有重要意义。该方法平衡了预测速度与决策有用性，而非追求极致的精度，是工程应用中非常务实的策略。

title: Mirror-Score: Calibrated, Inference-only Scoring Exposes the Limits of Sequence-compatibility Ranking in D-peptide Design
summary: D-peptides combine protease resistance with high target specificity, but computational design of D-peptide binders remains immature. Mirror-Peptidizer introduced an in silico mirror-image screening pipeline using target reflection, backbone generation, and ProteinMPNN sequence design, but its raw ProteinMPNN negative log-likelihood (NLL) ranking was not validated against measured affinities, and only 4 of 9 tested MDM2 designs bound detectably. We introduce Mirror-Score, a calibrated, inference-only scoring framework for heterochiral D-peptide/L-protein complexes, and a public benchmark of 31 crystal complexes across four target families, including 18 with literature-verified affinities. Raw ProteinMPNN NLL is not a valid affinity ranker: its pooled Spearman correlation with affinity is 0.19, and correlations reverse between MDM2/CHIP (+0.62) and gp41 (-0.70). We therefore evaluate Boltz-2 mirror-space cofolding confidence. For the complete viral-entry family (7 structures representing 3 peptides), interface predicted local distance difference test (pLDDT) achieves structure-level leave-one-out Spearman rho = 0.90 (p = 0.006) and correctly orders all three peptides by affinity, whereas NLL fails (structure-level rho = 0.18). Because only three independent chemotypes are represented, this result indicates directional consistency rather than a statistically validated predictor. Cross-family calibration does not transfer at current sample sizes, supporting family-matched calibration as the practical deployment mode. We also specify a prospective design protocol for the antimicrobial-resistance targets LasR and LecB from Pseudomonas aeruginosa, including mirrored structures, ligand-derived hotspot maps, diffusion-model-ready inputs, and Mirror-Score ranking. Code, benchmark data, structures, and analysis scripts are openly available at https://github.com/Jiadalee/Mirror-Score.

title: ABC: Advantage-Based Control Variates for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Recent progress in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has highlighted the effectiveness of simple critic-free policy-gradient methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). In contrast, actor-critic methods rely on learned value functions whose approximation error can introduce bias through commonly used advantage estimators such as temporal-difference error. Motivated by this observation, we revisit trajectory-level control variates through an advantage-value formulation, which we call Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC). This formulation reveals that the covariance structure is closely related to the return decomposition used in Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE). Finally, we combine ABC with DAE into a single actor-critic algorithm and evaluate it in an offline-to-online RLVR setting, where the critic is first trained on previously collected trajectories and adapted during online learning. On mathematical reasoning tasks, ABC achieves performance competitive with GRPO using substantially fewer online optimization steps.

title: Mnemon: Raw Records, Fast Judgments, Slow Thoughts
comments: 16 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code, prompts and run records: https://github.com/Grivn/mnemon-memory-agent
summary:
Long-term memory lets an LLM assistant use a history it can no longer reread, and most memory systems build it by rewriting conversations into facts, graphs or typed memories at write time. We argue that the work of memory divides, as thinking does, into two systems. Most of it is fast System 1 work: many small, independent yes/no judgments about records, such as whether a record is needed or no longer current, which a decision model makes by the dozen in a third of a second. Only a little is slow System 2 work: writing a few search queries, naming what the reply needs and composing the answer, which an LLM does well but slowly. We present Mnemon, a memory agent built on this division. It keeps conversations as raw, dated records; an LLM (System 2) plans searches over them, a decision model, Jev (System 1), judges what the searches return, and rules with explicit budgets turn the judgments into a small View for an unchanged answering model. A background pass consolidates each record once into topic timelines, value histories and standing instructions linked to the records, so that questions about a whole conversation reach evidence their own searches miss. Because nothing is decided about a record when it is written, the same agent can read any store that returns dated records.
  With gpt-4.1-mini answering, as in a public re-evaluation of 14 systems, Mnemon scores 91.7% on LoCoMo, the highest among them, and 83.8% on LongMemEval-S, from under 4k tokens of context per question, with the lowest effective cost index on LoCoMo. With a reasoning model answering, it reaches 92.2% on LoCoMo and 94.4% on LongMemEval-S, the latter on par with the best published results. From 100K to 10M tokens of history on BEAM, its cost per question grows by a factor of 1.11. On the same records, Jev separates gold evidence better than two LLMs and is 3-11 times faster.

title: Introducing the CZAR Loss: A Tailored Objective Function for Financial Log-Return Predictions
comments: 22 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables; appeared in ADI (September 2026)
summary: In quantitative finance, standard regression losses are misaligned with the economics of return prediction. As the conditional mean of financial log-returns is close to zero, symmetric losses such as the mean squared and mean absolute errors make the constant zero forecast a near-optimal solution, penalizing models with genuine but noisy directional skill. This applies both during training, where predictions shrink toward zero, and during evaluation, where trivial forecasters can lead loss-based rankings. Under a Gaussian linear prediction model, we show that all symmetric monotonic losses share a universal breakeven directional accuracy against the zero predictor, which rises sharply and becomes unobtainable as the prediction noise approaches the standard deviation of the returns. We introduce the CZAR (Composite Zero-Agnostic Return) loss function, a piecewise quadratic loss built around five key requirements: convexity in the prediction, asymmetry with true return direction that vanishes at zero, near-linear penalization of undershoots and wrong-direction predictions, divergence for large errors, and an adaptive loss floor for evaluation. CZAR is provably convex in the prediction at fixed true value, has closed-form gradient and Hessian suitable for custom objectives in gradient-boosted libraries, and its four hyperparameters reduce to a single choice through correlated defaults. In idealized tests, the minimum directional accuracy required for a CZAR-evaluated forecaster to outperform the zero predictor under mean log loss remains near the 50% chance level, whereas the corresponding threshold for symmetric losses rises sharply with prediction noise. This advantage persists under heavy-tailed return distributions. In a LightGBM experiment on intraday BTC log-returns, CZAR-trained models reduce the `zero-returns bias' and improve directional accuracy on large-magnitude returns.

title: SMat-Attention: Structured Long-Context Sequence Modeling
summary: Long-context sequence models face a fundamental tradeoff: softmax attention uses flexible token-level interactions at quadratic cost, whereas linear attention obtains linear-time training and constant-time decoding by compressing history into a fixed-size state. In this work, we ask whether we can connect these regimes through a tunable notion of structure. To this end, we introduce Structured Matrix Attention (SMat-Attention) via a family of causal masks with structured long-range routing whose row supports have VC-dimension $d$. In our construction, $d=1$ recovers the standard causal mask, and increasing $d$ permits richer subset-routing patterns. We give chunkwise forward and backward algorithms to enable hardware-efficiency. For sequences of length $T$, the hard-routing construction takes $O(T^{2-3/d}+T)$ work, despite the mask being dense, for our prescribed family. In fixed-horizon streaming, decoding after the distant prefix takes constant time per token using $O(T^{1-1/d})$ cached states. SMat-Attention therefore makes VC-dimension an explicit knob governing access-pattern complexity, prefill cost, and decoding memory. Empirically, subset-routing and rule-assisted multi-key retrieval experiments illustrate the masks' routing expressiveness. Extensions to Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet using learned routing with top-$k$ query reads retain subquadratic prefill, improve recall accuracy over the backbones in several settings, and achieve comparable small-scale language-modeling performance.

title: Understanding Decision-Making Mechanisms in Neural Routing Solvers
summary: Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) has achieved strong empirical success, yet the internal mechanisms driving model decisions remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate three representative autoregressive NCO models spanning two encoder-decoder configurations: AM and POMO (heavy-encoder, light-decoder), and LEHD (light-encoder, heavy-decoder). Through behavioral analyses, representation probing, and causal interventions, we examine how these models construct solutions and use internal representations during decoding. Our results suggest that AM and POMO predominantly follow a persistent geometric pattern throughout solution construction, whereas LEHD contains linearly accessible information about multiple future actions. Causal experiments further provide evidence for the role of future-node representations in LEHD's decision-making. We also observe that LEHD relies strongly on the current-node representation for immediate local decisions, while the start-node representation plays a broader navigational role over the subsequent route. Cross-instance alignment analyses additionally indicate that LEHD maps current-node representations into a relatively shared latent region, which may provide a stable reference for evaluating subsequent decisions. Across the Traveling Salesman Problem and the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem, these results reveal distinct decision-making patterns across these architecturally distinct solvers and provide a foundation for more interpretable analyses of NCO solvers. Code and additional visualizations are provided in the https://github.com/NCO-Interpretability/NCO-Interpretability.

title: FLOORA: A Human-Aligned Domain-Specific Language Model for Architectural Design
summary: Foundation models are powerful generators, but many engineering domains require structured representations that general-purpose systems handle poorly. We introduce FLOORA (Floor Layout Optimization with RL Alignment), a family of small domain-specific language (DSL) models for architectural layout generation. With specialized data and alignment, our 0.6B model outperforms much larger frontier models, achieving VLM judge win rates up to 92.0% on out-of-distribution real-world buildings and 96.0% on synthetic buildings. Human evaluations further corroborate these results, with FLOORA selected as the best model in 89.3% of evaluations. FLOORA combines a token-efficient DSL, custom tokenization, domain-specific pretraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL) with learned human-preference and verifiable rewards. This pipeline improves architectural and geometric validity, supported by extensive empirical evaluation and ablation studies. Although focused on architecture, our results suggest that similar domain-specific recipes may be useful in other engineering domains with structured, verifiable outputs. Datasets, models, and inference code are available at https://github.com/AutodeskAILab/floora.

title: Irene: Equivalence Checking of Hybrid Quantum Programs via Structure-Preserving Symbolic Reduction
summary: Equivalence checking is essential for validating compiler transformations of hybrid quantum programs, which combine quantum operations, measurements, and classical control. Measurement-dependent control limits unitary reasoning, while dependencies between classical outcomes and quantum operations can enlarge intermediate symbolic states. We present Irene, an equivalence-checking framework for bounded hybrid quantum programs based on structure-preserving symbolic reduction. The framework progressively simplifies equivalence obligations through three levels of reasoning. At the gate level, algebraic identities simplify unitary regions. At the hybrid path-sum (HPS) level, reduced symbolic execution states are represented as typed graphs, whose isomorphism certifies equivalence. Remaining obligations are handled by density kernels that characterize transformations of input density operators into observable outputs, allowing comparison even when internal measurement histories differ. Residual coefficient differences are encoded as SMT queries. A common set of symbolic reductions supports HPS and density-kernel reasoning by preserving factored Boolean and arithmetic expressions, eliminating reducible dependencies before expanding residual sums. We evaluate Irene against five equivalence checkers on 1,982 program pairs from seven benchmark suites. Irene solves 1,584 pairs (79.92%), compared with 57.52% for MQT QCEC, the baseline with the highest aggregate coverage, with a mean end-to-end time of 3.93 seconds per solved pair. Applied as an equivalence-checking oracle, Irene also identifies 15 previously unknown bugs in quantum compilers, including Qiskit, Cirq, and PennyLane.

title: AerialDojo-200K: A Large-Scale Benchmark Suite for Open-World Aerial Object-Goal Search
summary: Open-world aerial object-goal search is a foundational yet challenging task, requiring aerial agents to autonomously explore large-scale, unstructured three-dimensional environments and reach target objects specified by semantic descriptions or reference images, rather than following route-specific instructions. However, research in this task remains at a nascent stage and relies on small, environment-specific benchmarks with heterogeneous action spaces and data formats. These limitations hinder large-scale training and cross-benchmark evaluation, constraining the scalability and generalizability of aerial agents. To address this problem, we propose AerialDojo-200K, a large-scale benchmark suite for open-world aerial object-goal search, with 3 times as many scenes and 18.7 times as many task instances as the largest existing benchmark for this task. Specifically, we construct 42 simulation scenes spanning four scene families and 21 scene types, including 18 urban, 12 natural, six infrastructure, and six disaster scenes. To ensure data quality, 12 annotators spent two months manually annotating 109 landmarks, 2099 target objects, and 2099 object anchors across these scenes. We further construct 205,732 task instances, comprising over 100K semantic-goal and over 100K image-goal instances across Base, Standard, and Long-Horizon settings. Each task instance includes a collision-free reference trajectory and corresponding multi-view video recordings. We also develop a unified evaluation framework with a scene partition comprising 21 in-distribution scenes and 21 out-of-distribution scenes. Finally, our evaluation of five open-source and four closed-source multimodal large language models reveals that there is still a long way to go toward achieving general-purpose aerial agents. All can be found at https://fengtt42.github.io/AerialDojo/.

title: A Hyperbolic Bound for File Retrieval in DNA-Based Data Storage
summary: In DNA-based storage systems, data are retrieved by sequencing molecules sampled from a DNA pool. We study how the way coding redundancy is shared between files affects their expected retrieval times. Our focus lies on the case of two files that are encoded by a systematic linear code over an arbitrary finite field. We consider the conjecture that the sum obtained by dividing each file dimension by its expected retrieval time is at most one whenever the dimension of at least one file is more than one. For this, we develop a geometric view of the retrieval process. As molecules are sampled, we follow the growing span of the corresponding columns of the generator matrix and track how much of this span comes from each file. Among the samples that enlarge the overall span, this lets us compare those that make progress toward recovering both files with those that make progress toward neither. We call a column mixed if the corresponding encoded symbol combines information from both files. In this work, we sharpen a projection bound and use it to control the effect of mixed columns. We prove the conjecture whenever the total information dimension is at least twice the number of mixed columns plus two. For equal-sized files, this allows up to one fewer mixed column than the dimension of either file and extends the previous result for codes with no mixed columns.

title: The Uneven Decline of Collective Knowledge Production: Evidence from Stack Overflow After Generative AI
summary: Generative AI (Gen AI) is reshaping how individuals learn and work, but its consequences for collective knowledge, the shared body of knowledge that online communities produce together, remain poorly understood. Prior work has documented an aggregate decline in participation on knowledge-sharing platforms, but it remains unclear which specific kinds of knowledge are being lost first. We study this question using Stack Overflow, one of the largest online communities for software engineering, treating the release of ChatGPT-3.5 as a natural shock. Analyzing over two million questions posted between 2020 and 2025, we track how two dimensions of collective knowledge, difficulty and data availability, change following Gen AI's release. Using diverse methods and robust checks, we find consistent patterns. Easy questions decline sharply while difficult questions become more common, a pattern corroborated by rising code complexity. Data-rich topics and tags lose share of questions, while data-scarce ones gain ground. The two dimensions also interact: the decline in easy questions is concentrated specifically within data-rich domains, while difficult questions increase regardless of data availability. This pattern extends beyond Python across programming languages, with more prevalent languages showing sharper shifts. Together, our findings reveal that Gen AI's impact on collective knowledge is uneven, eroding easy, accessible knowledge first while more complex, less common knowledge persists.

title: Mixture-of-Kittens: MoE Megakernel for NVL72s
summary: AI accelerator systems are rapidly consolidating into scale-up architectures, where tens to thousands of GPUs communicate over high-bandwidth, single-hop fabrics. We find that existing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training systems, optimized for conventional scale-out networks, transfer poorly to this setting, often running slower than a naive baseline built with PyTorch and NCCL. With industry roadmaps pointing toward even larger scale-up domains, understanding the performance tradeoffs of this hardware regime is increasingly important. We present Mixture-of-Kittens (MoK), an MoE training system designed for Nvidia NVL72. MoK builds on three insights that unlock performance on scale-up domains: (1) choosing push- or pull-based communication per operator, (2) restructuring the computation-communication overlap, and (3) fully eliminating CPU-GPU synchronization. MoK distills these insights into a single deterministic training megakernel that fuses token dispatch, shared and routed expert FFNs, and token combine. Across MoE layer shapes from four widely used open-weight models, MoK delivers up to $2.37\times$ the throughput of the strongest publicly available baseline. In a production run on 512 GPUs spanning multiple GB300 NVL72 racks, MoK improves end-to-end training throughput by $1.41\times$.

title: LongCat-DeepResearch Technical Report
summary: We present LongCat-DeepResearch, a deep research system that combines an enhanced LongCat model with a multi-agent workflow for producing comprehensive, evidence-grounded reports. The workflow separates global planning from detailed investigation and coordinates revision at the section level. Multiple planning agents first explore external sources and refine an actionable research plan, termed ResearchSpec. Research agents then investigate and draft their assigned sections in parallel, gathering additional evidence in separate contexts as their analyses develop. Once the sections are assembled, global review guides targeted local revisions, reducing reliance on repeated full-report rewriting. This workflow also supports the construction of research tasks and trajectories for the mid-training and post-training of LongCat's general-purpose models. LongCat-DeepResearch achieves 55.25 on DeepResearchBench, 51.35 on DeepResearchBench II, and 79.83 on ResearchRubrics. On an in-house benchmark, it scores 76.04, ranking second among four compared systems. Development-set analyses show benefits from combining planning perspectives, while further planning refinement has mixed effects. Additional editing improves average automatic readability preference across two benchmarks, with different trends on each.

AI.translation: 我们提出了 LongCat-DeepResearch，一个深度研究系统，它结合了增强型 LongCat 模型和多智能体工作流，用于生成全面、有证据支持的报告。该工作流将全局规划与详细调查分开，并在章节层面协调修订。多个规划智能体首先探索外部来源并完善一个可操作的研究计划，称为 ResearchSpec。研究智能体随后并行调查并起草其分配的章节，在分析发展过程中在单独的上下文中收集额外证据。一旦章节组装完成，全局审查将指导有针对性的局部修订，减少对重复完整报告重写的依赖。此工作流还支持为 LongCat 通用模型的训练和后训练构建研究任务和轨迹。LongCat-DeepResearch 在 DeepResearchBench 上取得了 55.25 分，在 DeepResearchBench II 上取得了 51.35 分，在 ResearchRubrics 上取得了 79.83 分。在一个内部基准测试中，它获得了 76.04 分，在四个比较系统中排名第二。开发集分析显示，结合规划视角带来了益处，而进一步的规划细化则效果不一。额外的编辑改善了两个基准测试中平均自动可读性偏好，但趋势不同。
AI.summary: LongCat-DeepResearch 是一个集成了增强型 LongCat 模型和多智能体工作流的深度研究系统，旨在生成全面且有证据支持的报告。其工作流通过全局规划、详细调查和章节级修订来组织，规划智能体负责制定研究计划，研究智能体并行撰写章节并收集证据，最后通过全局审查进行局部修订。该系统在多个基准测试中表现优异，例如 DeepResearchBench、DeepResearchBench II 和 ResearchRubrics，并在内部基准测试中排名第二。分析表明，结合不同的规划视角和额外的编辑步骤有助于提高报告质量和可读性。
AI.keywords: 深度研究系统, 多智能体工作流, LongCat 模型, 报告生成, 自动化研究
AI.comments: 该论文提出的 LongCat-DeepResearch 系统通过其独特的多智能体工作流，有效地解决了生成高质量、有证据支持的报告的挑战。其将全局规划与局部执行和修订相结合的策略，显著减少了传统报告撰写中常见的重复性工作。这种模块化和协作式的智能体方法是其创新之处，对于自动化深度研究和报告生成领域具有重要意义。在不同基准测试中的优异表现也证明了其有效性。

title: Spectral Methods for the Complexity of Planar Graph Homomorphisms
summary: We explore the frontier beyond the recently discovered barrier represented by the \emph{quantum automorphism group} $qut(M)$ in the classification theory of planar graph homomorphisms $PlGH(M)$. We show that analyzing the spectral relations of $M$ can prove \#P-hardness when traditional vertex separation and domain-reduction methods with planar edge gadgets provably fail due to the $\qut(M)$ barrier. We prove two criteria of \#P-hardness for $PlGH(M)$: a spectral criterion and a determinant criterion. It is known that the core problem for the classification of $PlGH(M)$ for nonnegative matrices $M$ is for positive definite entry-wise positive matrices. We use the spectral criterion to show that $PlGH(M)$ is \#P-hard for all circulant matrices of prime order $q \ge 3$, while for $q=2$ it is precisely the matchgate case and is P-time computable by the FKT algorithm (for planar perfect matching). We also prove a complexity dichotomy for $\PlGH$ problems defined by tensor products of 2 by 2 matrices. This gives a complete complexity classification for this class of matrices, and the FKT algorithm together with a holographic transformation is \emph{universal}---every $PlGH(M)$ is either (1) P-time computable over all graphs, or (2) \#P-hard in general but P-time computable over planar graphs, or (3) \#P-hard over planar graphs; furthermore, $PlGH(M)$ in (2) consists of precisely those computable by FKT with a holographic transformation.

AI.title_translation: 平面图同态复杂度的谱方法
AI.tldr: 本文超越了量子自同构群在平面图同态分类中的障碍，通过谱分析证明了在传统方法失效时，某些平面图同态问题是#P-hard的，并提出了谱准则和行列式准则。研究了循环矩阵和2x2矩阵张量积定义的同态，并给出了一个普遍的复杂性分类。
AI.motivation: 探索超越量子自同构群 $qut(M)$ 障碍的平面图同态 $PlGH(M)$ 分类理论，尤其是在传统顶点分离和域规约方法因该障碍而失效的情况下，寻找新的方法来证明复杂性。
AI.method: 通过分析矩阵 $M$ 的谱关系来证明 #P-hard 复杂度。提出了两个 #P-hard 准则：一个谱准则和一个行列式准则。利用谱准则分析了素数阶循环矩阵和 2x2 矩阵张量积定义的 $PlGH$ 问题的复杂性。
AI.result:
1. 证明了当传统方法因 $qut(M)$ 障碍失效时，谱关系分析可以证明 #P-hard 复杂度。2. 提出了两个 #P-hard 准则：谱准则和行列式准则。3. 对于素数阶 $q 
eq 2$ 的循环矩阵 $M$，证明了 $PlGH(M)$ 是 #P-hard 的；对于 $q=2$，它是 FKT 算法可计算的 P-时间问题。4. 证明了由 2x2 矩阵张量积定义的 $PlGH$ 问题的复杂性二分法。5. 提出了一个普遍的复杂性分类，即每个 $PlGH(M)$ 要么是 (1) 在所有图上都是 P-时间可计算的，要么是 (2) 通常是 #P-hard 但在平面图上是 P-时间可计算的，要么是 (3) 在平面图上是 #P-hard 的。其中 (2) 恰好是可以通过 FKT 算法结合全息变换计算的问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过谱方法成功突破了量子自同构群的障碍，为平面图同态的复杂性分类提供了新的理论和工具。特别是，FKT 算法结合全息变换被证明是普遍的，能够解决特定类别的平面图同态问题，并给出了一个完整的复杂性分类。
AI.translation:
我们探索了平面图同态 $PlGH(M)$ 分类理论中，最近发现的由量子自同构群 $qut(M)$ 所代表的障碍之外的前沿。我们表明，当传统的顶点分离和带平面边小工具的域规约方法因 $qut(M)$ 障碍而失效时，分析 $M$ 的谱关系可以证明 #P-hard 复杂度。我们为 $PlGH(M)$ 证明了两个 #P-hard 准则：一个谱准则和一个行列式准则。已知非负矩阵 $M$ 的 $PlGH(M)$ 分类核心问题是针对正定且分量为正的矩阵。我们使用谱准则表明，对于所有素数阶 $q 
eq 2$ 的循环矩阵，$PlGH(M)$ 是 #P-hard 的，而对于 $q=2$，它恰好是 matchgate 情况，可以通过 FKT 算法在 P-时间内计算（用于平面完美匹配）。我们还证明了由 2x2 矩阵张量积定义的 $PlGH$ 问题的复杂性二分法。这为这类矩阵提供了一个完整的复杂性分类，并且 FKT 算法与全息变换是普遍的——每个 $PlGH(M)$ 要么是 (1) 在所有图上都是 P-时间可计算的，要么是 (2) 通常是 #P-hard 但在平面图上是 P-时间可计算的，要么是 (3) 在平面图上是 #P-hard 的；此外，(2) 中的 $PlGH(M)$ 恰好是由 FKT 结合全息变换可计算的那些。
AI.summary: 本文研究了超越量子自同构群障碍的平面图同态分类问题。作者通过谱方法，提出了两个 #P-hard 准则（谱准则和行列式准则），成功证明了在传统方法失效时，某些平面图同态的复杂性。具体地，利用谱准则分析了素数阶循环矩阵和2x2矩阵张量积定义的同态问题，并给出了一个普适的复杂性分类，指出FKT算法结合全息变换在特定情况下具有普遍性。
AI.keywords: 平面图同态, 谱方法, 复杂度, #P-hard, 量子自同构群
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于通过引入谱方法，成功突破了量子自同构群在平面图同态分类中的已知障碍。这为理解这类问题的内在复杂性提供了全新的视角和强大的分析工具。提出的谱准则和行列式准则具有重要的理论价值，而对循环矩阵和张量积矩阵的分析则给出了具体的复杂性分类结果，对于未来的相关研究具有指导意义。

title: Argus: Academic Integrity in the Era of Generative AI
summary: The rapid proliferation of large language models (LLMs) in the context of education has introduced significant challenges in enforcement of academic integrity, especially in programming courses. We present Argus, an automated detection system for LLM-assisted student work in undergraduate C programming assignments. Argus integrates behavioral and stylistic indicators to create a holistic picture of the student's progress through an assignment and surfaces anomalies that point to potential misuse of LLM assistance. We quantify and analyze data over six years of Spring semester offerings in a large-enrollment CS2 course at Purdue University using Argus, finding that 45% of enrolled students exhibited patterns consistent with LLM-assisted code development in Spring 2026. To contextualize these results, we analyze the relationship between flagged LLM use and student performance on written, in-person proctored examinations, and find a significant negative correlation. We also explore the problem of mitigating false positives, recognizing that erroneous accusations of academic integrity carry significant consequences for students and instructors alike, particularly in the context of large enrollment courses. We argue that any automated detection system must be accompanied by a structured process for human review. We discuss the consequences for future course design, changing academic policy as these tools become more ubiquitous, and the pedagogical implications of LLM-based tools in computer science education.

AI.title_translation: Argus：生成式AI时代的学术诚信
AI.tldr: Argus是一个自动化系统，用于检测大学生C语言编程作业中使用LLM的情况，发现2026年春季有45%的学生有LLM辅助代码开发的模式，且LLM使用与考试成绩呈负相关，强调人工审查的重要性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在教育领域的迅速普及给学术诚信带来了巨大挑战，尤其是在编程课程中，需要一个系统来检测学生对LLM的潜在滥用。
AI.method: 提出Argus系统，一个自动化检测系统，用于识别大学生C语言编程作业中LLM辅助的学生作品。Argus整合行为和风格指标，全面描绘学生完成作业的过程，并发现可能滥用LLM辅助的异常。
AI.result: 对普渡大学大规模CS2课程六年春季学期的数据进行量化和分析，发现2026年春季有45%的在校学生表现出与LLM辅助代码开发一致的模式。被标记的LLM使用与学生的笔试（现场监考）成绩之间存在显著的负相关。
AI.conclusion: LLM在教育中的普及对学术诚信构成挑战，Argus系统能有效检测LLM辅助的代码开发。检测结果显示LLM使用与学生表现负相关。强调自动化检测系统必须辅以结构化的人工审查过程，并讨论了对未来课程设计、学术政策和计算机科学教育中LLM工具的教学影响。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在教育领域的迅速普及，给学术诚信的执行带来了重大挑战，尤其是在编程课程中。我们提出了Argus，一个用于检测本科C语言编程作业中LLM辅助学生作品的自动化检测系统。Argus整合了行为和风格指标，以全面描绘学生完成作业的过程，并揭示指向潜在滥用LLM辅助的异常。我们使用Argus量化并分析了普渡大学一门大规模CS2课程六年春季学期的数据，发现在2026年春季，45%的在校学生表现出与LLM辅助代码开发一致的模式。为了将这些结果背景化，我们分析了被标记的LLM使用与学生在书面、现场监考考试中的表现之间的关系，发现存在显著的负相关。我们还探讨了减轻误报的问题，认识到错误的学术诚信指控对学生和教师都会带来严重后果，特别是在大规模课程中。我们认为任何自动化检测系统必须辅以结构化的人工审查过程。我们讨论了未来课程设计、随着这些工具变得更加普及而改变的学术政策，以及LLM工具在计算机科学教育中的教学意义。
