AI.title_translation: cktFormer：基于Transformer的自动化模拟电路设计方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于双Transformer架构的自动化模拟电路设计方法cktFormer，通过节点和边预测模型有效学习电路拓扑，提升了生成电路的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统的模拟电路设计是一个复杂、耗时且容易出错的迭代过程，阻碍了整体生产力；利用生成式AI和机器学习自动化这一阶段具有巨大潜力，但现有方法存在局限性。
AI.method: 引入了一种双Transformer架构，将网表数据结构化为基于图的表示，并由两个互联的模型组成：用于提议组件的节点预测模型和用于推断有效连接的边预测模型。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该架构在生成电路的有效性方面优于AnalogGenie和cktGNN等近期模型。
AI.conclusion: cktFormer通过双Transformer架构有效解决了模拟电路设计自动化中的瓶颈，在生成电路的有效性方面表现优异，为AI驱动的电路综合提供了新的基准。
AI.translation: 电路设计是一个复杂且需要专业电子工程知识的迭代过程，涉及在满足功耗、成本和信号完整性等性能约束的同时选择组件。然而，手动设计既耗时又容易出错。尽管制造流程的其他阶段受益于AI驱动的优化，但电路设计仍然是一个瓶颈，限制了整体生产力。生成式AI和机器学习为自动化和改进这一阶段提供了潜力，从而提高了效率和准确性。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了一种双Transformer架构，利用注意力机制来建模复杂的非序列电路关系，从而弥合了AI与电路设计之间的差距。我们的方法将网表数据结构化为基于图的表示，从而能够有效学习电路拓扑和组件交互。该系统由两个互联的模型组成：提出组件的节点预测模型和推断有效连接的边预测模型。这种协同且解耦的设计捕捉了组件级语义和全局结构的一致性。在我们的实验中，该架构在生成电路的有效性方面优于AnalogGenie和cktGNN等近期模型。通过解决现有方法的关键局限性，我们的工作推进了电子工程的自动化，并为AI驱动的电路综合贡献了一个基准。
AI.summary: 本文提出了cktFormer，一种基于双Transformer的自动化模拟电路设计方法。该方法将网表转化为图表示，通过节点预测和边预测两个解耦的模型分别学习组件语义和全局结构，显著提高了生成电路的有效性。
AI.keywords: 模拟电路设计, 变压器架构, 图表示, 节点预测, 边预测
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的双模型架构用于模拟电路设计，创新性地将网表数据结构化为图表示，并解耦为节点预测和边预测，在生成电路的有效性上超越了现有模型如AnalogGenie和cktGNN。

title: Degeneracy-Orthogonal Geometric Constraints for LiDAR SLAM
summary: Autonomous robot navigation relies on simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) to estimate motion and maintain an accurate pose within an environment. However, in axially uniform corridors such as long tunnels and pipelines, LiDAR odometry is fundamentally limited by unconstrained drift along the feature-weak travel direction. This structural degeneracy cannot be resolved by local scan matching alone. To address this challenge, we propose the Degeneracy-orthogonal Contour Offset Descriptor (DeCOD), a structure-aligned geometric descriptor for cross-sectional landmarks. Cross-sectional boundaries, such as pipe joints and structural rings, provide metric constraints along this degenerate axis, but distinguishing individual landmarks requires capturing subtle surface variations across nearly identical profiles. The descriptor parameterizes signed normal deviation from estimated boundary contours, and matching explicitly resolves heading ambiguity and decouples first-order contour errors by distortion estimation. Matched landmarks yield geometric factors that enforce agreement in cross-section position and corridor axis alignment during pose-graph optimization, correcting longitudinal drift while leaving rotation about the common axis unconstrained. On a public benchmark and in field experiments, DeCOD achieves robust landmark retrieval over standard 3D descriptors and successfully stabilizes trajectories across different odometry frontends, reliably constraining longitudinal drift under geometric degeneracy.

AI.title_translation: 用于激光雷达SLAM的退化正交几何约束
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为DeCOD的几何描述符，通过利用轴对称走廊中的横截面地标，有效解决了激光雷达SLAM在退化环境中的纵向漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 在轴对称走廊（如长隧道和管道）中，激光雷达里程计由于沿弱特征旅行方向缺乏约束而存在根本性的漂移限制，且这种结构退化无法仅通过局部扫描匹配解决。
AI.method: 提出了一种结构对齐的几何描述符（DeCOD），通过参数化估计边界轮廓的符号法向偏差，利用匹配解决航向模糊并通过畸变估计解耦一阶轮廓误差，在位姿图优化中引入几何因子施加截面位置和走廊轴线对齐约束。
AI.result: 在公共基准测试和实地实验中，DeCOD实现了比标准3D描述符更鲁棒的地标检索，成功稳定了不同里程计前端的轨迹，并在几何退化下可靠地约束了纵向漂移。
AI.conclusion: DeCOD描述符能够有效解决激光雷达SLAM在几何退化走廊中的纵向漂移问题，在基准测试和实地实验中表现出鲁棒的性能。
AI.translation: 自主机器人导航依赖于同时定位与建图（SLAM）来估计运动并在环境中保持准确的位姿。然而，在诸如长隧道和管道等轴对称走廊中，激光雷达里程计从根本上受到沿弱特征行驶方向上无约束漂移的限制。这种结构退化仅靠局部扫描匹配是无法解决的。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了退化正交轮廓偏移描述符（DeCOD），这是一种针对横截面地标的结构对齐几何描述符。横截面边界（如管道接头和结构环）沿该退化轴提供了度量约束，但区分个别地标需要捕获几乎相同轮廓上的细微表面变化。该描述符参数化了来自估计边界轮廓的符号法向偏差，并且匹配通过畸变估计明确地解决了航向模糊并解耦了一阶轮廓误差。匹配的地标产生了几何因子，在位姿图优化期间强制横截面位置和走廊轴对齐的一致性，校正纵向漂移，同时使绕公共轴的旋转保持无约束。在公开基准测试和实地实验中，DeCOD实现了优于标准3D描述符的鲁棒地标检索，并成功稳定了不同里程计前端的轨迹，在几何退化下可靠地约束了纵向漂移。
AI.summary: 本文针对激光雷达SLAM在轴对称环境中面临的几何退化和纵向漂移挑战，提出了一种名为DeCOD的结构对齐几何描述符。通过利用横截面地标提供度量约束，并在位姿图优化中加入正交几何因子，有效抑制了沿弱特征方向的漂移，提升了机器人导航的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 激光雷达SLAM, 几何退化, 结构对齐, 位姿图优化, 机器人导航
AI.comments: 该论文针对激光雷达SLAM在轴对称退化环境（如隧道、管道）中沿弱特征方向漂移的痛点，提出了DeCOD几何描述符。通过提取截面轮廓的符号法向偏差来提供度量约束，并在位姿图中进行优化，创新性强且实用价值高。

title: Drag as Evidence: Motion-Grounded Latent Recomposition for Drag-Based Editing
summary: Modern image editors excel at semantic manipulation and visual synthesis, yet remain limited in precise spatial control, motivating the development of drag-based editing. However, existing drag-based methods often struggle to balance drag accuracy with natural, plausible, and intent-aligned generation. We propose MoRe-Drag, a motion-grounded drag-based editing method. Our key insight is to treat pixel-space warping as coarse motion evidence, and to inject this evidence into the generative sampling trajectory. Specifically, MoRe-Drag performs region-aware latent recomposition over refinement, inpainting, and anchor regions, coupled with stage-adaptive conditioning that progressively shifts from motion-grounded structure formation to semantic refinement. We further support an instruction-free interface by adapting the MLLM-based text encoder for drag-aware instruction inference. Experiments on DragBench-SR and DragBench-DR show that MoRe-Drag substantially improves drag precision over strong base editors and achieves superior drag accuracy among SOTA drag-based methods, while delivering strong semantic consistency and visually realistic results. Code and dataset will be publicly released.

AI.title_translation: 作为证据的拖拽：用于拖拽编辑的运动接地潜在重构
AI.tldr: MoRe-Drag将像素级变形作为运动证据注入生成轨迹中，实现了兼具高精度与视觉真实感的拖拽式图像编辑。
AI.motivation: 现代图像编辑器虽然擅长语义操作和视觉合成，但在精确的空间控制上仍受限制；而现有的基于拖拽的编辑方法往往难以在拖拽精度与自然、合理、符合意图的生成之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出了MoRe-Drag方法，将像素空间变形作为粗略运动证据注入生成采样轨迹中；执行区域感知的潜在重构（涵盖精炼、修补和锚点区域）；采用阶段自适应条件控制，逐步从运动基础的结构形成过渡到语义精炼；并适配基于MLLM的文本编码器支持免指令推理。
AI.result: 在DragBench-SR和DragBench-DR上的实验表明，MoRe-Drag显著提高了基础编辑器的拖拽精度，在同类SOTA方法中实现了卓越的拖拽准确度，同时保持了强烈的语义一致性和视觉真实感。
AI.conclusion: MoRe-Drag通过运动基础的潜在重构和阶段自适应条件控制，显著提升了拖拽编辑的精度与生成质量，且支持免指令接口，在DragBench上取得了SOTA的性能。
AI.translation: 现代图像编辑器在语义操作和视觉合成方面表现出色，但在精确的空间控制方面仍然有限，这推动了基于拖拽的编辑的发展。然而，现有的基于拖拽的方法往往难以在拖拽精度与自然、合理和符合意图的生成之间取得平衡。我们提出了 MoRe-Drag，一种基于运动基础的拖拽编辑方法。我们的核心见解是将像素空间变形视为粗略的运动证据，并将该证据注入生成采样轨迹中。具体来说，MoRe-Drag 在精炼、修复和锚点区域上执行区域感知的潜在重构，并配合阶段自适应条件控制，该控制逐渐从运动基础的结构形成转向语义精炼。我们还通过调整基于 MLLM 的文本编码器以进行拖拽感知的指令推理，来支持免指令的接口。在 DragBench-SR 和 DragBench-DR 上的实验表明，与强大的基础编辑器相比，MoRe-Drag 显着提高了拖拽精度，并在 SOTA 基于拖拽的方法中实现了卓越的拖拽准确度，同时提供了强烈的语义一致性和视觉逼真的结果。代码和数据集将公开发布。
AI.summary: MoRe-Drag是一种新颖的基于拖拽的图像编辑方法，它通过将像素级 warping 作为运动证据注入生成采样过程，并结合区域感知潜在重构与阶段自适应条件控制，从而在保证高拖拽精度的同时生成自然、符合意图的真实图像。
AI.keywords: 基于拖拽的编辑, 图像生成, 潜在重构, 运动证据, 空间控制
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的基于拖拽的图像编辑方法MoRe-Drag，核心创新在于将像素级空间变形视为粗略的运动证据并注入生成采样轨迹中，有效平衡了拖拽精度与生成图像的视觉合理性。

title: NesTok: Nested Self-Aligned 1D Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: One-dimensional (1D) variable-length visual tokenizers enable adaptive compression by varying the number of tokens, allowing downstream autoregressive (AR) models to flexibly trade off generation quality against computational cost using a single tokenizer. However, existing approaches based on nested dropout often fail to fully exploit the representational capacity of the tokenizer, resulting in suboptimal performance in both image reconstruction and generation. In this work, we introduce NesTok, a nested self-alignment framework tailored to dynamic visual tokenizers. NesTok introduces cross-length training, which jointly optimizes reconstruction across token lengths while using the full-length sequence to guide shorter counterparts, enabling shorter token sequences to approach the reconstruction quality of full-length sequences. On ImageNet, NesTok improves substantially over standard training and achieves an rFID score of 0.98. On downstream image generation, it achieves the state-of-the-art gFID score of 1.46 on ImageNet 256$\times$256 among existing variable-length autoregressive image generation methods. Code will be available at https://github.com/jaiwei804/NesTok.

AI.title_translation: NesTok：用于自回归图像生成的嵌套自对齐一维分词器
AI.tldr: 提出NesTok（一种用于自回归图像生成的嵌套自对齐1D分词器），通过跨长度训练显著提升了变长视觉分词器的图像重建与生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于嵌套 dropout 的1D变长视觉分词器方法往往无法充分利用分词器的表征能力，导致图像重建和生成性能次优。
AI.method: 引入了NesTok（一种嵌套自对齐框架），采用跨长度训练，在联合优化不同长度的重建任务时，利用全长序列来指导较短序列，从而使较短的标记序列也能接近全长的重建质量。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上，NesTok的rFID得分达到0.98；在ImageNet 256×256的下游图像生成任务中，达到了最先进的1.46的gFID得分。
AI.conclusion: NesTok通过跨长度训练和自对齐机制，有效提升了1D变长视觉分词器的表现，为自回归图像生成提供了一种高效、灵活的新方案。
AI.translation: 一维（1D）变长视觉分词器通过改变标记的数量来实现自适应压缩，允许下游自回归（AR）模型使用单个分词器在生成质量和计算成本之间灵活权衡。然而，现有的基于嵌套dropout的方法往往无法充分利用分词器的表征能力，导致图像重建和生成的性能次优。在这项工作中，我们推出了NesTok，这是一种专为动态视觉分词器量身定制的嵌套自对齐框架。NesTok引入了跨长度训练，它在联合优化不同标记长度的重建任务的同时，使用全长序列来指导较短的序列，从而使较短的标记序列能够接近全长序列的重建质量。在ImageNet上，NesTok比标准训练有了实质性的改进，实现了0.98的rFID分数。在下游图像 generation 中，它在现有变长自回归图像生成方法中，在ImageNet 256×256上实现了最先进的1.46的gFID分数。代码将在 https://github.com/jaiwei804/NesTok 上发布。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为NesTok的嵌套自对齐1D分词器，用于自回归图像生成。通过引入跨长度训练和自对齐机制，该方法解决了现有变长分词器利用率不足的问题，在ImageNet重建和生成任务中均取得了优异的性能。
AI.keywords: 自回归图像生成, 变长视觉分词器, 嵌套自对齐, 跨长度训练, ImageNet
AI.comments: 该论文提出了NesTok，通过嵌套自对齐框架解决了1D变长视觉分词器在图像重建和生成中表现不佳的问题，在ImageNet上取得了领先的gFID和rFID成绩，展现了很高的创新性和实用价值。

title: FastVR: Efficient Streaming Video Restoration with One-Step Diffusion
summary: Diffusion-based video restoration recovers realistic details, but its practical deployment is limited by two efficiency bottlenecks: costly VAE encoding and decoding, and the quadratic cost of full self-attention in diffusion transformers (DiTs). This paper presents FastVR, a streaming video restoration framework built on a one-step diffusion model, which delivers strong restoration quality and temporal consistency while processing 1080p video at 11 FPS on a single H20 GPU. To improve inference efficiency, FastVR combines a lightweight VAE with chunk-wise causal attention, which substantially reduces the computational cost. During training, it further adopts velocity consistency regularization and continuous trajectory learning, which improve restoration quality. Extensive experiments show that FastVR is more efficient than the evaluated diffusion baselines while achieving state-of-the-art performance on synthetic and real-world benchmarks. We hope that this work supports further progress in the community.

title: Dual-Mode Low-Rank Learner with Bridge-Prototype Ensemble for Vision-Language Class-Incremental Learning
comments: 21 pages, 11 figures, and 12 tables, including the appendix
summary: Benefiting from transferable visual-textual alignment, CLIP has been widely adopted for class-incremental learning (CIL). However, existing learners either repeatedly update components shared across tasks, leading to knowledge overwriting, or overly isolate new-task updates, hindering the reuse of CLIP's transferable knowledge and limiting plasticity. Moreover, the text-based or bimodal classifier designs still fail to effectively integrate complementary information from the visual and textual modalities. To address these challenges, we introduce DuLBE, which couples dual-mode low-rank learning with a bridge-prototype ensemble classifier for exemplar-free CIL. DuLBE allocates two visual low-rank update modes according to the gradient demand and uses gradient routing to coordinate them: a compact and rewritable shared mode is selected from historically occupied visual directions to reuse transferable knowledge, while residual modes provide low-interference channels for task-specific variations. Building on the resulting stable inter-modal structure, we further construct geodesic bridges between visual prototypes and text embeddings on the unit hypersphere, and ensemble reliable bridge prototypes to compensate for the modality-gap limitations of textual decision boundaries. Extensive experiments under multiple settings show that DuLBE achieves state-of-the-art CIL performance while retaining the high parameter efficiency of low-rank tuning.

title: QuantMLA: Function-Aligned Dual-Path Quantization for Low-Bit MLA KV Caching
summary: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) enables expressive multi-head attention with compact caches for its content and decoupled RoPE paths, yet cache memory still scales linearly with context length and batch size. In this work, we establish a systematic model of MLA's dual-path quantization errors, characterizing their distinct effects on attention-output distortion and explaining the pronounced amplification of RoPE-path errors. Guided by this analysis, we introduce QuantMLA, a function-aligned framework for low-bit dual-path quantization. We derive path-specific transformation spaces that preserve full-precision computation while remaining fully fusible into model parameters offline, eliminating online transformation overhead. Within these spaces, QuantMLA learns path-specific transformations with function-aligned objectives: attention-output reconstruction captures the content path's coupled matching and aggregation errors, while positional QK reconstruction preserves the RoPE-induced component of the attention logits and admits a theoretical bound on output distortion. Across four MLA model families, QuantMLA enables, to our knowledge, the first reported joint INT4 caching of the content and RoPE caches with minimal accuracy degradation. Further compressing the content cache to INT2 while retaining the RoPE key cache at INT4 maintains competitive performance on challenging reasoning and code benchmarks. We develop a native low-bit MLA attention kernel that integrates unpacking and dequantization directly into attention computation. The physical cache layout provides 3.59x compression at 128K context, while a cache-pressure serving workload achieves 5.168x higher whole-job output throughput than BF16. The code will be released upon acceptance.

title: The Reach of Abelian Covers in Hypergraphs
comments: 45 pages, full version of SODA 2027 paper
summary:
Covers in hypergraphs are frequently studied to capture various forms of dependence between hyperedges. For example, even covers--which check if each vertex appears in an even number of hyperedges--have found much success recently in the study of locally decodable codes. Inspired by a recently-emerging line of work on the non-redundancy of constraint satisfaction problems (CSPs), we introduce and study two novel families of covers of hypergraphs which are stricter than even covers: \emph{Abelian} covers and Catalan covers. Abelian covers are similar to even covers, except that arithmetic is now done over the integers rather than modulo 2, allowing us to capture dependences over arbitrary Abelian groups. Catalan covers capture the behavior of non-Abelian groups by only allowing local cancellations in a sequence of hyperedges.
  We prove three main results about Abelian and Catalan covers. First, using tools from lattice theory, we show that any $r$-uniform hypergraph with $n$ vertices and $n \log(r)$ hyperedges has an Abelian cover. Second, using tools from algebraic topology, we show that in any $3$-uniform hypergraph, Abelian covers and Catalan covers are equivalent; thereby showing that Catalan covers emerge after $O(n)$ hyperedges in $3$-uniform hypergraphs. Finally, using the theory of nilpotent groups, we show that there exists a $4$-uniform hypergraph which has an Abelian cover but not a Catalan cover. Collectively, these results exactly characterize the reach that Abelian covers have in deducing dependences in hypergraphs. As our primary application, we show that any arity-$3$ CSP with an infinite-domain Mal'tsev extension has linear non-redundancy. This implies near optimal streaming, sparsification, and kernelization algorithms for this family of CSPs. Previously, such a result was only known for the much simpler case of arity-$2$ CSPs.

title: Federated Clustering with Unknown Local and Global Cluster Cardinalities
summary: Federated clustering methods that do not require the global number of clusters $K$ still assume that each client knows its local number $K_g$. This assumption is hard to justify when clients know no more about their data than the server does, as in fault diagnosis across independently operated industrial sites. We propose a two-phase framework in which neither count is known: each client first estimates $K_g$ from its own data, and an aggregator that requires local counts, such as FedGEM, then uses these estimates in place of the true values. For the first phase we introduce Adaptive Split--Merge (ASM), which grows a spherical Gaussian mixture by BIC-driven splitting and then merges excess components. ASM uses no labels, selects its hyperparameters on held-out client data only, and makes no assumption about how clusters are shared across clients. We derive a closed-form split criterion whose critical cluster size falls with anisotropy and rises with dimension, and show empirically that over-fragmentation grows with the number of points per cluster, which federation divides among clients. Across eight datasets, ASM with FedGEM attains a mean ARI of 0.333, against 0.256 for the next best label-free estimator and 0.361 when the true local counts are supplied. It also gives the most reliable global estimates of $K$ and is robust when client size is decoupled from local cardinality.

title: SCORAS-MoE: Joint Compression and Resource-Adaptive Deployment of MoE-VLMs in LEO Satellite Networks
summary: Deploying large vision-language models (VLMs) onboard satellites enables onboard data processing and reduces raw data downlink. However, onboard inference faces two resource challenges. Limited onboard memory and energy require model compression and distributed deployment. Dynamic resource availability requires fast deployment decisions as illumination, battery levels, and communication conditions change. We present SCORAS-MoE, a joint compression and deployment framework for mixture-of-experts (MoE) VLMs in low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks. To address limited resources, SCORAS-MoE measures the perturbation of the routed MoE output caused by low-rank approximation, assigns higher ranks to more sensitive experts, and distributes compressed model shards across satellites for cooperative inference. The compressed models yield profiles of measured accuracy and inference energy. To adapt to dynamic resources, the online scheduler selects profile compositions and shard placements in each slot. For each candidate composition, it reduces placement to a minimum-cost assignment problem solved by the Hungarian algorithm, while enumerating the compositions yields the optimal deployment for the current-slot objective. Experiments on Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct show that allocating ranks based on output perturbation is particularly effective under aggressive compression, with an absolute gain of $3.7\%$ in mean accuracy over uniform rank allocation when expert projections retain $30\%$ of their original parameters. The fixed-profile scheduler achieves higher throughput with fewer service switches and lower battery impact than the evaluated proximal policy optimization (PPO) and evolutionary baselines, with respective speedups of $8.7\times$ and $183.5\times$. Adaptive profile selection further improves the balance between service quality and energy use.

AI.title_translation: SCORAS-MoE：LEO卫星网络中MoE-VLM的联合压缩与资源自适应部署
AI.tldr: SCORAS-MoE是一个针对LEO卫星网络中MoE-VLM的联合压缩和资源自适应部署框架，通过基于输出扰动的低秩近似进行模型压缩，并利用在线调度器解决动态资源下的部署问题，显著提高了压缩效率和部署性能。
AI.motivation: 在卫星上部署大型视觉语言模型（VLM）可以实现星上数据处理并减少原始数据下行链路。然而，星上推理面临两大资源挑战：有限的星上内存和能源需要模型压缩和分布式部署；动态变化的资源可用性（如光照、电池电量和通信条件）需要快速的部署决策。
AI.method: SCORAS-MoE通过测量路由MoE输出因低秩近似引起的扰动来解决资源受限问题，为更敏感的专家分配更高的秩，并将压缩后的模型分片分发到卫星上进行协同推理。对于动态资源，在线调度器在每个时隙选择配置组合和分片放置。它将放置问题简化为匈牙利算法解决的最小成本分配问题，并通过枚举组合找到当前时隙目标的最佳部署。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct上的实验表明，在激进压缩下，基于输出扰动分配秩特别有效，当专家投影保留其原始参数的30%时，平均准确率比均匀秩分配绝对提高3.7%。固定配置调度器比评估的PPO和进化基线具有更高的吞吐量、更少的服务切换和更低的电池影响，分别实现了8.7倍和183.5倍的加速。自适应配置选择进一步改善了服务质量和能源使用之间的平衡。
AI.conclusion: SCORAS-MoE框架通过结合基于输出扰动的模型压缩和资源自适应部署策略，显著提升了MoE-VLM在LEO卫星网络中资源受限和动态环境下的性能和效率，实现了服务质量与能源使用的良好平衡。
AI.translation: 在卫星上部署大型视觉语言模型（VLM）可以实现星上数据处理并减少原始数据下行链路。然而，星上推理面临两大资源挑战。有限的星上内存和能源需要模型压缩和分布式部署。动态变化的资源可用性需要快速的部署决策，因为光照、电池电量和通信条件会随之改变。我们提出了SCORAS-MoE，一个用于低地球轨道（LEO）卫星网络中专家混合（MoE）VLM的联合压缩和部署框架。为了解决资源受限问题，SCORAS-MoE测量路由MoE输出因低秩近似引起的扰动，为更敏感的专家分配更高的秩，并将压缩后的模型分片分发到卫星上进行协同推理。压缩后的模型会产生测量的准确性和推理能耗配置文件。为了适应动态资源，在线调度器在每个时隙选择配置文件组合和分片放置。对于每个候选组合，它将放置问题简化为匈牙利算法解决的最小成本分配问题，同时枚举这些组合以找到当前时隙目标的最佳部署。在Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct上的实验表明，在激进压缩下，基于输出扰动分配秩特别有效，当专家投影保留其原始参数的30%时，平均准确率比均匀秩分配绝对提高3.7%。固定配置调度器比评估的近端策略优化（PPO）和进化基线具有更高的吞吐量、更少的服务切换和更低的电池影响，分别实现了8.7倍和183.5倍的加速。自适应配置选择进一步改善了服务质量和能源使用之间的平衡。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了SCORAS-MoE，一个针对LEO卫星网络中MoE-VLM的联合压缩与资源自适应部署框架。为解决星上资源受限问题，SCORAS-MoE基于输出扰动进行低秩近似压缩，并为敏感专家分配更高秩，将模型分片分布式部署。为适应动态资源，在线调度器通过匈牙利算法优化分片放置，并枚举配置组合以实现最佳部署。实验结果表明，该方法在激进压缩下显著提高了模型准确性，并实现了更高的吞吐量和更低的能耗，优于现有基线，同时平衡了服务质量与能源使用。
AI.keywords: MoE-VLM, LEO卫星网络, 模型压缩, 资源自适应部署, 在线调度器
AI.comments: SCORAS-MoE的创新点在于其联合压缩与部署策略，特别是在模型压缩阶段引入了基于输出扰动的秩分配机制，这在资源极度受限的卫星环境中，能够更智能地保留模型性能。其在线调度器对动态资源变化的适应性也极具价值。该研究为在LEO卫星网络中高效部署大型AI模型提供了有前景的解决方案，对于边缘AI和空间计算领域具有重要意义。

title: Graph-Spectral Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Multivariate time series anomaly detection typically relies on evaluating discrepancies between observations and outputs produced by models trained on normal data. An alternative perspective is to characterize the distribution of normal data through the generative dynamics, i.e., the velocity field, of flow matching models. However, standard flow matching typically adopts linear probability paths that overlook dependencies among variables, leading to a misalignment with the structured data distribution. To address this issue, we propose GRASP, a flow matching framework with a graph-spectral path for multivariate time series anomaly detection. GRASP incorporates graph structure into the probability path by minimizing a fixed-endpoint action that combines kinetic energy with graph Dirichlet energy. This formulation yields a closed-form path based on graph-frequency-dependent hyperbolic interpolation. A velocity predictor trained on normal data then detects anomalies using weighted velocity discrepancies aggregated across source samples, flow times, and graph frequencies. Theoretically, we establish that GRASP is invariant to the choice of Laplacian eigenbasis and decompose its expected oracle anomaly score into bounded endpoint uncertainty and graph-frequency-weighted Fisher discrepancy. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate the superior anomaly detection performance of GRASP and validate the effectiveness of its graph-spectral path and weighting mechanism.

AI.title_translation: 多元时间序列异常检测的图谱流匹配
AI.tldr: GRASP提出一种图谱流匹配框架，通过图结构概率路径解决传统流匹配忽略变量依赖的问题，用于多元时间序列异常检测，并取得了优异性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的多元时间序列异常检测依赖于观测值与模型输出的差异。另一种方法是利用流匹配模型的生成动力学（即速度场）来表征正常数据的分布。然而，标准的流匹配通常采用线性概率路径，这会忽略变量之间的依赖关系，导致与结构化数据分布不匹配。
AI.method: 本文提出GRASP，一个用于多元时间序列异常检测的图谱流匹配框架。GRASP通过最小化结合动能和图Dirichlet能量的固定端点动作，将图结构融入概率路径。这种公式化产生了基于图频率依赖的双曲线插值的闭合形式路径。在正常数据上训练的速度预测器，通过聚合源样本、流时间和图频率的加权速度差异来检测异常。
AI.result: 理论上，GRASP对Laplacian特征基的选择是不变的，并且其预期预言机异常分数可以分解为有界端点不确定性和图频率加权的Fisher散度。在四个基准上的实验表明，GRASP具有卓越的异常检测性能，并验证了其图谱路径和加权机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GRASP通过引入图谱概率路径有效解决了传统流匹配在多元时间序列异常检测中忽略变量依赖的问题，显著提升了异常检测性能。
AI.translation: 多元时间序列异常检测通常依赖于评估观测值与通过正常数据训练的模型输出之间的差异。另一种视角是通过流匹配模型的生成动力学（即速度场）来表征正常数据的分布。然而，标准的流匹配通常采用线性概率路径，这会忽略变量之间的依赖关系，导致与结构化数据分布不匹配。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了GRASP，一个用于多元时间序列异常检测的图谱流匹配框架。GRASP通过最小化结合动能和图Dirichlet能量的固定端点动作，将图结构融入概率路径。这种公式化产生了基于图频率依赖的双曲线插值的闭合形式路径。在正常数据上训练的速度预测器，然后使用聚合了源样本、流时间和图频率的加权速度差异来检测异常。理论上，我们建立了GRASP对Laplacian特征基的选择是不变的，并将其预期预言机异常分数分解为有界端点不确定性和图频率加权的Fisher散度。在四个基准上的实验表明，GRASP具有卓越的异常检测性能，并验证了其图谱路径和加权机制的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出GRASP，一种用于多元时间序列异常检测的图谱流匹配框架。针对传统流匹配在处理多元时间序列时忽略变量间依赖的问题，GRASP通过引入结合图结构和图谱路径的概率流，实现了对正常数据分布更精确的刻画。该方法通过训练速度预测器并利用加权速度差异进行异常检测，并在理论和实验上证明了其有效性和优越性能。
AI.keywords: 多元时间序列异常检测, 图谱流匹配, GRASP, 概率路径, 速度场
AI.comments: GRASP的创新点在于将图结构和图谱路径引入流匹配模型，从而有效解决了传统流匹配在处理多元时间序列时忽略变量间依赖的问题。这种方法提供了一种新颖且理论上稳健的异常检测范式，特别适用于具有复杂内部依赖关系的时间序列数据。其理论分析也增加了方法的可靠性。

title: When Can Prefixes Compile LoRA? Exact Resource-Capped Tests for Frozen Attention
summary: Can a fixed continuous prefix replace a given low-rank adapter while the attention head stays frozen? In this research, we show that the answer depends on the adapter's target through three conditions. First, observability: at one causal readout, every independent key--value prefix sees the content only through the query, attention partition, and value numerator, so a target that differs on two inputs with equal summaries incurs an error floor at every prefix length; norm caps extend this floor to nearly equal summaries. Second, realizability: at a common query, any prefix reduces exactly to two aggregate variables, and the norm-capped optimum is an attained second-order-cone program, also after a fixed output projection; it places two equal-norm rank-one value updates on opposite sides of compilability. Third, implementation: under affine query exposure, $2r$ signed slots approximate a rank-$r$ value update, but their values grow as $O(ε^{-3/2})$, and the construction passes all 400 tolerance checks in float64 yet only 38 in bfloat16. A first-layer GPT-2 readout with fixed token and position meets the common-query condition without clamping activations; at three such heads, the capped optimum leaves 18.4\% to 74.2\% of the projected adapter effect uncompiled, with a head-dependent value--query ordering. All claims concern local approximation at one head, not whole-network equivalence.

AI.title_translation: 前缀何时能编译 LoRA？冻结注意力的精确资源受限测试
AI.tldr: 本文通过三个条件和严格的资源受限测试，研究了固定连续前缀在冻结注意力机制下替代 LoRA 的可行性与局限性。
AI.motivation: 研究在注意力机制保持冻结的情况下，固定的连续前缀是否以及何时能够替代给定的低秩适配器（LoRA）。
AI.method: 通过提出三个条件（可观测性、可实现性和实现方式），利用二阶锥规划（SOCP）、局部近似分析以及在 GPT-2 第一层上的实验，对前缀编译 LoRA 的可行性进行精确测试。
AI.result: 研究表明，目标差异会导致错误下限；norm-capped 最优解可以通过二阶锥规划获得；在仿射查询暴露下，$2r$ 个带符号槽可以近似 rank-$r$ 的值更新，但对数值精度极其敏感（float64 通过 400 项，bfloat16 仅过 38 项）；在 GPT-2 实验中，截断的最优解会留下 18.4% 至 74.2% 的未编译适配器效果。
AI.conclusion: 在冻结注意力机制下，固定连续前缀能否替代低秩适配器取决于可观测性、可实现性和实现方式三个条件，且在实际大模型应用中存在明显的误差下限与精度敏感性。
AI.translation: 一个固定的连续前缀能否在注意力头保持冻结的情况下替代给定的低秩适配器？在这项研究中，我们通过三个条件展示了答案取决于适配器的目标。首先是可观测性：在因果读出时，每个独立的键-值前缀仅通过查询、注意力分区和值分子观察内容，因此在具有相同摘要的两个输入上有所不同的目标会在每个前缀长度上产生误差下限；范数上限将此floor扩展到几乎相等的摘要。其次是可实现性：在公共查询下，任何前缀精确简化为两个聚合变量，并且范数上限最优解是一个实现的二阶锥程序，也在固定输出投影之后；它将两个等范数的秩一值更新放在可编译性的两侧。第三是实现：在仿射查询暴露下，$2r$ 个带符号槽近似秩-$r$ 的值更新，但它们的值增长为 $O(ε^{-3/2})$，该构造通过了 float64 中的所有 400 项容差检查，但在 bfloat16 中只通过了 38 项。具有固定 Token 和位置的第一层 GPT-2 读出满足公共查询条件，无需钳位激活；在此类三个头中，带上限的最优解留下了 18.4% 到 74.2% 的投影适配器效果未编译，具有与头相关的值-查询排序。所有声明均关于单个头的局部近似，而非全网络等价性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在冻结注意力机制下，用固定连续前缀替代低秩适配器（LoRA）的可行性。通过提出可观测性、可实现性和实现方式三个核心条件，结合二阶锥规划和 GPT-2 实例测试，揭示了前缀编译 LoRA 的理论边界、误差下限以及对浮点精度的强依赖性。
AI.keywords: LoRA, 连续前缀, 注意力机制, 可观测性, 可实现性
AI.comments: 该论文探讨了在冻结注意力机制下，使用连续前缀替代低 rank 适配器（LoRA）的可行性和精确资源受限测试，具有较强的理论深度，揭示了不同精度（如 float64 与 bfloat16）下的实现差异。

title: Emergent Specialization in Populations of Self-Supervised Collaborative Vision Experts Without a Shared Gate or Cross-Agent Gradients
summary: Can a population of neural networks develop a useful division of labor without a shared gate or gradients between agents? We study a setting where each network has its own weights, trains independently on the same heterogeneous data, and can ask another agent for help through a forward pass. Unlike mixtures of experts, where a jointly trained gate assigns inputs to experts, specialization here must emerge without central control. We test this in a small scale proxy for predictive visual pretraining. Initially identical agents are finetuned on an unlabeled mixture of six visual domains using masked prediction of frozen DINOv3 features. We measure specialization by asking whether the best agent for an input aligns with its latent domain, and utilization by asking whether responsibility is distributed across agents. We progressively remove central control, ending with DISCO (DIStributed COllaboration) where each agent locally selects a helper, reads its internal state through a gradient free channel, and rewards its router only for the improvement that help provides. Specialization emerges and is useful. Randomly routed populations underperform a single generalist, while semantically routed populations outperform it, showing that specialization rather than population size drives the gain. Specialization persists without a central router, and gradient free communication lets nonexperts exploit emergent expertise. In DISCO, a random agent helped by the expert matches the solo generalist, while experts surpass it, including on data outside the specialization mixture. Local routers select the emergent expert for 98% of inputs. These effects persist across population size, model capacity, data imbalance, and finetuning seeds, providing measurable evidence for the dynamics needed by decentralized predictive pretraining.

AI.title_translation: 在没有共享门控或跨智能体梯度的自监督协作视觉专家群体中涌现的专业化
AI.tldr: 本文研究了在没有中央控制和跨智能体梯度的情况下，神经网络群体如何发展出有用的分工。通过名为DISCO的机制，智能体可以局部选择帮助者并进行无梯度通信，结果显示专业化能够涌现并提高性能，超越了单一的通用模型。
AI.motivation: 研究神经网络群体是否能在没有共享门控或智能体间梯度的情况下，发展出有用的分工，以实现去中心化的预测性预训练。
AI.method: 研究在一个视觉预测预训练的代理任务中，每个神经网络独立训练，通过前向传播请求帮助。通过逐步移除中央控制，最终引入DISCO（DIStributed COllaboration）机制，其中每个智能体局部选择帮助者，通过无梯度通道读取内部状态，并仅根据帮助提供的改进奖励其路由器。利用DINOv3特征的掩码预测进行微调，并测量专业化和利用率。
AI.result: 专业化能够涌现且有用。随机路由的群体表现不如单一通用模型，而语义路由的群体则超越了它，表明专业化而非群体规模驱动性能提升。专业化在没有中央路由器的情况下依然存在，无梯度通信使非专家能够利用涌现的专业知识。在DISCO中，由专家帮助的随机智能体能与单独的通用模型匹配，而专家则超越了它，甚至在专业化混合之外的数据上也是如此。局部路由器为98%的输入选择了涌现的专家。这些效果在群体规模、模型容量、数据不平衡和微调种子方面都持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络群体可以在没有中央控制和跨智能体梯度的情况下，通过局部协作和无梯度通信，发展出有效的专业化，从而显著提高性能，并为去中心化预测性预训练提供了可衡量的证据。
AI.translation: 一个神经网络群体能否在没有共享门控或智能体间梯度的情况下，发展出有用的分工？我们研究了一个场景，其中每个网络都有自己的权重，在相同的异构数据上独立训练，并且可以通过前向传播请求另一个智能体的帮助。与专家混合模型不同，在专家混合模型中，联合训练的门控将输入分配给专家，而这里的专业化必须在没有中央控制的情况下涌现。我们在一个用于预测性视觉预训练的小规模代理任务中对此进行了测试。最初相同的智能体使用冻结的DINOv3特征的掩码预测，在六个视觉领域的未标记混合数据上进行微调。我们通过询问输入最佳智能体是否与其潜在领域对齐来衡量专业化，并通过询问责任是否分布在各个智能体之间来衡量利用率。我们逐步移除中央控制，最终引入DISCO（DIStributed COllaboration）机制，其中每个智能体局部选择一个帮助者，通过无梯度通道读取其内部状态，并仅根据帮助提供的改进奖励其路由器。专业化涌现并证明是有用的。随机路由的群体表现不如单一通用模型，而语义路由的群体则超越了它，表明专业化而非群体规模驱动性能提升。专业化在没有中央路由器的情况下依然存在，无梯度通信使非专家能够利用涌现的专业知识。在DISCO中，由专家帮助的随机智能体能与单独的通用模型匹配，而专家则超越了它，包括在专业化混合之外的数据上。局部路由器为98%的输入选择了涌现的专家。这些效果在群体规模、模型容量、数据不平衡和微调种子方面都持续存在，为去中心化预测性预训练所需的动态提供了可衡量的证据。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了在没有中央控制和跨智能体梯度的情况下，神经网络群体如何实现专业化分工。通过引入名为DISCO的去中心化协作机制，智能体可以局部选择帮助者并通过无梯度通道通信。实验证明，专业化能够自然涌现，并通过语义路由而非随机路由显著提升性能，甚至超越单一通用模型。即使在没有中央路由器的情况下，专业化也持续存在，并且无梯度通信使得非专家也能利用专业知识。这一发现为去中心化预测性预训练提供了有力证据。
AI.keywords: 自监督学习, 神经网络专业化, 去中心化协作, 无梯度通信, DINOv3
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了在没有中央门控和跨智能体梯度的情况下实现神经网络群体专业化的方法。DISCO机制通过局部决策和无梯度通信，展示了去中心化系统涌现复杂行为的潜力。这项工作对于理解和设计更具可扩展性和鲁棒性的多智能体系统具有重要意义，尤其是在联邦学习和边缘计算等去中心化AI应用领域。

title: Beyond Conditional Independence: Root Cause Analysis with Deep Causal Models
summary: Root cause analysis (RCA) is a critical problem in many real-world scenarios. RCA enables the identification of faulty or failing mechanisms in a system by comparing anomalous observations with corresponding reference (i.e., regular) observations. However, existing approaches rely either on heuristic methods or on conditional independence tests with a strong unconfoundedness assumption, and thus fail to exploit other complicated distributional constraints in the presence of latent variables. To relax these assumptions, we model the underlying system as a causal model and the anomalous system as a change in the structural functions of the same causal model. Specifically, to handle unobserved confounders, we establish an implicit connection between distributional constraint testing and root cause analysis. To adapt our approach to data generated from arbitrary causal models, we employ the deep causal model (DCM) framework, in which we design the causal model using neural networks. Finally, we illustrate how our method, RCA-DCM, can utilize different levels of partial graphical knowledge to perform RCA. We evaluate RCA-DCM against state-of-the-art baselines on simulated datasets, a physics-based causal chamber and two micro-service applications. RCA-DCM improves top-1 accuracy over the strongest baseline on both Sock Shop (0.880 vs. 0.752) and Online Boutique (0.776 vs. 0.712), and when the true root cause in the causal chamber is unobserved and acts as a latent confounder, it recovers the exact root-cause set more often than any competing method (perfect recovery rate (PRR) 0.846 vs. 0.731).

title: NeuroDyn-EEG: An Interpretable Pre-trained Model for EEG Based on Neural Dynamics
comments: Yi Cui and Tong Zhao contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Ling Zhang, Yuxiang Yan, and Bo Hong
summary:
Clinical scalp electroencephalography (EEG) offers a noninvasive window into neural dynamics of neuropsychiatric disorders. However, discriminative deep models often lack anatomically indexed physiological interpretability. We propose NeuroDyn-EEG, a pretraining framework integrating generative priors from neural dynamics. It couples an extended Jansen-Rit neural mass model, leadfield-based source projection, and simulation-based parameter inversion. Trained on synthetic parameter-EEG pairs within physiological ranges, NeuroDyn-EEG estimates 11 regional parameter families across 90 AAL regions plus one global parameter from standard 19-channel EEG, using only ~2.43M trainable parameters.
  We evaluate the framework across three levels. First, controlled simulations demonstrate robust parameter recovery under diverse noise conditions, while real resting-state EEG evaluations confirm spectral and phase consistency in an inverse-forward closed loop. Second, on four clinical benchmarks (AD65, PD31, Figshare MDD, and TUAB), NeuroDyn-EEG achieves competitive classification performance, securing the highest BACC, AUROC, and AUCPR on PD31 and MDD, and highest BACC on AD65. Third, post hoc regional analyses reveal disease-specific alterations: local synaptic connectivity C_1 involves the most altered regions in AD65, whereas the firing threshold theta ranks first in MDD, offering testable mechanistic hypotheses.
  Overall, NeuroDyn-EEG maps scalp EEG to anatomically indexed dynamical parameters, bridging representation learning and mechanistic neurophysiology. Code: https://github.com/Gnosis-Neurodynamics/NeuroDyn-EEG.

AI.title_translation: NeuroDyn-EEG：一个基于神经动力学的脑电图可解释预训练模型
AI.tldr: NeuroDyn-EEG是一个可解释的脑电图预训练模型，通过整合神经动力学先验知识，将头皮脑电图映射到解剖学索引的动态参数。它在模拟中表现出鲁棒的参数恢复能力，在临床基准测试中取得了有竞争力的分类性能，并揭示了疾病特异性的区域参数改变。
AI.motivation: 判别式深度模型通常缺乏解剖学索引的生理学可解释性，而临床头皮脑电图（EEG）为神经精神疾病的神经动力学提供了一个非侵入性窗口。
AI.method: 我们提出了NeuroDyn-EEG，这是一个整合了神经动力学生成先验知识的预训练框架。它结合了扩展的Jansen-Rit神经质量模型、基于导联场的源投影和基于仿真的参数反演。该模型在生理范围内的合成参数-脑电图对上进行训练，使用约2.43M的可训练参数，从标准19导联脑电图中估计90个AAL区域的11个区域参数族和一个全局参数。
AI.result: 首先，受控仿真显示在不同噪声条件下参数恢复鲁棒，真实静息态脑电评估证实了逆向-前向闭环中的频谱和相位一致性。其次，在四个临床基准测试（AD65、PD31、Figshare MDD和TUAB）中，NeuroDyn-EEG取得了有竞争力的分类性能，在PD31和MDD上获得了最高的BACC、AUROC和AUCPR，在AD65上获得了最高的BACC。第三，事后区域分析揭示了疾病特异性改变：局部突触连接C_1涉及AD65中最常改变的区域，而MDD中放电阈值theta排名第一。
AI.conclusion: NeuroDyn-EEG将头皮脑电图映射到解剖学索引的动态参数，弥合了表征学习和机制神经生理学之间的鸿沟。
AI.translation:
临床头皮脑电图（EEG）为神经精神疾病的神经动力学提供了一个非侵入性窗口。然而，判别式深度模型通常缺乏解剖学索引的生理学可解释性。我们提出了NeuroDyn-EEG，这是一个整合了神经动力学生成先验知识的预训练框架。它结合了扩展的Jansen-Rit神经质量模型、基于导联场的源投影和基于仿真的参数反演。NeuroDyn-EEG在生理范围内的合成参数-脑电图对上进行训练，使用约2.43M的可训练参数，从标准19导联脑电图中估计90个AAL区域的11个区域参数族和一个全局参数。
我们在三个层面评估了该框架。首先，受控仿真显示在不同噪声条件下参数恢复鲁棒，而真实静息态脑电评估证实了逆向-前向闭环中的频谱和相位一致性。其次，在四个临床基准测试（AD65、PD31、Figshare MDD和TUAB）中，NeuroDyn-EEG取得了有竞争力的分类性能，在PD31和MDD上获得了最高的BACC、AUROC和AUCPR，在AD65上获得了最高的BACC。第三，事后区域分析揭示了疾病特异性改变：局部突触连接C_1涉及AD65中最常改变的区域，而MDD中放电阈值theta排名第一，提供了可检验的机制假设。
总的来说，NeuroDyn-EEG将头皮脑电图映射到解剖学索引的动态参数，弥合了表征学习和机制神经生理学之间的鸿沟。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了NeuroDyn-EEG，一个基于神经动力学的可解释预训练模型，旨在解决传统深度学习模型在脑电图分析中缺乏生理学可解释性的问题。该模型通过整合Jansen-Rit神经质量模型、导联场源投影和仿真参数反演，从标准19导联脑电图估计区域性神经动力学参数。实验结果表明，NeuroDyn-EEG在参数恢复、频谱和相位一致性方面表现鲁棒，并在多个临床基准测试中取得了有竞争力的分类性能。此外，模型还能够揭示疾病特异性的区域参数改变，为理解神经精神疾病的机制提供了新的视角，成功连接了表征学习和机制神经生理学。
AI.keywords: 脑电图, 神经动力学, 可解释模型, 预训练, 神经精神疾病
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于其将神经动力学模型（Jansen-Rit）与深度学习预训练框架相结合，实现了从头皮脑电图到解剖学索引的动态参数的映射，从而提供了更高的生理学可解释性。这对于理解神经精神疾病的潜在机制具有重要意义，并为诊断和治疗提供了新的工具。其在合成和真实数据上的多层次评估验证了模型的有效性和鲁棒性，尤其是在临床基准测试中取得的竞争性表现和揭示疾病特异性生物标志物的能力，展示了其巨大的应用潜力。

title: LexiconVLA: Learning Reusable Atomic Action Codebooks for Unseen Tasks
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models struggle to reuse recurring interactions in unseen tasks. Our diagnostic study reveals that reliable task completion does not imply consistent execution of constituent atomic actions across task contexts. We present LexiconVLA, a retrievable atomic-action lexicon for cross-task reuse. Global and detail codebooks capture shared interaction structure and fine-grained execution variation, respectively, preserving both reusable patterns and execution details. Visual-Atomic Action Alignment couples trajectory reconstruction from visual state changes with visual outcome prediction from action codes, grounding the lexicon in motion and its effects. We learn these codebooks with trajectory reconstruction and visual alignment on our AtomAction Dataset of 57,803 segments from 69 tasks. A planner and scene-aware adapter translate new goals into code-conditioned subtasks for a shared policy, without skill-specific experts or deployment-time parameter updates. Across five policy backbones on 26 RLBench tasks, LexiconVLA largely maintains performance on 18 seen tasks while improving success on 8 tasks held out from policy training. With BridgeVLA, unseen-task success rises from 16.67% to 34.17% (+17.50 percentage points), and overall success reaches 71.08%, the highest among methods with reported results. Real-robot experiments demonstrate stepwise execution and failure recovery.

AI.title_translation: 词汇VLA：学习可重用的原子动作词典以应对未见过的任务
AI.tldr: LexiconVLA通过学习可重用的原子动作词典来解决视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在处理新任务时复用已有交互的难题。该模型包含全局和细节码本，分别捕捉交互的通用结构和执行细节，并通过视觉-原子动作对齐将其与视觉状态变化和动作效果联系起来。在AtomAction数据集上训练后，LexiconVLA能够将新目标转化为子任务，无需特定技能专家或部署时参数更新，并在RLBench任务上显著提升了未见任务的成功率，甚至在真实机器人实验中也展示了其逐步执行和故障恢复的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在处理未见过的任务时，难以有效复用在不同任务中出现的重复性交互。这表明，即使能够可靠地完成任务，也并不意味着其能够一致地执行构成任务的原子动作。
AI.method: LexiconVLA提出了一种可检索的原子动作词典，用于跨任务复用。它包含全局码本（捕捉共享交互结构）和细节码本（捕捉精细的执行变异）。通过视觉-原子动作对齐，将轨迹重建（来自视觉状态变化）与视觉结果预测（来自动作码本）相结合，将词典与运动及其效果联系起来。该模型在AtomAction数据集（包含69个任务的57,803个片段）上进行训练。一个规划器和场景感知适配器将新目标转化为码本条件化的子任务，用于共享策略，无需特定技能的专家或部署时的参数更新。
AI.result: 在26个RLBench任务的5个策略骨干上进行评估，LexiconVLA在18个已见任务上基本保持了性能，同时在8个未用于策略训练的测试任务上提高了成功率。与BridgeVLA结合使用时，未见任务的成功率从16.67%提升到34.17%（+17.50个百分点），总体成功率达到71.08%，高于其他已有结果的方法。真实机器人实验也证明了其逐步执行和故障恢复的能力。
AI.conclusion: LexiconVLA通过引入可重用的原子动作词典，有效解决了VLA模型在处理未见任务时复用交互的挑战，显著提升了在新任务上的表现，并能在真实机器人上实现复杂行为。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在复用未见任务中反复出现的交互方面存在困难。我们的诊断研究表明，可靠的任务完成并不意味着在任务上下文中一致地执行构成性原子动作。我们提出了LexiconVLA，一个用于跨任务复用的可检索原子动作词典。全局和细节码本分别捕捉共享的交互结构和细粒度的执行变异，同时保留了可复用的模式和执行细节。视觉-原子动作对齐将来自视觉状态变化的轨迹重建与来自动作码本的视觉结果预测相结合，将词典 grounding 在运动及其效果上。我们在包含69个任务的57,803个片段的AtomAction数据集上，通过轨迹重建和视觉对齐来学习这些码本。规划器和场景感知适配器将新目标转化为码本条件化的子任务，用于共享策略，无需特定技能的专家或部署时的参数更新。在26个RLBench任务上的五个策略骨干上，LexiconVLA在18个已见任务上基本保持了性能，同时提高了8个未用于策略训练的任务的成功率。与BridgeVLA结合，未见任务的成功率从16.67%提升到34.17%（+17.50个百分点），总体成功率达到71.08%，是报告结果中最高的方法。真实机器人实验展示了逐步执行和故障恢复能力。
AI.summary: LexiconVLA是一种新颖的视觉语言动作（VLA）模型，它通过构建一个可重用的原子动作词典来克服现有模型在处理新任务时复用交互能力的不足。该词典包含全局和细节码本，能够同时捕捉动作的通用模式和具体执行细节，并通过视觉-原子动作对齐技术将这些动作与视觉状态的变化及其后果联系起来。通过在AtomAction数据集上的训练，LexiconVLA能够有效地将新任务的目标转化为一系列可执行的原子动作子任务，从而无需针对特定任务进行额外的训练或调整。实验结果表明，LexiconVLA在RLBench基准测试中显著提高了模型在未见任务上的成功率，并且在真实机器人上的应用也验证了其逐步执行和故障恢复的能力。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言动作, 原子动作, 动作词典, 任务泛化, 可重用性
AI.comments: 这项工作在VLA领域取得了重要进展，通过引入原子动作词典的概念，有效地解决了模型泛化能力和可复用性问题。全局和细节码本的设计以及视觉-原子动作对齐的引入，为理解和生成复杂动作序列提供了新的视角。然而，AtomAction数据集的构建和其对模型性能的影响，以及在更广泛、更复杂的真实世界场景中的鲁棒性仍有待进一步研究。

title: DSPO: Diversity-aware Subjective Policy Optimization for Robust Emotional Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement Learning has significantly advanced the complex reasoning capabilities of MLLMs. However, prevailing RL algorithms suffer a severe failure in emotion reasoning tasks. These methods heavily rely on deterministic hard-label supervision and point-wise isolated evaluation, creating a fundamental gap with the inherently subjective and continuously distributed nature of human emotions. Furthermore, unlike explicit physical objects, emotional states are deeply implicit within visual cues. This abstract nature exacerbates visual hallucinations in MLLMs, leading to plausible yet ungrounded emotional evidence. To address these limitations, we propose Diversity-Aware Subjective Policy Optimization (DSPO), a reinforcement learning framework that jointly promotes subjective affective coverage and visual grounding. First, we construct a context-grounded emotional distribution prior in the VAD space by combining the lexical prior of the annotated emotion with image-specific contextual information. Based on this prior, we introduce a Distribution-Aligned Emotional Diversity Reward (DEDR), which measures the leave-one-out marginal contribution of each candidate emotion within a rollout. DEDR rewards candidates whose inclusion brings the predicted affective set closer to the context-grounded prior, thereby preserving plausible subjective interpretations without encouraging unconstrained dispersion. We further develop Counterfactual Visual Intervention Gating (CVIG), which masks the visual region highlighted in the reasoning process and uses the resulting candidate-wise probability changes to reduce the weights of interpretations unsupported by visual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple public benchmarks, especially on the cross-domain performance, i.e., improving +10.8\% on average cross-domain accuracy than EMO-R3.

AI.title_translation: DSPO：面向鲁棒情感推理的多样性感知主观策略优化
AI.tldr: DSPO通过结合情感分布先验和反事实视觉干预，解决了多模态大模型在情感推理中的局限性，提高了鲁棒性和跨领域性能。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习算法在情感推理任务中表现不佳，因为它们依赖确定性的硬标签监督和孤立的评估，这与人类情感的主观性和连续性以及情感线索的隐晦性存在差距，导致模型产生视觉幻觉。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为DSPO（Diversity-Aware Subjective Policy Optimization）的强化学习框架，该框架包含两个主要部分：1. 上下文情境化情感分布先验：结合词汇先验和图像特定上下文信息，构建VAD空间中的情感分布先验。 2. 分布对齐情感多样性奖励（DEDR）：根据情感分布先验，衡量每个候选情感的边际贡献，奖励那些能使预测情感集更接近先验的情感。 3. 反事实视觉干预门控（CVIG）：通过掩盖视觉区域并分析概率变化，减少视觉证据不足的解释的权重。
AI.result: DSPO在多个公开基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，尤其在跨领域性能上，平均提高了10.8%的准确率，优于EMO-R3。
AI.conclusion: DSPO通过引入多样性感知的主观策略优化，有效地解决了多模态大模型在情感推理中的视觉幻觉和主观性挑战，显著提升了模型的鲁棒性和跨领域泛化能力。
AI.translation: 强化学习在提升多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的复杂推理能力方面取得了显著进展。然而，现有的强化学习算法在情感推理任务中存在严重缺陷。这些方法严重依赖确定性的硬标签监督和逐点孤立评估，与人类情感固有的主观性和连续分布特性之间存在根本性差距。此外，与明确的物理对象不同，情感状态深藏于视觉线索之中。这种抽象性加剧了MLLM中的视觉幻觉，导致生成看似合理但缺乏依据的情感证据。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了多样性感知主观策略优化（DSPO），一个强化学习框架，旨在同时促进主观情感覆盖和视觉基础。首先，我们通过结合标注情感的词汇先验和图像特定的上下文信息，在VAD空间中构建了一个上下文情境化的情感分布先验。基于此先验，我们引入了分布对齐情感多样性奖励（DEDR），它衡量了每个候选情感在一次试验（rollout）中的遗漏一个（leave-one-out）边际贡献。DEDR奖励那些能够使预测情感集更接近上下文情境化先验的候选情感，从而在不鼓励无约束扩散的情况下保留了合理的主观解释。我们进一步开发了反事实视觉干预门控（CVIG），它掩盖了推理过程中突出显示的视觉区域，并利用由此产生的候选情感概率变化来降低不受视觉证据支持的解释的权重。大量的实验表明，DSPO在多个公开基准测试中均取得了最先进的性能，尤其在跨领域性能方面，平均准确率比EMO-R3提高了10.8%。
AI.summary: DSPO是一种新颖的强化学习框架，通过构建上下文情境化的情感分布先验并引入分布对齐情感多样性奖励（DEDR）和反事实视觉干预门控（CVIG），解决了多模态大语言模型在情感推理中的局限性，包括对主观性和视觉证据的依赖不足问题，从而提高了模型的鲁棒性和跨领域性能。
AI.keywords: 情感推理, 强化学习, 多模态大语言模型, DSPO, 视觉接地
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的强化学习方法DSPO，有效解决了多模态大语言模型在情感推理中的关键挑战，如情感的主观性、连续性以及视觉证据的依赖性。通过引入情感分布先验和反事实视觉干预机制，DSPO在提高模型性能和鲁棒性方面取得了显著成果，特别是在跨领域应用上。该方法为未来情感推理和多模态理解的研究提供了有价值的思路和技术支持。

title: Causal-EVC: Breaking Emotional Spurious Causality via Spatiotemporal Grounding and Counterfactual Intervention
summary: Emotional Video Captioning aims to generate factually accurate and emotionally empathetic descriptions. While recent methods have recognized the importance of visual causes to guide emotion perception and caption generation, they fundamentally rely on simple attention matching, which inevitably suffers from {causal redundancy and spurious correlations} in co-occurrence bias (e.g., misclassifying ``sadness'' as ``joy'' on a sunny beach), leading to severe shortcut learning from confusing backgrounds. Furthermore, existing evaluations fail to verify whether models have genuinely mastered causal reasoning or merely exploited background confounders. To address these limitations, we first construct {EVC-CauseGround}, a comprehensive benchmark with dense spatio-temporal causal annotations. Crucially, it introduces a carefully selected {Causal-Faithfulness Subset} to explicitly quantify genuine emotion-cause attribution. Second, we propose {Causal-EVC}, an emotion-grounding captioning framework, which introduces a Motion-guided Causal Spatiotemporal Localization module to precisely decouple causal triggers from background confounders. Besides, we introduce an Interpretable Sparse Emotion Routing module. By synthesizing counterfactual representations and formulating a novel counterfactual contrastive objective, we enforce the model to anchor its emotion predictions strictly on authentic causal triggers instead of confusing background. Extensive experiments show that Causal-EVC not only achieves the best performance on semantic metrics but also exhibits significant advantages in the causal-faithfulness subset, which demonstrates that our model could mine emotional cues from genuine visual causes and mitigate co-occurrence bias for interpretable multimodal emotion understanding.

AI.title_translation: Causal-EVC：通过时空定位和反事实干预打破情感虚假因果关系
AI.tldr: Causal-EVC通过引入新的基准数据集EVC-CauseGround和情感定位字幕框架Causal-EVC，解决了情感视频字幕中因共现偏差导致的虚假因果关系问题，并通过运动引导的时空定位和反事实对比学习，使模型能够从真实视觉原因中挖掘情感线索，而非混淆背景。
AI.motivation: 现有情感视频字幕方法依赖简单的注意力匹配，导致因共现偏差（如将“悲伤”误分类为“快乐”在阳光海滩上）产生的虚假因果关系和捷径学习，且现有评估无法验证模型是否真正掌握因果推理。
AI.method:
1. 构建了EVC-CauseGround基准数据集，包含密集的时空因果标注和Causal-Faithfulness子集以量化真实情感-原因归因。
2. 提出了Causal-EVC情感定位字幕框架，包含运动引导的因果时空定位模块，以精确解耦因果触发器和背景混淆因素。
3. 引入了可解释的稀疏情感路由模块，通过合成反事实表示和反事实对比目标，强制模型将情感预测严格锚定在真实因果触发器上。
AI.result: Causal-EVC不仅在语义指标上取得了最佳性能，而且在因果忠实度子集上表现出显著优势。
AI.conclusion: Causal-EVC模型能够从真实的视觉原因中挖掘情感线索，并减轻共现偏差，从而实现可解释的多模态情感理解。
AI.translation: 情感视频字幕旨在生成事实准确且情感共鸣的描述。尽管最近的方法已经认识到视觉原因对于指导情感感知和字幕生成的重要性，但它们本质上依赖于简单的注意力匹配，这不可避免地受到共现偏差中“因果冗余和虚假相关性”的影响（例如，在阳光明媚的海滩上错误地将“悲伤”分类为“快乐”），导致从混淆背景中产生严重的捷径学习。此外，现有评估未能验证模型是否真正掌握了因果推理，或者仅仅利用了背景混淆因素。为了解决这些局限性，我们首先构建了EVC-CauseGround，一个包含密集时空因果标注的综合基准。至关重要的是，它引入了一个精心选择的Causal-Faithfulness子集，以明确量化真实的情感-原因归因。其次，我们提出了Causal-EVC，一个情感定位字幕框架，它引入了一个运动引导的因果时空定位模块，以精确地将因果触发器与背景混淆因素解耦。此外，我们引入了一个可解释的稀疏情感路由模块。通过合成反事实表示并制定一个新颖的反事实对比目标，我们强制模型将其情感预测严格锚定在真实因果触发器上，而不是混淆背景。大量实验表明，Causal-EVC不仅在语义指标上取得了最佳性能，而且在因果忠实度子集上表现出显著优势，这表明我们的模型可以从真实的视觉原因中挖掘情感线索，并减轻共现偏差，以实现可解释的多模态情感理解。
AI.summary: 本文针对情感视频字幕中存在的虚假因果关系和捷径学习问题，提出了Causal-EVC框架。该框架通过构建EVC-CauseGround数据集，引入运动引导的因果时空定位模块和可解释的稀疏情感路由模块，结合反事实对比学习，有效解耦因果触发器与背景混淆因素。实验证明，Causal-EVC在语义指标和因果忠实度方面均表现出色，能够从真实视觉原因中识别情感，并减少共现偏差。
AI.keywords: 情感视频字幕, 因果推理, 时空定位, 反事实干预, EVC-CauseGround

title: Code4Scene: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Constructing and Editing 3D Scenes
summary: Frontier coding agents can now write and execute code that authors 3D environments, but whether they reliably understand 3D structure and precisely control scene state remains unclear. The generated 3D scene is a persistent, executable artifact: a convincing render can hide incorrect spatial relations, intersecting objects, or unintended modifications. We introduce Code4Scene, a benchmark of 190 Unreal Engine cases built from human-assembled scenes that evaluates coding agents on two complementary settings under a shared execution interface. Construction tests scene-level spatial reasoning from open-ended language specifications, where many realizations are valid; editing tests precise control of scene state, where the agent must recover the target scene from reference images while preserving everything else. Rather than scoring code or rendered views, Code4Scene evaluates the generated engine-native scene for task fulfillment, artifact integrity, and static physical validity, with edits additionally compared against withheld ground truth. Across 14 coding-agent configurations on the 95-case public set, construction and editing performance are strongly correlated but not interchangeable (Spearman $ρ= 0.78$): Claude Fable 5.1 leads construction, Gemini 3.8 Flash leads editing, and GPT-6 Astra narrowly leads overall. Spatial Composition is the weakest construction category for every agent, while editing remains imprecise: the best Repair F1 is only 0.527, and 35.8% of edits that fully recover the target still introduce unintended changes elsewhere in the scene. These results expose a gap between plausible 3D generation and reliable spatial reasoning and state control.

title: XBDD: A Highly Optimized ROBDD with Per-Edge Variable-Flip Maps
summary: The Reduced Ordered Binary Decision Diagram (ROBDD) is a canonical representation of Boolean functions and is widely used in tasks such as equivalence checking and satisfiability checking of combinational circuits. Classical ROBDD packages greatly improve the efficiency of building ROBDDs through a series of optimization techniques, and compress the node scale of the ROBDD through complement edges. However, existing implementations do not take into account the local polarity differences of isomorphic Boolean functions, and still produce a distinct node for each polarity combination, thereby causing an explosion in the number of nodes. This paper proposes XBDD, a highly optimized ROBDD that, on the basis of fully implementing complement edges and their accompanying engineering techniques, introduces a per-edge variable-flip map. XBDD attaches a flip map to each edge to indicate which input variables must be negated when that edge is followed. This allows nodes that differ only in local input polarities to be merged, further reducing the node count. For certain function families, this sharing even yields exponential compression. We also propose methods that use a bitmap and a map pool to substantially reduce the extra overhead brought by the map, and propose normalization and cofactor operators for the map. In addition, XBDD implements several other engineering optimizations to further improve both time and space efficiency. Experiments show that XBDD trades a controllable time cost for a significant space gain, validating the effectiveness of the per-edge variable-flip map.

title: DRHeC: Differentiable Rendering for Hand-Eye Calibration with RGB-Based Gradients
summary:
Accurate hand-eye calibration is crucial for precision manipulation. Traditional methods rely on markers, with their precision dependent on marker accuracy and observability. In contrast, markerless methods, such as learning-based approaches, use deep neural networks to directly extract keypoints or features from images, enabling the computation of hand-eye transformation with a single image and without the need for physical markers. Recently, differentiable rendering-based methods for hand-eye calibration have leveraged physical models to render binary masks and compare them with observations, enabling hand-eye calibration without fiducial markers in the calibration stage and providing interpretable optimization. While the state-of-the-art differentiable rendering methods achieve remarkable accuracy, the use of binary masks can result in the loss of internal profile details, reducing precision. Additionally, these methods can also suffer from unstable optimization and local minima.
  In this study, we propose a novel RGB-based differentiable rendering framework that provides richer geometric and appearance cues by incorporating color and mask geometric features, thereby improving calibration accuracy and optimization stability. Additionally, we propose a mask-guided image-to-image translation method to ensure explicit preservation of color and geometric consistency throughout the translation. Our approach is validated through both simulation and real-world experiments, with results demonstrating strong accuracy and robustness and clear improvements over existing differentiable rendering methods. Our method achieves a grasping success rate of 88.9% and insertion success rate of 57.4% on the UR5e real-world experiment, outperforming the state-of-the-art differentiable rendering hand-eye calibration method EasyHeC by 46.3 and 48.1 percentage points, respectively.

title: Aperture: Merge-Consistent Rotary States for Compressed Tokens
summary: Token compression combines content from several positions, yet rotary position embeddings usually assign the merged token one coordinate. We ask what positional information must survive later merges. Aperture stores Fourier moments of the token's weighted support at the model's rotary frequencies. We prove that these moments have minimal real dimension among continuous states sufficient for the selected expected rotary interactions. Represented mass makes updates additive; attention normalisation remains a separate readout choice. Uniform intervals give a centre rotation times a sinc gain. We characterise when centres determine interval widths and construct matched examples where they do not. Numerical checks verify the weighted-support implementation. In trained temporal readers, compression transfer varies with gain calibration and feature placement. In a prespecified native video question-answering comparison, stored support reaches $65.63\%$ accuracy versus $67.12\%$ for the deployed merging rule. These results separate exact positional preservation under compression from downstream benefit.

title: Decoding Affective Nuances: Enhancing MLLMs via Hierarchical Emotion Reasoning and Contrastive Discriminative Pruning
summary: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in objective understanding tasks, their performance in affective reasoning still falls significantly short of human standards. We attribute it to a central capability gap: MLLMs are difficult to reliably distinguish semantically proximal emotions based on fine-grained visual evidence, which could be decoupled as two limitations: 1) Insufficient Attribution. The global reasoning paradigm of conventional MLLMs severely dilutes fine-grained emotion cues, where subtle emotional states are usually implicitly encoded, thereby generating emotional misjudgments in complex scenarios. 2) Insufficient Discrimination. Existing methods could only identify regions generally associated with emotions, which fails to distinguish discriminative regions between semantically similar emotions, leading to ambiguous emotion judgements. To overcome these limitations, we present a training-free inference-time optimization framework, named Decoding Affective Nuances (DAN). Specifically, we propose a Hierarchical Emotional Reasoning Chain (HERC) that enhances the insufficient attribution by harmonizing fine-grained scene/object-level cues and performing a soft-gated reasoning. Furthermore, to discriminate between semantically proximal emotions, we design a Contrastive Discriminative Visual Pruning (CDVP), which isolates discriminative visual tokens to reason the final emotion category by computing the absolute discrepancy between the attention distributions of similar emotions. Performances on several benchmarks demonstrate that DAN significantly improves discrimination for affective nuances without consuming additional training resources, especially achieving +10.47% improvements with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on WebEmo25 dataset that contains 25 fine-grained emotion categories.

title: The Editor Has Read-Only Access: Correctness Signals in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models generate code by repeatedly updating a partially masked sequence. We ask whether their internal activations encode code correctness and whether that information can improve generation. Across six diffusion models, linear probes distinguish passing from failing attempts, with the strongest reads generally appearing beyond the early layers. Controls using small semantic mutations support a connection to correctness rather than surface style alone. In comparisons with model confidence, probe point estimates offer no consistent advantage. Adding a probe-derived direction to the residual stream does not yield a dependable improvement in the tested steering settings, while the opposite direction degrades performance. We distinguish these observations from claims about statistical significance or a general inability to steer. Supplementary methods, archived results, and code document the tested interventions and the limits of their statistical calibration and reproducibility.

title: Scale-Invariant Manipulability Shape Tracking Across Heterogeneous Manipulators
summary: When transferring manipulability across systems with different sizes and kinematic structures, matching absolute ellipsoid scale may be unnecessary when the goal is to reproduce orientation and semi-axis length ratios. Full-matrix tracking, however, penalizes both shape and absolute-scale differences, even when only shape matching is required. We therefore propose a scale-invariant manipulability shape-tracking method that treats matrices differing only by a positive scalar factor as equivalent and uses their unit-determinant representatives. We derive the differential of the unit-determinant shape representative and an orthonormal coordinate representation of the tangent tracking residual under the affine-invariant Riemannian metric (AIRM). The resulting scale-invariant objective is integrated with position and end-effector direction tasks in a constrained joint-velocity quadratic program. Simulations with four heterogeneous robots evaluate robot-to-robot and human-to-robot transfer. On three followers, the proposed method achieves endpoint shape distances of 9.30 x 10^-5 without scale tuning. With robot-specific target scales tuned during motion, the Full method retains endpoint axis-ratio errors of 0.19-0.31 on KR500 and UR20. For human reaching with concurrent tasks, the proposed method yields dual force shapes elongated along X like the human target on all four robots, with endpoint position errors of 2.4-5.6% of reference arm length versus up to 75% for the Full method tracking the original human ellipsoid.

title: TaRL: Learning General and Physical Rewards from Tactile Demonstrations
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to sequence precise contacts, maintain stable grasps, and apply directed forces. Reinforcement learning (RL) can acquire such behaviors automatically, but its performance hinges on reward design: sparse rewards reduce the learning efficiency, while dense rewards are hard to specify. Visual reward learning addresses this by inferring rewards from action-free demonstrations. Because it conditions only on visual observations, it fails to capture rewards beyond visual goals. We propose Tactile Reward Learning (TaRL), a framework that learns rewards from tactile demonstrations. TaRL takes a sequence of tactile deformation maps as input, and regresses task-completion progress from both successful and failed demonstrations. Because TaRL captures local robot-object interaction, it provides informative feedback to learn firm grasps and correctly directed forces; meanwhile, it is robust to changes in scene layout such as object position. We evaluate TaRL on four manipulation tasks in simulation and two in the real world. Used as a shaping reward, it substantially improves both sample efficiency and final success rate, raising success on Nut threading from 34% to 56% in simulation and on cube pickup from 37% to 97% in the real world. Combining tactile with visual rewards improves performance further. TaRL also generalizes across object instances: trained on box placement and directly deployed to can placement, it significantly improves policy learning on the new task. Project page is available at https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/tarl.

title: Regularized policy gradient with learned mixtures of Gaussians for games with continuous actions
summary: Most successes of superhuman game-playing algorithms are in games with discrete actions, yet in auctions, robotics, sports, or trading, actions are nearly continuous. Prior techniques either rely on expert-designed discretizations or are sample inefficient. We present a scalable policy-gradient algorithm for large sequential games with continuous or mixed discrete and continuous actions. It combines magnetic mirror descent with a mixture of Gaussians reparametrization, trained via self-play. We show that it approximates equilibrium in games where gradient descent fails. In sequential games, it outperforms neural fictitious self-play and matches or outperforms the final strategies of policy space response oracles with 3.5--5.5$\times$ fewer samples. In heads-up no-limit Texas hold'em, it performs on par with Slumbot.

title: Harnessing Large Language Models to Compile Task-Relevant Context into Bayesian Optimisation
summary: Incorporating rich task-relevant context, such as domain knowledge and external observations, is a key capability yet remains challenging for Bayesian optimisation (BO). Recently, practitioners have started to use large language models (LLMs) to generate and execute BO programs through coding harnesses. In such emerging practices, the posterior belief is shaped not only by Bayesian inference but also by LLM-generated model and data artefacts, offering a flexible route for task context to enter BO as executable code. To study whether and how LLMs can be harnessed to compile diverse contextual signals for BO, we formulate LLM-compiled BO as generalised-context decision making. We propose HarBO, a BO-specialised harness that compiles generalised context into the core artefacts of standard BO through a validated multi-stage workflow. Our theory analyses the regret under imperfect compilation and the effect of adding new context. Across synthetic functions and real-world benchmarks, we find that LLM harnesses can effectively compile context into standard BO, achieving competitive performance with specialised LLM-embedding-based and direct LLM-in-the-loop BO methods. General coding harnesses can be effective in familiar domains such as hyperparameter optimisation, but fall short in unfamiliar, context-rich domains. Together, these results establish LLM harnesses as a promising, but not automatically reliable, route for making rich task context usable in BO.

title: GitHarness: Git Init Your Harness Working Memory for Perpetual User Requirements
summary: LLM-based agents increasingly collaborate with users on long-horizon tasks, accumulating evidence, code, and drafts through extensive search, reasoning, and execution. As users inspect these results, they may supply missing information requirement completion, introduce new requirements requirement elicitation, or revise existing ones requirement shift. These changes often affect only part of the accumulated work, yet agents may carry forward obsolete information or turn local revisions into global rewrites. Existing approaches clarify current intent without determining how prior work should change, or reuse execution histories under a fixed objective. We address this gap by formulating dynamic-requirement collaboration as joint requirement tracking and local update. We introduce GitHarness, a pluggable Git-style framework that organizes requirement states and their corresponding harness work states into a branchable version history. A trainable Git Agent resolves requirement changes and selects a semantically compatible historical state. A unified version interface then restores that state and creates a new branch, enabling the underlying harness to exclude obsolete information, inherit compatible work, and focus execution on affected parts. The Git Agent is trained through interface-level black-box reinforcement learning, with downstream harnesses and task-execution models kept fixed. We also construct MTAgentBench, a verifier-preserving benchmark covering mathematical reasoning, text-to-SQL, agentic search, software engineering, and research synthesis. Experiments demonstrate strong task performance alongside effective requirement tracking, preservation of valid work, and efficient execution.

title: Influence Ranking Improvement via Link Addition in Social Networks
summary: Social media platforms increasingly rely on influential users for information dissemination in domains such as marketing and political campaigns. As the value of being recognized as influential grows, users may have incentives to strategically enhance their influence. In this study, we investigate whether and to what extent the influence ranking of a target node can be improved by adding a limited number of outgoing links in the context of influence maximization (IM). We formulate the Link Selection Problem for Influence Ranking Improvement (LSP-IRI) as the problem of selecting a fixed-size set of additional outgoing links from a target node in order to maximize its rank improvement. To examine this problem, we consider two representative heuristic strategies: a greedy method that directly optimizes rank improvement and a computationally efficient random search method. We conduct experiments on four real-world networks ranging from thousands to hundreds of thousands of nodes. The results show that even a few added links can substantially improve IM-based influence rankings. In particular, the greedy method improves the ranks of nodes initially ranked around 50 by several tens of positions on average with only three added links, sometimes moving them into the top 10. The random search method achieves smaller gains under strict budgets but reduces computation time by up to approximately 98% compared with the greedy method and becomes effective when larger budgets are allowed. These findings show that IM-based influence rankings are sensitive to limited local structural modifications and highlight a trade-off between ranking improvement and computational efficiency.

title: Hard-Trace First-Order Residual Learning for Coupled Stokes-Brinkman-Darcy Flow
summary: Stokes-Brinkman-Darcy (SBD) models connect free flow and porous flow through a Brinkman layer of finite thickness. The proposed method for solving these coupled equations consists of a mixed first-order formulation, shared interface traces and hard traction constraints, and a pressure correction based on boundary mass balance. Independent stresses, Darcy flux and pressure-gradient auxiliaries avoid second derivatives of network outputs. Boundary liftings and shared traces impose exterior and interface kinematic conditions exactly, while a stress map enforces native Brinkman-Darcy force balance. An integral momentum relation determines the pressure correction after training, without reference-pressure labels. Across two manufactured solutions and three permeabilities, mean corrected upper-pressure relative $L^2$ errors range from 0.87% to 2.58%; correction reduces both upper-pressure $L^2$ errors and the full Brinkman-pressure $H^1$ error in every run. Paired controls assess the contributions of interface sharing and traction enforcement. A non-manufactured filtration problem tests mixed-boundary adaptation against an independently refined finite-element reference, with all four runs satisfying the prescribed field and physical-consistency criteria.

title: RAE-PPG: Duration-Grounded Retain-and-Extend Pretraining for PPG Foundation Models
summary: Signal features derived from photoplethysmography (PPG) require different signal durations to characterize. Existing PPG foundation models treat duration as a pretraining or evaluation condition rather than using the different durations required by PPG features to organize self-supervision. We hypothesize that self-supervision should expand with signal duration, allowing a single encoder to progressively acquire additional features while preserving and reusing earlier learning. We introduce Retain-and-Extend PPG (RAE-PPG), which trains a single Transformer encoder successively on 10 s, 30 s, and 240 s inputs, adding supervision for signal features supported by each longer observation. The encoder is partitioned into duration-specific parameter groups, allowing later stages to reuse earlier groups while updating only the group assigned to the current stage. Selected earlier targets are reused to supervise later stages, encouraging the corresponding features to remain accessible in longer-input representations. Direct decoding from the final encoder shows that earlier features remain recoverable from longer-input representations, while later-stage features show higher mean decoding performance at their introduction durations. Controlled comparisons further show that prior-stage learning provides a better basis for learning newly introduced features at both transitions. Across 18 tasks from eight datasets, the final frozen encoder achieves the best observed score on 12 tasks compared with five existing PPG foundation models.

title: Epistemic Typing as a PostgreSQL Table Access Method: Adversarial Conflict Resolution Under Confidence Forgery and Sybil Coordination
comments: 13 pages, 1 figure. Under review at PVLDB Volume 20. Code and benchmark artifacts: https://github.com/emailvenkatm/kndb (branch postgres-experiment)
summary: We describe KNDB, a PostgreSQL 18 table access method (TAM) that types every row with an engine-assigned epistemic kind (MEASURED, INFERRED, or DERIVED) and resolves per-slot conflicts inside every write-time heapam callback. Rows land as ordinary heap tuples; seven of the 44 TAM callbacks are overridden (tuple_insert, multi_insert, tuple_update, tuple_delete, tuple_insert_speculative, tuple_complete_speculative, relation_toast_am), the other 37 delegate to heap; we provide a completeness argument over the interface as a paper artefact. This paper reports the engineering behind that decision and the adversarial evaluation that motivated it. On a confidence-forgery workload where an attacker asserts INFERRED writes with confidence in [0.95,1.0] against honest MEASURED writes with confidence in [0.5,0.9], KNDB beats a confidence-only baseline by 63 percentage points on the Book-Author fusion dataset and 92.7 points on the Zheng crowdsourcing dataset. Both wins are proven load-bearing on the kind axis by a source-rebuild disable-and-test in which the lattice is neutralised and the win vanishes. Against four truth-discovery baselines (TruthFinder, CRH, CATD, ACCU) reimplemented from the original equations and validated to within 0.3 percentage points of the published numbers, KNDB is competitive below a per-dataset density-saturation cell and dominant at or above it. We formalise the cell as k* ~ rho_alg * h_top, where h_top is per-slot top honest surface-form support, and validate the prediction within +/-20% on Book-Author and +/-30% on Zheng. Because the kind axis is assigned by the engine from independent metadata and cannot be forged at write time, KNDB's k* is unbounded. The paper is honest about where KNDB loses: CRH and ACCU outperform KNDB below saturation on Zheng, and KNDB scores zero on three temporal knowledge-editing benchmarks whose ground truth is last-writer-wins.

title: Where Does Randomness Matter in Neural Cellular Automata?
summary: Stochastic cell updates are often used throughout the life of a neural cellular automaton (NCA), from backpropagation through time to final rollout. This leaves two questions entangled: does update randomness help learn a useful rule, and must that randomness remain at execution? We separate training and evaluation update modes in controlled Growing NCA experiments, then vary the states shown during training. Under the standard constant-rate persist recipe, asynchronous training passes the short-horizon quality test in 10/10 runs, compared with 3/10 synchronous runs. All ten asynchronous models also retain the target for 4,096 steps under deterministic evaluation. For a scalar translation-invariant lattice, we derive an exact mean-square criterion: random masking can damp mean modes, but it also injects variance, and a mean-only test misclassifies four non-marginal settings. Finally, among 30 models that all pass the same reconstruction test, eight of ten grow-trained models become off-target at 4,096 steps, while all persist and regenerate models retain the target; damage recovery separates persist from regenerate. The results distinguish optimization reliability, execution mode, and task-specific behavior instead of treating them as one stability property.

title: Seeing What Should Be Heard: Diagnosing and Repairing Cross-Modal Shortcuts in Omni-Modal LLMs
summary: Omni-modal large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer a question using the modality it explicitly refers to. However, existing training paradigms rarely verify whether models actually follow this modality, because multimodal inputs from the same sample often provide redundant evidence for the same answer. In this work, we uncover a pervasive cross-modal shortcut in omni-modal LLMs: when asked an audio-related question, models rely on the image as much as on the audio, and sometimes even more. To systematically diagnose this behavior, we introduce the Factorized Modality Diagnostic, which independently swaps audio and images between samples to isolate each modality's causal contribution. Across two model families in different settings, we find that this shortcut persists throughout supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning post-training, while judge-based RL may further amplify such reliance on irrelevant visual information. Based on this finding, we propose DMC-Repair, which trains models on the same kind of cross-modal swapped samples while assigning supervision according to the modality specified by the question. This prevents models from exploiting the spurious correspondence between modalities within the same clip. Experiments demonstrate that DMC-Repair reduces the image-induced share of the answer effect by 59.9%, effectively suppressing the cross-modal shortcut without compromising audio-question answering performance. The reduction in shortcut reliance generalizes across two model families and zero-shot to an unseen dataset and an unseen benchmark, and persists through subsequent post-training. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DMC-Repair.
