AI.title_translation: LLM代理社会中的局部可预测性与集体保真度
AI.tldr: 本研究发现邻居信息能提升LLM代理社会的个体与集体预测准确性，但集体收益和历史效应取决于具体条件，凸显了直接集体验证的重要性。
AI.motivation: 紧凑的替代模型虽然可以降低模拟大型语言模型社会的成本，但前提是它们必须能够准确重现集体行为。
AI.method: 对比了9455条已发表的轨迹和关于意见动力学的新实验，评估了各个设置下的个体预测和集体预测。
AI.result: 邻居信息在所有16个公共数据设置中均提升了个体预测能力，并在保留问题上改善了汇总的集体预测，但集体收益取决于迁移条件。针对24个新陈述的测试未证实早期研究中关于初始状态预测的对比历史效应，但Qwen模型在观察三轮后受益于历史信息。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明邻居信息能够改善个体预测和集体预测，但集体收益取决于迁移条件；同时，历史效应对初始状态预测的影响因模型和观察轮次而异。
AI.translation: 紧凑的替代模型可以降低模拟大型语言模型（LLM）社会成本，但必须重现集体行为。我们利用9,455条已发表的轨迹和关于意见动力学的新实验，对比了个体预测与集体预测。邻居信息在所有16个公共数据设置中均改善了个体预测，并在保留问题上提升了汇总的集体预测，尽管集体收益取决于迁移条件。对24个新陈述的测试并未证实早期关于初始状态预测的对比历史效应。Qwen在观察三轮后受益于历史信息。这些发现促使我们进行直接的集体验证、对可用观测施加显式限制，并与简单基线进行比较。
AI.summary: 该论文探讨了如何利用紧凑替代模型模拟LLM代理社会，发现引入邻居信息能够有效提升个体预测和集体预测的准确性，但集体收益受迁移条件制约，历史效应也表现出模型和观察轮次的依赖性，强调了直接集体验证的必要性。
AI.keywords: LLM-Agent社会, 局部可预测性, 集体保真度, 意见动力学, 模拟成本
AI.comments: 本文研究了LLM代理社会中的局部可预测性和集体保真度，指出了紧凑替代模型在减少模拟成本方面的潜力与挑战，强调了直接进行集体验证和对比简单基线的重要性。

title: Meta-learning accelerates detector design optimization
summary: The quality of a detector design is ultimately determined by the quality of the inference it enables, that is, by the accuracy with which the quantities of interest are reconstructed from the raw detector response. For complex detectors, the inference is performed by machine learning models, and the relation between the design and the attainable inference performance is, in general, non-trivial. In this work, we consider the optimization of the inference performance with respect to the detector design. The conventional approach prescribes retraining the inference model at every candidate design, thus, treating the evaluations as independent tasks and discarding the shared structure of the optimal inference algorithms at different designs. We propose the meta-learned objective estimate (MLOE): instead of solving the inference problem anew at every candidate design, a single meta-inference model, conditioned on the design and trained continually along the optimization path, is shared across all of them. We test MLOE on three families of optimization problems, the last of which comprises two design spaces of the Spectrometer Straw Tracker of the Search for Hidden Particles (SHiP) experiment; under matched budgets of simulation calls, the meta-inference model evaluates a candidate design using fewer simulation calls than the baseline strategies and holds the better rank over the convergence curve in all examined cases.

AI.title_translation: 元学习加速探测器设计优化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于元学习的目标估计（MLOE）方法，通过共享条件化元推理模型，显著加速了复杂探测器设计的优化过程。
AI.motivation: 传统探测器设计优化方法在每个候选设计处都需要重新训练推理模型，这把每次评估当作独立任务处理，从而忽略了不同设计下最优推理算法所共享的结构，导致计算效率低下。
AI.method: 提出元学习目标估计（MLOE），利用一个以设计为条件并在优化路径上持续训练的单一元推理模型，在所有候选设计之间共享，避免了为每个候选设计从头训练推理模型。
AI.result: 在三个优化问题家族（包括SHiP实验的谱仪丝状径迹探测器设计空间）上的测试表明，在匹配的模拟调用预算下，MLOE比基线策略用更少的模拟调用评估候选设计，并在所有测试案例的收敛曲线上保持更好的排名。
AI.conclusion: 元学习目标估计（MLOE）能够有效加速探测器设计优化，在相同模拟预算下比基线策略表现出更高的评估效率和更好的收敛性能。
AI.translation: 探测器设计的质量最终取决于它所支持的推理质量，即从原始探测器响应中重建目标量的准确性。对于复杂的探测器，推理是通过机器学习模型进行的，设计与可获得的推理性能之间的关系通常是非显而易见的。在这项工作中，我们考虑针对探测器设计的推理性能优化。传统方法要求在每个候选设计处重新训练推理模型，从而将评估视为独立任务，并丢弃了不同设计下最优推理算法的共享结构。我们提出了元学习目标估计（MLOE）：不是在每个候选设计处重新以新方法解决推理问题，而是在所有候选设计之间共享一个单一的元推理模型，该模型以设计为条件，并沿优化路径持续训练。我们在三个优化问题家族上测试了MLOE，其中最后一个问题包含“寻找隐藏粒子”（SHiP）实验的分光仪丝状径迹探测器的两个设计空间；在匹配的模拟调用预算下，元推理模型评估候选设计所需的模拟调用比基线策略少，并且在所有检查的案例中在收敛曲线上保持更好的排名。
AI.summary: 本文提出了元学习目标估计（MLOE）方法来加速探测器设计优化。通过引入一个在所有候选设计间共享的条件化元推理模型，避免了传统方法中对每个候选设计重复训练的低效性，实验证明该方法在多项任务中均能以更少的模拟调用实现更好的收敛性能。
AI.keywords: 元学习, 探测器设计优化, 机器学习推理, SHiP实验
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的基于元学习的目标估计方法（MLOE），解决了复杂探测器设计优化中传统方法需要为每个候选设计重新训练推理模型的计算瓶颈，显著提高了优化效率和性能。

title: Matrix-Vector Complexity of Low-Rank Approximation
summary: We establish matching polynomial query bounds for low-rank approximation from exact matrix--vector products. Given an unknown matrix $A\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$, at each step a randomized algorithm chooses either $v\in\mathbb{R}^n$ and receives $Av$, or $u\in\mathbb{R}^m$ and receives $A^\top u$. The choice may depend measurably on all previous queries and replies and on the algorithm's private randomness; each vector product costs one query. The output is a rank-$k$ right projector with Schatten-$p$ residual at most $1+\varepsilon$ times optimal. Write $N=\min\{m,n\}$ and let $Q_p^*$ denote the worst-case query budget for success probability $2/3$ on every input. For every $1\le k<N$ and sufficiently small $\varepsilon$, our lower bounds, combined with existing Krylov upper bounds, give $Q_p^*=\widetildeΘ\!\left(\min\{N,k\min\{p^{1/6}\varepsilon^{-1/3},\varepsilon^{-1/2}\}\}\right)$ $(2\le p<\infty)$, $Q_\infty^*=\widetildeΘ\!\left(\min\{N,k\varepsilon^{-1/2}\}\right)$. These bounds have universal constants and allow $p$ to vary with the problem parameters, identifying the transition at $p\varepsilon\asymp1$. A complementary result for each fixed $1\le p<2$ gives $\widetildeΘ_p(\min\{N,k\varepsilon^{-1/3}\})$, with constants and an accuracy threshold that may depend on $p$. Together, the results recover this fixed-norm rate for every fixed finite $p$, supplying the multiplicative rank dependence missing from previous lower bounds. Tildes suppress logarithmic factors. The proof extends adaptive Wishart deferred decisions to a rectangular factor with a $k$-dimensional nullspace. Posterior overlap gives a short fixed-norm argument, while persistence of small compression eigenvalues controls growing $p$ and the spectral endpoint. Exact range recovery handles target costs of order $k$; the Wishart family covers the remaining regimes.

AI.title_translation: 低秩近似的矩阵-向量复杂度
AI.tldr: 本文建立了低秩近似在精确矩阵-向量乘积下的匹配多项式查询界限，全面厘清了不同范数和精度要求下的复杂性。
AI.motivation: 为了确定低秩近似从精确矩阵-向量乘积出发的最坏情况查询预算（即矩阵-向量复杂度），并解决以往下界中缺失的乘性秩依赖性问题。
AI.method: 利用随机算法选择向量进行矩阵-向量乘积查询，将适应性Wishart推迟决策扩展到具有$k$维零空间的矩形因子，结合后验重叠和压缩特征值的持久性来控制不断增长的$p$和谱端点。
AI.result: 给出了不同$p$值和误差参数下精确的$\widetilde{\Theta}$查询界限，识别了$p\varepsilon \asymp 1$处的转变，并补充了固定$1 \le p < 2$时的互补结果，从而恢复了每个固定有限$p$的固定范数速率。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过建立匹配的多项式查询界限，彻底搞清了低秩近似在精确矩阵-向量乘积下的复杂性，厘清了不同范数和参数下的转换规律。
AI.translation: 我们建立了从精确矩阵-向量乘积进行低秩近似的匹配多项式查询界限。给定一个未知矩阵 $A\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$，在每一步中，随机算法选择 $v\in\mathbb{R}^n$ 并接收 $Av$，或者选择 $u\in\mathbb{R}^m$ 并接收 $A^\top u$。该选择可以根据之前所有的查询和响应以及算法的私有随机性来进行；每个向量乘积消耗一个查询。输出是一个秩为 $k$ 的右投影算子，其 Schatten-$p$ 残差至多为最优值的 $1+\varepsilon$ 倍。记 $N=\min\{m,n\}$，设 $Q_p^*$ 表示在每个输入上成功概率为 $2/3$ 的最坏情况查询预算。对于每个 $1\le k<N$ 且足够小的 $\varepsilon$，我们的下界结合现有的Krylov上界，给出了 $Q_p^*=\widetildeΘ\!\left(\min\{N,k\min\{p^{1/6}\varepsilon^{-1/3},\varepsilon^{-1/2}\}\}\right)$ $(2\le p<\infty)$，以及 $Q_\infty^*=\widetildeΘ\!\left(\min\{N,k\varepsilon^{-1/2}\}\right)$。这些界限具有通用常数，并允许 $p$ 随问题参数变化，识别出 $p\varepsilon\asymp1$ 处的转变。针对每个固定的 $1\le p<2$ 的互补结果给出了 $\widetildeΘ_p(\min\{N,k\varepsilon^{-1/3}\})$，其常数和精度阈值可能取决于 $p$。总之，这些结果为每个固定的有限 $p$ 恢复了这种固定范数速率，提供了先前下界所缺少的乘性秩依赖性。微tilde符号抑制了对数因子。证明将自适应Wishart推迟决策扩展到具有 $k$ 维零空间的矩形因子。后验重叠给出了一个简短的固定范数论证，而小压缩特征值的持久性控制了增长的 $p$ 和谱端点。精确的范围恢复处理了 $k$ 阶的目标成本；Wishart族则覆盖了其余的方案。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了从精确矩阵-向量乘积进行低秩近似的查询复杂度，建立了匹配的多项式查询界限，明确了在不同Schatten-p范数和精度要求下的最坏情况查询预算，填补了先前理论中乘性秩依赖性的空白。
AI.keywords: 低秩近似, 矩阵-向量复杂度, 查询界限, 随机算法,  Schatten范数
AI.comments: 该论文在低秩近似的矩阵-向量复杂度方面取得了突破性进展，建立了匹配的多项式查询界限，填补了以往下界中缺失的乘性秩依赖性，对理论计算机科学和数值线性代数领域具有重要意义。

title: Crown graphs maximise the representation number of bipartite graphs
summary: The representation number of a graph is the least positive integer $k$ for which its vertices can be arranged in a word, each occurring $k$ times, so that two distinct letters alternate precisely when the corresponding vertices are adjacent. We prove that every bipartite graph on $N\ge9$ vertices has representation number at most $\lceil N/4\rceil$. Together with the known representation number of crown graphs, this settles the conjecture that crowns maximise the representation number among bipartite graphs of the same order. The proof develops a construction of Mozhui and Krishna by reducing the choice of a representing word to an ordering problem for neighbourhoods. We characterise the obstructions to this ordering and use probability estimates to exclude them for all sufficiently large balanced bipartitions. Two finite assertions complete the argument, each established by a checked Boolean unsatisfiability certificate. A refinement of the ordering argument treats the remaining odd part sizes directly. The main theorem and the crown-extremality corollary, including the finite certificate arguments, have also been formalised and verified in Lean 4.

AI.title_translation: 冠图最大化了二分图的表示数
AI.tldr: 本文证明了冠图在同阶二分图中具有最大的表示数，并使用 Lean 4 对该定理进行了形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 解决关于二分图表示数的长期猜想，即验证冠图是否在同阶二分图中具有最大的表示数。
AI.method: 通过将代表词的选择归约为邻域的排序问题，利用概率估计排除阻碍，并通过布尔不可满足性证书处理有限断言，最后在 Lean 4 中完成了形式化验证。
AI.result: 证明了顶点数 $N \ge 9$ 的每个二分图的表示数至多为 $\lceil N/4\rceil$，进而证实了冠图在同阶二分图中使表示数最大化的猜想。
AI.conclusion: 证明了冠图（crown graphs）在相同阶数的二分图具有最大的表示数，从而解决了该领域的猜想，并且该工作已被 Lean 4 完全形式化和验证。
AI.translation: 图的表示数是使得其顶点可以排成一个单词（每个顶点出现 $k$ 次）的最小正 integer $k$，从而使得当且仅当对应的顶点相邻时，两个不同的字母恰好交替出现。我们证明了每个具有 $N \ge 9$ 个顶点的二分图的表示数至多为 $\lceil N/4\rceil$。结合已知的冠图表示数，这解决了关于冠图在同阶二分图中使表示数最大化的猜想。该证明通过将代表词的选择归约为邻域的排序问题，发展了 Mozhui 和 Krishna 的一种构造。我们刻画了这种排序的阻碍，并使用概率估计在所有足够大的平衡二分中排除它们。两个有限断言完成了论证，每个断言都由经过检查的布尔不可满足性证书确立。排序论证的细化直接处理了其余的奇数部分大小。主要定理和冠极值推论（包括有限证书论证）也已在 Lean 4 中形式化并得到了验证。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了二分图的表示数，证明了顶点数 $N \ge 9$ 的二分图表示数至多为 $\lceil N/4\rceil$，从而证实了冠图在同阶二分图中使表示数最大化的猜想。该证明结合了组合构造、概率方法、计算机辅助验证以及 Lean 4 形式化。
AI.keywords: 图论, 表示数, 二分图, 冠图, 形式化证明
AI.comments: 该论文结合了图论中的极值问题、概率估计、计算机辅助验证（Boolean unsatisfiability certificates）以及 Lean 4 形式化证明，展示了现代数学研究的多样性和严谨性。

title: Beyond Discrimination: Calibrated Geoprior Fusion for Bioacoustic Monitoring
summary: Modern bioacoustic foundation models like Perch and BirdNET can identify species with high discriminative accuracy, yet their confidence scores are often uncalibrated and difficult to interpret as probabilities of real-world occurrence. This limits their use for ecological inference beyond threshold-based detection. We leverage a global annotated acoustic dataset (WABAD) to produce calibration priors for an acoustic model, optionally incorporating species-level information. We introduce new methods of fusing the acoustic predictions with geopriors, which empirically improves calibration while preserving discrimination. Together, these results suggest a path to simpler and more reliable acoustic monitoring for broad biodiversity.

AI.title_translation: 超越判别：面向生物声学监测的校准地理先验融合
AI.tldr: 通过将地理先验与声学预测进行校准融合，解决了生物声学模型置信度不可靠的问题，从而实现了更准确的生态监测。
AI.motivation: 现代生物声学基础模型虽然具有很高的判别准确率，但其置信度分数往往未经校准，难以解释为现实世界中的发生概率，从而限制了其在生态推断中的应用。
AI.method: 利用全球标注声学数据集（WABAD）生成声学校准先验，并引入新的方法将声学预测结果与地理先验进行融合。
AI.result: 实验表明，新提出的声学预测与地理先验融合方法在保持判别准确率的同时，显著改善了模型的校准性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将全球声学数据集与地理先验相融合，该研究成功提升了生物声学模型置信度的校准能力，且不损失区分准确度，为实现更简单、更可靠的生态监测铺平了道路。
AI.translation: 现代生物声学基础模型（如Perch和BirdNET）能够以高判别准确率识别物种，然而它们的置信度分数通常未经校准，难以被解释为现实世界中物种出现的概率。这限制了它们在超越基于阈值检测的生态学推断中的应用。我们利用全球标注的声学数据集（WABAD）为声学模型生成校准先验，并可选择性地结合物种级信息。我们引入了将声学预测与地理先验相融合的新方法，在保持判别能力的同时，经验性地改善了模型校准。这些结果共同表明了一条通向更简单、更可靠的生物多样性声学监测的发展路径。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种通过校准地理先验融合来改进生物声学监测的方法，利用全球声学数据集（WABAD）将声学预测与地理先验相结合，在保持模型判别准确性的同时显著提升了置信度校准能力。
AI.keywords: 生物声学监测, 地理先验融合, 模型校准, 生物多样性, 基础模型
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将生物声学模型的分类预测与地理先验（geoprior）进行校准融合，解决了现有基础模型（如Perch和BirdNET）置信度分数无法准确转化为现实发生概率的痛点，对生态学推断和大规模生物多样性监测具有重要意义。

title: BarcodeMAE+: Rethinking Masked Pretraining and Global Representations for DNA Barcode Foundation Models
summary: Many DNA foundation models are pretrained by masking parts of a sequence and asking the model to reconstruct them. Standard masked pretraining exposes the encoder to special [MASK] tokens that are absent at inference, creating a mismatch between training and downstream use. The role of an explicit global sequence representation such as a [CLS] token and how it should be trained also remain poorly understood for DNA barcodes. We introduce BarcodeMAE+ and study model architecture, global [CLS] representation, and auxiliary pretraining objectives across arthropod COI (BIOSCAN-5M) and fungal ITS (UNITE+INSD) barcodes. Across both barcode regions, the encoder-decoder MAE-LM architecture outperforms its matched encoder-only counterpart in nearly all evaluated configurations, supporting MAE-LM as an effective architectural design for DNA barcode foundation models. A trained global [CLS] representation provides substantial additional gains: on BIOSCAN-5M, [CLS] accuracy increases from 47.53% without an auxiliary objective to 80.65% with cross-entropy genus classification. The best auxiliary objective is region-dependent: cross-entropy performs best on BIOSCAN-5M, whereas pairwise same-genus classification performs best on UNITE+INSD, reaching 73.19% on Yeast and 63.07% on Filamentous Fungi. BarcodeMAE+ outperforms published DNA foundation model baselines on BIOSCAN-5M and achieves the highest Yeast accuracy among the evaluated UNITE+INSD baselines using frozen encoder representations. Similarity-weighted softmax KNN voting further stabilizes accuracy as neighbourhood size increases. Overall, encoder-decoder masked pretraining and an explicitly trained global representation are strong design choices for DNA barcode foundation models, while the optimal objective for learning that representation depends on the biological domain.

AI.title_translation: BarcodeMAE+：重新思考DNA条形码基础模型的掩码预训练与全局表征
AI.tldr: BarcodeMAE+通过改进掩码预训练架构与全局表征学习，显著提升了DNA条形码基础模型的物种分类性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的DNA基础模型掩码预训练存在训练与推理时的[MASK]标记不匹配问题，且DNA条形码中显式全局序列表征（如[CLS]标记）的作用和训练方式尚不明确。
AI.method: 引入BarcodeMAE+框架，研究模型架构、全局[CLS]表征以及跨节肢动物COI和真菌ITS条形码的辅助预训练目标，并采用相似度加权softmax KNN投票来稳定准确率。
AI.result: 编码器-decoder MAE-LM架构优于编码器-only对应架构；通过交叉熵等辅助目标训练的全局[CLS]表征带来了显著的性能提升；BarcodeMAE+超越了现有的DNA基础模型基线。
AI.conclusion: 编码器-解码器掩码预训练与显式训练的全局表征是DNA条形码基础模型的强大设计选择，而学习该表征的最佳辅助目标则取决于生物学领域。
AI.translation: 许多DNA基础模型通过掩盖序列的一部分并要求模型进行重建来预训练。标准的掩码预训练使编码器暴露于在推理时不存在的特殊[MASK]标记中，造成了训练和下游使用之间的不匹配。对于DNA条形码而言，诸如[CLS]标记之类的显式全局序列表征的作用以及它应该如何训练仍然缺乏深入理解。我们引入了BarcodeMAE+，并在节肢动物COI（BIOSCAN-5M）和真菌ITS（UNITE+INSD）条形码上研究了模型架构、全局[CLS]表征以及辅助预训练目标。在两个条形码区域中，编码器-解码器MAE-LM架构在几乎所有评估配置中都优于与其匹配的纯编码器对应架构，证明了MAE-LM是DNA条形码基础模型的一种有效架构设计。经过训练的全局[CLS]表征提供了显著的额外增益：在BIOSCAN-5M上，[CLS]准确率从没有辅助目标的47.53%提高到采用交叉熵属分类的80.65%。最佳辅助目标具有区域依赖性：交叉熵在BIOSCAN-5M上表现最好，而成对同属分类在UNITE+INSD上表现最好，在酵母菌上达到73.19%，在丝状真菌上达到63.07%。BarcodeMAE+在BIOSCAN-5M上优于已发表的DNA基础模型基线，并在使用冻结编码器表征时在评估的UNITE+INSD基线中实现了最高的酵母菌准确率。相似度加权的softmax KNN投票进一步稳定了随着邻域大小增加时的准确率。总体而言，编码器-解码器掩码预训练和显式训练的全局表征是DNA条形码基础模型的强大设计选择，而学习该表征的最佳目标取决于生物学领域。
AI.summary: 本文提出了BarcodeMAE+，通过重新思考DNA条形码基础模型的掩码预训练和全局表征，证明了编码器-解码器架构和精心设计的全局辅助预训练目标能够显著提升物种分类等下游任务的性能。
AI.keywords: DNA条形码, 基础模型, 掩码自编码器, 全局表征, 生物信息学
AI.comments: 本文针对DNA条形码基础模型，深入探讨了掩码预训练中的分布偏移问题以及全局表征（如[CLS]标记）的作用。BarcodeMAE+通过采用编码器-解码器架构并配合经过良好训练的全局辅助任务，在多个数据集上取得了显著的性能提升，对生物多样性监测和物种鉴定具有重要意义。

title: Wasserstein Causal Forests for Distribution-Valued Outcomes
summary: This paper proposes Wasserstein Causal Forests (WCF) for settings in which each unit's outcome is itself a probability distribution. This study also defines finite-grid transformed average and conditional average treatment effects, including a reference-distance contrast that asks whether treatment moves unit-level distributions toward a prespecified benchmark. Simulations cover null effects, location and shape changes, limited overlap, equal-mean but different laws, heterogeneous effects, multimodality, and structural zeros. WCF is most accurate on the conditional-law metric in most reported designs and sharply improves reference-effect estimation in the principal location-and-shape settings, but it is less accurate than the forest baselines for multimodal settings. WCF is applied to the famous Project STAR \citep{word1990state}, revealing that small classes alter more than the mean: they raise within-grade mathematics achievement by $0.161$ standard deviations on average (SE $0.028$); but the gain is not a uniform location shift, it is larger in the upper part of the classroom score distribution ($+0.179$ at the ninetieth percentile versus $+0.091$ at the tenth) and, in descriptive stratum estimates, largest in the schools serving the most economically disadvantaged students (highest free-lunch quartile, $+0.262$, versus $+0.092$ to $+0.164$ elsewhere), while overall dispersion is essentially unchanged.

AI.title_translation: 用于分布值结果的Wasserstein因果森林
AI.tldr: 本文提出了Wasserstein Causal Forests，用于估计和分析结果为概率分布时的异质性因果效应。
AI.motivation: 传统因果推断方法主要关注标量结果，无法满足当每个单元的结果本身是一个概率分布（分布值结果）时的建模和异质性处理效应分析需求。
AI.method: 提出了 Wasserstein Causal Forests (WCF) 方法，定义了有限网格变换的平均和条件平均处理效应，并结合了参考距离对比（reference-distance contrast）。
AI.result: 模拟表明WCF在条件律指标上准确度最高，显著改善了基准位置和形状设置下的参考效应估计，但在多峰设置下不如传统的森林基线。在Project STAR的应用中发现小班教学不仅提高平均数学成绩，且对成绩分布的上层影响更大，对经济弱势学生的增益最大。
AI.conclusion: Wasserstein Causal Forests (WCF) 能够有效估计分布值结果的因果效应，揭示传统均值分析所忽略的分布异质性（如Project STAR数据中的分位数差异和贫困学校的显著增益）。
AI.translation: 本文提出了Wasserstein因果森林（WCF），适用于每个单元的结果本身为概率分布的情景。本研究还定义了有限网格转换的平均和条件平均处理效应，包括一个参考距离对比，用于探究处理是否将单元级分布推向预先指定的基准。模拟涵盖了零效应、位置和形状变化、有限重叠、均值相等但规律不同、异质效应、多峰性和结构零点。WCF在多数报告设计的条件律度量上最准确，并显著改进了主要位置和形状设置下的参考效应估计，但在多峰设置下的准确度低于森林基线。WCF被应用于著名的Project STAR项目，结果显示小班授课不仅改变了均值：它们使年级内数学成绩平均提高了0.161个标准差（标准误0.028）；但这种收益并非一致的位置平移，在课堂成绩分布的上半部分更大（第90百分位为+0.179，第10百分位为+0.091），并且在描述性分层估计中，在服务于经济最弱势学生的学校中最大（最高免费午餐四分位数处为+0.262，而其他地方为+0.092到+0.164），而总体离散度基本保持不变。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Wasserstein Causal Forests (WCF)，用于处理结果为概率分布的因果推断问题。该方法定义了新的平均和条件平均处理效应及参考距离对比。模拟和Project STAR教育数据集的应用证明了其在捕捉分布异质性方面的有效性和准确性。
AI.keywords: Wasserstein Causal Forests, Distribution-Valued Outcomes, Causal Inference, Treatment Effects, Project STAR
AI.comments: 该论文提出了Wasserstein Causal Forests (WCF)方法，将因果推断扩展到了结果为概率分布的复杂场景，并在Project STAR数据集上得到了有意义的应用。其创新在于利用Wasserstein距离处理分布型结果的异质性处理效应，但在多峰分布场景下性能有待提高。

title: Reconstructing Implicit Scientific Knowledge: Evaluating LLM Agents through End-to-End Reproduction of Astronomy
summary: The integration of large language models (LLMs) into scientific workflows is accelerating, yet their ability to reconstruct the reasoning underlying published research remains unexplored. Papers specify explicit procedures while leaving many methodological dependencies-data selection, calibration corrections, priors, and domain assumptions-implicit. This ambiguity complicates the evaluation of LLM-based agents, since a failure to reproduce a result may reflect either limitations of the agent or underspecification in the source. We present a framework that evaluates agents through end-to-end reproduction, separating execution from verification and computational failure from methodological ambiguity. We apply it to fourteen astronomy studies: a case study from The Astrophysical Journal and thirteen papers published in Nature. Eleven of the thirteen contained an ambiguity preventing a uniquely specified reproduction path. In a controlled case study, twelve predefined paths, a 3x2x2 sensitivity analysis over sample definition, sky masking, and parallax zero-point treatment-gave estimates from 2.16 to 3.53 kpc for the same quantity, with only one recovering the published value (about 2.70 kpc). The published value was never used as an optimization target, selection criterion, or stopping condition; the matching path was found only after all twelve had run. Crucially, the decisive information (a +0.02 mas parallax zero-point correction) was already in the paper, but the agents did not recognize its causal relevance until the analysis made the effect visible. Matching a published outcome therefore does not validate reconstruction of the underlying reasoning, and the bottleneck is as often a failure to connect relevant information as to retrieve it. End-to-end reproduction thus serves both as a test of reproducibility and as a framework for evaluating implicit scientific knowledge in AI systems.

AI.title_translation: 重构隐式科学知识：通过天文学的端到端复现评估LLM智能体
AI.tldr: 该研究通过天文学论文的端到端复现，评估了LLM智能体处理隐式科学知识的能力，发现科学文献中的方法学歧义是AI复现的主要障碍。
AI.motivation: 科学论文通常只明确规定程序，而将许多方法学依赖项（如数据选择、校准修正、先验知识和领域假设）保持隐式，这使得评估基于LLM的科学智能体变得复杂，因为复现失败可能源于智能体局限性或源文本的未明确性。
AI.method: 提出一个端到端复现的评估框架，将执行与验证、计算失败与方法学歧义分离，并将其应用于14项天文学研究（1篇《天体物理学杂志》案例研究和13篇《自然》杂志论文）。
AI.result: 13篇《Nature》论文中有11篇包含阻止唯一指定复现路径的歧义；受控案例研究的12条预定义路径给出了从2.16到3.53 kpc的不同估计值，只有一条恢复了已发表的值（约2.70 kpc），且决定性的视差零点修正信息原本就存在于论文中，但智能体未能认识到其因果相关性。
AI.conclusion: 端到端复现既是检验科学可重复性的手段，也是评估AI系统中隐式科学知识的有效框架。研究表明，匹配已发表的结果并不一定验证了底层推理的重建，瓶颈往往在于连接相关信息而非检索信息。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）在科学工作流中的集成正在加速，然而它们重构已发表研究背后推理的能力仍未得到探索。论文指定了显式程序，同时留下许多方法学依赖项——数据选择、校准校正、先验和领域假设——保持隐式。这种歧义使基于LLM的智能体的评估变得复杂，因为未能复现结果可能反映了智能体的局限性，或者是源文本中的未明确性。我们提出了一个通过端到端复现来评估智能体的框架，将执行与验证、计算失败与方法学歧义分离。我们将其应用于十四项天文学研究：《天体物理学杂志》的一项案例研究和发表在《自然》杂志上的十三篇论文。十三篇中有十一篇包含阻止唯一指定复现路径的歧义。在对照案例研究中，十二条预定义路径（对样本定义、天空遮罩和视差零点处理进行3x2x2灵敏度分析）对同一数量给出了从2.16到3.53 kpc的估计值，其中只有一条恢复了发表值（约2.70 kpc）。已发表的值从未用作优化目标、选择标准或停止条件；匹配的路径仅在所有十二条路径运行后才被发现。至关重要的是，决定性信息（+0.02 mas视差零点校正）已经在论文中，但在分析使效果可见之前，智能体并未认识到其因果相关性。因此，匹配已发表的结果并不能验证底层推理的重构，瓶颈往往在于连接相关信息，正如检索它一样。因此，端到端复现既是可重复性的测试，也是评估AI系统中隐式科学知识的框架。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通过端到端天文学研究复现来评估大语言模型智能体隐式科学知识的框架。研究发现，科学论文中普遍存在的隐式方法学歧义是AI复现的巨大瓶颈，且单纯匹配已发表结果并不能证明AI成功重建了底层推理。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型智能体, 科学复现, 隐式科学知识, 天文学, 方法学歧义
AI.comments: 该论文新颖地提出了一种通过端到端天文学论文复现来评估大语言模型（LLM）智能体隐式科学知识的方法。研究揭示了科学文献中普遍存在的隐式方法学歧义，对于评估AI在科学发现中的真实推理能力具有重要启示。

title: Solver Agent: an Agentic AI Framework for Theoretical Physics Computations Applied to F-theory Uplifts of O3-planes and S-folds
comments: Comments: 85 pages + appendices. Solver Agent is available in https://github.com/starrfree/solver-agent. Sessions for reproducibility are available in https://storage.googleapis.com/solver-agent-sessions/solver-agent-f-theory-uplifts/index.html. Further codes in https://github.com/alexmininno/orientifold_databases
summary: We introduce Solver Agent, an AI framework based on large language models for calculations and proofs in mathematics and theoretical physics. The solution process is tracked through a persistent ledger that records assumptions, derivations, and computations. A central agent delegates tasks to specialized sub-agents, while independent agents verify both intermediate steps and the final result. This setup improves the traceability, reproducibility, and verification of computer-assisted calculations. Applying Solver Agent, we study global F-theory uplifts of Type IIB orientifolds and their S-fold generalizations. We establish sufficient conditions for Weierstrass models over projective threefolds with terminal $\mathbb{Z}_k$ quotient singularities ($k\in\{2,3,4,6\}$) to give $\mathbb{Q}$-factorial projective elliptically fibered Calabi-Yau fourfolds with isolated Gorenstein terminal quotient singularities. These geometries realize O3-planes and S-folds, where local D3-brane probes of the latter yield four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=3$ superconformal field theories. Using stringy invariants, we derive fixed-point contributions to Hodge data and Euler characteristics, and show that these Euler corrections determine the localized D3-brane charges required for tadpole cancellation. We illustrate these results using toric hypersurface constructions, where a single three-dimensional polytope determines both the Type IIB Calabi-Yau threefold and the F-theory base; here, the orientifold double cover naturally forms a bisection of an alternative genus-one-fibered uplift with discrete $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge symmetry. Finally, we provide methods for toric computations and four-form flux analysis in four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ compactifications with non-abelian gauge sectors.
comment: Comments: 85 pages + appendices. Solver Agent is available in https://github.com/starrfree/solver-agent. Sessions for reproducibility are available in https://storage.googleapis.com/solver-agent-sessions/solver-agent-f-theory-uplifts/index.html. Further codes in https://github.com/alexmininno/orientifold_databases

AI.title_translation: 求解器智能体：用于理论物理计算的智能体AI框架及其在O3平面与S-fold的F-theory提升中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个名为Solver Agent的AI框架，用于提高理论物理计算的可靠性，并成功将其应用于F-theory、O3平面和S-fold的研究中。
AI.motivation: 为了提高数学和理论物理中计算机辅助计算的可追溯性、可复现性和可验证性，解决复杂理论推导中的错误累积问题，并将其应用于F-theory uplifts、O3平面和S-fold等前沿物理研究。
AI.method: 引入基于大语言模型的Solver Agent框架，利用持久化账本记录推导过程，通过中心智能体分派任务给子智能体，并由独立智能体进行步骤与结果验证；结合弦论不变量、复曲面超曲面构造以及四形式磁通分析进行物理推导。
AI.result: 建立了射影三维流形上Weierstrass模型给出具有特定孤立奇点的$\mathbb{Q}$-阶乘射影椭圆纤维化卡拉比-丘四维流形的充分条件；推导出了Hodge数据和欧拉特征数的固定点贡献，证明了欧拉修正确定了蝌蚪消解所需的局域D3膜电荷；提供了具有非阿贝尔规范部门的四维$\mathcal{N}=1$紧化中的复曲面计算和四形式磁通分析方法。
AI.conclusion: Solver Agent框架有效提升了理论物理复杂计算的可追溯性与可靠性，并通过实际应用成功推导了F-theory提升中关于O3平面和S-fold的关键几何与物理性质。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了Solver Agent，这是一个基于大语言模型的AI框架，用于数学和理论物理中的计算与证明。求解过程通过一个持久化账本进行跟踪，该账本记录了假设、推导和计算。一个中心智能体将任务委派给专门的子智能体，同时独立智能体验证中间步骤和最终结果。这种设置提高了计算机辅助计算的可追溯性、可复现性和可验证性。应用Solver Agent，我们研究了IIB型定向折叠及其S-fold推广的全局F-theory提升。我们为具有终端 $\mathbb{Z}_k$ 商奇点（$k\in\{2,3,4,6\}$）的射影三维流形上的Weierstrass模型给出了充分条件，以产生具有孤立Gorenstein终端商奇点的 $\mathbb{Q}$-阶乘射影椭圆纤维化卡拉比-丘四维流形。这些几何结构实现了O3平面和S-fold，其中后者的局域D3膜探针产生了四维 $\mathcal{N}=3$ 超共形场论。利用弦论不变量，我们推导了对Hodge数据和欧拉特征数的固定点贡献，并证明了这些欧拉修正决定了蝌蚪消解所需的局域D3膜电荷。我们使用复曲面超曲面构造阐明了这些结果，其中单个三维多胞形同时决定了IIB型卡拉比-丘三维流形和F-theory基底；在此，定向折叠双重覆盖自然构成了具有离散 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 规范对称性的备用亏格一纤维提升的双截面。最后，我们提供了具有非阿贝尔规范部门的四维 $\mathcal{N}=1$ 紧化中的复曲面计算和四形式磁通分析方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Solver Agent——一个用于数学和理论物理计算的AI智能体框架，具备持久化账本、任务委派和独立验证机制。作者将该框架应用于研究Type IIB定向折叠及其S-fold推广的全局F-theory提升，推导了几何奇点条件、Hodge数据贡献及局域D3膜电荷，展示了AI在辅助前沿物理研究方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: Solver Agent, 智能体AI框架, F-theory, O3-planes, S-folds, Calabi-Yau fourfolds
AI.comments: 本文创新性地提出了一种基于大语言模型的智能体框架（Solver Agent），用于解决数学和理论物理中的复杂计算和证明问题。通过持久化账本、中心分工与独立验证机制，显著提升了计算机辅助计算的可追溯性和可靠性。在具体物理应用上，该框架成功应用于F理论提升、O3平面及S-fold的研究，展示了AI在尖端理论物理研究中的巨大潜力。

title: SIFARI: Self-Supervised Interferometric Fitting for Astronomical Radio Imaging
summary: Radio-interferometric images are reconstructed from sparsely sampled visibilities, and CLEAN-based imaging can struggle with spatial filtering, complex morphologies, and uncertainty quantification. Alternative methods that fit visibilities directly can address some of these limitations but often require manual choices of image priors and model hyperparameters. We present SIFARI (Self-Supervised Interferometric Fitting for Astronomical Radio Imaging), a self-supervised neural network workflow that represents sky brightness as a continuous function of position and fits measured visibilities without an external image training set or explicit spatial regularizer. An empirical rule sets the Fourier feature scale from the visibilities before training, controlling how readily the network fits fine structure. Sampling network weights with Stochastic Weight Averaging-Gaussian (SWAG) gives approximate brightness uncertainty estimates, which we combine with a thermal-noise floor to construct spatially resolved signal-to-noise maps. In synthetic ALMA tests, SIFARI yields an effective point-source response about eight times narrower than the natural-weighting CLEAN restoring beam and recovers more extended flux than CLEAN when short baselines are missing. It also achieves higher image fidelity than the restored CLEAN images in all three morphology benchmarks. Applied to ALMA observations of PDS 70, SIFARI recovers the bright outer ring together with faint compact emission in the central cavity. For long-baseline-only WISPIT 2 data, SIFARI supplies a sky model for phase self-calibration where the CLEAN model is inadequate. The restored, self-calibrated SIFARI image has approximately 30% lower RMS noise than the CLEAN image made from the original visibilities without self-calibration.

title: Infrared Subtraction with Artificial Intelligence
comments: 31 pages, 11 figures. Prompts and pseudocode for LLM-based agents to reproduce the figures are available in the Ancillary files section
summary: We present AI-developed local infrared subtraction, building on projection to Born and EFT matching. The framework separates an integrable radiation term from a finite contribution at Born kinematics, referred to as the Born contact. The contact is determined using the EFT singular distribution in a resolution observable such as N-jettiness $τ_N$. Under human physics guidance, an LLM develops two implementations. One uses a neural network for phase space projection and fits the contact by matching to EFT cumulants. The other uses an analytic construction that keeps the Born momenta fixed while integrating over radiation. It combines the EFT $δ(τ_N)$ coefficient with finite 4-dimensional radiation integrals to calculate the contact term directly. This gives a local subtraction formula without a slicing parameter, while reusing existing lower-order radiation calculations and EFT singular predictions. As a demonstration, we reconstruct the full NLO correction for massless 3- and 4-jet production in electron-positron annihilation. The attempt to the NNLO dijet production is also made by recursively using the NLO P2B construction with the LLM designing machine-learning controls to reduce the variance of the contact integral. The tested predictions are in good agreement with EERAD3. The numerical calculation and projection-network training use a 2020 Apple M1 MacBook, without GPU acceleration, illustrating the feasibility of the construction with modest computing resources. The appendices develop an extension of the local subtraction to 3-jet NNLO, giving explicit radiation maps and a proposed contact formula. We also show how to integrate over NNLO radiation while keeping the Born momenta fixed, for any number of massless final-state jets. Our results demonstrate how AI can help higher-order calculations by constructing infrared subtraction and improving its numerical integration.

AI.title_translation: 基于人工智能的红外减除
AI.tldr: 本论文利用大语言模型开发了一种无需切片参数的局域红外减除框架，成功实现高阶粒子物理计算并显著降低了计算资源需求。
AI.motivation: 为了克服粒子物理高阶计算中的红外发散难题，探索人工智能在大语言模型和机器学习的辅助下构建高效、无切片参数的局域红外减除方案的可行性。
AI.method: 利用人类物理学指导的大语言模型开发了两种实现方案：一是利用神经网络进行相空间投影并通过匹配EFT累积量来拟合Born接触项；二是利用解析构造在固定Born动量的同时对辐射进行积分，直接计算接触项。
AI.result: 成功重构了正负电子湮灭中无质量3-jet和4-jet产额的完整NLO修正，尝试了NNLO二喷注产额计算，预测结果与EERAD3高度吻合，且整个计算和训练仅使用无GPU加速的Apple M1芯片完成。
AI.conclusion: AI能够通过结合人类物理学指导成功开发出局域红外减除方案，有效加速高阶微扰QCD计算并减少算力需求。
AI.translation: 我们提出了基于人工智能开发的局域红外减除方法，该方法建立在投影到Born和有效场论（EFT）匹配的基础之上。该框架将可积辐射项从Born运动学下的有限贡献（称为Born接触项）中分离出来。该接触项利用EFT在分辨率可观测量（如N-jettiness $\tau_N$)中的奇异分布来确定。在人类物理学的指导下，大语言模型开发了两种实现方式。一种使用神经网络进行相空间投影，并通过与EFT累积量匹配来拟合接触项；另一种使用解析结构，在对辐射进行积分的同时保持Born动量固定，将EFT $\delta(\tau_N)$ 系数与有限的4维辐射积分结合起来直接计算接触项。这给出了一个没有切片参数的局域减除公式，同时重用了现有的低阶辐射计算和EFT奇异预测。作为演示，我们重构了正电子湮灭中无质量3喷注和4喷注产额的完整NLO修正。通过递归使用带有LLM设计机器学习控制的NLO P2B结构来减少接触积分的方差，还尝试了NNLO双喷注产额的计算。测试预测结果与EERAD3高度吻合。数值计算和投影网络训练使用的是2020款配备Apple M1芯片的MacBook，无需GPU加速，说明了该结构在适度计算资源下的可行性。附录中将局域减除扩展到了3喷注NNLO，给出了显式的辐射映射和建议的接触公式。我们还展示了如何在保持Born动量固定的同时对NNLO辐射进行积分，适用于任意数量的无质量末端喷注。我们的结果证明了人工智能如何通过构建红外减除和改进数值积分来协助高阶计算。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种由人工智能开发局域红外减除框架，通过结合有效场论匹配和投影到Born的方法，实现了无切片参数的红外发散处理，并成功计算了电子-正电子湮灭中的多喷注微扰修正。
AI.keywords: 红外减除, 人工智能, 有效场论, 微扰QCD, 机器学习
AI.comments: 该论文展示了人工智能（特别是大语言模型）在解决粒子物理中高阶计算瓶颈（红外减除）方面的巨大潜力，不仅生成了创新的数值和解析实现方案，还体现了低算力消耗的高效性。

title: Dual-Anchor Acceleration Is Near-Optimal for Stochastic Monotone Root-Finding
summary: Among distinct optimal acceleration mechanisms for deterministic monotone root-finding problems and fixed-point problems, dual-anchoring has recently been shown to admit a more robust direct stochastic extension than standard anchor acceleration. However, without additional strong monotonicity, the existing stochastic dual-anchoring guarantee has two limitations: first, it requires cocoercivity in expectation, and second, it attains only $O(ε^{-3})$ oracle complexity, leaving a gap to the near-optimal $\tilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ complexity achieved by other methods. In this work, we address both of these limitations by combining dual-anchoring with stochastic resolvent approximation and optimized variance control. For unbiased stochastic oracles with variance bounded by $σ^2$, where sample operators are monotone and uniformly $L$-Lipschitz, our algorithm finds a point with $ε$-residual with a near-optimal oracle complexity of $O ( (LD / ε) \ell + (σ^2 / ε^2) \ell^2)$, where $\ell = \log (1 + LD / ε)$ and $D$ is the initial distance to a solution. This result improves the best known oracle complexity in the noise-dominated regime under these samplewise assumptions, reducing the poly-logarithmic factor from cubic to quadratic.

AI.title_translation: 双锚加速对于随机单调求根是近乎最优的
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于随机单调求根的新型双锚加速算法，成功将预言机复杂度改进至近乎最优的 $\tilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$。
AI.motivation: 现有的随机双锚定算法在没有强单调性时存在两个局限性：一是需要期望意义下的余矫顽力（cocoercivity），二是只能达到 $O(\varepsilon^{-3})$ 的预言机复杂度，与其它方法达到的接近最优的 $\tilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 复杂度存在差距。本文旨在克服这两个局限性。
AI.method: 将双锚定（dual-anchoring）与随机预解式近似（stochastic resolvent approximation）以及优化的方差控制相结合。
AI.result: 在无偏随机预言机、方差有界、样本算子单调且一致 $L$-Lipschitz 的假设下，算法找到 $\varepsilon$-残差点所需的预言机复杂度为 $O ( (LD / \varepsilon) \ell + (\sigma^2 / \varepsilon^2) \ell^2)$（其中 $\ell = \log (1 + LD / \varepsilon)$），改进了噪声主导区间的已知最佳预言机复杂度，将多对数因子的阶数从三次降到了二次。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合双锚定、随机预解式近似和优化的方差控制，本文提出的算法在随机单调求根问题中实现了接近最优的预言机复杂度，弥补了现有方法的不足。
AI.translation: 在确定性单调求根问题和不动点问题的各种最优加速机制中，双锚定最近被证明比标准锚加速具有更稳健的直接随机扩展。然而，在没有额外强单调性的情况下，现有的随机双锚定保证有两个局限性：首先，它要求期望意义下的余矫顽力；其次，它只能达到 $O(\varepsilon^{-3})$ 的预言机复杂度，与其它方法达到的接近最优的 $\tilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 复杂度留下了差距。在这项工作中，我们通过将双锚定与随机预解式近似和优化的方差控制相结合，解决了这两个局限性。对于方差由 $\sigma^2$ 限制的无偏随机预言机，其中样本算子是单调且一致 $L$-Lipschitz 的，我们的算法在样本级假设下以接近最优的预言机复杂度 $O ( (LD / \varepsilon) \ell + (\sigma^2 / \varepsilon^2) \ell^2)$ 找到具有 $\varepsilon$-残差的点，其中 $\ell = \log (1 + LD / \varepsilon)$，$D$ 是到解的初始距离。这一结果改进了在这些样本级假设下噪声主导 regime 中已知的最佳预言机复杂度，将多对数因子从三次减少到二次。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合双锚定、随机预解式近似和方差控制的新算法，用于解决随机单调求根问题。该算法在标准的样本级单调性和 Lipschitz 连续性假设下，实现了接近最优的 $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 预言机复杂度，克服了以往双锚定方法需要余矫顽力且复杂度较低的局限性。
AI.keywords: 随机单调求根, 双锚加速, 预言机复杂度, 方差控制, 随机预解式近似
AI.comments: 该论文成功解决了随机单调求根问题中双锚加速算法在弱单调性假设下的复杂性差距，将噪声主导区间的复杂度界限从立方对数因子改进到了二次，具有很高的理论重要性。

title: Hybrid Neural Simulation-Based Inference for Robust Applications and Limited-Budget Scenarios
comments: 10 pages, 8 figures, code available at https://github.com/benevedes/hybrid-nsbi
summary:
We develop two hybrid techniques that approach the performance of neural simulation-based inference (NSBI) analyses while substantially reducing the computational cost of inference and preserving some or all of the reliability guarantees of parametric methods. The first approach is broadly applicable, while the second is tailored to a class of particle physics analyses that admit a semi-parametric NSBI formulation.
  With only a modest compromise in raw sensitivity, these methods represent an important step toward computationally efficient NSBI in offline analyses and also open the door to the exploration of trigger-level applications in the future. Based on our comparison studies, we recommend the use of our first approach, Latent Categories, for robust and efficient inference.
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, code available at https://github.com/benevedes/hybrid-nsbi

AI.title_translation: 用于鲁棒应用和有限预算场景的混合神经模拟推断
AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种混合神经模拟推断技术，能够在大幅降低计算成本的同时保持较高的性能和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前的神经模拟推断（NSBI）分析计算成本高昂，而传统的参数化方法虽然计算成本低但可能缺乏灵活性，因此需要开发既能保持NSBI性能又能大幅减少计算成本并保留参数化方法可靠性的混合技术。
AI.method: 开发了两种混合技术：第一种是广泛适用的通用方法，第二种是针对半参数化NSBI公式的粒子物理学分析定制的方法。
AI.result: 这两种方法在仅有适度敏感性妥协的前提下，显著降低了推断的计算成本，并为未来在触发级别的应用铺平了道路。研究推荐第一种方法“Latent Categories”用于稳健且高效的推断。
AI.conclusion: 提出的混合NSBI方法在计算效率和统计可靠性之间取得了很好的平衡，其中“Latent Categories”方法尤其推荐用于稳健高效的推断。
AI.translation: 我们开发了两种混合技术，它们在接近神经模拟推断（NSBI）分析性能的同时，大幅降低了推断的计算成本，并保留了参数化方法的部分或全部可靠性保证。第一种方法具有广泛的适用性，而第二种则专门针对适用于半参数化NSBI公式的一类粒子物理分析。在对原始敏感性只有微小妥协的情况下，这些方法向离线分析中计算高效的NSBI迈出了重要一步，也为未来探索触发级别的应用打开了大门。根据我们的比较研究，我们推荐使用我们的第一种方法“Latent Categories”来进行稳健且高效的推断。
AI.summary: 该论文开发了两种用于稳健应用和有限预算场景的混合神经模拟推断（NSBI）技术。这些技术在大幅降低计算成本并保持参数化方法可靠性的同时，接近了NSBI的性能，其中“Latent Categories”方法被推荐用于高效推断。
AI.keywords: 神经模拟推断, 混合技术, 粒子物理学, 计算效率, 统计推断
AI.comments: 该论文提出了两种混合神经模拟推断（NSBI）技术，在大幅降低计算成本的同时保留了参数化方法的可靠性保证，为粒子物理学及其他领域的离线和触发级别的高效推断开辟了新途径。

title: From Weak to Strong Testing in Gaussian Models
summary:
We study the computational complexity of hypothesis testing in the spiked Wigner model, a prototypical model for detecting low-rank structure in a large random matrix. Below the "BBP" eigenvalue transition, it is expected that strong detection --- with both type I and II errors vanishing --- requires exponential time. Assuming this as a conjecture, we determine the limits of polynomial-time weak detection, exactly characterizing the possible tradeoffs between type I and II errors. Specifically, the optimal tradeoff is achieved by a particular linear spectral statistic. Thus, the question of weak detection is entirely reduced to that of strong detection.
  The proof builds on ideas of Nagda-Raghavendra (2025) and Moitra-Wein (2025). The low-degree likelihood ratio (LDLR) plays a key role: any test that slightly beats the LDLR can be boosted to have an even higher success probability. This leads us to establish a computational analogue of the Neyman-Pearson lemma for a subclass of additive Gaussian models: for a given super-polynomial runtime, the best possible tradeoff between type I and II errors is either the one achieved by thresholding the LDLR, or the trivial tradeoff that results from strong detection.

AI.title_translation: 从高斯模型中的弱检验到强检验
AI.tldr: 本文研究了高斯模型中弱检验与强检验的计算复杂度权衡，证明了弱检验的最优错误率权衡可由低阶似然比（LDLR）实现，并将弱检验归约至强检验。
AI.motivation: 在尖峰维格纳模型中，研究弱检验（在多项式时间内）与强检验之间的计算复杂度限制及错误率权衡。
AI.method: 利用低阶似然比（LDLR）的方法，借鉴了近期学者的研究成果，建立了一类可加高斯模型的计算模拟 Neyman-Pearson 引理。
AI.result: 最优的错误率权衡由特定的线性谱统计量实现，弱检验问题完全归约到了强检验问题；对于给定的超多项式运行时间，最优的Ⅰ类和Ⅱ类错误权衡要么由对LDLR进行阈值化实现，要么是强检验产生的平凡权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了多项式时间内弱检验的极限，并将弱检验问题完全归约到了强检验问题。
AI.translation:
我们研究了尖峰维格纳模型中假设检验的计算复杂度，这是检测大随机矩阵中低秩结构的原型模型。在“BBP”特征值相变以下，预计强检测（I型和II型错误均趋于零）需要指数时间。在这一猜想下，我们确定了多项式时间弱检测的极限，精确表征了I型和II型错误之间可能的权衡。具体而言，最优权衡由特定的线性谱统计量实现。因此，弱检验问题完全简化为了强检验问题。
证明建立在 Nagda-Raghavendra (2025) 和 Moitra-Wein (2025) 的思想基础之上。低阶似然比（LDLR）起到了关键作用：任何稍微超越 LDLR 的检验都可以被增强，从而具有更高的成功概率。这引导我们为一类加性高斯模型建立 Neyman-Pearson 引理的计算模拟：对于给定的超多项式运行时间，I型和II型错误之间的最佳可能权衡要么是通过对 LDLR 进行阈值化实现的权衡，要么是由强检测导致的平凡权衡。
AI.summary: 本文研究了尖峰维格纳模型中假设检验的计算复杂度，在假设低于BBP相变点强检测需要指数时间的前提下，精确刻画了多项式时间弱检测下Ⅰ类和Ⅱ类错误之间的最优权衡。研究表明最优权衡可通过线性谱统计量（特别是低阶似然比LDLR的阈值化）实现，从而将弱检验问题归约至强检验。
AI.keywords: 假设检验, 尖峰维格纳模型, 计算复杂度, 低阶似然比, 尼曼-皮尔逊引理
AI.comments: 本文创新性地研究了高斯模型中从弱检验到强检验的计算复杂度权衡，将低阶似然比（LDLR）与假设检验的计算模拟 Neyman-Pearson 引理结合，具有重要的理论价值。

title: Design and Analysis of a 2D Vernier Structure
summary: This paper presents the design and simulation of a 2D Vernier Time-to-Digital Converter (TDC) targeting less than 20 picosecond time resolution and 5-bit output resolution. The TDC comprises voltage-controlled delay buffers, NAND-based SR latches with reset functionality, and a calibration loop using a phase-frequency detector (PFD) and charge pump. The calibration loop dynamically adjusts delay mismatches to maintain consistent timing across process-voltage-temperature (PVT) corners, significantly improving linearity. Simulations show that the TDC achieves a resolution of 16.9 ps for tt corner and maintains DNL and INL below 0.5 LSB under all tested PVT conditions

AI.title_translation: 二维维尼尔结构的设计与分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种2D维尼尔时间数字转换器（TDC），实现了小于20皮秒的分辨率，并通过动态校准在各种PVT条件下保持了极佳的线性度。
AI.motivation: 旨在设计一种高时间分辨率（小于20皮秒）和特定输出分辨率（5位）的二维维尼尔时间数字转换器（TDC），并解决工艺、电压和温度（PVT）变化对定时一致性和线性的影响。

AI.conclusion: 该2D维尼尔TDC设计成功实现了小于20皮秒的时间分辨率和优异的线性度，验证了校准环路在应对PVT变化方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种二维维尼尔时间数字转换器（TDC）的设计与仿真，其目标是实现小于20皮秒的时间分辨率和5位输出分辨率。该TDC包含电压控制延迟缓冲器、具有复位功能的基于NAND的SR锁存器，以及使用相位频率检测器（PFD）和电荷泵的校准环路。校准环路动态调整延迟失配，以在工艺-电压-温度（PVT）角下保持一致的定时，从而显着提高线性度。仿真表明，该TDC在tt工艺角下实现了16.9皮秒的分辨率，并在所有测试的PVT条件下将DNL和INL保持在0.5 LSB以下。
AI.summary: 本文设计并仿真了一种二维维尼尔时间数字转换器（TDC），旨在实现低于20皮秒的时间分辨率和5位输出分辨率。通过采用压控延迟缓冲器、SR锁存器以及由PFD和电荷泵组成的校准环路，该设计能够动态调整延迟失配，以保持不同PVT条件下的定时一致性和高线性度。仿真验证了其卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: 2D Vernier, Time-to-Digital Converter, TDC, 延时缓冲器, PVT校准
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的二维维尼尔结构，主要应用于时间数字转换器（TDC），通过引入校准环路有效克服了PVT变化带来的影响，实现了高分辨率和良好的线性度。

title: Measuring trainable degrees of freedom in materials graph neural networks: a random-subspace intrinsic dimension analysis
summary: Final predictive accuracy is the standard basis for comparing graph neural networks (GNNs) in materials-property prediction, but it does not show how strongly performance depends on access to trainable parameter-space directions. Here, we introduce trainable-degree dependence as a complementary characterization of materials GNN learning. Using random-subspace intrinsic-dimension analysis, we train CGCNN, ALIGNN, and DimeNet++ in randomly oriented parameter subspaces across six prediction tasks and measure how performance recovers as independent trainable degrees of freedom are restored. The resulting recovery curves separate endpoint accuracy from the trainable-dimensional demand required to recover it. They reveal distinctions that final errors alone miss: metallic classification and log-bulk-modulus regression recover near-reference performance from small fractional subspaces, formation-energy and band-gap prediction show stronger architecture dependence, and phonon prediction is most sensitive to dimensional restriction. Dataset-size sweeps show that band-gap models require larger fractional subspaces as training data grows, whereas formation-energy and bulk-modulus responses are more stable. A width sweep shows that fractional thresholds can remain stable while absolute threshold dimensions increase with model size. Random-subspace analysis therefore provides a targeted stress test for how materials GNNs use their optimization space.

AI.title_translation: 测量材料图神经网络中的可训练自由度：随机子空间本征维数分析
AI.tldr: 本研究利用随机子空间本征维数分析来测量材料图神经网络中的可训练自由度，揭示了不同模型和任务对参数空间维度的依赖关系。
AI.motivation: 传统的图神经网络（GNNs）比较仅依赖最终预测精度，无法揭示性能对可训练参数空间方向的依赖程度，因此需要一种互补的表征方法来研究材料GNNs的学习机制。
AI.method: 使用随机子空间本征维数分析方法，在随机取向的参数子空间中训练CGCNN、ALIGNN和DimeNet++模型，跨越六个预测任务测量性能随可训练自由度恢复的变化曲线。
AI.result: 恢复曲线成功区分了端点精度与恢复所需的训练维度需求，揭示了不同任务（如金属分类、体积模量、形成能、带隙和声子预测）对维度限制的不同敏感度，并展示了数据集大小和模型宽度对可训练自由度的影响。
AI.conclusion: 随机子空间本征维数分析为评估材料GNNs的参数利用效率提供了一个有效的压力测试框架，弥补了传统最终精度评估的不足。
AI.translation: 最终预测准确率是比较材料-性质预测中图神经网络（GNNs）的标准基础，但它并未表明性能在多大程度上取决于对可训练参数空间方向的访问。在这里，我们引入可训练度依赖性作为材料 GNN 学习的补充表征。通过使用随机子空间本征维数分析，我们在六个预测任务的随机定向参数子空间中训练了 CGCNN、ALIGNN 和 DimeNet++，并测量了随着独立可训练自由度的恢复，性能如何恢复。由此产生的恢复曲线将端点准确度与恢复它所需的可训练维度需求区分开来。它们揭示了仅靠最终误差所遗漏的区别：金属分类和对数体积模量回归从小分数子空间恢复接近参考的性能，形成能和带隙预测显示出更强的架构依赖性，声子预测对维度限制最敏感。数据集大小扫描表明，随着训练数据的增长，带隙模型需要更大的分数子空间，而形成能和体积模量响应更稳定。宽度扫描表明，随着模型尺寸的增加，分数阈值可以保持稳定，而绝对阈值维度则会增加。因此，随机子空间分析为材料 GNN 如何利用其优化空间提供了有针对性的压力测试。
AI.summary: 该论文通过引入随机子空间本征维数分析，研究了材料图神经网络（GNNs）中的可训练自由度。通过在随机参数子空间中训练多个主流GNN模型并跨任务评估其性能恢复，该方法揭示了传统最终精度所忽略的架构依赖性、维度需求以及对数据集大小和模型宽度的敏感性，为评估材料GNNs的优化空间提供了一种新的压力测试手段。
AI.keywords: 材料图神经网络, 本征维数分析, 可训练自由度, 随机子空间, 预测性能
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将随机子空间本征维数分析引入材料图神经网络（GNNs）的研究中，突破了传统仅依赖最终预测精度的评估标准，为理解不同架构在参数空间中的学习机制和效率提供了强有力的工具。

title: Better Behavioral Prediction, More Faithful Model Ablations? Evidence from Sequential Choice
summary: Using predictive models to explain cognition requires more than accurate behavioral predictions. Input ablations offer an appealing route: remove information from a model and interpret the resulting performance change as evidence of its importance for behavior. Yet this inference assumes that the model's dependence on information reflects the dependence of the process generating the behavior. We test it in two synthetic sequential bandit tasks with known generating policies, where past choices can remain informative when feedback is unavailable to a predictor. We compare GRUs and Transformers trained from scratch, a fine-tuned LLaMA model, and cognitive models across systematically varied reward contributions. Our analyses distinguish prediction after training without reward observations from the response of a fixed predictor to donor-reward replacement. Three findings emerge. First, in the restless task, neural models trained without rewards predict held-out choices better than four simple training-fitted behavioral baselines. Second, under matched donor replacement, accurate predictors can respond much less than the known generator. Third, at some reward weights, neural networks predict better than a pooled reinforcement-learning model but have less faithful changes in choice probabilities; the model ordering differs between the two tasks. These independent-test results separate information sufficient for prediction from response fidelity under a specified ablation in sequential choice. They motivate validating model-ablation responses independently of predictive performance before using them to infer how the observed behavior was generated.

AI.title_translation: 更好的行为预测，更忠实模型消融？来自序列选择的证据
AI.tldr: 准确预测行为的模型不一定在消融实验中忠实反映真实的认知机制。
AI.motivation: 使用预测模型解释认知时，通常采用输入消融法来判断信息对行为的重要性，但这假设了模型的依赖性反映了真实生成过程，该研究旨在测试这一假设的有效性。
AI.method: 在两个具有已知生成策略的合成序列老虎机任务中，对比了从头训练的GRU和Transformer、微调的LLaMA模型以及认知模型，分析系统变化奖赏贡献下的预测表现与消融响应。
AI.result: 1.在restless任务中，不含奖赏训练的神经模型预测效果优于四个简单行为基线；2.在匹配的供体替换下，准确的预测器的响应可能远小于真实生成器；3.在某些奖赏权重下，神经网络预测效果优于强化学习模型，但其选择概率的变化忠实度较低。
AI.conclusion: 模型对特定输入的依赖并不等同于真实认知过程的依赖，模型消融的响应需要进行独立的验证，不能单纯依赖预测性能来推断行为生成机制。
AI.translation: 使用预测模型来解释认知，不仅仅需要准确的行为预测。输入消融提供了一条吸引人的途径：从模型中移除信息，并将由此产生的性能变化解释为其对行为的重要性的证据。然而，这种推断假设了模型对信息的依赖反映了生成行为的过程的依赖。我们在两个具有已知生成策略的合成序列强盗任务中对其进行了测试，在这些任务中，当预测器无法获得反馈时，过去的选择仍然可以提供信息。我们比较了从头训练的GRU和Transformer、微调的LLaMA模型以及在系统变化的奖赏贡献下的认知模型。我们的分析区分了在没有奖赏观察的情况下训练后的预测与固定预测器对供体-奖赏替换的响应。得出了三个发现。首先，在restless任务中，没有奖赏训练的神经模型比四个简单的训练拟合行为基线更好地预测了保留的选择。其次，在匹配的供体替换下，准确的预测器的响应可以比已知的生成器少得多。第三，在某些奖赏权重下，神经网络的预测效果比合并的强化学习模型更好，但在选择概率上的变化忠实度较低；这两个任务的模型排序有所不同。这些独立测试结果将预测所需的充分信息与序列选择中指定消融下的响应忠实度区分开来。它们促使我们在使用模型消融来推断观察到的行为是如何生成之前，独立于预测性能验证模型消融响应。
AI.summary: 该论文通过在合成序列决策任务中对比不同模型的表现与消融响应，发现高预测准确性并不保证模型消融的忠实度，强调在利用模型消融推断真实行为生成机制前必须独立验证其响应。
AI.keywords: 行为预测, 模型消融, 认知建模, 序列决策, 忠实度
AI.comments: 该论文通过合成序列决策任务研究了行为预测模型的“消融 faithfulness（忠实度）”问题，指出高预测准确性并不意味着模型学到了与真实认知过程相同的依赖关系，对认知建模中使用消融法解释大脑机制提出了警示。

title: Fundamental Limits of Transferability and Equivariance in Algebraic Signal Models I: Finite Dimensions
summary: We study the fundamental limits of transferability in algebraic signal processing through homomorphisms between algebraic signal models. Homomorphisms are linear maps between the signal spaces of two models that commute with filtering, so filtering a signal and transferring it across domains can be done in either order. The existence of such maps is governed entirely by coincidences among the filtered eigenvalues of the two models' shift operators, but existence alone is insufficient: the space of homomorphisms always contains trivial elements that destroy all information. We introduce the spectral transfer efficiency $η(θ)\in[0,1]$ to quantify information-preserving quality, prove that every homomorphism decomposes into unconstrained blocks over coincidence classes, derive the dimension of the homomorphism space, and characterize exactly when lossless transfer is achievable. Beyond normal shift operators, we quantify a departure-from-normality penalty and show how filter derivatives can repair spectral defectiveness. The theory yields concrete consequences in three settings: for sampling, eigenvalue interlacing converts transferability under subsampling into an explicit filter design constraint; for compressed sensing, $η(θ)$ controls the restricted isometry constant and the coherence of the resulting measurements, and recovery decouples across coincidence classes; and for machine learning, spectral aliasing emerges as the controlled symmetry breaking that makes transfer between mismatched domains possible at all.

AI.title_translation: 代数信号模型中迁移性与等变性的基本限制 I：有限维情形
AI.tldr: 本文建立了有限维代数信号模型中信息无损迁移与等变性的理论框架，引入谱迁移效率定量刻画迁移质量，并在采样、压缩感知和机器学习中得到具体应用。
AI.motivation: 探究代数信号处理中信号在不同模型间进行迁移时的基本限制，解决现有方法中同态映射存在平凡元素并丢失信息的问题，并定量研究信息保持质量。
AI.method: 利用代数信号模型之间的同态映射，结合谱分析、特征值重合类、以及偏差非正规性惩罚和滤波器导数等数学工具，推导同态空间的维数并刻画无损迁移。
AI.result: 引入了谱迁移效率 $\eta(\theta)$ 来量化信息保持质量，证明了同态映射可分解为 coincidence classes 上的无约束块，推导了同态空间的维数，并精确刻画了无损迁移实现的条件。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过同态映射与谱分析，系统刻画了代数信号模型中信息无损迁移的充要条件，并揭示了其在采样、压缩感知及机器学习中的广泛应用。
AI.translation: 我们通过代数信号模型之间的同态映射，研究了代数信号 processing 中迁移性的基本限制。同态映射是两个模型的信号空间之间与滤波可交换的线性映射，因此滤波信号并在不同域间进行迁移的顺序可以互换。此类映射的存在性完全由两个模型的移位算子的滤波特征值之间的重合度所决定；然而，仅有存在性是不够的：同态空间总包含会摧毁所有信息的平凡元素。我们引入了谱迁移效率 $\eta(\theta)\in[0,1]$ 来定量描述信息保持质量，证明了每个同态映射都可以分解为重合类上的无约束块，推导了同态空间的维数，并精确刻画了何时可以实现无损迁移。除了正规移位算子之外，我们量化了偏离正规性的惩罚，并展示了滤波器导数如何修复谱缺陷。该理论在三种设定下产生了具体的结论：对于采样，特征值交错将子采样下的迁移性转换为显式的滤波器设计约束；对于压缩感知，$\eta(\theta)$ 控制了所得测量的限制等距常数（RIC）和相干性，且恢复过程可以在重合类上解耦；对于机器学习，谱 aliasing 表现为受控的对称性破缺，这使得不匹配域之间的迁移成为可能。
AI.summary: 本文研究了有限维代数信号处理中迁移性的基本限制，利用同态映射与谱特征分析，引入了谱迁移效率来衡量信息保持质量，推导了同态空间的维度及无损迁移条件，并在采样、压缩感知和机器学习中展示了具体应用。
AI.keywords: 代数信号处理, 迁移性, 同态映射, 谱分析, 等变性
AI.comments: 该论文从代数信号处理的视角深入探讨了迁移性与等变性的基本限制，特别引入了谱迁移效率来量化信息保持质量，并在采样、压缩感知和机器学习等多个领域展示了坚实的理论应用，是一篇具有高度理论价值的佳作。

title: From Classical to Quantum Channels: Achieving Positive Covert Rates
comments: 44 pages, 9 figures, single column, part of the results will be presented at the 2026 IEEE Information Theory Workshop
summary: In this paper, we study the conditions under which covert communication at positive rates is feasible over discrete memoryless classical, classical-quantum, and quantum channels. For classical point-to-point channels, we show that if the dimension of the channel input probability simplex exceeds that of the channel output probability simplex, equivalently, if the input alphabet has larger cardinality than the output alphabet, then positive covert rates are achievable for certain classes of Discrete Memoryless Channels (DMCs). We further show that allowing the innocent symbol (i.e., the symbol transmitted in the no-communication mode) to be chosen appropriately can enlarge the class of DMCs for which positive covert rates are achievable. We also study covert communication over classical Multiple-Access Channels (MACs), where the additional transmitter effectively enlarges the set of available channel input pairs, and we show that the conditions required to satisfy the covertness constraint are less restrictive for MACs than for point-to-point channels. We extend these results to classical-quantum DMCs by showing that if the dimension of the input probability simplex exceeds the affine dimension of the set of output states that can be induced at the channel output, then positive covert rates are achievable for certain classes of classical-quantum DMCs. Finally, for quantum channels, we show that if the innocent state (i.e., the state transmitted in the no-communication mode) is mixed, then the covertness constraint can always be satisfied by a non-trivial input ensemble. Consequently, positive covert rates are achievable whenever the legitimate receiver can distinguish at least two states in a suitable such ensemble.
comment: 44 pages, 9 figures, single column, part of the results will be presented at the 2026 IEEE Information Theory Workshop

AI.title_translation: 从经典信道到量子信道：实现正隐蔽速率
AI.tldr: 本文证明了通过利用维度优势、多址接入特性或量子混合态，可以在经典到量子的各类信道中实现正的隐蔽速率。
AI.motivation: 研究在离散无记忆经典信道、经典-量子信道以及量子信道中，实现具有正速率的隐蔽通信所需的具体条件。
AI.method: 通过分析输入概率单纯形与输出概率单纯形（或输出状态仿射维数）之间的维度关系，并探讨无通信模式下合适符号或混合态的选择对满足隐蔽性约束的影响。
AI.result: 研究表明：对于经典点对点信道，当输入字母表势大于输出时可实现正隐蔽速率；对于多址接入信道，隐蔽性约束条件相对更宽松；对于经典-量子信道，输入单纯形维度超过输出状态仿射维度时可行；对于量子信道，当无通信模式下的“无辜状态”为混合态时，总能满足隐蔽性约束并实现正隐蔽速率。
AI.conclusion: 通过分析信道输入输出的维度关系以及利用混合态的特性，论文证明了在经典、经典-量子及纯量子信道中实现正隐蔽速率的可行性。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们研究了在离散无记忆经典、经典-量子以及量子信道中，实现正速率隐蔽通信的可行条件。对于经典点对点信道，我们表明如果信道输入概率单纯形的维度超过信道输出概率单纯形，即等价于输入字母表的势大于输出字母表，那么对于某些类别的离散无记忆信道（DMCs），正的隐蔽速率是可以实现的。我们进一步表明，允许适当地选择无辜符号（即在无通信模式下传输的符号）可以扩大能够实现正隐蔽速率的DMC类别。我们还研究了经典多址接入信道（MACs）上的隐蔽通信，其中附加的发射机有效地扩大了可用信道输入对的集合，并且我们表明，满足隐蔽性约束所需的条件对于MACs来说比对于点对点信道更不严格。我们将这些结果扩展到经典-量子DMCs，通过证明如果输入概率单纯形的维度超过可在信道输出端诱导出的输出状态集的仿射维度，则对于某些类别的经典-量子DMCs，正的隐蔽速率是可以实现的。最后，对于量子信道，我们表明如果无辜状态（即在无通信模式下传输的状态）是混合态，则隐蔽性约束总是可以通过非平凡的输入系综来满足。因此，每当合法接收器能够区分这样一个合适系综中的至少两个状态时，正的隐蔽速率就是可实现的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在经典、经典-量子及量子信道中实现正隐蔽速率的条件，发现当输入维度大于输出维度或仿射维数、合理选择无通信模式下的符号/状态（如量子信道中的混合态）时，可以实现正的隐蔽速率。
AI.keywords: 隐蔽通信, 正隐蔽速率, 离散无记忆信道, 经典-量子信道, 量子信道
AI.comments: 该论文系统性地研究了从经典信道到量子信道中实现正隐蔽速率的条件，特别是针对输入输出维度差、多址接入信道以及量子态混合性等关键因素进行了深入探讨，为隐蔽通信理论从经典向量子领域的延伸做出了重要贡献。

title: Non-Ionizing Radiation Measurements for Trajectography Radars
summary: This work presents a Non-Ionizing Radiation (NIR) measurement campaign and proposes a specific measurement method for trajectography radars. This kind of radar has a high gain narrow beam antenna and emits a high power signal. Power density measurements from a C-band trajectography radar are carried out using bench equipment and a directional receiving antenna, instead of the commonly used isotropic probe. The measured power density levels are assessed for compliance test via comparison with the occupational and general public exposure limit levels of both the International Commission on Non-Ionizing Radiation Protection (ICNIRP) and the Brazilian National Telecommunication Agency (Anatel). The limit for the occupational public is respected everywhere, evidencing the safe operation of the studied radar. However, the limit for the general public is exceeded at a point next to the radar's antenna, showing that preventive measures are needed.

AI.title_translation: 弹道测量雷达的非电离辐射测量
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对弹道测量雷达的非电离辐射定向测量方法，实测发现其职业暴露安全但雷达天线附近的公众暴露超标，需采取预防措施。
AI.motivation: 弹道测量雷达具有高增益窄波束和发射高功率信号的特点，为了评估其非电离辐射水平并确保其符合职业和公众的暴露限值标准，需要开展针对性的辐射测量并提出特定的测量方法。
AI.method: 使用台式设备和定向接收天线代替常用的各向同性探头，对C波段弹道测量雷达进行功率密度测量，并将测量结果与国际非电离辐射防护委员会（ICNIRP）和巴西国家电信局（Anatel）的职业和公众暴露限值进行比较。
AI.result: 研究发现，所有测试地点的职业暴露水平均符合标准，证明了雷达运行的安全性；但在雷达天线附近的一处地点，公众暴露水平超出了标准限值，表明需要采取预防措施。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明弹道测量雷达在职业暴露限值内是安全的，但在天线附近超出了公众暴露限值，必须采取预防措施以保障公众安全。
AI.translation: 本文展示了一项针对弹道测量雷达的非电离辐射（NIR）测量活动，并提出了一种针对该类雷达的具体测量方法。此类雷达具有高增益窄波束天线并发射高功率信号。本研究使用台式设备和定向接收天线（而非常用的各向同性探头）对C波段弹道测量雷达的功率密度进行了测量。通过与国际非电离辐射防护委员会（ICNIRP）和巴西国家电信局（Anatel）的职业及公众暴露限值进行对比，对测得的功率密度水平进行了合规性评估。在所有区域职业暴露限值均得到满足，证明了所研究雷达的安全运行。然而，在雷达天线附近的一处地点，公众暴露限值被超过，表明需要采取预防措施。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种针对弹道测量雷达的非电离辐射测量方法，利用定向接收天线和台式设备对C波段雷达的功率密度进行了实测，并将其与国际和巴西的暴露标准进行了合规性评估，发现职业暴露安全但天线附近公众暴露超标。
AI.keywords: 非电离辐射, 弹道测量雷达, 功率密度测量, 电磁暴露限值, 天线测量

title: Tensor-Train Compressed Separable PINNs: A Curvature-Aware Optimization Framework for Parametric PDEs in High Dimensions
summary: In this work, we develop a second-order optimization framework for physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) applied to high-dimensional parametric partial differential equations (PDEs). The framework is built on the Gauss--Newton pullback metric, which provides an operator-informed notion of curvature in parameter space and connects the method to the broader family of natural gradient schemes. We show that, for coordinate-separable neural architectures and linear differential operators (or linearized operators in the nonlinear case) admitting a finite separable representation, the residual Jacobian inherits a structured separable factorization. This yields an exact compressed formulation of the Gauss--Newton step in a reduced space, without assembling the full residual Jacobian on the exponentially large tensor-product collocation grid. The dimension of the reduced space (the effective compressed dimension) is determined by the local collocation grid sizes, the separable operator structure, and the contraction pattern of the architecture, thereby avoiding dependence on the full tensor-product grid size and replacing dense linear algebra in parameter space by a substantially smaller structured problem. Within our framework, we investigate canonical polyadic and tensor-train parametrizations and derive their full algebraic characterization relevant to the Gauss--Newton method, including the structure of the residual Jacobian, the resulting compressed system, and its effective compressed dimension. Numerical experiments on high-dimensional PDEs, including parametric problems, demonstrate the high efficiency of the proposed compressed Gauss--Newton method, which achieves substantially lower errors than tensor-compressed first-order baselines with orders of magnitude fewer iterations and only a fraction of the computing time.

summary: Tablet-based teaching and learning has become increasingly common in university mathematics courses, offering capabilities such as digital ink, dynamic visualisation, and real-time annotation. However, there is limited experiential evidence regarding how students perceive the specific benefits and drawbacks of tablet-supported teaching and learning, particularly in Transnational Education (TNE) settings. This paper presents results from a small-scale exploratory survey of undergraduate students ($n = 19$) attending mathematics courses within an applied sciences degree programme, who anonymously rated a set of statements regarding their experiences with tablet-based instruction on a five-point Likert scale. Initial analysis shows that students in this cohort perceived tablet teaching most positively in supporting step-by-step understanding and active engagement during lectures through real-time annotation and structured note-taking. In contrast, perceptions related to long-term recall, interest in mathematics, and preference over alternative teaching methods were more mixed. These findings suggest that students in this cohort perceived tablet-based teaching positively for supporting procedural understanding, while perceptions of other aspects of learning appeared more varied.

title: Additive Quasi-isometry via rooted graph partitions and layering partition
summary:
For a graph $H$, $\langle H \rangle$ denotes the class of all subdivisions of $H$ and $tw(H)$ denotes the treewidth of $H$. In this paper, we prove the following. For $k\geq 1, R\geq 1$, let $G,H$ be two graphs such that strong isometric path complexities (Chakraborty et al. [\textsc{Disc. Math., 2026}]) of both $G$ and $\langle H \rangle$ are at most $k$, and $G$ admits an honest, ``nicely rooted'' $R$-bounded $H$-partition. Then, there is a graph $F$ with $tw(F)\leq tw(H)$ such that $G$ admits a $(1,33\cdot R\cdot k^2)$-quasi-isometry to $F$.
  Using results of Albrechtsen, Distel, and Georgakopoulos (2025), we also obtain that $K_{2,t}$-asymptotic minor-free graphs admit quasi-isometries with additive distortion to $K_{2,t}$-minor-free graphs. This answers an open question raised by the above authors.
  As part of our proof, we combine the graph-partition based method and the layering partition based method (Chepoi et al. [\textsc{Discrete Comput. Geom.} 2012]) to obtain additive quasi-isometry when both the source and all subdivisions of the target graph have bounded strong isometric path complexity.

title: Inverse Optimal Feedback Stabilization of 3D Nonholonomic Vehicles in Spherical Coordinates
comments: Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: Inverse optimal control provides optimality and robustness guarantees without solving the Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman (HJB) equation, but its application to 3D nonholonomic vehicles has been precluded by the absence of strict control Lyapunov functions (CLFs). Recently, such strict CLFs were constructed for the 3D nonholonomic vehicle in spherical coordinates, which circumvent Brockett's obstruction, on the largest possible domain. Building on this construction, this paper develops a general inverse optimal stabilizing controller for the 3D nonholonomic vehicle actuated by surge velocity, pitch rate, and yaw rate. The design is a damping $L_gV$ feedback that minimizes a meaningful cost and inherits stability margins. Its flexibility is demonstrated through two choices of penalty function: a quadratic running cost on the state, recovering a near-classical optimal control formulation, and stabilization under user-defined input constraints. Numerical simulations illustrate stabilization performance, control-effort tradeoffs, and the effect of input constraints.

title: One-Step Next-Latent Prediction Is Not a World Model
summary: Next-latent prediction fits a map from the current embedding to the next one. LeNEPA carries this objective to time series, replacing the stop-gradient of next-embedding prediction with the isotropy penalty of LeJEPA. A world model is a transition kernel that can be rolled out. The one-step regression identifies a conditional mean, and a mean is a kernel only in special cases. For a linear-Gaussian Markov latent, the mean transition and the innovation covariance are fixed by the one-step problem, and the open-loop squared error at horizon $K$ equals the trace of the sum of the pushed-forward innovation covariances. That error grows with $K$ after the one-step fit is exact. If the conditional mean is nonlinear, composing it is not the multi-step conditional mean. If the observation is a non-injective function of a Markov state, a memoryless one-step map does not determine future observations, while a short window can. An isotropy penalty is a function of the embedding marginal, so its partial derivative in the transition weights is zero. On a scalar autoregression with coefficient $0.9$, the one-step mean squared error is $0.998$ and the $16$-step open-loop error is $5.10$. On a hidden rotation, an eight-step window reaches $16$-step error $0.056$, while the current scalar alone reaches $0.778$. Raising the isotropy weight from $0.1$ to $10$ leaves eight-step latent error inside $[0.78,0.85]$ on three seeds.

title: Algebraic Vector Fields on $S^2$ are $2$-generated
summary: We exhibit two vector fields on $S^2$, which generate the entire Lie algebra of algebraic vector fields. Compositions of the flows associated with these two vector fields enable us to approximate every diffeomorphism of $S^2$ isotopic to the identity in the $\mathrm{C}^r$-sense for any $r\geq 0$.

title: Quantifying Teleportation Overhead in Distributed Unitary Coupled-Cluster Ansätze
summary: Distributed quantum computing (DQC) has been proposed as a way to scale quantum algorithms for practical applications beyond monolithic quantum processor architectures. Among these applications, quantum chemistry is widely regarded as one of the most promising use cases for quantum computing. In this work, we estimate the distributed-resource requirements of unitary coupled-cluster (UCC) ansätze for quantum chemistry, focusing on unitary coupled-cluster singles and doubles (UCCSD), unitary pair coupled-cluster doubles (UpCCD), and unitary pair coupled-cluster with generalized singles and doubles (UpCCGSD) circuits for hydrogen chains. We focus on a teleportation-based approach to DQC, quantitatively comparing a naive distribution method to the output of the TeleSABRE algorithm. For both approaches, we estimate the cost of handling nonlocal two-qubit gates across a fixed midpoint or quarter-point partition, reporting Bell-pair/classical-communication costs in teleportation. Across Jordan-Wigner and Bravyi-Kitaev, we find that UpCCD with spin-blocked Jordan-Wigner ordering gives the most favorable scaling, while UCCSD incurs substantially larger distributed-resource requirements.

title: InstCharVoice: Grounding Natural-Language Instructions for Character-Level Control in Text-to-Speech
comments: 5 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables; Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Instruction-based text-to-speech (ITTS) systems enable natural-language control of expressive speech generation, but often offer limited transparency and fine-grained control over individual text units. Character-level controllable TTS systems provide explicit acoustic control, yet typically rely on user-specified acoustic attributes. To bridge this gap, we propose InstCharVoice, a unified framework that grounds natural-language instructions in character-level acoustic control. We first construct grounded instruction annotations on the WordVoice-5A-zh corpus using Qwen3-Omni. With this supervision, we train an autoregressive model to identify instruction-relevant characters and predict their acoustic attributes before generating the corresponding speech tokens. Keyword prediction and grounding-aware loss weighting help the model focus on instruction-relevant characters and attributes. Experiments show improved instruction following and keyword-level acoustic control over representative ITTS systems, with competitive speech naturalness and explicit character-level controllability. Audio samples are available at https://xxh333.github.io/instcharvoice-demo/.

title: Conversable Quantum Fire in the Standard Model
summary:
Quantum fire consists of quantum states that can be efficiently functionally cloned but cannot be transmitted using one-way classical communication. Whereas all previous quantum-fire constructions with proven untelegraphability are relative to an oracle, ours, based on one-shot signatures, is in the standard model.
  Our construction achieves two further notions that we introduce: (a) keyless untelegraphability, a strengthening of untelegraphability; and (b) conversability, meaning that a flame, though not telegraphable via one-way classical communication, can be transmitted via classical interaction. Hence one-way and two-way classical communication differ qualitatively in their power to transmit this quantum fire.
  We use these two novel properties of quantum fire, along with its clonability, to give one of the first cryptographic applications of quantum fire. Keyless untelegraphability forces the distribution of serial numbers of valid flames to have high min-entropy, while conversability and clonability allow the corresponding flame to be cloned and transferred using only classical communication.
  We present two variants of our conversable quantum-fire construction. The first, based on one-shot signatures (instantiable from subexponential iO, subexponentially secure one-way functions, and LWE), supports polynomially many flames, and super-logarithmic min-entropy of the serial-number distribution. The second, under the stronger assumption of exponentially unforgeable one-shot signatures (instantiable relative to a classical oracle), supports exponentially many flames, and linear min-entropy.

title: Distance flexibility in spatial matching: the value of concentration
summary: In spatial matching markets, a supply unit's flexibility is measured by its service radius, the maximum distance at which it can serve demand. In dimensions $k \geq 2$, we study how a platform should allocate service radii among the supply nodes subject to a budget on their sum. The platform makes this choice before observing supply and demand locations, with the objective of maximizing the expected fulfilled demand. We show that the shape of a preferred allocation depends on the total budget: under suitable conditions, large budgets favor allocations that are more uniform in the sense of majorization, while small budgets favor concentration. We also characterize a non-uniform allocation that is asymptotically optimal for a very-sparse regime, and show that the uniform allocation is suboptimal in this regime. Our results provide theoretical explanations for the radius allocation questions raised by the numerical experiments in [ASY26b].

title: Cross-attention encoding models reveal dynamic spatiotemporal routing across human higher visual cortex
summary: Understanding how the brain parses actions and events from time-varying natural inputs is a central challenge in neuroscience. Recent work has used deep neural network (DNN) models to build stimulus-computable fMRI encoding models that predict single-voxel responses to complex natural videos. However, the majority of video-computable encoding models predict responses using simple linear mappings from model tokens, overlooking the spatiotemporal structure shared by video representations and neural responses. Recent cross-attention encoding models address this limitation for static images, enabling flexible stimulus-dependent weighting of image content across space. Here, we extend this framework to naturalistic video, using per-parcel cross-attention to dynamically route features from a self-supervised video model (V-JEPA-2) across both space and time, fitting this model to fMRI responses to short video clips. We compare joint spatiotemporal attention with factorized and selectively constrained alternatives, and find that joint routing improves predictions of brain responses to held-out videos across higher visual regions, most consistently in lateral and dorsal visual areas associated with dynamic motion perception. Moreover, our method provides interpretable, stimulus-specific attention maps that dynamically follow moving objects, revealing which locations and temporal moments contribute to each neural response. We further show that attention maps from parcels in different category-selective networks (face-, body-, scene-selective) differentially weight content in accordance with expected semantic selectivity. Together, this work provides a new computational framework for understanding how visual information is adaptively weighted by cortical populations during dynamic visual perception.

title: Finite-Sample Theory for Fitted Q-Iteration When Actions Are Functions
summary: Offline reinforcement learning seeks optimal decision rules from previously collected data. In some applications, a decision can be an entire function, such as a fluence map in radiation therapy or a smooth movement trajectory in robotics. In this paper, we study the finite-sample theory for fitted Q-iteration (FQI) with functional actions in a discounted infinite-horizon setting. Three major difficulties arise in this setting: first, the absence of a Lebesgue probability density for functional actions complicates coverage descriptions; second, conventional coverage requirements can be restrictive; and third, the large functional action space makes greedy optimization in FQI challenging. To address these difficulties, we study smoothness-regularized policy search under a critic-relative coverage condition. This condition measures how well logged data distinguish relevant action-value differences without requiring an action density. Our main theorem gives finite-sample guarantees for learned-policy regret relative to the best value within a fixed smooth class of functional-action policies. The results allow trajectory lengths to be either bounded or growing and Q-functions to be fitted by either functional-input kernel ridge regression or adaptive functional neural networks. For a few examples, we can obtain polynomially decaying regret bounds in the number of logged transitions, up to logarithmic factors, with logarithmically many FQI iterations. Numerical experiments show gains of learned functional-action policies over constant-action policies and support our adoption of a critic-relative coverage condition.

title: Receptive-field-constrained stimulus optimization for human early and intermediate visual cortex
summary: An ongoing challenge in sensory neuroscience is to characterize the feature dimensions encoded by cortical populations. Recent approaches probe feature selectivity in a data-driven way, by synthesizing a most-exciting-input (MEI) for a target neural population. While this approach has been successfully applied to human higher visual cortex using fMRI data, generating MEIs for early- and mid-level retinotopic visual areas requires additional modeling constraints due to small receptive field sizes. To address this challenge, we introduce two novel MEI generation frameworks, Receptive Field Diffusion for Visual Exploration (RF-DiVE) and Receptive Field Gradient Optimization (RF-GO). Both methods use a population receptive field (pRF)-constrained voxelwise encoding model; RF-DiVE combines this with a pretrained latent diffusion model, while RF-GO uses regularized gradient ascent. When applied to single voxels in retinotopically defined areas V1-hV4, using data from the Natural Scenes Dataset, we obtain MEIs that exhibit consistent structure within the pRF, suggesting selectivity for local features like contour, color, and texture. We systematically compare MEIs generated by RF-DiVE and RF-GO using two encoding backbones, performing in-silico validation of predicted responses to MEIs using independent encoding models. Across all methods and all visual areas, MEIs elicit higher model-predicted responses than the most activating natural images. We further find that the choice of generation framework and encoding backbone differentially affects MEI properties, including their visual appearance, structural interpretability, and cross-model generalizability. These results offer a new approach for performing data-driven characterization of spatial and feature selectivity across human visual cortex.

title: LOCO-AdaMP: Built-in LOCO Inference for Adaptive Minipatch Ensembles with Enhanced Prediction
summary: As black-box machine learning models become increasingly common, extracting interpretations with uncertainty quantification has become a critical challenge. One popular type of interpretation is leave-one-covariate-out (LOCO) feature importance, while prior LOCO inference methods often require data-splitting or model-refitting. A recent ensemble framework, LOCO-MP, addresses these challenges using minipatches that subsample both observations and features, but massive feature subsampling can hurt prediction in high-dimensional sparse settings. Motivated by this limitation, we consider minipatch ensembles with adaptive feature sampling guided by LOCO importance, and propose LOCO-AdaMP, which enables free LOCO inference for the resulting adaptive minipatch ensemble. We show that LOCO-AdaMP yields substantially improved predictive models while retaining asymptotically valid feature importance inference without data-splitting, despite the complex dependence between the adaptive sampling distribution and the LOCO importance statistics. Our analysis relies on a careful leave-two-out perturbation bound for the iteratively updated sampling probabilities together with the stability of LOCO scores induced by observation subsampling. Empirical results on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate advantages of LOCO-AdaMP over existing methods in predictive performance, inferential power, and stability. Overall, LOCO-AdaMP provides a flexible ensemble framework (agnostic to base models) that delivers both strong predictive performance and asymptotically valid, powerful feature importance inference for regression.

title: Where Should Physics Enter a Molecular Crystal Generator?
summary: Generative models make molecular crystal structure prediction fast, but their samples still exhibit geometric and packing violations. Physics can be introduced during training, post-training, or inference, yet these choices are rarely compared with the generator and physical signal held fixed. We introduce CrystAF, an all-atom crystal flow-map generation model, and use it with the UMA interatomic potential to systematically study where physics should enter. Post-training learns physical preferences directly into CrystAF, improving molecular validity and crystal packing while leaving sampling unchanged: physics is paid for once during training rather than repeatedly at deployment. In contrast, UMA relaxation is effective at repairing local clashes but makes generation 6--26$\times$ slower, while learning from relaxed targets provides little benefit. These routes are complementary rather than competing. Physics-informed post-training first shifts the generated distribution toward more physically reasonable structures, after which inexpensive inference-time corrections further remove clashes and restore stereochemistry that the generator cannot represent. Importantly, the same post-training strategy also improves the multi-step all-atom Clari-M and rigid-body MolCrystalFlow generators, demonstrating transfer across architectures and representations. Together, our results suggest a simple principle: learn reusable physical alignment into the generator, and reserve inference-time physics for residual constraints that are better corrected than learned.
