title: CAMEO: A Class-Activation-Mapped Equitable Overlay Framework for Fair and Robust Deep Learning-based Skin Condition Diagnosis
summary: Deep learning classifiers for dermoscopic skin lesions often reach high in-distribution accuracy while quietly relying on spurious background cues such as skin tone, device vignetting, and embedded rulers, rather than on lesion morphology. This undermines robustness and fairness across skin tones. This work asks whether Explainable AI (XAI), typically used only to audit a finished model, can instead be repurposed as an active training signal that corrects this shortcut without sacrificing diagnostic accuracy. We introduce CAMEO (Class Activation Mapped Equitable Overlay), a framework that improves skin-lesion classification by selecting stable model explanations and using them to separate lesions from their backgrounds. It then replaces the background with realistic synthetic skin while keeping the lesion unchanged. On HAM10000 and dark-skin ISIC images, CAMEO maintained accuracy while reducing background-driven errors by nearly four times. It also made the model's attention more consistent when backgrounds changed. Results across multiple tests show that reducing reliance on background information improves robustness, with Fitzpatrick-based backgrounds providing a realistic and interpretable approach. Results show that XAI-guided augmentation can make dermoscopic classifiers measurably more robust and fair at no cost to accuracy. They also clarify that it is the mechanism and not the specific tone palette that matters, and that the lasting contribution of XAI here lies in stability-screened, annotation-free lesion localisation rather than in the robustness number itself.

AI.title_translation: CAMEO：一种基于类激活映射的公平叠加框架，用于公平和鲁棒的深度学习皮肤病诊断
AI.tldr: CAMEO框架通过利用可解释AI（XAI）作为训练信号来修正皮肤病诊断模型中对背景线索的依赖，从而在不牺牲准确性的前提下显著提高了模型的公平性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 深度学习皮肤病分类器在诊断皮肤病变时，常常依赖于皮肤色调、设备晕影和嵌入式标尺等虚假背景线索，而非病变形态本身，这损害了模型在不同肤色间的鲁棒性和公平性。
AI.method: 本研究提出了CAMEO（Class Activation Mapped Equitable Overlay）框架。该框架利用可解释AI（XAI）选择稳定的模型解释，并用其将病变与背景分离。随后，它用逼真的合成皮肤替换背景，同时保持病变图像不变，以此作为一种主动训练信号来纠正模型的捷径学习。
AI.result: 在HAM10000和深肤色ISIC图像数据集上，CAMEO在保持诊断准确性的同时，将背景驱动的错误减少了近四倍。它还使得模型在背景变化时注意力更加一致。多项测试结果表明，减少对背景信息的依赖可以提高模型的鲁棒性，并且基于Fitzpatrick的背景提供了一种现实且可解释的方法。
AI.conclusion: XAI引导的数据增强可以在不牺牲准确性的前提下，显著提高皮肤镜分类器的鲁棒性和公平性。研究还明确指出，关键在于机制而非特定的色调，并且XAI在此的持久贡献在于通过稳定性筛选实现的无标注病变定位，而非鲁棒性数值本身。
AI.translation: 深度学习皮肤病变分类器通常能达到很高的分布内准确率，但却悄然依赖于虚假的背景线索，例如肤色、设备晕影和嵌入式标尺，而非病变形态本身。这损害了跨肤色的鲁棒性和公平性。这项工作探讨了可解释AI（XAI）——通常仅用于审计已完成的模型——是否可以被重新用作一种主动训练信号，以在不牺牲诊断准确性的情况下纠正这种捷径。我们引入了CAMEO（Class Activation Mapped Equitable Overlay），一个通过选择稳定的模型解释并利用它们将病变与背景分离来改进皮肤病变分类的框架。然后，它用逼真的合成皮肤替换背景，同时保持病变不变。在HAM10000和深肤色ISIC图像上，CAMEO在保持准确性的同时，将背景驱动的错误减少了近四倍。它还使得模型在背景变化时注意力更加一致。多项测试结果表明，减少对背景信息的依赖可以提高鲁棒性，其中基于Fitzpatrick的背景提供了一种现实且可解释的方法。结果表明，XAI引导的增强可以在不牺牲准确性的情况下，使皮肤镜分类器在可衡量上更具鲁棒性和公平性。它们还阐明了重要的是机制而非特定的色调，并且XAI在此的持久贡献在于通过稳定性筛选实现的无标注病变定位，而非鲁棒性数字本身。
AI.summary: 本论文提出CAMEO框架，旨在解决深度学习皮肤病诊断模型过度依赖背景线索导致公平性和鲁棒性不足的问题。CAMEO将可解释AI（XAI）从审计工具转变为主动训练信号，通过利用XAI生成的类激活图来分离病变与背景，并替换背景以生成增强数据。实验结果表明，CAMEO在不影响准确性的前提下，显著减少了模型对背景的依赖，提升了诊断的公平性和鲁棒性，尤其是在深肤色图像上表现优异，并强调了XAI在无标注病变定位中的关键作用。
AI.keywords: 皮肤病诊断, 深度学习, 可解释AI, 公平性, 鲁棒性, 数据增强, 类激活图
AI.comments: CAMEO框架的创新之处在于其将可解释AI（XAI）从传统的模型审计工具重新定位为一种主动的训练信号，用于指导数据增强。这种XAI引导的增强方法，特别是通过稳定性筛选实现无标注病变定位，为解决深度学习模型在医疗诊断中存在的公平性和鲁棒性问题提供了一个新颖且有效途径。该方法在不牺牲准确性的前提下显著提升了模型性能，对于提高医疗AI的可信度和实际应用价值具有重要意义。

title: Degree Balance as a Fine-Grained Complexity Boundary for Quantum SAT
summary:
The local Hamiltonian problem is the canonical $\mathsf{QMA}$-complete problem, and $O(2^n)$ time classical algorithms and $O(2^{n/2})$ time quantum algorithms are known to solve the problem in the worst case. It is not clear how to improve these brute force strategies for a broad class of the problem because ground states are highly entangled in general, and we cannot directly apply known strategies for classical CSPs.
  In this work, we present exponentially faster classical and quantum algorithms under two mild assumptions: (1) the Hamiltonian is frustration-free on YES instances, and (2) it is approximately regular, meaning that every qubit is acted upon by approximately the same number of constraints.
  We complement these upper bounds by showing that, assuming (Q)SETH, quantum 5-SAT admits no non-trivial worst-case speedup. Our lower bound further demonstrates that the dependence of our algorithms on regularity is in some sense nearly optimal. Specifically, quantum 5-SAT remains (Q)SETH-hard even for Hamiltonians in which all but $O(\sqrt{n})$ qubits participate in only constantly many constraints, while the remaining $O(\sqrt{n})$ qubits each participate in $O(\sqrt{n})$ constraints. By contrast, if either the size of this high-degree subset or the degrees of its qubits is reduced by a factor of $n^δ$, for any $δ>0$, our algorithm solves the problem in time $O(2^{(1- \varepsilon)n})$ for some $\varepsilon>0$.
  Together, our upper and lower bounds establish a fine-grained complexity dichotomy for quantum satisfiability.

AI.title_translation: 量子SAT的度平衡作为细粒度复杂度边界
AI.tldr: 本文在无挫折和近似正则条件下，为局部哈密顿量问题提出了指数级更快的经典和量子算法；同时，在(Q)SETH假设下，证明量子5-SAT没有非平凡的最坏情况加速，从而建立了量子可满足性的细粒度复杂度二分法。
AI.motivation: 局部哈密顿量问题是QMA完全问题，现有算法在最坏情况下是暴力求解（经典$O(2^n)$，量子$O(2^{n/2})$）。由于基态通常高度纠缠，无法直接应用经典CSP策略，因此很难改进这些暴力策略。
AI.method: 本文在哈密顿量无挫折且近似正则（即每个量子比特受到大致相同数量的约束作用）的两个温和假设下，提出了指数级更快的经典和量子算法。此外，通过证明在(Q)SETH假设下，量子5-SAT不承认非平凡的最坏情况加速，并指出算法对正则性的依赖是接近最优的，从而提供了下限。
AI.result: 1. 在哈密顿量无挫折且近似正则的条件下，提出了指数级更快的经典和量子算法。2. 在(Q)SETH假设下，量子5-SAT没有非平凡的最坏情况加速。3. 下限结果表明，算法对正则性的依赖在某种意义上是接近最优的。具体而言，即使在大多数量子比特度数较低但少数$O(\sqrt{n})$个量子比特度数较高（$O(\sqrt{n})$）的情况下，量子5-SAT仍然是(Q)SETH难的。4. 如果高度数子集的大小或其量子比特的度数减少$n^\delta$倍，算法可以在$O(2^{(1-\varepsilon)n})$时间内解决问题。
AI.conclusion: 综合来看，本文的上限和下限为量子可满足性建立了一个细粒度复杂度二分法。
AI.translation:
局部哈密顿量问题是规范的$\mathsf{QMA}$完全问题，已知在最坏情况下，经典算法需要$O(2^n)$时间，量子算法需要$O(2^{n/2})$时间来解决该问题。对于一类广泛的问题，如何改进这些暴力策略尚不清楚，因为基态通常高度纠缠，我们无法直接应用经典的CSP已知策略。
在这项工作中，我们在两个温和的假设下提出了指数级更快的经典和量子算法：(1) 哈密顿量在YES实例上是无挫折的，并且 (2) 它是近似正则的，这意味着每个量子比特受到大致相同数量的约束作用。
我们通过证明，假设(Q)SETH，量子5-SAT不承认非平凡的最坏情况加速来补充这些上限。我们的下限进一步表明，我们的算法对正则性的依赖在某种意义上是接近最优的。具体而言，即使对于除$O(\sqrt{n})$个量子比特外，所有量子比特都只参与常数个约束，而剩余的$O(\sqrt{n})$个量子比特各自参与$O(\sqrt{n})$个约束的哈密顿量，量子5-SAT仍然是(Q)SETH难的。相比之下，如果这个高度数子集的大小或其量子比特的度数减少$n^\delta$倍，对于任何$\delta>0$，我们的算法可以在$O(2^{(1- \varepsilon)n})$时间内解决该问题，对于某个$\varepsilon>0$。
综合来看，我们的上限和下限为量子可满足性建立了一个细粒度复杂度二分法。
AI.summary: 本文研究了QMA完全的局部哈密顿量问题，针对现有暴力算法效率低下的问题，在哈密顿量无挫折且近似正则的两个温和假设下，提出了指数级更快的经典和量子算法。同时，通过引入下限，证明在(Q)SETH假设下量子5-SAT没有非平凡的最坏情况加速，并指出算法对正则性的依赖是接近最优的。这些发现共同为量子可满足性建立了一个细粒度复杂度二分法，揭示了结构特性如何影响量子计算的复杂性边界。
AI.keywords: 量子SAT, 局部哈密顿量, 细粒度复杂度, 度平衡, 量子算法
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它超越了量子SAT问题的最坏情况复杂度分析，引入了“度平衡”（即近似正则性）这一细粒度结构特性作为影响算法效率的关键因素。通过同时提供新的高效算法（上限）和证明某些情况下无法进一步加速（下限），论文为量子可满足性建立了一个全面的细粒度复杂度图景。这对于理解量子计算的内在限制和发现特定条件下的加速潜力具有重要意义。

title: Travel Mode- and Purpose-Specific Origin-Destination Matrices for England and Wales from Fused Travel Survey and Mobile Network Data
comments: 13 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Supplementary material provided as an ancillary file
summary: Origin-destination (OD) matrices sit behind much of quantitative transport planning, from model calibration and accessibility analysis to the appraisal of new services and development. The increasing emphasis on place-based solutions requires mobility data that can support decision-making not only at the strategic level, but also at finer spatial scales. This requires up-to-date OD evidence at small-area resolution, disaggregated by travel mode and purpose, which remains either inaccessible or unavailable. In this work, we present dense MSOA-to-MSOA OD matrices for England and Wales, segmented by seven travel modes and representative time periods, with eight trip purposes for the weekday morning peak. The matrices are built by calibrating aggregate mobile network data provided by BT against National Travel Survey (NTS), census and trip-rate evidence, preserving the observed spatial structure of movement while referencing its age, mode and purpose composition to the survey. The open-source data processing pipeline is released alongside the matrices, so that the construction of the dataset can be inspected in full and adapted to other years, regions or assumptions.
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Supplementary material provided as an ancillary file

AI.title_translation: 基于融合出行调查与移动网络数据的英格兰和威尔士特定出行方式与目的的起点-终点矩阵
AI.tldr: 本研究通过融合移动网络数据与出行调查，首次为英格兰和威尔士生成了高分辨率、按出行方式与目的细分的开源OD矩阵，赋能精细化交通规划。
AI.motivation: 现代定量交通规划和基于地方的解决方案需要精细空间尺度、实时更新、且按出行方式和目的细分的OD矩阵，而现有数据往往无法满足这些要求，因此需要开发新的数据融合方法。
AI.method: 通过使用国家出行调查（NTS）、人口普查和出行率数据，对来自BT的聚合移动网络数据进行校准，在保持移动空间结构的同时，利用调查数据反映年龄、出行方式和目的构成。
AI.result: 成功生成了英格兰和威尔士MSOA到MSOA的高密度OD矩阵，包含7种出行方式、代表性时间段，以及工作日早高峰的8种出行目的，并发布了开源数据处理流程。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合移动网络大数据与多源调查数据，本文成功构建并开源了英格兰和威尔士高分辨率、多维细分的OD矩阵，有效支持了精细化和基于地方的交通规划与决策。
AI.translation: 起点-终点（OD）矩阵是许多定量交通规划的基础，从模型校准和可达性分析到新服务和开发的评估均需用到。对基于地方的解决方案日益增加的强调，要求交通流动数据不仅能支持战略层面的决策，还能支持更精细空间尺度的决策。这就需要最新的、小区域分辨率的、按出行方式和目的细分的OD证据，而这些目前要么无法获取，要么不可用。在这项工作中，我们展示了英格兰和威尔士稠密的MSOA到MSOA的OD矩阵，按七种出行方式和代表性时间段进行细分，并针对工作日早高峰划分了八种出行目的。这些矩阵是通过将BT提供的聚合移动网络数据与国家出行调查（NTS）、人口普查和出行率证据进行校准而构建的，在保留观察到的移动空间结构的同时，将年龄、出行方式和目的构成与调查相关联。开源的数据处理流程与矩阵一同发布，以便可以完整地检查数据集的构建过程，并适用于其他年份、地区或假设。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种融合移动网络大数据与国家出行调查数据的方法，生成了英格兰和威尔士高空间分辨率（MSOA到MSOA）、按出行方式和目的细分的全面OD矩阵，并开源了相关数据处理流程。
AI.keywords: Origin-destination matrices, Mobile network data, Travel survey, Transport planning, England and Wales
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将移动运营商的大数据与国家出行调查（NTS）及人口普查数据进行融合，生成了高空间分辨率、按出行方式和目的细分的英格兰和威尔士OD矩阵，并开源了处理流程，极大地填补了精细化交通规划数据的空白。

title: Quantum Computing for Network Security Classification: Near-Term Classification and Long-Term Memory Efficiency
summary: Quantum computing has already been explored in several network-security applications. However, how quantum computing may contribute to network-security classification in both the near term and the longer term has not been systematically discussed. This paper studies this question through two complementary experiments. First, we evaluate near-term quantum-kernel support vector machines (SVMs) on practical network-security classification tasks and compare them with classical SVM baselines on KDD Cup 1999, CICIDS2017, and BoT-IoT. Across these runs, quantum kernels are competitive. They can match or improve classical baselines in some settings, while classical RBF kernels remain stronger in others. This suggests that near-term quantum-kernel methods should be evaluated as practical, dataset-dependent alternatives to classical kernels rather than as uniformly superior replacements. Second, we use quantum oracle sketching (QOS) to study a longer-term memory advantage for classification with streaming classical samples. In QOS, samples are processed online and used to incrementally construct an approximate quantum oracle, which provides coherent query access for downstream quantum algorithms without retaining the entire dataset. Under the QOS-inspired machine-size estimate, comparable accuracy corresponds to a substantially smaller effective memory-size proxy than explicit sparse/QRAM-style storage. Compared with a simple streaming proxy, the result is more nuanced because aggressive feature filtering can make the streaming dimension small. This suggests that the long-term value of quantum computing for network-security classification may lie in memory-efficient data access rather than immediate runtime speedup. Together, these experiments show how quantum computing may contribute to network-security classification from near-term classification performance and longer-term memory efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 面向网络安全分类的量子计算：近期分类与长期内存效率
AI.tldr: 本文研究了量子计算在网络安全分类中的应用，发现近期量子核SVM可作为经典方法的有效替代，而长期来看其主要价值在于内存高效的数据访问。
AI.motivation: 尽管量子计算已在多个网络安全应用中得到探索，但其在近期和长期网络安全分类中的具体贡献尚未得到系统探讨，因此需要通过实验评估其实际效用。
AI.method: 通过两个互补的实验进行研究：首先评估近期量子核支持向量机（SVMs）在KDD Cup 1999、CICIDS2017和BoT-IoT数据集上的表现，并与经典SVM基线进行对比；其次利用量子Oracle草图（QOS）研究流式经典样本分类中的长期内存优势。
AI.result: 近期量子核SVM具有竞争力，在某些设置下能匹配或超越经典基线，但在其他设置下经典RBF核仍更强；在长期内存效率方面，QOS通过在线处理和增量构建近似量子Oracle，在对应可比准确率时展现出比显式稀疏/QRAM式存储小得多的有效内存大小代理。
AI.conclusion: 量子计算在网络安全分类中的价值是多维度的：近期表现为作为经典核函数的有效、数据集依赖的替代方案，而长远来看则体现为通过数据流处理实现的高效内存访问。
AI.translation: 量子计算已经在几个网络安全应用中得到了探索。然而，量子计算如何在近期和长期对网络安全分类做出贡献，尚未得到系统地讨论。本文通过两个互补的实验研究了这个问题。首先，我们在KDD Cup 1999、CICIDS2017和BoT-IoT数据集上评估了近期量子核支持向量机（SVMs）在实际网络安全分类任务中的表现，并将其与经典SVM基线进行了比较。在这些运行中，量子核具有竞争力。它们在某些设置下可以匹配或改善经典基线，而在其他设置下经典RBF核仍然更强。这表明，近期的量子核方法应该被评估为经典核的实际的、依赖于数据集的替代方案，而不是统一的优越替代品。其次，我们使用量子Oracle草图（QOS）来研究流式经典样本分类的长期内存优势。在QOS中，样本被在线处理并用于增量构建近似量子Oracle，它为下游量子算法提供相干查询访问，而无需保留整个数据集。在QOS启发的机器大小估计下，可比的准确度对应于比显式稀疏/QRAM式存储大为缩小的有效内存大小代理。与简单的流式代理相比，结果更加微妙，因为积极的特征过滤可以使流式维度变小。这表明，量子计算对网络安全分类的长期价值可能在于内存高效的数据访问，而不是即时的运行加速。总之，这些实验展示了量子计算如何从近期分类性能和长期内存效率方面对网络安全分类做出贡献。
AI.summary: 该论文通过两个互补的实验研究了量子计算在网络安全分类中的应用。一方面，评估了近期的量子核支持向量机，发现其性能具有竞争力且取决于具体数据集；另一方面，利用量子Oracle草图探讨了长期的内存效率，表明量子计算在网络安全分类中的长期价值可能在于内存高效的数据访问而非即时的运行加速。
AI.keywords: 量子计算, 网络安全分类, 量子核支持向量机, 量子Oracle草图, 内存效率
AI.comments: 该论文系统地探讨了量子计算在网络安全分类中的应用，兼顾了近期的分类性能和长期的内存效率。通过具体的实验评估，打破了“量子算法必然全面超越经典算法”的迷思，强调了量子核方法和量子Oracle草图（QOS）在实际应用中的权衡与数据集依赖性，为量子机器学习在网络安全领域的落地提供了理性且深刻的见解。

title: Reliability Testing of Medical Model Performance under Distributed Deployment
summary: Distributed inference has become an indispensable part of deploying medical models under practical latency, memory, and throughput constraints. Although modern frameworks improve serving efficiency through tensor parallelism, mixed precision, kernel fusion, and multi-device communication, they are generally assumed to preserve the behavior observed during centralized HuggingFace evaluation. This assumption creates an evaluation-deployment mismatch: a model may pass offline evaluation but produce a different output after the execution stack changes. To address this mismatch, we propose a testing framework and an improved, distributed-execution-sensitive medical-model benchmark that evaluates the same checkpoint and input under a centralized HuggingFace reference and matched distributed deployments. Extensive experiments across language, vision, and multimodal medical models show that execution changes can produce measurable output disagreements. Across supported visual settings, the test success rate ranges from 0.21 to 0.43 for single-modality models and from 0.32 to 0.98 for multimodal models. The benchmark is aimed at extending medical-model evaluation from capability and security to evaluation-deployment consistency.

AI.title_translation: 医疗模型在分布式部署下的性能可靠性测试
AI.tldr: 医疗模型在分布式部署时，其输出可能与集中式评估不一致，本文提出了一个测试框架和基准来评估这种不一致性，并发现执行变化会导致显著的输出差异。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗模型在分布式部署时，假设其行为与集中式评估一致，但这导致了评估与部署之间的不匹配，即模型在执行栈变化后可能产生不同输出。
AI.method: 提出一个测试框架和一个改进的、对分布式执行敏感的医疗模型基准，通过在集中式HuggingFace参考和匹配的分布式部署下评估相同的检查点和输入来解决评估-部署不匹配问题。
AI.result: 跨语言、视觉和多模态医疗模型的广泛实验表明，执行变化会产生可测量的输出不一致。在支持的视觉设置中，单模态模型的测试成功率范围为0.21至0.43，多模态模型为0.32至0.98。
AI.conclusion: 该基准旨在将医疗模型的评估从能力和安全性扩展到评估-部署一致性。
AI.translation: 分布式推理已成为在实际延迟、内存和吞吐量限制下部署医疗模型不可或缺的一部分。尽管现代框架通过张量并行、混合精度、内核融合和多设备通信提高了服务效率，但通常假设它们会保留在集中式HuggingFace评估中观察到的行为。这种假设导致了评估-部署不匹配：模型可能通过离线评估，但在执行栈更改后产生不同的输出。为了解决这种不匹配，我们提出了一个测试框架和一个改进的、对分布式执行敏感的医疗模型基准，该基准在集中式HuggingFace参考和匹配的分布式部署下评估相同的检查点和输入。对语言、视觉和多模态医疗模型的广泛实验表明，执行变化会产生可测量的输出不一致。在支持的视觉设置中，单模态模型的测试成功率范围为0.21至0.43，多模态模型为0.32至0.98。该基准旨在将医疗模型的评估从能力和安全性扩展到评估-部署一致性。
AI.summary: 本文针对医疗模型在分布式部署中存在的评估与部署不匹配问题，即模型在执行栈变化后可能产生与集中式评估不同的输出，提出了一种新的测试框架和分布式执行敏感的医疗模型基准。该基准通过在集中式参考和分布式部署下评估相同模型和输入来量化不一致性。实验证明，执行变化会导致显著的输出差异，并且该基准旨在提升医疗模型评估的部署一致性。
AI.keywords: 医疗模型, 分布式部署, 可靠性测试, 评估-部署不匹配, 基准
AI.comments: 这篇论文解决了医疗模型在实际部署中一个重要但常被忽视的问题——分布式部署引起的行为不一致性。其创新之处在于提出了一个专门的测试框架和基准来量化这种不一致性，这对于确保医疗AI的可靠性和安全性至关重要。研究结果揭示了这种不一致性的普遍存在，并为未来的模型部署实践提供了有价值的指导。

title: Hierarchical Utility Calibration for Structured Multiclass Decisions
summary: In multiclass probabilistic prediction, Utility Calibration (UC), which focuses auditing on specified utilities, has recently received attention as a way to guarantee downstream decisions while controlling computational and sample requirements. At the same time, some multiclass problems have meaningful label hierarchies that play important roles in medicine and image classification, yet how UC evaluates utility within a hierarchy remains insufficiently understood. We show that the difference between realized utility and predicted mean utility admits an exact decomposition into a sum of contributions from the internal nodes of the label tree. This decomposition shows that positive and negative contributions from different nodes can cancel, and that even when UC is small, the utility errors remaining in parts of the hierarchy need not be small. To address this problem, we propose Hierarchical Utility Calibration (HUC), which evaluates each node contribution before summation while retaining the same target utility, subgroup, and predicted-utility interval. We further provide finite-sample evaluation over all predicted-utility intervals and propose HUC-Boost, which updates only violated internal nodes, with theoretical guarantees for both.

AI.title_translation: 结构化多类决策的层次效用校准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了层次效用校准（HUC），以解决在具有标签层次结构的多类预测中，传统效用校准（UC）可能无法充分评估层次结构内部效用误差的问题，并提供了HUC-Boost算法及其理论保证。
AI.motivation: 在多类概率预测中，效用校准（UC）被用于保证下游决策，同时控制计算和样本需求。然而，在医学和图像分类等领域，一些多类问题具有重要的标签层次结构，但UC如何评估层次结构内的效用尚不清楚，且现有方法可能导致层次结构部分中的效用误差不小。
AI.method: 本文首先证明了实现效用与预测平均效用之间的差异可以精确分解为标签树内部节点的贡献总和。为了解决现有UC的局限性，提出了层次效用校准（HUC），它在求和之前评估每个节点的贡献，同时保持相同的目标效用、子组和预测效用区间。此外，还提供了所有预测效用区间的有限样本评估，并提出了HUC-Boost算法，该算法仅更新违反的内部节点。
AI.result: 研究发现，实现效用与预测平均效用之间的差异可以分解为标签树内部节点的贡献总和，这表明来自不同节点的正负贡献可能会相互抵消，即使UC值很小，层次结构部分中的效用误差也可能不小。通过HUC和HUC-Boost，可以在保持相同目标效用等条件的同时，更有效地评估和校准层次结构内的效用误差，并提供了理论保证。
AI.conclusion: 传统的效用校准在具有标签层次结构的多类决策中存在局限性，可能无法充分捕捉层次内部的效用误差。本文提出的层次效用校准（HUC）及其HUC-Boost算法通过分解并单独评估层次结构中每个节点的贡献，有效解决了这一问题，并提供了理论保证，为结构化多类决策提供了更精细的效用校准方法。
AI.translation: 在多类概率预测中，效用校准（UC）通过将审计重点放在特定效用上，最近作为一种在控制计算和样本需求的同时保证下游决策的方法受到了关注。与此同时，一些多类问题具有在医学和图像分类中扮演重要角色的有意义的标签层次结构，然而UC如何评估层次结构内的效用仍然理解不足。我们表明，实现效用与预测平均效用之间的差异可以精确分解为标签树内部节点的贡献总和。这种分解表明，来自不同节点的正负贡献可以相互抵消，并且即使UC很小，层次结构部分中剩余的效用误差也无需很小。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了层次效用校准（HUC），它在求和之前评估每个节点的贡献，同时保留相同的目标效用、子组和预测效用区间。我们进一步提供了所有预测效用区间的有限样本评估，并提出了HUC-Boost，它仅更新违反的内部节点，两者均具有理论保证。
AI.summary: 本文针对多类概率预测中具有标签层次结构的问题，指出传统效用校准（UC）可能无法充分揭示层次结构内部的效用误差。研究首先证明了效用差异可分解为标签树内部节点的贡献总和，并发现这些贡献可能相互抵消，导致UC虽小但局部误差仍大。为解决此问题，提出了层次效用校准（HUC），它在求和前评估每个节点的贡献，并保持目标效用等参数不变。此外，还提出了HUC-Boost算法，该算法仅更新违反的内部节点，并提供了两者的理论保证，旨在为结构化多类决策提供更精确的效用校准。
AI.keywords: 效用校准, 层次结构, 多类决策, 误差分解, HUC-Boost
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于揭示了传统效用校准在处理具有层次结构的标签时可能存在的不足，即效用误差的分解和相互抵消问题。通过提出层次效用校准（HUC）和HUC-Boost，该研究提供了一种更精细、更准确的方法来评估和校准层次结构内部的效用，这对于医学诊断和图像分类等对错误敏感的领域具有重要意义。理论保证的提供增加了方法的可信度。

title: Second-Moment Stochastic Approximation Methods
summary: Classical stochastic approximation methods rely on estimators of the first moment (mean) of a random regression function. We study methods that employ estimators of both the first and the second moments, which include modern deep-learning optimizers such as Adam and Muon as special cases. We derive second-moment stochastic approximation methods through the lens of optimal preconditioning for solving matrix equations, and develop a two-stage framework for their convergence analysis. The first stage focuses on the analysis of conceptual (impractical) methods that rely on the exact first and second moments. In the second stage, we replace the exact moments with their respective estimators, and invoke Dvoretzky's theorem to show that the resulting practical methods converge almost surely to a neighborhood of the target solution. The size of the neighborhood depends on the biases and variances of the first- and second-moment estimators. We derive concrete bounds for Muon and a spectral variant of Adam that determine the radius of their neighborhood of convergence.

AI.title_translation: 二阶随机逼近方法
AI.tldr: 本文通过最优预处理视角统一研究了包含Adam和Muon在内的二阶随机逼近优化方法，并建立了两阶段收敛性分析框架，证明了其几乎必然收敛到由矩估计误差决定的邻域。
AI.motivation: 传统随机逼近方法仅依赖随机回归函数一阶矩（均值）的估计器，而现代深度学习优化器（如Adam和Muon）同时使用了第一矩和第二矩估计器，本文旨在为这类同时利用一阶和二阶矩的随机逼近方法建立统一的理论和收敛性分析框架。
AI.method: 通过求解矩阵方程的最优预处理视角推导二阶随机逼近方法，并开发了一个两阶段收敛分析框架：第一阶段分析依赖精确矩的理想方法，第二阶段利用Dvoretzky定理将精确矩替换为估计器，研究其实际收敛性。
AI.result: 证明了所得的实际方法几乎必然收敛到目标解的一个邻域，该邻域的大小取决于一阶和二阶矩估计器的偏差和方差，并为Muon和Adam的谱变体推导出了明确的收敛邻域半径界限。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功推导并分析了一类二阶随机逼近方法，证明了其实际算法几乎必然收敛到目标解的邻域，并通过具体界限阐明了Muon和Adam变体的收敛半径与矩估计误差的关系。
AI.translation: 经典随机逼近方法依赖于随机回归函数一阶矩（均值）的估计器。我们研究了同时使用一阶和二阶矩估计器的方法，其中包括现代深度学习优化器（如Adam和Muon）作为特例。我们通过求解矩阵方程的最优预处理视角推导了二阶随机逼近方法，并开发了一个用于其收敛分析的两阶段框架。第一阶段侧重于分析依赖于精确一阶和二阶矩的概念性（不切实际的）方法。在第二阶段中，我们用各自的估计器替换精确矩，并调用Dvoretzky定理证明所得的实际方法几乎必然收敛到目标解的邻域。该邻域的大小取决于一阶和二阶矩估计器的偏差和方差。我们推导了Muon和Adam的谱变体的具体界限，这些界限决定了它们收敛邻域的半径。
AI.summary: 本文研究了结合一阶和二阶矩估计器的随机逼近方法，涵盖了Adam和Muon等现代深度学习优化器。作者通过最优预处理视角推导了这些方法，并建立了一个两阶段收敛性分析框架，证明了算法几乎必然收敛至由矩估计误差决定的目标解邻域，同时给出了具体优化器的收敛半径界限。
AI.keywords: 随机逼近, 二阶矩估计, 优化器, 深度学习, 收敛性分析
AI.comments: 该论文通过最优预处理视角统一了现代深度学习优化器（如Adam和Muon），并利用Dvoretzky定理建立了一个严谨的两阶段收敛性分析框架，对理解一阶和二阶矩估计的偏差与方差对收敛性能的影响具有重要理论价值。

title: Best Practices in EEG Analysis: Preprocessing, Modeling, and Machine Learning
comments: 38 pages, 5 figures. Chapter 16 of the 2026 monograph "Electroencephalogram Signals and Cognition," edited by Hema A. Murthy, Shrikanth Narayanan, Mriganka Sur, and Rajeswari Aghoram
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis requires careful choices in preprocessing, statistical modeling, and machine learning because EEG signals are highly susceptible to artifacts, volume conduction, low signal-to-noise ratio, and substantial inter-subject variability. This chapter provides a practical and methodological guide to modern EEG analysis, spanning EEG preprocessing, artifact removal, filtering, bad-channel detection and interpolation, re-referencing, independent component analysis (ICA), and preprocessing of simultaneous EEG-fMRI recordings. We review major approaches for computational EEG analysis, including event-related potentials (ERPs), time-frequency analysis, functional and effective connectivity, source localization, multivariate decoding, permutation testing, and multiple-comparison correction. We then examine machine-learning methods for EEG, from feature-based classifiers to deep learning and emerging EEG foundation models, with emphasis on cross-subject generalization, limited-data regimes, data leakage, evaluation metrics, and fair benchmarking. Reproducibility is treated as a core requirement throughout, including transparent preprocessing, BIDS-EEG data organization, standardized derivatives, preservation of raw data, and FAIR data practices. The chapter is intended as a practical reference for researchers developing reliable, interpretable, and reproducible EEG analysis and machine-learning pipelines.

AI.title_translation: 脑电图分析的最佳实践：预处理、建模和机器学习
AI.tldr: 本章为现代脑电图分析提供实用的方法指南，涵盖预处理、伪影去除、统计建模、机器学习方法以及可重复性实践。
AI.motivation: 脑电图信号易受伪影、容积传导、低信噪比和受试者间显著变异性的影响，因此在预处理、统计建模和机器学习方面需要仔细选择。本章旨在为研究人员提供开发可靠、可解释和可重复的脑电图分析和机器学习流程的实用参考。
AI.method: 本章涵盖脑电图预处理（伪影去除、滤波、坏通道检测和插值、重新参考、独立成分分析、同步脑电图-fMRI记录预处理）、计算脑电图分析（事件相关电位、时频分析、功能和有效连接、源定位、多变量解码、置换检验、多重比较校正）以及机器学习方法（基于特征的分类器、深度学习、新兴脑电图基础模型），并强调跨受试者泛化、有限数据、数据泄露、评估指标和公平基准测试。可重复性贯穿始终，包括透明预处理、BIDS-EEG数据组织、标准化衍生物、原始数据保存和FAIR数据实践。
AI.result: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.conclusion: 本章旨在为研究人员提供开发可靠、可解释和可重复的脑电图分析和机器学习流程的实用参考，强调可重复性是核心要求。
AI.translation: 脑电图（EEG）分析在预处理、统计建模和机器学习方面需要仔细选择，因为脑电图信号极易受到伪影、容积传导、低信噪比和受试者间显著变异性的影响。本章为现代脑电图分析提供了实用且方法性的指南，涵盖了脑电图预处理、伪影去除、滤波、坏通道检测与插值、重新参考、独立成分分析（ICA）以及同步脑电图-fMRI记录的预处理。我们回顾了计算脑电图分析的主要方法，包括事件相关电位（ERP）、时频分析、功能和有效连接、源定位、多变量解码、置换检验和多重比较校正。然后，我们考察了用于脑电图的机器学习方法，从基于特征的分类器到深度学习和新兴的脑电图基础模型，重点关注跨受试者泛化、有限数据状况、数据泄露、评估指标和公平基准测试。可重复性被视为贯穿始终的核心要求，包括透明预处理、BIDS-EEG数据组织、标准化衍生物、原始数据保存和FAIR数据实践。本章旨在为开发可靠、可解释和可重复的脑电图分析和机器学习流程的研究人员提供实用参考。
AI.summary: 本章提供了关于脑电图（EEG）分析的最佳实践指南，涵盖了从预处理（如伪影去除、滤波、ICA）到统计建模（如ERP、时频分析、源定位）以及机器学习方法（如深度学习、基础模型）的全面内容。文章强调了在处理EEG信号固有挑战时，如何实现可靠、可解释和可重复的分析流程，并特别关注数据可重复性实践。
AI.keywords: 脑电图分析, 预处理, 机器学习, 可重复性, 统计建模
AI.comments: 这篇章节为EEG分析领域提供了一个全面的实践指南，其创新性在于将传统EEG处理方法与新兴的机器学习和深度学习技术相结合，并强调了可重复性和公平基准测试的重要性，这对于推动EEG研究的标准化和可靠性具有重要意义。它作为一个参考，对于希望开发稳健EEG分析流程的研究人员非常有价值。

title: MyoCodec: A Streaming Neural Codec for Electromyography
summary: Neural codecs encode continuous signals into compact sequences of discrete tokens, providing an interface for efficient transmission, storage, and token-based sequence modeling. This paradigm has been widely adopted in modern speech and audio frameworks; however, the biosignal domain still lacks a neural codec designed specifically for low-bitrate streaming and generalization across diverse downstream tasks. We present MyoCodec, a streaming neural codec designed for electromyography (EMG). Inspired by recent neural audio codecs, MyoCodec combines causal Transformers with residual vector quantization to encode continuous EMG signals into different levels of EMG representations spanning from continuous latent features to discrete tokens operating at 50 Hz. Trained on twelve public EMG datasets, MyoCodec achieves favorable performance in both intrinsic codec quality and representative downstream tasks, including typing (emg2qwerty), hand-pose (emg2pose), speech decoding (emg2speech), and speech-to-EMG synthesis (speech2emg). Across these tasks, MyoCodec exhibits strong performance against prior models while providing a compact and causal EMG representation. During streaming inference, it requires compute time of only 0.482 ms for each 20 ms frame, enabling real-time streaming. Also, the discrete token representation provided by MyoCodec has the potential to support integration into language-model based approaches, creating a path toward LLM-based interactive systems, where tokenized EMG representations are directly processed into such language or speech models. Code and model weights are released.

title: Quantum Fidelity Landscape-Guided Prior Calibration for Single-Circuit QGAN Image Generation
summary: Quantum Generative Adversarial Networks (QGANs) have emerged as representative generative models in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era and have attracted increasing attention in quantum machine learning. However, most existing QGAN methods rely on patch-based decomposition strategies, which weaken the global consistency of generated images and increase quantum resource overhead. In this work, we investigate a simpler approach: pixel-level, end-to-end image generation using a single-quantum-circuit QGAN. By analyzing the structural matching relationship between the quantum prior and the target data distribution in Hilbert space, we provide a new theoretical perspective for understanding the training behavior of naive end-to-end QGANs. Specifically, we introduce the Quantum Fidelity Landscape (QFL), defined as the pairwise-fidelity structure induced by an ensemble of quantum states and preserved under shared unitary transformations of the quantum generation process. We show that, under a fixed Lipschitz readout, this invariant imposes a one-sided bound on decoded sample separation, motivating calibration of the prior-induced QFL before adversarial training. To validate this theoretical insight, we propose BasicQGAN, a QGAN framework incorporating quantum prior calibration. Before adversarial optimization, BasicQGAN aligns the prior-induced QFL with the data-induced QFL. Experimental results on small-scale grayscale image datasets show that BasicQGAN achieves stable and effective end-to-end pixel-level image generation while requiring fewer qubits and trainable parameters than representative patch-based quantum generators. Furthermore, experiments with different initial quantum-state ensembles show that QFL-calibrated ensembles achieve better generative performance.

title: Efficient Transmit Waveform Design for MIMO-OFDM DFRC Systems with 1-Bit DACS
summary: This paper studies efficient waveform design for MIMO-OFDM dual-functional radar-communication (DFRC) systems with 1-bit digital-to-analog converters (DACs), which remains underexplored in the literature. We formulate the DFRC waveform design problem by maximizing the trace of the target angular Fisher information matrix (FIM), subject to symbol-error probability constraints realized via constructive interference (CI) and a time-domain 1-bit transmit alphabet constraint. The resulting problem is a large-scale nonlinear integer programming problem. We develop an inexact alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) algorithm with alternating time- and frequency-domain updates. The proposed scheme enables subcarrier-wise optimization in the frequency domain and closed-form primal and dual updates in the time domain. In particular, the CI constraints are deliberately retained in both the time- and frequency-domain subproblems to promote the feasibility of intermediate iterates and improve the convergence behavior of ADMM. Simulation results demonstrate promising DFRC performance.

title: Does a prosody-trained representation help beyond trainable fusion? A parameter-matched study with frozen HuBERT
summary: Explicit prosodic cues may help automatic speech recognition (ASR) of spontaneous speech, but auxiliary representations typically require additional trainable components, making it unclear whether gains come from the auxiliary information or the fusion mechanism. We address this using a frozen HuBERT backbone and a 64-dimensional representation trained to predict log F0, voicing, Delta log F0, log energy, and spectral tilt. We compare a frozen-backbone recognizer (Baseline), trainable fusion with zero auxiliary input (Null), and the same fusion supplied with the learned representation (Learned). Across Buckeye, Switchboard, and AMI IHM, Null reduces WER by 0.71-1.45 points over Baseline, whereas Learned differs from Null by +0.07, -0.09, and +0.00 points, with no significant differences. However, removing or mismatching the representation at inference increases Learned WER. Thus, Learned depends on the representation yet shows no measurable incremental WER benefit over the parameter-matched control.

title: RNA Design via Conditioned Flow Matching and Finite-Policy Reinforcement Learning
summary: RNA design aims to identify sequences that fold into specified secondary structures. Existing methods formulate the task as target-specific search or conditional generation. However, natural RNA evolution proceeds through sequence variation and selection, with compensatory substitutions, whereas these methods do not explicitly model this process. To address this limitation, we propose a two-stage framework comprising RNA Inverse-Folding Flow (RNA-IFlow) and RNA-IFlow-RL. RNA-IFlow uses structure-conditioned Dirichlet Flow Matching to model coordinated variation across the sequence, while RNA-IFlow-RL maps the learned flow to a pairing-preserving finite policy and refines it with thermodynamic feedback. Our framework achieves leading performance on multiple benchmarks, reaching 85.19% Pass@1 on Rfam-27. Further analyses reveal thermodynamic gains, policy dynamics, and robustness across settings. Our work couples coordinated variation with thermodynamic selection, offering a novel paradigm for RNA design.

title: Digital Twin Modeling of Quantum Dynamical Systems: Dissipative Quantum Reservoir Computing
summary:
Modeling the response of driven many-body quantum systems from input--output data is difficult: the dynamics are nonlinear, history dependent, and expensive to simulate as system size grows. A paradigmatic case is High-Harmonic Generation~(HHG), where a strong field drives a medium to emit radiation that is highly sensitive to the drive and encodes long-range temporal correlations. We introduce a dissipative quantum reservoir computing~(DQRC) framework that builds a digital twin of such a system, learning its input--output map directly from data while the reservoir---itself a small open quantum system---stays fixed and only a classical readout is trained. We show that a minimal single-qubit reservoir reproduces the HHG response of a substantially larger Ising spin chain, and on a representative benchmark matches and on several metrics surpasses previously reported temporal convolutional and Kolmogorov--Arnold-network models, while using a simpler, physically realizable system. A single fixed reservoir further generalizes across a broad range of drives, indicating that it learns a shared physical response structure rather than memorizing trajectories. These results establish dissipative quantum reservoirs as compact, physically grounded digital twins for nonlinear, memory-dependent quantum dynamics.
  Code is available at \href{https://github.com/AI-and-Quantum-Computing/DQuRC}{https://github.com/AI-and-Quantum-Computing/DQuRC}.

title: Louder, Longer, Livelier: Acoustic Shortcuts and Underspecified Rationales in Speech LLM Judges
summary: LLM-as-a-judge is widely used for evaluating text, but extending this paradigm to speech requires models to interpret acoustic as well as linguistic evidence. This introduces a modality-specific risk: a speech judge may treat a perceptually salient cue as evidence of quality even when that cue is irrelevant to the target criterion or receives more weight than human listeners give it. We call this behavior an acoustic shortcut. To study it, we audit six speech LLM judges using controlled manipulations of intensity, content richness, and emotional delivery. We evaluate both pointwise scoring and pairwise comparison, using human preference calibration to interpret the results. The judges consistently reward louder audio, prefer content-rich speech more strongly than human listeners do, and map emotional delivery into quality preferences. These effects are most visible in pairwise comparison, while pointwise scores often obscure them. More concerningly, the accompanying rationales rarely identify the acoustic cue that changes a judgment and instead repeatedly rely on a limited vocabulary, leaving them acoustically underspecified. Together, these findings show that reliable speech judges must both resist acoustic shortcuts and ground their rationales in the acoustic evidence behind their decisions. To support reproducibility and future audits, we also release SpeechJudgeAudit, the controlled stimuli and evaluation tools used in this study.

title: Towards Scalable Quantum Unit Commitment in Power Systems: Encoding and Complexity Reduction Techniques
summary: This paper develops a Quantum optimisation Unit Commitment (UC) framework that benefits from Pauli Correlation Encoding (PCE) as a qubit reduction preprocessing technique and Sample-based Quantum Diagonalisation (SQD) as a hybrid post-processing refinement method. The UC problem is formulated in binary form, then transformed into a QUBO problem and mapped onto an Ising representation suitable for adiabatic quantum evolution within the Qibo framework. This study analyses how PCE and SQD techniques affect qubit scalability, computational effort, feasibility, and probability of recovering the optimal solution as the number of generators increases. The results show that PCE reduces the effective size of the encoded problem, SQD improves the concentration of probability on feasible and optimal solutions, and their combined application provides the best overall behaviour in several scalable case studies, achieving more reliable solutions with lower effective computational cost than the unreduced formulation. The repository is available open source in Github (link is not yet available until work is published. However, if requested by the reviewers, we can make it open for a scific time window, if requested).

title: An LLM-powered Agent Framework for Heterogeneous Evacuation Behavior Modeling under a Moving Threat in a Public Plaza
summary: Modeling heterogeneous evacuation behavior under a moving threat is difficult because human perception, memory, and evidence evaluation are not well captured by fixed rules. We propose a novel LLM-powered agent-based framework to represent these internal decision processes. Each pedestrian agent perceives a private symbolic ASCII view, maintains a Memory-based Knowledge Graph derived solely from individual observations, and makes decisions through persona-conditioned prompts under a common sampling configuration. A compressed decision context with stateless memory preserves trial-and-error experience across turns while excluding reasoning traces, and a validation engine separates behavioral choice from physical feasibility by executing routes only over observed terrain. We evaluated eight personality compositions in eight paired randomized blocks within a simulated public plaza. Usable-exit knowledge was strongly associated with evacuation success: 89.5% of agents possessing such knowledge evacuated, compared with 1.05% of those without it. Personality compositions also differed in their evaluation of remembered threat evidence: the proportion of danger assessments varied by 0.265, while high-urgency, low-directness decisions ranged from 11.41% to 34.33%. After direct threat sightings, responses converged, with 99.6% of assessments classifying the situation as dangerous. Movement was selected in 99.8% of decisions. Overall, evacuation outcomes were strongly associated with information access, while evacuation time was jointly associated with spatial geometry, information, and affect. The framework provides an auditable approach to generating endogenous behavioral heterogeneity through persona-conditioned LLM agents in crowd-evacuation simulations.

title: Consistency and Convergence of the Backward-Euler Scheme for Stochastic Functional Differential Equations Driven by Fractional Brownian Motion
summary: We study the backward-Euler scheme for a class of stochastic functional differential equations (SFDEs) with memory driven by a fractional Brownian motion with Hurst parameter H > 1/2. We first establish the local consistency of the method, with a local truncation error of order H -$ρ$- $β$ + 1, and then, as the main result, prove the uniform global pathwise convergence of the numerical approximation, on a set of probability one, with order H -$ρ$ -$β$, for $β$ $\in$ (1-H, 1/2) and 0 < $ρ$ < H -$β$. A uniform high-probability formulation with deterministic constants follows as a corollary. In particular, the convergence order can be taken arbitrarily close to 2H -1, matching the order obtained for the explicit Euler scheme. The convergence proof relies on an exact integral representation of the scheme at mesh points, an a priori bound for the numerical solution, fractional calculus estimates, and a Gronwall inequality for weakly singular kernels.

title: SQUARE: Structured Quantum Representation Adapters as Compact Quadratic Feature Maps for Frozen Language Models
summary: Frozen language models (LMs) are increasingly used as fixed feature extractors for downstream reranking, scoring, and preference modeling, raising a practical question: how should a compact module represent interactions among features in a fixed low-dimensional bottleneck? Common linear and low-rank adapters remain linear at the adaptation module itself, whereas explicit second-order alternatives introduce pairwise interactions through direct parameterization or predefined factorizations. We propose SQUARE, a Structured QUAntum REpresentation adapter that amplitude-encodes the bottleneck vector, applies a parameterized quantum circuit, and measures the resulting state. We show that each basis-probability feature is exactly a normalized quadratic form in the bottleneck coordinates, while the additional Pauli-$Z$ readouts are signed linear combinations of these probabilities. The measured map can therefore parameterize interactions over $O(d^2)$ coordinate pairs through a small set of shared circuit parameters, where $d$ is the bottleneck dimension. It provides a structured parameterization within, rather than beyond, the classical normalized-quadratic feature class. In a disjoint same-pipeline evaluation over eight GLUE-derived controlled interaction tasks and five shared seeds, SQUARE achieves an average test accuracy of $0.7565$, compared with $0.7355$ for an affine normalized-quadratic predictor, $0.7271$ for the evaluated parameter-matched Givens mixing model, $0.6817$ for an MLP, and $0.6155$ for a frozen-circuit control. Under reduced supervision, it also shows consistent gains over the strongest evaluated classical comparator, with the same qualitative pattern across multiple frozen LM backbones. All circuit experiments use simulation, while the learned feature map can be evaluated exactly in batched PyTorch without quantum hardware.

title: Probabilistic Symbolic-Distillation Model of Droplet Collision for Spray Simulation at High Ambient Pressures
summary: Droplet collision governs droplet population dynamics in many chemical engineering processes, such as spray drying, spray cooling, agricultural spraying, and combustion. Existing analytical models impose deterministic, pairwise boundaries between collision outcomes, whereas machine-learning classifiers lack the explicit functional form required of analytical collision submodels. In this study, we develop a probabilistic symbolic-distillation model using nearly forty thousand experimental events spanning eight regimes and five dimensionless parameters, including over five thousand data for ambient pressure up to 50 atm. A machine-learning teacher learns the joint outcome-probability landscape from these data, and symbolic regression subsequently distils it into eight class-specific expressions that jointly define a coupled analytical model. The resulting analytical field replaces abrupt regime switching with finite-width fuzzy boundaries. It outperforms the evaluated conventional analytical boundary models and reveals that their main limitation is the inability of zero-width boundaries to represent gradual probability transitions. The "biased-dice" sampling scheme provides a statistically consistent and practically convenient model implementation for Eulerian-Lagrangian spray simulation.

AI.title_translation: 用于高环境压力喷雾模拟的液滴碰撞概率符号蒸馏模型
AI.tldr: 结合机器学习与符号回归构建显式解析概率模型，以模糊边界替代传统突变边界，精准预测高压喷雾中的液滴碰撞。
AI.motivation: 现存液滴碰撞解析模型采用确定性且突变的零宽度边界，无法表征渐进的概率过渡；而黑盒机器学习分类器又缺乏工程喷雾模拟子模型所需的显式数学解析形式。
AI.method: 利用近四万个实验数据（含50个大气压下的高压数据），先通过机器学习模型拟合联合碰撞概率景观，再通过符号回归将其蒸馏为包含8个特定类别显式表达式的耦合解析模型，并采用“有偏骰子”方案进行采样。
AI.result: 所建立的解析场用具有有限宽度的模糊边界取代了传统突变机制，预测精度优于传统解析边界模型，证实了传统模型的主要缺陷在于零宽度边界无法反映概率的渐变过渡。
AI.conclusion: 该模型成功以解析表达式实现了概率性、平滑过渡的液滴碰撞结果预测，为高环境压力下的欧拉-拉格朗日喷雾模拟提供了统计一致且便于部署的高效工具。
AI.translation: 液滴碰撞主导着喷雾干燥、喷雾冷却、农业喷洒和燃烧等诸多化学工程过程中的液滴群动力学演化。现有的解析模型在碰撞结果之间施加了确定性的两两边界，而机器学习分类器又缺乏解析碰撞子模型所需的显式函数形式。在本研究中，我们利用近四万次涵盖八种机制和五个无量纲参数的实验事件（包括五千余条高达50个大气压的环境压力数据），开发了一种概率符号蒸馏模型。机器学习“教师”模型首先从这些数据中学习联合结果概率景观，随后符号回归将其蒸馏为八个特定类别的表达式，共同定义了一个耦合的解析模型。由此生成的解析场用有限宽度的模糊边界取代了突变的机制切换。它的性能优于所评估的传统解析边界模型，并揭示了传统模型的主要局限在于零宽度边界无法表征渐进的概率过渡。“有偏骰子”采样方案为欧拉-拉格朗日喷雾模拟提供了一种统计一致且易于实际应用的模型实现方式。
AI.summary: 本文针对高环境压力喷雾模拟中的液滴碰撞问题，提出了一种概率符号蒸馏模型。该模型结合机器学习表征与符号回归，提取出显式解析表达式以形成概率模糊边界，并配合高效采样方案，显著提升了喷雾模拟中液滴碰撞结果预测的准确性与实用性。
AI.keywords: 液滴碰撞, 符号蒸馏, 概率模型, 喷雾模拟, 高环境压力
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地结合了机器学习的概率建模能力与符号回归的可解释性，解决了高压喷雾模拟中液滴碰撞机制突变与缺乏显式解析式的两难问题；所提出的模糊边界与偏置骰子采样对提升欧拉-拉格朗日模拟的物理真实性具有重要工程价值。

title: Optimal Entanglement Routing in Quantum Repeater Chains: Beyond Fixed Operation Order and Purification Schedule
summary: Entanglement routing establishes entangled pairs between distant nodes of a quantum network by purifying and swapping pairs generated on elementary links. Existing methods typically restrict the decision space along two axes: the operation order, often fixed to purify-then-swap (PtS), and the purification schedule of each link, often restricted to pumping. Focusing on linear repeater chains with finite link capacities, we relax both restrictions and study the maximization of the expected end-to-end throughput subject to a fidelity threshold under two quantum-noise models. We develop a unified capacity-aware optimization framework comprising an exact mixed-integer linear program (MILP) under PtS, instantiated with either pumping or general tree purification schedules, and an exact dynamic program (DP) over arbitrary operation orders. Under symmetric Pauli noise, we prove that pumping converges to a fidelity strictly below unity, imposing a capacity-independent feasibility bound and a maximum chain length on every pumping-based PtS method, whereas general tree schedules yield a capacity-dependent bound. We further prove that post-swap purification never increases the throughput, so a free operation order can only increase feasibility. Numerical evaluations confirm the bounds: tree schedules serve over 90\% of the requests that pumping cannot at moderate fidelity thresholds; within the pumping class, a free operation order recovers much of this advantage; but once links use tree schedules, the tree-based MILP and the order-exact DP serve identical request sets throughout. Operation order and purification schedule are thus substitutes, with the purification schedule the dominant factor governing feasibility under symmetric Pauli noise.

AI.title_translation: 量子中继链中的最优纠缠路由：超越固定操作顺序与纯化调度
AI.tldr: 该论文突破了传统固定操作顺序和纯化调度的限制，提出了量子中继链中纠缠路由的最优化框架，证明了纯化调度是决定网络可行性的主导因素。
AI.motivation: 现有的量子网络纠缠路由方法通常将决策空间限制在固定的操作顺序（如先纯化后交换）和固定的链路纯化调度（如泵浦调度）上，这限制了端到端吞吐量和可行性，因此需要放松这些限制进行联合优化。
AI.method: 开发了一个统一的容量感知优化框架，包括在纯化后交换（PtS）策略下的精确混合整数线性规划（MILP），以及在任意操作顺序下的精确动态规划（DP）。
AI.result: 理论证明和数值评估表明，树型纯化调度比泵浦调度支持更多请求，且交换后纯化不会增加吞吐量；操作顺序和纯化调度可作为替代，其中纯化调度是决定可行性的主导因素。
AI.conclusion: 纯化方案是决定对称泡利噪声下量子中继链可行性的主导因素，而操作顺序与纯化方案在一定程度上可作为替代。
AI.translation: 纠缠路由通过提纯和交换在基本链路上生成的纠缠对，在量子网络的远程节点之间建立纠缠对。现有方法通常在两个维度上限制决策空间：一是操作顺序，通常固定为先纯化后交换（PtS）；二是每条链路的纯化调度，通常局限于泵浦调度。针对具有有限链路容量的线性中继链，我们放松了这两项限制，研究了在两种量子噪声模型下、满足保真度阈值的最大化期望端到端吞吐量问题。我们开发了一个统一的容量感知优化框架，包括在PtS下采用泵浦或通用树型纯化调度的精确混合整数线性规划（MILP），以及在任意操作顺序下的精确动态规划（DP）。在对称泡利噪声下，我们证明了泵浦的收敛保真度严格低于1，对每种基于泵浦的PtS方法施加了与容量无关的可行性界限和最大链长度，而通用树型调度则产生与容量相关的界限。我们进一步证明了交换后纯化绝不会增加吞吐量，因此自由的操作顺序只能提高可行性。数值评估证实了这些界限：在中等保真度阈值下，树型调度能够服务泵浦无法支持的90%以上的请求；在泵浦类别内，自由的操作顺序恢复了大部分优势；但一旦链路使用树型调度，基于树的MILP和阶数精确的DP在整个过程中服务相同的请求集。因此，操作顺序和纯化调度是替代品，在对称泡利噪声下，纯化调度是决定可行性的主导因素。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了量子中继链中的最优纠缠路由问题，放松了传统固定操作顺序和纯化调度的限制，提出了一种统一的容量感知优化框架（结合MILP与DP），证明了纯化调度和操作顺序对系统可行性的影响，并通过数值实验验证了树型调度在提升网络吞吐量和可行性方面的显著优势。
AI.keywords: 量子网络, 纠缠路由, 量子中继器, 混合整数线性规划, 动态规划
AI.comments: 该论文突破了量子中继链中固定操作顺序和纯化方案的传统限制，通过混合整数线性规划和动态规划方法，深入探讨了纠缠路由的最优化问题，对量子网络的设计具有重要的理论指导意义。

title: Encoding and Node Choices in Transversal Fault-Tolerant Distributed Quantum Computations: An Initial Study
summary: We compare and study different Bivariate-Bicycle (BB) encodings and node choices for distributed quantum operations such as transversal non-local CNOTs. We observe that while some encodings have more physical qubits requiring more ebits for a distributed computation, reducing ebit consumption alone might not be the best criterion for selecting an encoding for the logical qubits, if the goal is to reduce the logical error rate of the distributed computation; for example, one should also consider encodings with a larger distance, which using more physical qubits can provide. We consider distributed, or non-local, CNOTs and computation of the global gate (GCZ) over distributed logical qubits as examples. The choice of encoding enables particular concurrent operations; e.g., we show that a transversal physical GCZ on a self-dual $[[120,8,12]] BB$ code can realize eight concurrent logical GCZ operations after accounting for the logical permutation induced by transversal Hadamard.

AI.title_translation: 横向容错分布式量子计算中的编码与节点选择：一项初步研究
AI.tldr: 本文研究了分布式量子计算中编码与节点选择的权衡，发现单纯减少纠缠消耗并非最优，需综合考虑编码距离与并发逻辑操作能力以降低逻辑错误率。
AI.motivation: 探究在分布式容错量子计算中，如何选择不同的双变量自行车（BB）编码和节点选择方案，以优化非局域量子操作（如横向非局域CNOT）。
AI.method: 比较和研究不同的双变量自行车（BB）编码和节点选择方案，以分布式非局域CNOT和全局门（GCZ）计算为示例进行分析。
AI.result: 研究表明，虽然某些编码需要更多物理量子比特和ebit，但一味减少ebit消耗并非选择逻辑量子比特编码的最佳准则；应当考虑具有更大距离的编码。此外，特定的编码选择能支持并发操作，例如自我对偶的$[[120,8,12]]$ BB码通过横向物理GCZ可实现八个并发的逻辑GCZ操作。
AI.conclusion: 在设计分布式容错量子计算时，不能仅仅以减少ebit消耗为唯一优化标准，还需综合考虑编码距离以及支持的并行逻辑操作，以实现更低的逻辑错误率。
AI.translation: 我们对比并研究了用于分布式量子操作（如横向非局域CNOT）的不同双变量自行车（BB）编码和节点选择方案。我们观察到，虽然某些编码具有更多的物理 qubits、在分布式计算中需要更多的 ebits，但如果目标是降低分布式计算的逻辑错误率，仅仅减少 ebit 消耗可能并不是选择逻辑 qubit 编码的最佳准则；例如，我们还应考虑具有更大距离的编码，而更多的物理 qubits 可以提供这种优势。我们以分布式（或非局域）CNOT 以及跨分布式逻辑 qubits 的全局门（GCZ）计算为例进行了探讨。编码的选择能够实现特定的并发操作；例如，我们展示了在自对偶 $[[120,8,12]] BB$ 码上的横向物理 GCZ 在考虑由横向 Hadamard 引起的逻辑置换后，可以实现八个并发的逻辑 GCZ 操作。
AI.summary: 本文研究了分布式容错量子计算中双变量自行车（BB）编码和节点选择的权衡问题。结果表明，减少纠缠对（ebit）消耗并不总是降低逻辑错误率的最佳准则，编码距离和并发操作能力同样至关重要。
AI.keywords: 分布式量子计算, 容错, 双变量自行车编码, 纠缠对, 逻辑门
AI.comments: 本文通过对比不同的双变量自行车（BB）编码和节点选择方案，探讨了分布式容错量子计算中的编码与资源分配权衡问题。研究强调在降低逻辑错误率时，盲目减少纠缠对（ebit）消耗并非最优准则，而编码距离等因素同样关键。该研究对未来分布式量子计算架构的设计具有重要的参考价值。

title: Quantum Leakage Resilience of Shamir Secret Sharing
summary:
We initiate the study of quantum leakage resilience of unmodified Shamir secret sharing over prime fields. A well-studied leakage model for Shamir's secret sharing classically is single-bit local leakage from each share. We consider its quantum analogue where, for each party, a local leakage channel takes as input the party's share and outputs a leaked qubit. Without preshared entanglement, we show that the distinguishing advantage is $2^{-Ω(n)}$ when the threshold rate $t/n=τ$ exceeds $τ_\star\approx0.73339$ by a fixed positive margin.
  More generally, we allow disjoint entangled blocks of any fixed maximum size where there is no entanglement between different blocks or with the adversary, and each block emits at most a fixed number of qubits. Security holds when the threshold rate is high enough (sufficiently close to one). We then allow a specified set of devices to share entanglement with the adversary. We show that security holds even when a linear number of devices ($αn$ for small $α>0$) share entanglement with each other and with the adversary for a large enough threshold rate.
  As a complementary negative result, we also show that even classical single-bit leakage makes Shamir scheme insecure if we allow arbitrarily large entanglement between the leakage devices. A GHZ state shared by exactly $t$ leakage devices makes even classical one-bit leakage insecure, without any entanglement with the adversary. In this attack, each participating device emits only one classical bit, and their joint parity distinguishes any chosen pair of secrets with a constant advantage. Thus, for fixed threshold rates above $τ_\star$, the maximum number of devices that may share arbitrary entanglement with one another and with the adversary while preserving security is linear in $n$ up to constant factors, although the optimal support fraction remains open.

AI.title_translation: Shamir秘密共享的量子泄露韧性
AI.tldr: 本文研究了Shamir秘密共享方案在量子泄露下的安全性，证明了在门限率足够高且纠缠受限时方案是安全的，但任意大的设备间纠缠会破坏其安全性。
AI.motivation: 研究传统的Shamir秘密共享方案在量子泄露模型下的安全性，即当每个参与方输出一个泄露量子比特时方案是否仍然安全。
AI.method: 分析了在不同纠缠假设下（无纠缠、不相交纠缠块、以及设备与攻击者共享纠缠）Shamir方案的区分优势，并构造了利用GHZ状态的攻击实例作为对立结果。
AI.result: 当门限率超过约0.73339时，无预共享纠缠的Shamir方案的区分优势为 $2^{-\Omega(n)}$；在受限纠缠和特定设备与攻击者共享纠缠的情况下方案仍然安全；但若允许任意大的纠缠（如GHZ状态），即使是经典单比特泄露也会导致方案不安全。
AI.conclusion: 在无预共享纠缠或仅有受限纠缠块的情况下，当门限率足够高时，Shamir秘密共享方案对量子泄露具有鲁棒性；然而，若允许泄露设备间存在任意大的纠缠，即使是经典的单比特泄露也会破坏其安全性。
AI.translation:
我们开启了对素域上未修改的Shamir秘密共享方案的量子泄露韧性的研究。Shamir秘密共享一个经过深入研究的经典泄露模型是来自每个份额的单比特局部泄露。我们考虑其量子模拟，其中对于每个参与方，局部泄露通道以参与方的份额作为输入并输出一个泄露量子比特。在没有预共享纠缠的情况下，我们证明当门限率 $t/n=\tau$ 超过 $\tau_\star\approx0.73339$ 一个固定的正余量时，区分优势为 $2^{-\Omega(n)}$。
更一般地，我们允许任何固定最大大小的不相交纠缠块，其中不同块之间或与攻击者之间没有纠缠，并且每个块最多发射固定数量的量子比特。当门限率足够高（足够接近1）时，安全性成立。然后，我们允许一组指定的设备与攻击者共享纠缠。我们证明，即使对于足够大的门限率，当线性数量的设备（对于小的 $\alpha>0$ 的 $\alpha n$）彼此共享纠缠并与攻击者共享纠缠时，安全性仍然成立。
作为一个补充的消极结果，我们还表明，如果我们允许泄露设备之间存在任意大的纠缠，即使是经典的单比特泄露也会使Shamir方案不安全。恰好由 $t$ 个泄露设备共享的GHZ状态甚至使经典的单比特泄露变得不安全，且不需要与攻击者有任何纠缠。在这个攻击中，每个参与的设备只发射一个经典比特，并且它们的联合奇偶校验以常数优势区分任意选择的一对秘密。因此，对于高于 $\tau_\star$ 的固定门限率，在保持安全性的同时，可能彼此之间以及与攻击者共享任意纠缠的最大设备数量在常数因子范围内是关于 $n$ 的线性函数，尽管最优的支持分数仍然是一个开放问题。
AI.summary: 本文研究了Shamir秘密共享方案在素域上的量子泄露韧性。研究表明，在适当高的门限率下，即使面对局部的量子泄露或受限的纠缠攻击，未修改的Shamir方案依然是安全的；然而，如果允许泄露设备之间共享任意大小的纠缠，即使是经典的单比特泄露也会使该方案变得不安全。
AI.keywords: Quantum Leakage, Shamir Secret Sharing, Entanglement, Threshold Rate, Cryptographic Security
AI.comments: 该论文首次研究了Shamir秘密共享方案在量子信息泄露下的安全性，拓展了传统密码学中对侧信道攻击和量子泄露的理解，具有重要的理论意义。

title: Geometry-Aided Channel Deduction with Partial Channel Estimates and Uncalibrated Digital Twin
summary: The acquisition of high-dimensional channel state information (CSI) in wireless MIMO-OFDM communications usually requires high pilot overhead, or relies on accurate and complete positional or environmental information. In this paper, we propose a geometry-aided channel deduction (GCD) approach, which utilizes an uncalibrated digital twin (DT) with only approximate environmental geometry and positions to assist the channel acquisition. The key rationale behind is that, even imprecise geometric information, which can be easily obtained in advance through radio sensing technologies or existing geographic databases, provides certain structural features about the current channel; meanwhile, the coarse instantaneous channel estimates using only a small amount of pilots provide dedicated information that aligns with the channel structure and further compensates for the geometry inaccuracy and other channel unknowns. To this end, we first extract geometric features from the DT, which contain only simple structural information of the channel. Then we propose random prompt augmentation, a novel method to generate an appropriate prompt that converts geometric multi-path structure into a CSI-like representation while suppressing the disturbance of other unknown channel parameters. The prompt is then fused with the pilot-based instantaneous channel estimate via a channel deduction network. To further enhance the network's versatility, we incorporate pilot configurations into the existing learning architecture to support variable pilot patterns. Comprehensive experiments validate the superiority of the proposed method, which demonstrates high channel acquisition quality, low pilot overhead, and strong robustness. Furthermore, the structural prompt also serves as scenario-related context, enabling our approach to generalize well in new scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 基于部分信道估计与非校准数字孪生的几何辅助信道推演
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合不精确数字孪生几何信息与少量导频的几何辅助信道推演方法，实现了低开销、高质量的信道获取和良好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 无线MIMO-OFDM通信中获取高维信道状态信息通常需要高的导频开销，或者高度依赖准确完整的几何与环境信息，这在实际中难以满足。因此，需要一种能够利用不精确的环境几何信息和少量导频来实现高效信道获取的方法。
AI.method: 提出几何辅助信道推演（GCD）方法，首先从数字孪生中提取几何特征，然后通过提出的随机提示增强方法将多径结构转换为类似信道的表示，最后通过信道神经网络将其与基于导频的瞬时信道估计相融合，并支持可变导频模式。
AI.result: 广泛的实验验证了该方法的优越性，表现出高质量的信道获取能力、较低的导频开销以及强鲁棒性，同时结构化提示使其在新的场景中具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的几何辅助信道推演（GCD）方法能够利用不精确的数字孪生几何信息和少量导频估计，实现高质量的信道获取，并具有低导频开销和良好的场景泛化能力。
AI.translation: 在无线MIMO-OFDM通信中，获取高维信道状态信息（CSI）通常需要较高的导频开销，或者依赖于准确且完整的空间或环境信息。在本文中，我们提出了一种几何辅助信道推演（GCD）方法，该方法利用仅具有近似环境几何和位置的未校准数字孪生（DT）来辅助信道获取。其背后的核心原理是：即使是通过无线传感技术或现有地理数据库轻松预先获得的不精确几何信息，也能提供关于当前信道的某些结构特征；同时，仅使用少量导频的粗略瞬时信道估计提供了与信道结构对齐的专用信息，并进一步补偿了几何不准确性及其他信道未知数。为此，我们首先从DT中提取几何特征，这些特征仅包含信简单的信道结构信息。然后，我们提出了一种新颖的随机提示增强方法，用于生成适当的提示，将几何多径结构转换为类CSI表示，同时抑制其他未知信道参数的干扰。接着，通过信道推演网络将该提示与基于导频的瞬时信道估计相融合。为了进一步增强网络的通用性，我们将导频配置融入现有的学习架构中，以支持可变导频模式。综合实验验证了所提方法的优越性，展现出高质量的信道获取、较低的导频开销以及强大的鲁棒性。此外，结构化提示还可以作为场景相关的上下文，使我们的方法能够很好地泛化到新场景中。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种几何辅助信道推演（GCD）方法，利用带有近似环境几何形状的非校准数字孪生和少量的导频估计来辅助信道获取。通过提取几何特征、采用随机提示增强以及信道推演网络融合，该方法实现了低导频开销下的高质量信道获取，并具备优异的鲁棒性与泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 信道获取, 数字孪生, 几何辅助, 导频开销, 信道推演
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种结合非校准数字孪生和部分信道估计的几何辅助信道推演方法，创新性地利用随机提示增强和通道推演网络解决了传统信道获取中高导频开销或依赖高精度环境信息的痛点，具有较强的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

title: A Memory-Magic Exchange Law in Streaming Clifford+T Compilation
summary: A phase that reaches a fault-tolerant processor in additive pieces can be remembered until the last piece arrives, or executed on arrival: the first option costs classical memory carried across rounds, the second costs magic states committed before the phase is known. We determine the exchange rate $α$, committed $T$ gates per bit of memory forgone, for ancilla-free coordinatewise Clifford+$T$ compilation. The Ramanujan bound for the Clifford+$T$ lattice gives $α\ge2$ with explicit constants, the square-root barrier of the spectral method. An elementary determinant method, using that quaternion numerators are lattice points on spheres in both real embeddings of $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt2)$, counts words near an arbitrary rotation coset below that barrier and gives $α\ge11/5$ asymptotically and unconditionally, and a height dichotomy for the resulting sphere sections raises this to $α\ge17/7$. At Clifford-framed cosets the volume law holds up to subexponential factors: all but a vanishing fraction of $z$-rotations need $T$-count $(3-o(1))\log_2(1/\varepsilon)$, and processes whose committed pieces are close to Clifford-framed $z$-rotations, including per-rotation pipelines, have $α\ge3-o(1)$, which a fractional-passthrough family attains under the Ross-Selinger typical-cost hypothesis. Under an equidistribution conjecture supported by exhaustive enumeration to $T$-count 22, $α=3$ in general and memory should be shed in whole rotations. The bounds hold even when the phases cancel to the identity; side information enters through a conditional entropy; probabilistic mixing halves the costs but not the rate. With clean ancillas and a phase-gradient catalyst, table lookups batched across coordinates drive the rate to $O(1/\log\log(1/\varepsilon))$, so the constant-rate law is specific to coordinatewise synthesis.

AI.title_translation: 流式Clifford+T编译中的内存-魔术交换定律
AI.tldr: 论文揭示并量化了流式量子编译中经典内存与魔术态之间的交换规律，推导出了交换率的严格数学下界。
AI.motivation: 在容错量子处理器中，分步到达的相位可以通过经典内存记忆或预先提交魔术态来处理，为了理解这两种资源之间的权衡，作者旨在确定无辅助坐标wise Clifford+T编译中的内存与魔术态交换率。
AI.method: 运用了Ramanujan界、谱方法的平方根壁垒、初等行列式方法（利用四元数分子作为球面上的格点）以及穷举枚举和猜想支持等数论和代数方法。
AI.result: 确定了交换率 $\alpha$ 的多个渐近与无条件下界（如 $\alpha \ge 11/5$, $17/7$, $3-o(1)$），并在特定等分布猜想下证明一般情况下 $\alpha = 3$，同时指出当引入辅助量子比特和催化剂时常数速率律会发生改变。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了流式Clifford+T编译中内存与魔术态消耗的显式交换定律，证明了在不同条件下交换率的下界，并在特定猜想下达到极限值3。
AI.translation: 一个以累加片段形式到达容错处理器的相位，可以被记住直到最后一片到达，或者在到达时立即执行：第一种选择消耗跨轮传递的经典内存，第二种选择消耗在相位已知之前提交的魔术态。我们针对无辅助坐标wise Clifford+T编译，确定了交换率 $\alpha$（每放弃一位内存所提交的 $T$ 门数）。Clifford+T格的Ramanujan界给出了带有显式常数的 $\alpha \ge 2$，即谱方法的平方根壁垒。一种初等行列式方法利用四元数分子是 $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{2})$ 两个实嵌入中球面上的格点，计算了该壁垒以下任意旋转陪集附近的字，在渐近且无条件的情况下给出了 $\alpha \ge 11/5$，而所得球面截面的高度二分法将其提升至 $\alpha \ge 17/7$。在Clifford框架的陪集处，体积定律在次指数因子下成立：绝大部分 $z$ 旋转需要 $T$ 计数 $(3-o(1))\log_2(1/\varepsilon)$，其提交片段接近Clifford框架 $z$ 旋转的过程（包括每旋转流水线）具有 $\alpha \ge 3-o(1)$，在Ross-Selinger典型成本假设下，一个分数透传族达到了这一点。在得到 $T$ 计数达22的穷举枚举支持的等分布猜想下，一般情况下 $\alpha = 3$，且内存应以完整旋转为单位丢弃。即使相位抵消为恒等算符，这些边界依然成立；边信息通过条件概率熵进入；概率混合使成本减半但没有改变速率。通过干净的辅助量子比特和相位梯度催化剂，跨坐标批处理的表查找将速率驱动至 $O(1/\log\log(1/\varepsilon))$，因此常数速率定律是坐标wise综合所特有的。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了流式Clifford+T编译中经典内存与魔术态之间的资源权衡（即交换定律），通过数学格点与数论方法推导出了交换率 $\alpha$ 的多个下界，并探讨了在不同条件及猜想下的渐近行为。
AI.keywords: Clifford+T编译, 容错量子计算, 内存与魔术态交换率, 四元数, 量子资源优化
AI.comments: 该论文在流式Clifford+T编译中首次揭示并量化了经典内存与魔术态（magic state）之间的交换规律，结合了代数数论、谱方法和四元数等深厚数学工具，对容错量子计算的资源优化具有重要理论意义。

title: Information Limits of Multistage Inventory Control: Learning, Valuation, and Censoring
summary: Learning how to replenish inventory and estimating the cost of doing so require different information. We establish information-theoretic lower bounds for offline multistage inventory control with independent bounded demand. For fixed additive error in total expected cost, policy learning requires cubically many scalar observations in the horizon in the worst case, even under full observation and adaptive sample allocation. This matches the known empirical-risk upper order. Stationarity permits a quadratic policy-learning guarantee, yet valuation with inherited stock can remain cubically difficult even when the optimal policy is known. Censoring sharpens this distinction: optimal decisions can be learnable while absolute costs remain unidentified. We give a carrysafe coverage condition under which truncation preserves inventory transitions and policy gaps exactly. Combining this reduction with a matching lower bound yields the sharp censored-learning rate, with raw sample requirements inversely proportional to the usable fraction of sales logs. The same qualified observations can check coverage and fit the policy under a joint error guarantee. The results isolate information limits for decisions and valuation under an explicit conditionally independent logging protocol.

AI.title_translation: 多阶段库存控制的信息极限：学习、估值与删失
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多阶段库存控制中策略学习、价值评估和删失数据的信息论极限，证明了决策学习与成本估计在样本复杂度上的根本差异。
AI.motivation: 学习如何补充库存与估计库存成本需要不同的信息，以往对这两者的信息极限和复杂性缺乏统一且严密的理论区分，特别是关于策略学习、价值评估以及数据删失的影响。
AI.method: 利用信息论方法推导多阶段库存控制在独立有界需求下的下界；提出一种“安全携带覆盖条件”（carrysafe coverage condition）来处理删失数据，将截断归约与下界匹配以获得精确的删失学习率。
AI.result: 在最坏情况下，固定加法误差的策略学习需要视界长度的立方级标量观测值（平稳性可降至平方级）；即便已知最优政策，含继承库存的价值评估仍可能是立方级困难的；删失数据会加剧这种区分，使得最优决策可学习而绝对成本无法辨识。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过建立信息论下界和新颖的覆盖条件，彻底阐明了多阶段库存控制中策略学习与成本评估的信息复杂性及其在删失数据下的表现。
AI.translation: 学习如何补充库存与估计库存成本需要不同的信息。我们为具有独立有界需求的离线多阶段库存控制建立了信息论下界。对于总期望成本中的固定加法误差，在最坏情况下，即使在完全观测和自适应样本分配下，策略学习也需要视界长度的立方级标量观测值，这与已知的经验风险上界阶数相匹配。平稳性允许平方级的策略学习保证，然而即使已知最优策略，带有继承库存的估值仍然可能是立方级困难的。删失数据加剧了这种区分：最优决策可能是可学习的，而绝对成本保持不可识别。我们给出了一个安全携带覆盖条件，在此条件下截断能够精确保持库存转换和策略差距。将这种归约与匹配的下界相结合，产生了精确的删失学习率，其原始样本需求与销售日志可用分数的倒数成正比。在联合误差保证下，相同的合格观测值可以检查覆盖范围并拟合策略。这些结果在显式的条件独立记录协议下隔离了决策和估值的信息极限。
AI.summary: 本文研究了多阶段库存控制在独立有界需求下的信息论限制。研究发现，策略学习和价值评估对信息的需求存在本质不同。平稳性可降低策略学习的样本复杂度，但价值评估仍可能极具挑战性。此外，文章还分析了删失数据对决策可学习性与成本识别的影响，并给出了精确的删失学习率。
AI.keywords: 库存控制, 信息论下界, 策略学习, 价值评估, 删失数据
AI.comments: 该论文从信息论的角度深入探讨了多阶段库存控制中的信息极限问题，特别区分了策略学习、价值评估与删失数据（censoring）之间的复杂关系。研究具有很高的理论深度，对理解不确定性环境下的库存优化与数据需求具有重要指导意义。

title: Succinct Arguments for QMA in the Quantum Random Oracle Model
summary:
Succinct arguments are a fundamental cryptographic primitive for verifying computational claims with small communication. In the classical setting, succinct arguments for NP can be constructed from unstructured hardness alone (e.g., hash functions) by compiling probabilistically checkable proofs (PCPs) or interactive oracle proofs (IOPs) for NP via the commit-and-open paradigm. In contrast, known succinct arguments for QMA rely on ``structured'' cryptographic primitives, or on the quantum PCP conjecture.
  We construct the first succinct argument for QMA in the quantum random oracle model (QROM) without relying on additional cryptographic assumptions or unproven conjectures. This yields succinct arguments for QMA from unstructured hardness alone, showing that ideal hash functions not only suffice for succinct arguments for NP but also for QMA.
  Underlying our result is an efficiency-preserving transformation that compiles quantum interactive oracle proofs (QIOPs), a recently introduced interactive generalization of quantum PCPs, into quantum arguments for the same language, via a natural quantum commit-and-open paradigm. Our transformation applies to every QIOP with public-query soundness, a notion that we formalize to capture a natural requirement of the commit-and-open paradigm and is satisfied by a known QIOP for QMA. As a key ingredient in our transformation, we formalize and construct extractable vector commitments for quantum states with local openings in the QROM, which may be of independent interest.

AI.title_translation: 量子随机预言机模型下QMA的简洁论证
AI.tldr: 该论文首次在量子随机预言机模型下，仅基于理想散列函数（无结构困难性）实现了针对QMA的简洁论证。
AI.motivation: 经典设置下基于无结构困难性（如散列函数）可以为NP构造简洁论证，而现有的QMA简洁论证依赖于结构化密码学原语或未证明的量子PCP猜想，缺乏仅基于无结构困难性的QMA简洁论证。
AI.method: 提出了一种保持效率的转换方法，通过自然的量子承诺打开范式，将具有公共查询可靠性的量子交互式预言机证明（QIOPs）编译为量子论证，并在QROM中形式化并构造了具有局部打开的量子状态可提取向量承诺。
AI.result: 在QROM中实现了首个针对QMA的简洁论证，无需额外的密码学假设或未证明的猜想，并开发了适用于量子态的可提取向量承诺。
AI.conclusion: 论文在QROM下成功构建了首个针对QMA的简洁论证，证明了理想散列函数不仅适用于NP，也适用于QMA的简洁论证。
AI.translation:
简洁论证是验证计算主张且通信量小的基础密码学原语。在经典设置中，通过提交-打开范式编译概率可检验证明（PCPs）或交互式预言机证明（IOPs），仅凭非结构化困难性（例如哈希函数）即可为NP构造简洁论证。相比之下，已知的QMA简洁论证依赖于“结构化”密码学原语，或依赖于量子PCP猜想。
我们构建了量子随机预言机模型（QROM）中的第一个QMA简洁论证，且不依赖于额外的密码学假设或未证明的猜想。这仅从非结构化困难性就得到了QMA的简洁论证，表明理想哈希函数不仅足以用于NP的简洁论证，也足以用于QMA。
我们结果的基础是一个保持效率的变换，它通过自然的量子提交-打开范式，将量子交互式预言机证明（QIOPs，一种最近引入的量子PCP的交互式推广）编译为相同语言的量子论证。我们的变换适用于具有公共查询可靠性的每一个QIOP——我们形式化了这个概念以捕捉提交--打开范式的自然需求，并且这个需求被一个已知的QMA的QIOP所满足。作为我们变换的关键要素，我们在QROM中形式化并构造了具有局部打开的量子状态的可提取向量承诺，这可能具有独立的研究价值。
AI.summary: 该论文在量子随机预言机模型（QROM）下，无需额外假设或未证明猜想，首次为QMA构造了简洁论证。其核心方法是通过自然的量子承诺打开范式，将具有公共查询可靠性的量子交互式预言机证明（QIOPs）编译为量子论证，并引入了QROM中的量子状态可提取向量承诺。
AI.keywords: QMA, 简洁论证, 量子随机预言机模型, 量子交互式预言机证明, 承诺打开范式
AI.comments: 该论文首次在量子随机预言机模型（QROM）下实现了针对QMA的高效简洁论证，摆脱了对结构化密码学假设或未证明猜想的依赖，是量子密码学领域的一个重要突破。

title: An Operator-Norm Approach to Security with Quantum Advice
summary:
Non-uniform security allows an adversary to receive bounded advice about an oracle before attempting a fresh challenge. This captures the most realistic attacks and has already been studied extensively in prior work. In this work, we introduce an operator-norm approach for non-uniform security in the quantum random oracle and random permutation models. This new approach yields a unified reduction for both search success probability and distinguishing advantage. Previously, the reduction only worked with success probability even in the decision games, yielding a worse bound.
  Our framework enables tight bounds for Yao's box, both with and without salting, and improved bounds for pseudorandom generators. We also prove an optimal generic salting theorem for decision games. By defining a property of a game, which separates the contributions of the existing queries in the offline stage and subsequent online queries, we obtain stronger bounds for specific salted constructions. These include salted permutation inversion, tight up to logarithmic factors, and salted random-function inversion, tight up to logarithmic factors and the gap already present in classical function inversion.

AI.title_translation: 具有量子建议的安全性的算子范数方法
AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种算子范数方法，用于研究量子模型下的非均匀安全性，实现了搜索与区分归约的统一，并在多个密码学问题中获得了更紧密的安全性边界。
AI.motivation: 传统的非均匀安全归约通常仅适用于搜索成功概率（即使在判定游戏中也是如此），这会导致较差的边界。为了克服这一限制并获得更紧密的安全性界，需要一种能够统一处理成功概率和区分优势的新方法。
AI.method: 引入了一种用于量子随机预言机和随机置换模型中非均匀安全性的算子范数方法，通过定义游戏的一致性属性来分离离线阶段已有查询和后续在线查询的贡献。
AI.result: 新方法成功实现了搜索成功概率和区分优势的统一归约，得到了有盐和无盐Yao氏箱的紧密界、改进的伪随机生成器界、判定游戏的最优通用加盐定理，以及特定加盐构造（如置换求逆和随机函数求逆）的更强边界。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的算子范数方法成功统一了量子随机预言机和随机置换模型中的非均匀安全性归约，为Yao氏箱、伪随机生成器以及加盐构造提供了更紧密或最优的安全性边界。
AI.translation:
非均匀安全性允许攻击者在尝试新的挑战之前，接收关于预言机的有界建议。这捕捉到了最现实的攻击，并在先前的研究中得到了广泛探讨。在这项工作中，我们为量子随机预言机和随机置换模型中的非均匀安全性引入了一种算子范数方法。这种新方法为搜索成功概率和区分 advantage（优势）提供了一个统一的归约。此前，即使在判定游戏中，归约也仅对成功概率有效，从而产生了较差的界。
我们的框架为带有和不带有加盐的 Yao 氏箱（Yao's box）实现了紧密的界，并为伪随机生成器提供了改进的界。我们还证明了判定游戏的最优通用加盐定理。通过定义游戏的一个属性（该属性分离了离线阶段现有查询和随后的在线查询的贡献），我们为特定的加盐构造获得了更强的界。这些构造包括：加盐置换求逆（在对数因子内是紧密的），以及加盐随机函数求逆（在对数因子以及经典函数求逆中已存在的差距内是紧密的）。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于算子范数的新方法来分析具有量子建议的非均匀安全性，适用于量子随机预言机和随机置换模型。该方法统一了搜索成功概率与区分优势的归约，并在Yao氏箱、伪随机生成器以及加盐构造中实现了更紧密或最优的安全性边界。
AI.keywords: 量子非均匀安全, 算子范数方法, 量子随机预言机, 加盐定理, 密码学归约
AI.comments: 该论文引入了一种新的算子范数方法来研究具有量子建议的非均匀安全性，在量子随机预言机和随机置换模型中取得了突破，统一了搜索成功概率和区分优势的归约，并在多个密码学构造中获得了更紧密的界。

title: End-to-End Optical Semantic Communication over a Nonlinear WDM Fiber Link
summary: Emerging optical-network applications increasingly use received data for inference and control rather than exact source reproduction, creating an opportunity to trade bit-level fidelity for greater transmission reach and efficiency. We propose an end-to-end optical semantic communication system for joint image classification and reconstruction over a nonlinear wavelength-division multiplexed (WDM) fiber channel. The system maps each image directly into a fixed-length sequence of channel symbols that preserves task-relevant information, without explicit source compression or channel coding. Experiments on the MNIST dataset cover launch powers from -9 to +3 dBm, fiber lengths up to 800 km, and 16-, 64-, and 256-Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) formats. At 0 dBm, classification accuracy remains between 98.92% and 99.31% across all tested link lengths and modulation orders, while requiring fewer transmitted symbols than a Low-Density Parity-Check (LDPC)-coded JPEG baseline at every tested modulation order. These results show that semantic communication can simultaneously extend optical reach and reduce transmission resources by conveying only task-relevant information.

AI.title_translation: 基于非线性WDM光纤链路的端到端光学语义通信
AI.tldr: 提出一种用于非线性光纤通信的端到端语义通信系统，能在扩展传输距离的同时减少资源消耗并保持高分类准确率。
AI.motivation: 新兴的光网络应用越来越多地将接收到的数据用于推理和控制，而不是精确的源重建，这创造了一种以牺牲比特级保真度来换取更大传输范围和效率的机会。
AI.method: 提出一种端到端的光学语义通信系统，无需显式源压缩或信道编码，直接将每幅图像映射为固定长度的信道符号，以在非线性波分复用（WDM）光纤通道中联合实现图像分类与重建。
AI.result: 在0 dBm发射功率下，所有测试的链路长度和调制阶数下，分类准确率保持在98.92%到99.31%之间，并且在每个测试的调制阶数下，所需的传输符号数均少于基于LDPC编码的JPEG基线。
AI.conclusion: 语义通信能够通过仅传输任务相关的信息，在非线性WDM光纤链路上实现扩展光传输距离和减少传输资源消耗的双重优势。
AI.translation: 新兴的光网络应用越来越多地将接收到的数据用于推理和控制，而不是精确的源重建，这创造了以比特级保真度换取更大传输范围和效率的机会。我们提出了一种用于非线性波分复用（WDM）光纤通道的端到端光学语义通信系统，用于联合图像分类和重建。该系统在没有显式源压缩或信道编码的情况下，将每幅图像直接映射为保留任务相关信息的固定长度信道符号序列。在MNIST数据集上的实验涵盖了-9到+3 dBm的发射功率、长达800公里的光纤长度以及16、64和256正交幅度调制（QAM）格式。在0 dBm时，在所有测试的链路长度和调制阶数下，分类准确率保持在98.92%和99.31%之间，同时在每个测试的调制阶数下，所需的传输符号都比低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）编码的JPEG基线少。这些结果表明，语义通信可以通过仅传达任务相关的信息，同时扩展光传输距离并减少传输资源。
AI.summary: 该文提出了一种用于非线性WDM光纤链路的端到端光学语义通信系统，通过直接将图像映射为信道符号来联合执行分类和重建任务，实验表明其在扩展传输距离和节省资源方面表现优异。
AI.keywords: 语义通信, 光纤通信, 波分复用, 图像分类, 端到端学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将语义通信引入非线性WDM光纤链路中，通过端到端联合设计平衡了图像分类与重建任务，不仅在长距离传输中保持了高准确率，还显著减少了传输资源开销，为未来面向智能任务的光网络设计提供了新思路。

title: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Is Hard to Beat, Yet Superlinear Drift Ships Lower Transport Costs
summary: Brešar and Mijatović \cite{bresar2025} show that Ornstein--Uhlenbeck diffusion is hard to beat in forward convergence under assumptions that exclude superlinear drift. We instead test superlinear Langevin diffusions for score-based image generation, computing their conditional scores numerically from a Fokker--Planck equation. In our experiments, the superlinear models beat the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck baseline on empirical Wasserstein distance across nearly the entire tested grid and show less variation across diffusion horizons. The ``hard to beat'' verdict of \cite{bresar2025} thus fails to be universal.

AI.title_translation: 奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克过程难以超越，但超线性漂移可降低传输成本
AI.tldr: 超线性漂移扩散打破了奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克过程“难以超越”的传统结论，在图像生成中实现了更低的传输成本。
AI.motivation: 检验此前被认为在收敛性上“难以超越”的奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克扩散在允许超线性漂移的情况下是否依然具有优势，并探索其在降低传输成本方面的潜力。
AI.method: 通过数值求解Fokker-Planck方程计算条件得分，测试超线性朗之万扩散在基于得分的图像生成中的表现，并与奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克基准进行对比。
AI.result: 在实验中，超线性模型在几乎整个测试网格上的经验Wasserstein距离均优于奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克基准，且在不同的扩散水平下表现出更小的变异性。
AI.conclusion: 在排除超线性漂移的假设下成立的“OU过程难以超越”的结论并非普遍适用，超线性漂移扩散在图像生成中展现出显著优势。
AI.translation: Brešar和Mijatović \cite{bresar2025}表明，在排除超线性漂移的假设下，奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克扩散在前向收敛性方面很难被超越。相反，我们测试了用于基于得分的图像生成的超线性朗之万扩散，通过Fokker-Planck方程数值计算它们的条件得分。在我们的实验中，超线性模型在几乎整个测试网格上的经验Wasserstein距离上击败了奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克基准，并且在不同的扩散视界下表现出更小的变异性。因此，\cite{bresar2025}的“难以超越”的结论并不是普遍适用的。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了超线性朗之万扩散在基于得分的图像生成中的应用。与先前认为奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克扩散难以超越的理论不同，本文通过数值计算条件得分，证明了超线性漂移能够降低传输成本并在经验Wasserstein距离上击败奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克基准。
AI.keywords: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck扩散, 超线性漂移, 图像生成, 评分匹配, Wasserstein距离
AI.comments: 该论文挑战了前人关于奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克（Ornstein-Uhlenbeck）扩散在收敛性上难以被超越的传统观点，通过引入超线性漂移的朗之万扩散，在图像生成任务中取得了更低的传输成本和更好的经验Wasserstein距离。创新性强，突破了现有理论假设的局限。

title: Schreyer Resolutions over the Exterior Algebra
summary: Schreyer's algorithm is usually the fastest way to determine a (typically non-minimal) free resolution of a finitely presented module over a polynomial ring. We adapt a refined version of Schreyer's algorithm to compute free resolutions over the exterior algebra, relying on relative Groebner bases. We illustrate the use of our algorithm for the computation of cohomology of coherent sheaves over projective space, which by the BGG correspondence can be computed via free resolutions over the exterior algebra. Schreyer's method relies on a tree traversal and thus has the potential for parallel computations. We report on ongoing work on a massively parallel implementation, observing that Gnawali's parallel approach over polynomial rings can be carried over to our setting.

AI.title_translation: 外代数上的施赖尔消解 (Schreyer Resolutions over the Exterior Algebra)
AI.tldr: 本文将计算多项式环自由消解的Schreyer算法适配到了外代数上，并通过相对Gröbner基实现了相干层上同调的高效计算及潜在的大规模并行化。
AI.motivation: 尽管Schreyer算法是多项式环上计算自由消解的最快方法之一，但其在外代数上的应用以及通过BGG对应计算射影空间上相干层上同调的需求，促使作者将该算法适配到外代数中。
AI.method: 采用基于相对Gröbner基的精炼Schreyer算法来计算外代数上的自由消解，并探讨了树遍历的并行化实现。
AI.result: 成功将Schreyer算法适配到外代数以计算自由消解，将其应用于射影空间上相干层上同调的计算，并推进了基于Gnawali并行方法的大规模并行实现工作。
AI.conclusion: 作者成功将Schreyer算法及相对Gröbner基理论适配于外代数，实现了自由消解的计算，并证明了其在并行计算（通过推广Gnawali的方法）上的可行性。
AI.translation: Schreyer算法通常是确定多项式环上有限展示模的（通常是非最小的）自由消解的最快方法。我们调整了Schreyer算法的一个精炼版本，依靠相对Gröbner基来计算外代数上的自由消解。我们演示了我们的算法在计算射影空间上相干层上同调的应用，通过BGG对应，这些上同调可以通过外代数上的自由消解来计算。Schreyer的方法依赖于树遍历，因此具有并行计算的潜力。我们报告了关于大规模并行实现的Ongoing工作，观察到Gnawali在多项式环上的并行方法可以迁移到我们的设定中。
AI.summary: 本文将Schreyer算法及其相对Gröbner基理论推广到外代数中，用于计算有限展示模的自由消解。通过BGG对应，该算法可用于计算射影空间上相干层的上同调。此外，由于该方法基于树遍历，作者还探讨并报告了将其在大规模并行计算中实现的前期工作。
AI.keywords: Schreyer Resolutions, Exterior Algebra, Gröbner Bases, Cohomology, Parallel Computations
AI.comments: 该论文将经典的Schreyer算法推广到了外代数（Exterior Algebra）上，通过相对 Gröbner 基计算自由消解，这对于通过BGG对应计算射影空间上相干层的上同调具有重要意义，并且其树遍历特性展现了良好的并行计算潜力。

title: Resonance Breaking in Noisy Shor's Algorithm
summary: We argue that the exponential quantum advantage in Shor's algorithm is broken under one-layer depolarizing noise of arbitrary small error rate, by analyzing a resonance breaking phenomenon in noisy quantum circuits. First, we express the distribution of measurements on $n$-qubit strings as the superposition of the $4^n$ wave functions in the Pauli path integral. In the noiseless case, the bit-strings achieving resonant peaks guaranteed a constant rate of successful measurements to factor a large number. Secondly, when the middle layer of the quantum circuit has independent depolarizing noise of rate $λ$, for any Hamming weight $d$, we obtain corresponding measurement rate bounded by $2(1-λ)^d$ for higher frequency terms and by $O(n^d)/2^{n/2}$ for low frequency terms. The rate approaches to zero as $n$ and $d$ approaches to infinity. Resonance breaking destroys the exponential quantum advantage. Furthermore, we design a classical factoring algorithm in polynomial time $O(n^d)$ to substitute the low frequency contribution.

AI.title_translation: 噪声Shor算法中的共振破坏
AI.tldr: 任意小的去极化噪声会导致Shor算法中的共振破坏，从而消除了其指数级量子优势。
AI.motivation: 探究在存在任意小的单层去极化噪声的情况下，Shor算法的指数级量子优势是否依然能够维持。
AI.method: 利用泡利路径积分将$n$比特字符串的测量分布表示为$4^n$个波函数的叠加，并分析中间层具有独立去极化噪声时的测量速率边界。
AI.result: 对于任意汉明权重$d$，高频项的测量速率被限制在$2(1-λ)^d$，低频项则被限制在$O(n^d)/2^{n/2}$，随着$n$和$d$趋于无穷大，速率趋近于零，共振破坏摧毁了量子优势，同时设计了一种$O(n^d)$多项式时间的经典因式分解算法。
AI.conclusion: 任意小的单层去极化噪声都会破坏Shor算法的共振峰，从而消除了其指数级量子优势，并允许使用多项式时间的经典算法替代低频贡献。
AI.translation: 我们通过分析含噪声量子电路中的共振破坏现象，论证了Shor算法中的指数级量子优势在具有任意小错误率的单层去极化噪声下会被破坏。首先，我们将$n$比特字符串上的测量分布表示为泡利路径积分中$4^n$个波函数的叠加。在无噪声情况下，实现共振峰的比特串保证了对大数进行因式分解的恒定成功测量率。其次，当量子电路中间层具有速率为$λ$的独立去极化噪声时，对于任意汉明权重$d$，我们得到高频项的相应测量速率边界为$2(1-λ)^d$，低频项为$O(n^d)/2^{n/2}$。随着$n$和$d$趋于无穷大，该速率趋近于零。共振破坏摧毁了指数级量子优势。此外，我们设计了一个时间复杂度为多项式时间$O(n^d)$的经典因式分解算法来替代低频贡献。
AI.summary: 该论文通过分析噪声量子电路中的共振破坏现象，证明了在任意小的单层去极化噪声下，Shor算法的指数级量子优势会被破坏，测量速率趋于零，并设计了一个多项式时间的经典因式分解算法来替代低频贡献。
AI.keywords: Shor算法, 量子优势, 共振破坏, 去极化噪声, 泡利路径积分
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了噪声对Shor算法指数级量子优势的毁灭性影响，通过引入共振破坏现象和泡利路径积分分析，对理解NISQ时代量子算法的局限性具有重要理论价值。

title: A Finslerian Approach for Embedding Directed Data
summary: Many datasets carry an intrinsic directionality: citations point backward in time, cells differentiate along lineages, and traffic follows preferred routes. Spectral embedding methods, including most of their extensions to directed graphs, discard this information: they symmetrize the data and map it into a Euclidean space where asymmetry cannot be represented. We instead model directed data as sampled from a Finsler manifold, whose distance depends on the direction of travel, and study the kernel operator built from this asymmetric distance. Through a moment expansion of this operator, we show that its symmetric and antisymmetric parts separate geometry from direction. As the bandwidth of the kernel vanishes, the symmetric part converges to a weighted Laplacian, recovering diffusion maps in the Riemannian case, while the antisymmetric part converges to a first-order transport operator that encodes the directionality. We prove that the corresponding graph operators, built from finitely many samples, converge uniformly and almost surely to these limits. For Randers metrics, this vector field is explicit and yields an embedding algorithm recovering both the manifold structure, from the spectrum of the symmetric part, and the underlying drift. We illustrate the approach on synthetic directed graphs and point-clouds.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于嵌入有向数据的芬斯勒方法
AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于芬斯勒流形的有向数据嵌入方法，通过分离核算子的对称与反对称部分，解决了传统方法无法在欧几里得空间中表示数据方向性的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统谱嵌入方法在处理具有内在方向性的有向数据集（如引用网络、细胞谱系、交通路线）时，往往会将其对称化并映射到无法表示非对称性的欧几里得空间，从而丢失了关键的方向信息。
AI.method: 利用芬斯勒流形对有向数据建模，研究基于非对称距离的核算子；通过该算子的矩展开（moment expansion）分离对称部分（几何）与反对称部分（方向）；证明图算子在有限样本下几乎必然一致收敛到其连续极限；针对Randers度量提出具体的嵌入算法。
AI.result: 证明了当核带宽趋于零时，核算子的对称部分收敛于加权拉普拉斯算子，反对称部分收敛于一阶输运算子；证明了有限样本下图算子的一致收敛性；在合成有向图和点云数据上成功验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将有向数据建模为芬斯勒流形并分析其核算子，论文成功分离了几何与方向性，并开发了能够同时恢复流形结构与底层漂移的有效嵌入算法。
AI.translation: 许多数据集都带有内在的方向性：引用在时间上倒流，细胞沿着谱系分化，交通遵循优选路线。包括大多数向有向图扩展的谱嵌入方法在内，都丢弃了这些信息：它们将数据对称化并映射到一个无法表示非对称性的欧几里得空间中。相反，我们将有向数据建模为从芬斯勒流形中采样的数据，该流形的距离取决于行进方向，并研究由这种非对称距离构建的核算子。通过该算子的矩展开，我们表明其对称和反对称部分将几何与方向分离开来。随着核带宽的消失，对称部分收敛于加权拉普拉斯算子（在黎曼情况下恢复扩散映射），而反对称部分收敛于编码方向性的一阶输运算子。我们证明了由有限样本构建的相应图算子一致且几乎必然地收敛到这些极限。对于Randers度量，这个向量场是显式的，并产生了一种嵌入算法，可以从对称部分的谱中恢复流形结构和底层漂移。我们在合成有向图和点云上说明了这种方法。
AI.summary: 该文提出了一种基于芬斯勒几何的新型有向数据嵌入方法，通过分析非对称距离核算子的对称与反对称部分，实现了数据几何结构与方向性特征的分离，并证明了相应图算子的理论收敛性，从而提供了一种能够同时恢复流形结构与漂移特征的有效算法。
AI.keywords: Finsler manifold, Directed data, Spectral embedding, Asymmetric distance, Transport operator
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于芬斯勒几何（Finslerian approach）的有向数据嵌入方法，能够同时捕捉数据的几何结构和方向性，克服了传统谱嵌入方法会丢弃有向信息的局限性，在理论和应用上均有重要创新。

title: Foundation Neural-Network Quantum States for Molecular Potential Energy Surfaces in Second Quantization
summary: Second-quantized neural-network quantum states have achieved accurate molecular energies, but extending them across molecular geometries requires a shared representation of the geometry-dependent wavefunction coefficients. We introduce geometry-conditioned foundation neural-network quantum states for molecular electronic structure in second quantization. A single autoregressive model learns a family of ground states from sparse anchor geometries and provides wavefunctions at untrained geometries without further optimization. Orbital alignment matches orbital identities and transports their phases, establishing an aligned orbital basis across geometries. Frozen energies reach chemical accuracy at every untrained query geometry for N$_2$, CO, and H$_4$. On additional molecular paths, the energy-trained wavefunctions yield dipoles, quadrupoles, and natural occupations without property labels. Across three paired N$_2$ training seeds, orbital alignment lowers the mean absolute energy error over all untrained query geometries from 34-37 mHa to 0.049-0.085 mHa. At approximately 1 mHa mean absolute error, frozen evaluation reduces the per-geometry cost by $986\times$ relative to independent optimization, yielding an estimated $25.8\times$ end-to-end GPU-cost reduction on a 161-point N$_2$ grid.

AI.title_translation: 基于二次量子化分子势能面的基础神经量子态
AI.tldr: 提出了一种跨分子几何结构的基础神经量子态方法，无需重新优化即可在任意分子构型下高效计算化学精度的能量和量子性质。
AI.motivation: 现有的二次量子化神经量子态虽然能实现准确的分子能量，但将其扩展到不同的分子几何结构需要为每个几何结构独立优化波函数或共享几何依赖的波函数系数，这在计算上非常昂贵且缺乏统一的几何泛化能力。
AI.method: 引入了几何条件基础神经量子态（Foundation NQS），采用单一自回归模型从稀疏的锚点几何结构学习基态族，并结合轨道对齐技术来匹配轨道身份和传输相位，从而在不同几何结构间建立对齐的轨道基底。
AI.result: 对于 N$_2$、CO 和 H$_4$ 分子，冻结能量在所有未训练的查询几何结构上均达到了化学精度；在 N$_2$ 测试中，轨道 alignment 将未训练查询几何结构的平均绝对能量误差从 34-37 mHa 降至 0.049-0.085 mHa，且相比独立优化降低了约 $986\times$ 的单几何结构计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发了几何条件基础神经量子态，能够以极低成本在未训练的分子几何结构上实现化学精度的能量计算和多极矩等性质预测，为分子势能面的高效精确模拟开辟了新途径。
