AI.title_translation: VectraYX-Vision-1B：一个2B以下的西班牙语/拉美网络安全视觉语言模型及其视觉接地限制分析
AI.tldr: 开发了亚2B的西班牙语网络安全视觉语言模型VectraYX-Vision-1B，并深入分析了其视觉接地的瓶颈与改进方法。
AI.motivation: 构建用于离线环境的亚2B（sub-2B）西班牙语/拉美网络安全视觉语言模型，并深入探究限制其视觉接地（visual grounding）性能的关键因素。
AI.method: 将冻结的1.04B参数解码器通过可训练投影器与冻结的视觉编码器（SigLIP或Qwen2-VL-2B塔）连接，在特定数据集（如B6和B8）上进行微调与评测，并使用冻结特征探针分析其视觉接地局限性。
AI.result: 使用SigLIP时模型在某些字段提取上受到限制；而移植Qwen2-VL塔显著提升了文本识别和地址读取能力（如从0.00提升至0.81），且仅训练投影器即可将工具识别率（B6）从0.00提升至0.96，但同时也暴出了灾难性遗忘和任务间泛化能力不足的问题。
AI.conclusion: VectraYX-Vision-1B展示了在特定网络安全任务中利用冻结骨干网络和可训练投影器的可行性，但也暴露出视觉接地（visual grounding）和任务泛化方面的局限性。未来需要更平衡的训练策略来同时兼顾不同任务的性能。
AI.translation: 我们构建了VectraYX-Vision-1B，这是一个用于离线使用的亚2B西班牙语/拉美网络安全视觉语言模型，并测量了限制其视觉接地的因素。一个冻结的1.04B参数解码器通过一个可训练的投影器与一个冻结的视觉编码器耦合：首先是SigLIP，然后是Qwen2-VL-2B塔并带有为llama.cpp的mmproj导出形状的投影器。使用SigLIP时，在修复了五个微调缺陷后，带有混淆图像对照组的九字段提取门在保持编码器不变且无文本提示的每种配置下都通过了相同的2/9字段。冻结特征探针解释了原因。移植带有自身合并器的Qwen2-VL塔读取了SigLIP从未读过的8字节地址（从0.00到0.81精确匹配）。在B8上（2,040个项目，34个字段，16个模板，混淆图像和最佳常量对照），Qwen塔检查点通过了9个字段，全部在训练过的模板-字段对之内。截图工具识别（B6）正好停留在0.000。这不是感知上限。股票Qwen2-VL-2B在我们像素预算下以0.93的词召回率转录相同的图像（加letterboxing后为0.52）。仅在B6的任务格式和渲染系列上训练投影器，将B6工具识别提升到0.96，召回率提升到0.48-0.51。因此，渲染文本的感知在这种冻结骨干设计中是存在且可训练的。证据很窄。B6对该投影器几乎是域内的（in-distribution），该投影器也忘记了B8的一部分（保留检查时平均字段准确率从0.53降至0.29）；运行是单种子的，且目前没有检查点能兼顾两者。我们记录了四个评测缺陷，撤回了先前的B6分数，并发布了代码、基准测试和检查点。
AI.summary: 该论文推出了VectraYX-Vision-1B，一个面向西班牙语/拉美地区的亚2B网络安全视觉语言模型，用于离线场景。研究详细评估了不同视觉编码器和投影器对视觉接地及文本识别性能的影响，揭示了感知能力的上限与训练局限性，并开源了相关代码、基准测试与检查点。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 网络安全, 视觉接地, 西班牙语/拉美地区, 模型局限性
AI.comments: 该论文构建了一个轻量级的西班牙语/拉美网络安全视觉语言模型，并深入探讨了其视觉基础和局限性。创新之处在于针对特定领域和低资源（sub-2B）场景进行了探索，并通过消融实验和控制变量分析了冻结编码器及投影器的性能瓶颈，为小型VLM的开发提供了宝贵的实证经验和开源资源。

title: SR-OPSD: Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) converts feedback into dense token-level supervision on student-generated trajectories, complementing reinforcement learning with sparse outcome rewards. Its self-teacher, derived from the student's current or exponentially averaged parameters and conditioned on additional context, evolves alongside the student and its rollout context distribution. The benefit of modifying this moving target depends on how target--student probability mismatches translate into updates. We propose \emph{Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation (SR-OPSD)}, which constructs a normalized geometric target from the self-teacher and a frozen initial policy, then minimizes the forward Rényi divergence from this target to the student. The interpolation coefficient controls the self-teacher's contribution, while the Rényi order controls the power weighting of target-to-student probability ratios in the gradient. For fixed contexts and target components, we establish a conditional variational characterization and derive the exact token-logit gradient, revealing how anchoring and projection jointly shape the effective update target. Experiments across scientific reasoning, tool use, mathematical reasoning, and code generation demonstrate strong performance across multiple model families and scales. Ablations further show that reference anchoring can improve or degrade performance depending on the projection objective, supporting the joint design of target construction and projection geometry.

AI.title_translation: SR-OPSD：自引用在线策略自蒸馏
AI.tldr: 本文提出了SR-OPSD方法，通过结合自教师和初始策略构建归一化几何目标并最小化前向Rényi散度，显著提升了大模型的在线策略自蒸馏性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中，移动目标的修改效果高度依赖于目标与学生概率不匹配转化为更新的方式，因此需要一种更优的目标构造和投影几何设计来提升性能和稳定性。
AI.method: 提出SR-OPSD方法，通过自教师和一个冻结的初始策略构建归一化的几何目标，并最小化从该目标到学生模型的前向Rényi散度，利用插值系数和Rényi阶数来控制梯度中的概率比重。
AI.result: 在科学推理、工具使用、数学推理和代码生成等多个任务及不同模型家族和规模的实验中，SR-OPSD展现出了强大的性能，消融实验也证明了参考锚定和投影目标的联合设计对性能的重要影响。
AI.conclusion: SR-OPSD通过结合自教师和冻结初始策略的目标构建方式，以及前向Rényi散度最小化，提供了一种更稳健的在线策略自蒸馏方案，在科学推理、代码生成等多个任务和模型规模上取得了优异的表现。
AI.translation: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）将反馈转换为学生生成轨迹上的稠密token级监督，以补充稀疏结果奖励的强化学习。其自教师源自学生的当前参数或指数平均参数，并以附加上下文为条件，与学生及其 rollout 上下文分布一同演化。修改这一移动目标的好处取决于目标与学生概率的不匹配如何转化为更新。我们提出了“自引用在线策略自蒸馏（SR-OPSD）”，它由自教师和冻结的初始策略构建一个归一化的几何目标，然后最小化从该目标到学生的前向Rényi散度。插值系数控制自教师的贡献，而Rényi阶数控制梯度中目标与学生概率比率的幂加权。对于固定的上下文和目标组件，我们确立了条件变分特征并推导出了精确的token-logit梯度，揭示了锚定和投影如何共同塑造有效的更新目标。在科学推理、工具使用、数学推理和代码生成方面的实验表明，该方法在多个模型系列和规模上表现出强劲的性能。消融实验进一步表明，参考锚定可以根据投影目标改善或降低性能，这支持了目标构造与投影几何的联合设计。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了自引用在线策略自蒸馏（SR-OPSD）方法。通过结合动态自教师与冻结初始策略构建归一化几何目标，并最小化前向Rényi散度，SR-OPSD有效地改进了策略更新机制，在多项复杂推理和生成任务中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 在线策略自蒸馏, 前向Rényi散度, 策略优化, 语言模型, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种名为SR-OPSD的新型自蒸馏方法，通过结合自教师与冻结初始策略构建归一化几何目标，并利用前向Rényi散度最小化来指导学生模型训练。这一设计深入探讨并揭示了锚定与投影几何对策略更新的影响，在多个复杂任务（如科学推理、数学、代码生成等）上展现出强大且稳健的性能。

title: RynnValue: Scaling Robotic Value Foundation Models with Temporal Distance
summary: General-purpose reward models are increasingly the bottleneck for scaling robot learning, yet the recipe for learning value-related capabilities from large-scale heterogeneous corpora remains underexplored. Existing approaches tie supervision to task-internal anchors such as preferences or normalized progress, none of which transfer cleanly across embodiments and data sources. We introduce RynnValue, an open-source value foundation model for robotic manipulation that replaces these anchors with temporal distance, the directed cost-to-go from an observation to the language-specified goal. Because temporal-distance labels can be derived directly from timestamps, RynnValue scales to over 7,000 hours and roughly 3M instruction-conditioned clips without preference or progress annotations. To make temporal-value learning reliable at scale, we combine random temporal sampling, temporal-order shuffling, and value-isolation attention, suppressing shortcuts that would leave predictions insensitive to failures and regressions. Trained without preference labels, RynnValue attains an average Kendall's $τ_a$ of 0.704 on RBM-EVAL-OOD, surpassing the fully preference-supervised state of the art (0.655) and more than doubling a progress-only counterpart (0.292), while generalizing zero-shot to unseen tasks, embodiments, and viewpoints. As a zero-shot reward model, RynnValue serves a range of downstream applications. Converted into dense rewards via potential-based shaping, it raises real-world policy success from 52.5% to 72.5% online and from 63.8% to 82.5% offline; used for data filtering, it improves multi-task behavior cloning success from 35.0% to 42.5%; and applied as inference-time value guidance, it lifts a frozen policy's success from 67.5% to 80.0%. These results establish temporal distance as a scalable supervision target and practical reward interface for generalist robot policies.

AI.title_translation: RynnValue：利用时间距离扩展机器人价值基础模型
AI.tldr: RynnValue通过利用时间距离作为可扩展的监督信号，无需偏好标注，成功构建了具备强零样本泛化能力的机器人价值基础模型，显著提升了下游策略的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的通用奖励模型在扩展机器人学习时遇到了瓶颈，因为现有方法依赖于偏好或标准化进度等任务内部锚点，无法在不同的具身形态和数据源之间清晰迁移。
AI.method: 引入RynnValue，使用时间距离（从观察到语言指定目标的有向剩余成本）作为监督信号，并结合随机时间采样、时间顺序洗牌和价值隔离注意力机制来消除捷径学习。
AI.result: 在RBM-EVAL-OOD上达到了0.704的平均Kendall's tau_a，超越了全偏好监督的SOTA（0.55），且在真实世界的策略成功率、数据过滤和推理时价值引导等下游应用中均取得了显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 时间距离被证明是一个可扩展的监督目标和实用的奖励接口，能够有效支撑通用机器人策略的泛化与性能提升。
AI.translation: 通用奖励模型日益成为扩展机器人学习的瓶颈，然而从大规模异构语料库中学习价值相关能力的方法仍未得到充分探索。现有的方法将监督与任务内部的锚点（如偏好或标准化进度）绑定，这些锚点都无法跨具身形态和数据源进行清晰的迁移。我们推出了RynnValue，一个用于机器人操作的开源价值基础模型，它用时间距离（从观察到语言指定目标的有向剩余成本）替代了这些锚点。由于时间距离标签可以直接从时间戳派生，RynnValue在无需偏好或进度标注的情况下，扩展到了超过7,000小时和约300万个指令条件片段。为了使时间价值学习在大规模下保持可靠，我们结合了随机时间采样、时间顺序洗牌和价值隔离注意力，抑制了使预测对失败和退步不敏感的捷径。在没有偏好标签的情况下训练，RynnValue在RBM-EVAL-OOD上获得了0.704的平均Kendall's τ_a，超越了完全偏好监督的最新技术（0.655），并且是仅进度对应方法的两倍多（0.292），同时能够零样本泛化到未见过的任务、具身形态和视角。作为零样本奖励模型，RynnValue支持了一系列下游应用。通过基于势能的塑造转化为密集奖励，它将真实世界策略的成功率在线从52.5%提高到72.5%，离线从63.8%提高到82.5%；用于数据过滤时，它将多任务行为克隆的成功率从35.0%提高到42.5%；作为推理时的价值指导应用时，它将冻结策略的成功率从67.5%提高到80.0%。这些结果确立了时间距离作为通用机器人策略的可扩展监督目标和实用奖励接口的地位。
AI.summary: 本文提出了RynnValue，一个通过时间距离扩展机器人价值基础模型的开源框架。它利用从时间戳直接派生的时间距离作为监督信号，无需偏好标注，即可在超7000小时的数据上进行扩展，并在零样本泛化和下游任务中展现出优异的性能。
AI.keywords: 机器人学习, 价值基础模型, 时间距离, 奖励模型, 零样本泛化
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出利用时间距离作为可扩展的机器人价值基础模型监督信号，摆脱了传统方法对偏好标注或任务内部进度锚点的依赖，并在多项下游任务中验证了其有效性和泛化能力。

title: RAISE: Diagnosing Acquisition Collapse in Costly LLM Signals
comments: 33 pages, 12 figures. v2: substantially revised and retitled (v1 title: "Detecting an Effect Is Not Learning to Act on It: A Reward-SNR Floor for LLM Acquisition Agents"); adds the RAISE audit, a controlled mechanism study, a fresh-cohort study, and a prospective offline pilot; new coauthors
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as costly, on-demand components in real systems, but calling them indiscriminately can waste substantial compute, latency, and serving budget. The key deployment question is therefore not only whether an LLM helps on average, but when it is worth calling. We identify a common failure mode, which we call acquisition collapse: an LLM signal can appear useful in aggregate or post hoc, yet still provide too little before-call information to support reliable selective use. We introduce RAISE (Reward-SNR Actionability in Signal Evaluation), a pre-routing diagnostic framework for testing whether available evidence supports selective use before committing to a routing strategy. We instantiate RAISE with Structured Hypothesis Embeddings (SHE), a frozen-LLM intent signal for recommendation using one LLM call per user, and evaluate it through controlled, retrospective, and fresh-cohort studies and a prospective offline pilot whose audit decisions are frozen before independent outcomes are revealed. Across these settings, predictable incremental benefit, not average lift alone, distinguishes settings with recoverable selective value; deployment additionally depends on cost and operational constraints. Seemingly strong oracle or subgroup gains can disappear under independent evaluation. More broadly, RAISE reframes costly inference as an information-acquisition problem: before paying for an expensive model, tool, sensor, or measurement, first test whether its value is predictable at decision time. This principle motivates cost-aware acquisition in settings ranging from agent tool use and stronger-model consultation to robotic sensing and clinical decision pipelines.
comment: 33 pages, 12 figures. v2: substantially revised and retitled (v1 title: "Detecting an Effect Is Not Learning to Act on It: A Reward-SNR Floor for LLM Acquisition Agents"); adds the RAISE audit, a controlled mechanism study, a fresh-cohort study, and a prospective offline pilot; new coauthors

AI.title_translation: RAISE：诊断昂贵大模型信号中的获取崩溃问题
AI.tldr: 本文提出了RAISE诊断框架，用于解决大语言模型按需调用中的“获取崩溃”问题，通过测试决策前信号的可预测价值来优化昂贵的模型调用成本。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型作为按需组件调用成本高昂，盲目调用会浪费计算、延迟和预算，而现有的聚合有效性无法保证在决策前提供足够的信息来支持可靠的选择性使用（即获取崩溃问题）。
AI.method: 引入RAISE（Reward-SNR Actionability in Signal Evaluation）预路由诊断框架，并使用结构化假设嵌入（SHE）进行实例化，通过控制研究、回顾性研究、新队列研究和前瞻性离线试点进行评估。
AI.result: 研究表明，可预测的增量收益（而非单纯的平均提升）是区分可恢复选择性价值的关键；在独立评估下，看似强大的预言机或子群增益可能会消失，实际部署还取决于成本和运营约束。
AI.conclusion: RAISE框架有效诊断了昂贵LLM信号的获取崩溃问题，强调在决策时可预测的增量收益是实现选择性调用的关键，为成本感知的信息获取提供了通用原则。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作真实系统中成本高昂、按需调用的组件，但无差别地调用它们会浪费大量的计算、延迟和服务器预算。因此，关键的部署问题不仅在于LLM平均是否有帮助，还在于什么时候值得调用。我们识别出一种常见的失败模式，称之为“获取崩溃”：LLM信号在总体上或事后看起来很有用，但在调用前提供的信息却太少，无法支持可靠的选择性使用。我们引入了RAISE（Reward-SNR Actionability in Signal Evaluation，信号评估中的奖励-信噪比可操作性），这是一个预路由诊断框架，用于在提交路由策略之前测试可用证据是否支持选择性使用。我们用结构化假设嵌入（SHE）实例化了RAISE，SHE是一种用于推荐的冻结LLM意图信号，每个用户使用一次LLM调用，并通过受控的、回顾性的、新队列的研究以及一个前瞻性的离线试点（其审计决策在独立结果揭示之前被冻结）对其进行评估。在这些设置中，可预测的增量收益（而不仅仅是平均提升）区分了具有可恢复选择性价值的设置；部署还取决于成本和运营约束。在独立评估下，看似强大的预言机或子群增益可能会消失。更广泛地说，RAISE将昂贵的推理重新定义为一个信息获取问题：在为一个昂贵的模型、工具、传感器或测量付费之前，首先测试其价值在决策时是否是可预测的。这一原则推动了从智能体工具使用、更强模型咨询到机器人传感和临床决策管道等各种设置中的成本感知获取。
AI.summary: 论文识别了大模型信号中的“获取崩溃”现象，即聚合有用的信号在决策前可能信息不足。为此，作者提出了RAISE诊断框架，用于在部署路由策略前测试证据是否支持选择性使用，从而指导成本感知的模型调用。
AI.keywords: 大模型调用成本, 选择性使用, 获取崩溃, RAISE框架, 结构化假设嵌入
AI.comments: 本文针对大模型调用成本高的问题，指出了“获取崩溃（acquisition collapse）”这一常见失败模式，并创新性地提出了RAISE框架和SHE方法，将昂贵的推理重新定义为信息获取问题，对智能体工具使用、大模型咨询等场景具有重要价值。

title: XBridge: Entity-Grounded Latent Bridge for Heterogeneous LLM Communication
summary: Heterogeneous multi-agent LLM systems, where agents are powered by different model families, can outperform homogeneous configurations by reducing redundant reasoning patterns. Yet existing communication protocols either operate through text, discarding the sender's internal representations, or require architectural homogeneity for latent-level transfer. We identify the entity grounding problem in cross-architecture communication: cross-attention bridges that transfer continuous representations across different LLM families suffer from rare-token compression collapse, where entity identity is lost in the continuous bottleneck (bridge-only F1 ~30%). We propose XBRIDGE, a decode-free communication protocol that addresses this through two mechanisms. Lexical Anchor Mapping (LAM) maps the sender's original context tokens to the receiver's vocabulary, providing discrete entity anchors. A Latent Enrichment Bridge (LEB) lets the receiver query the sender's hidden states for contextual enrichment. The entity anchors ground the bridge's contextual signals to specific entities through the receiver's own self-attention. Across three model families (Llama, Qwen, and Mistral), seven benchmarks, and both communication directions, XBRIDGE outperforms text-based communication on all seven tasks for each model pair while achieving 11x lower latency, and in a same-architecture setting it also exceeds a KV-sharing baseline on six of seven tasks. LEB requires only 264M trainable parameters (3.8% of the receiver), is trained on a small balanced sample set, and adds negligible inference overhead.

AI.title_translation: XBridge：异构大模型通信的实体接地潜在桥梁
AI.tldr: XBridge是一种专为异构大语言模型设计的低延迟通信协议，通过词汇锚点和潜空间丰富机制解决了跨架构传输中的实体丢失问题，性能超越传统文本通信和KV共享基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的异构多智能体大模型系统通信协议要么通过文本操作丢弃了发送方的内部表示，要么要求架构同质化。而现有的跨架构潜空间连续表示转移存在“实体接地问题”（即罕见标记压缩崩溃，导致实体身份丢失），因此需要一种能够高效且准确进行异构大模型间通信的协议。
AI.method: 提出XBridge解码无关通信协议，包含两个核心机制：1）词汇锚点映射（LAM），将发送方的原始上下文标记映射到接收方的词汇表，提供离散的实体锚点；2）潜空间丰富桥梁（LEB），允许接收方查询发送方的隐藏状态以进行上下文丰富。
AI.result: 在三个模型系列、七个基准测试和双向通信中，XBRIDGE在所有七个任务上均优于基于文本的通信，延迟降低了11倍；在同架构设置下，也在六个任务上超过了KV共享基线。同时，LEB仅需264M可训练参数（占接收方的3.8%），并具有极小的推理开销。
AI.conclusion: XBridge通过词汇锚点映射和潜空间丰富桥梁，有效解决了异构大语言模型跨架构通信中的实体接地问题，在多个基准测试中实现了性能和效率的双重超越。
AI.translation: 由不同模型系列驱动的异构多智能体大模型（LLM）系统，通过减少冗余的推理模式，可以胜过同构配置。然而，现有的通信协议要么通过文本操作丢弃了发送方的内部表示，要么要求进行潜空间传输的架构同质化。我们指出了跨架构通信中的实体接地问题：跨注意力桥梁在不同LLM系列之间传输连续表示时，会遭遇罕见标记压缩崩溃，导致实体身份在连续瓶颈中丢失（桥梁专用的F1约为30%）。我们提出了XBRIDGE，这是一种无需解码的通信协议，通过两种机制解决了这个问题。词汇锚点映射（LAM）将发送方的原始上下文标记映射到接收方的词汇表，提供离散的实体锚点。潜空间丰富桥梁（LEB）允许接收方查询发送方的隐藏状态以进行上下文丰富。实体锚点通过接收方自身的自注意力，将桥梁的上下文信号接地到特定实体。跨越三个模型系列（Llama、Qwen和Mistral）、七个基准测试以及两个通信方向，XBRIDGE在每个模型对的所有七个任务上都优于基于文本的通信，同时实现了11倍的低延迟；在同架构设置下，它还在七个任务中的六个任务上超过了KV共享基线。LEB仅需要2.64亿个可训练参数（占接收方的3.8%），在小型平衡样本集上进行训练，并增加了可忽略不计的推理开销。
AI.summary: 论文提出了XBridge，一种针对异构大语言模型通信的解码无关协议。通过词汇锚点映射和潜空间丰富桥梁，XBridge成功解决了跨架构通信中的实体接地问题，在大幅降低延迟的同时，显著提升了多模型协作的性能。
AI.keywords: 异构多智能体系统, 大语言模型通信, 潜空间迁移, 实体接地, 词汇锚点映射
AI.comments: 该论文针对异构大语言模型多智能体系统中的通信瓶颈问题，提出了XBridge通信协议。其创新点在于通过“词汇锚点映射”与“潜空间丰富桥梁”相结合的方式，解决了跨架构传输中的实体身份丢失和罕见词压缩崩溃问题，在保证低延迟的同时显著提升了通信效果。这为未来高效的异构大模型协同提供了重要的技术路径。

title: Massive Activations in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models: Pre-Attention Spikes and Inter-Spike Plateaus
summary: We present the first systematic study of massive activations (MAs) in layer-interleaved Hybrid linear attention large language models (HLA LLMs), examining their architectural organization, training-time emergence, underlying mechanisms, and functional significance. Across five linear attention architectures, six hybridization configurations, and five input domains, we identify two architecture-aligned morphologies: pre-attention spikes (PAS) immediately before full attention and inter-spike plateaus (ISP) persisting through intervening linear attention layers. Denser full attention increasingly connects PAS through ISP, approaching the persistent MAs of conventional Transformers. This organization also recurs across 12 public checkpoints spanning 1.2B-397B parameters, covering linear attention and state-space hybrids. Controlled pretraining of Gated DeltaNet (GDN) hybrids up to 1.3B reveals early emergence and consolidation of both morphologies, alongside asymmetric gating effects. Specifically, full attention output gates strongly attenuate MA magnitudes without eliminating their organization, whereas removing GDN output gates yields modest amplification. Mechanistically, we develop a shared systematic-outlier account: PAS follows a localized write-sink-cancel process, while ISP is consistent with delayed cancellation. Functionally, our interventions show that deleting only the four largest-magnitude PAS coordinates at each full attention input reduces mean downstream accuracy by 21.9%-63.6% relative to normal inference. Moreover, reference-conditioned spike-to-plateau connection consistently improves mean real-world retrieval accuracy, yielding relative gains of 1.1%-12.6% without retraining. Our code is available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/Massive-Activations-HLA.

AI.title_translation: 混合线性注意力大语言模型中的巨量激活：预注意力峰值与间歇平台
AI.tldr: 本文首次系统揭示了混合线性注意力大语言模型中巨量激活的形态、机制及其对模型性能的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 旨在填补对层交错混合线性注意力大语言模型（HLA LLMs）中巨量激活（MAs）现象研究的空白，探讨其架构组织、训练期出现、潜在机制和功能意义。
AI.method: 跨5种线性注意力架构、6种混合配置和5个输入域进行了系统研究，分析了12个公开检查点（1.2B-397B参数），并对Gated DeltaNet混合模型进行控制预训练及干预实验。
AI.result: 识别出预注意力峰值（PAS）和间歇平台（ISP）两种形态；发现删除极少数PAS会导致下游准确率大幅下降（21.9%-63.6%），而连接峰值与平台可使真实世界检索准确率相对提升1.1%-12.6%。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了HLA LLMs中巨量激活的结构、机制与功能作用，证明了PAS和ISP对于模型性能至关重要，并为理解和改进混合Transformer架构提供了新视角。
AI.translation: 我们对层交错混合线性注意力大语言模型（HLA LLMs）中的巨量激活（MAs）进行了首次系统研究，检查了它们的架构组织、训练期出现、底层机制和功能意义。跨越五种线性注意力架构、六种混合配置和五个输入域，我们识别出了两种与架构对齐的形态：紧接在全注意力之前的预注意力峰值（PAS）以及贯穿 intervening 线性注意力层的间歇平台（ISP）。更密集的全注意力通过ISP逐渐连接PAS，接近传统Transformer的持续性MAs。这种组织结构也在跨越1.2B-397B参数的12个公共检查点中重复出现，涵盖了线性注意力与状态空间混合模型。对Gated DeltaNet（GDN）混合模型高达1.3B的受控预训练揭示了这两种形态的早期出现和巩固，以及不对称的门控效应。具体而言，全注意力输出门显著衰减了MA的幅度，但没有消除它们的组织结构，而移除GDN输出门则产生适度的放大。在机制上，我们提出了一个共享的系统异常值解释：PAS遵循局部的写-汇聚-取消过程，而ISP与延迟取消一致。在功能上，我们的干预表明，在每个全注意力输入处仅删除四个最大幅度的PAS，会使平均下游准确率比正常推理降低21.9%-63.6%。此外，参考条件下的峰-台连接持续改善了平均真实世界检索准确率，在无需重新训练的情况下带来了1.1%-12.6%的相对增益。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/Massive-Activations-HLA 获取。
AI.summary: 本文首次系统研究了混合线性注意力大语言模型中的巨量激活现象，发现了预注意力峰值和间歇平台两种核心形态，揭示了其底层机制，并证明了它们对模型性能和检索能力的关键作用。
AI.keywords: 混合线性注意力大语言模型, 巨量激活, 预注意力峰值, 间歇平台, 模型机制
AI.comments: 该论文首次系统地研究了混合线性注意力大语言模型（HLA LLMs）中的巨量激活现象，揭示了其独特的形态学特征、机制及功能重要性，对未来高效架构设计具有重要意义。

title: Decode-Branch Transformers: Decoupling the Primary Prefill Path from Additional Decode Computation
summary: As large language models serve ever more requests, cumulative inference cost is growing relative to the one-time cost of training. In typical serving, prompt prefill runs in parallel and is compute-bound, whereas autoregressive decode is sequential and memory-traffic-bound. Conventional width or depth scaling raises both costs together, since every added layer is evaluated in both phases and enlarges the weights read at each decode step. We instead ask whether additional learned computation can be allocated to continuation prediction while preserving prompt-wide primary computation and a single KV cache. We realize this with the Decode-Branch Transformer. Its primary path alone processes the prompt and writes the KV cache; the decode branch is omitted during prefill and activated only from the final prompt position onward, adding continuation computation without writing state or affecting the primary path. The paths share attention, MLP, and output matrices, using separate token embeddings with lightweight coupling. Grouped decode reuses loaded weight tiles and the primary KV cache across both paths, so the added arithmetic does not proportionally increase dominant memory traffic or decode latency. Across matched-token comparisons, Decode-Branch achieves lower validation loss across architectures and data settings. In MoE models, the primary and branch expert fan-outs become independent knobs for trading prompt cost, decode cost, and predictive quality. We study two expert-allocation regimes, holding prefill or decode computation fixed, and expose a prefill-decode-quality trade-off enabled by phase-specific expert allocation.

AI.title_translation: 解码-分支Transformer：将主预填充路径与额外解码计算解耦
AI.tldr: Decode-Branch Transformer通过解耦预填充和解码计算路径，在不增加内存流量和KV缓存的前提下提升了语言模型的预测质量。
AI.motivation: 常规的宽度或深度缩放会同时增加预填充和解码的成本，而预填充受计算限制、解码受内存流量限制，因此作者希望在保持提示词主计算和单一KV缓存不变的同时，为续写预测分配额外的学习计算。
AI.method: 提出Decode-Branch Transformer架构，主路径处理提示词并写入KV缓存，解码分支仅从提示词最后一位激活以增加续写计算但不写状态；两路径共享注意力、MLP和输出矩阵，采用独立Token嵌入及轻量级耦合；通过分组解码重用加载的权重分块和主KV缓存。
AI.result: 在匹配Token的比较中，Decode-Branch在各种架构和数据设置下均实现了更低的验证损失；在MoE模型中，它通过独立调节主专家和分支专家的扩展，实现了预填充成本、解码成本与预测质量之间的灵活权衡。
AI.conclusion: Decode-Branch Transformer 成功解耦了预填充与解码的计算路径，在降低解码内存瓶颈的同时提升了模型的预测质量，为大语言模型的高效服务开辟了新的设计空间。
AI.translation: 随着大语言模型服务于越来越多的请求，累积的推理成本相对于训练的一次性成本不断增长。在典型的服务中，提示词预填充并行运行且受计算限制，而自回归解码则是串行运行且受内存流量限制。传统的宽度或深度缩放会同时提高这两种成本，因为每个增加的层在两个阶段都会被评估，并放大了每个解码步骤读取的权重。我们转而探讨是否可以在保留提示词范围的主计算和单一KV缓存的同时，为续写预测分配额外的学习计算。我们通过解码-分支Transformer实现了这一点。它的主路径单独处理提示词并写入KV缓存；解码分支在预填充期间被省略，仅从最后一个提示词位置开始激活，增加续写计算而不写入状态或影响主路径。两条路径共享注意力、MLP和输出矩阵，并使用带有轻量级耦合的独立Token嵌入。分组解码在两条路径之间重用加载的权重分块和主KV缓存，因此增加的算术并没有成比例地增加主要的内存流量或解码延迟。在匹配Token的比较中，Decode-Branch在各种架构和数据设置下都实现了更低的验证损失。在MoE模型中，主专家和分支专家扩展（fan-outs）成为用于权衡提示词成本、解码成本和预测质量的独立旋钮。我们研究了两种专家分配机制，保持预填充或解码计算固定，并揭示了由阶段特定专家分配所实现的预填充-解码-质量权衡。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Decode-Branch Transformer，这是一种将主提示词预填充路径与额外解码计算解耦的新型架构。通过在解码阶段引入不增加KV缓存状态和内存流量负担的分支计算，该方法在保持高效推理的同时降低了验证损失，并为大语言模型的预填充-解码-质量权衡提供了新的调优手段。
AI.keywords: Large Language Models, Inference Cost, Decode-Branch Transformer, Prefill-Decode Decoupling, Mixture of Experts
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的Transformer架构，通过解耦预填充（Prefill）和解码（Decode）阶段的计算，成功在不增加主路径KV缓存和主要内存带宽负担的情况下，提高了大语言模型的预测性能。这对于降低大模型推理成本具有重要意义。

title: Spatial Memory Agent: Experience-Grounded Procedural Memory for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial intelligence is becoming a foundation for embodied agents, robotic planning, and multimodal assistants. To improve the spatial reasoning ability of VLMs, existing work has mainly followed two lines. One line uses post-training methods, such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Another line adopts an agentic paradigm in which the model calls external spatial tools to gather intermediate spatial evidence. We study a complementary and underexplored route: Can a frozen VLM agent improve its spatial reasoning through \textbf{parameter-update-free self-evolution}, without depending on external expert spatial tools at inference time? We present \textbf{Spatial Memory Agent (SMA)}, an experience-grounded runtime memory framework that converts verified spatial experience into reusable transferable lessons. Specifically, SMA first queries the frozen VLM in a verifiable spatial environment, obtains a predicted answer and reward, and uses verifier-guided reflection to distill compact transferable lessons stored in memory cards. SMA further assigns each memory card a \textbf{Transfer Reliability Score (TRS)}, which is initialized uniformly and calibrated from later retrieval outcomes as visit evidence of future transfer reliability. During read-only deployment, SMA retrieves memory cards through semantic filtering and combined similarity--TRS ranking, allowing the retrieved memory to guide frozen model inference. Experiments across five representative spatial benchmarks show that SMA achieves the best macro-average accuracy for all four base VLMs and the best accuracy in most individual evaluations, establishing a practical parameter-update-free path for spatial self-evolution through reusable experience.

AI.title_translation: 空间记忆代理：用于空间智能的、基于经验基础的程序记忆
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 Spatial Memory Agent (SMA) 的运行时记忆框架，使冻结的 VLM 能够在无需参数更新或外部工具的情况下，通过可复用的空间经验实现空间推理能力的自进化。
AI.motivation: 现有提升 VLM 空间推理能力的方法主要依赖于后训练（监督微调、强化学习）或调用外部空间工具。本文旨在探索一条互补且未被充分探索的路线：冻结的 VLM 代理是否可以通过无参数更新的自我进化来提高其空间推理能力，而无需在推理时依赖外部专家空间工具。
AI.method: 提出 Spatial Memory Agent (SMA) 运行时记忆框架，包括使用验证器指导反射从可验证空间环境中蒸馏出可迁移的教训（存储在记忆卡中），引入转移可靠性分数（TRS）进行校准，并在部署时通过语义过滤和组合相似度--TRS 排序来检索记忆以引导推理。
AI.result: 在五个具有代表性的空间基准测试上的实验表明，SMA 为所有四个基础 VLM 实现了最佳的宏平均准确率，并在大多数单独评估中取得了最高准确率。
AI.conclusion: Spatial Memory Agent (SMA) 通过经验驱动的运行时记忆框架，成功实现了冻结 VLM 在无参数更新和无外部空间工具情况下的空间推理自进化，在多个空间基准测试中表现优异。
AI.translation: 空间智能正成为具身智能体、机器人规划和多模态助手的基础。为了提高视觉语言模型（VLM）的空间推理能力，现有工作主要遵循两个方向。一个方向是使用后训练方法，如监督微调和强化学习；另一个方向是采用代理范式，即模型调用外部空间工具来收集中间空间证据。我们研究了一条互补且未被充分探索的路线：一个冻结的 VLM 代理能否通过“无参数更新的自我进化”来提高其空间推理能力，而在推理时无需依赖外部专家空间工具？我们提出了“空间记忆代理（SMA）”，这是一个基于经验的运行时记忆框架，它将经过验证的空间经验转化为可重复使用的、可迁移的教训。具体来说，SMA 首先在可验证的空间环境中查询冻结的 VLM，获得预测答案和奖励，并使用验证器指导的反思来提炼存储在记忆卡中的紧凑、可迁移的教训。SMA 进一步为每张记忆卡分配了一个“转移可靠性分数（TRS）”，该分数初始化为统一值，并根据后续检索结果进行校准，作为未来转移可靠性的访问证据。在只读部署期间，SMA 通过语义过滤和组合相似度--TRS 排序来检索记忆卡，从而使检索到的记忆能够指导冻结模型的推理。在五个代表性空间基准测试上的实验表明，SMA 为所有四个基础 VLM 实现了最佳的宏平均准确率，并在大多数单独评估中取得了最高准确率，为通过可复用经验进行空间自我进化建立了一条实用的、无参数更新的路径。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了空间记忆代理（SMA），这是一种经验驱动的运行时记忆框架，它通过在可验证环境中利用验证器指导的反射和转移可靠性分数，使冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）能够在无需参数更新或外部工具的情况下实现空间推理的自进化。
AI.keywords: Spatial Intelligence, Vision-Language Models, Procedural Memory, Self-Evolution, Experience-Grounded
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种无需修改模型参数的经验基础程序记忆框架（Spatial Memory Agent, SMA），通过可验证环境中的反射机制提取可迁移的教训，并通过转移可靠性分数（TRS）进行优化，展现了冻结视觉语言模型（VLM）在空间推理任务中的强大自进化能力。其创新之处在于无需外部空间工具或参数更新即可提升空间智能。

title: From Answers to Policies: Efficient In-Context Learning System through Emulating Expert Investigation
comments: PIHF-MCP. Formalizing and automating in-context policy development with PIHF
summary: Pretrained large language models offer a practical foundation for learning useful behavior from few task-specific examples. We argue that current prompt and context optimization methods underuse the extensive knowledge and reasoning capabilities of trillion-parameter models. These capabilities can make adaptation more sample-efficient, more compute efficient and at no performance loss when organized around how human experts investigate failures. We formalize Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF), which makes this implicit procedure explicit for LLM agents to execute, and build its automated implementation, PIHF-MCP. Initialized from clinician feedback on rare-disease diagnosis, PIHF-MCP supplies the expert procedure, testing tools, review and persistent inquiry records to develop reusable task policies. Across general reasoning benchmarks (BIG-Bench Extra Hard, HoVer and LiveBench-Math), PIHF-MCP improved performance of the baseline model by 16.9, 22.2 and 4.7 percentage points, respectively. With a matched baseline model, development used about 1/5 of the labelled examples and 4% of the task rollouts reported by a previous SOTA in-context optimizer, making it about 9 times faster and 3 times cheaper at comparable or higher scores. In a low-data rare-disease diagnosis setting, policies developed from previous SOTA prompt optimizers trailed a previously published PIHF-developed system on every held-out cohort (on average 16 percentage points). These findings support a route to more efficient inference-time scaling: PIHF-MCP develops reusable policies from a few examples that improve performance on unseen cases and across models. Because each policy comes from an explicit, recorded investigation, the process also keeps humans in the loop and enables ownership and learning, making it well suited to high-stakes decisions.
comment: PIHF-MCP. Formalizing and automating in-context policy development with PIHF

AI.title_translation: 从答案到策略：通过模拟专家调查实现高效的上下文学习系统
AI.tldr: 通过模拟人类专家调查过程（PIHF-MCP），大语言模型能够在少样本条件下以极高的效率和更低的成本生成高质量、可重用的任务策略。
AI.motivation: 现有的提示和上下文优化方法未能充分利用万亿参数大语言模型的广泛知识和推理能力，导致在少样本学习中样本和计算效率低下。
AI.method: 提出 Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) 框架及其自动化实现 PIHF-MCP。该方法结合了专家流程、测试工具、审查以及持久化的调查记录，将隐式的专家推理过程显式化，以开发可重用的任务策略。
AI.result: 在多个通用推理基准测试（如 BIG-Bench Extra Hard、HoVer 和 LiveBench-Math）中，PIHF-MCP 比基线模型分别提升了 16.9、22.2 和 4.7 个百分点；与先前的 SOTA 上下文优化器相比，它仅使用约 1/5 的标注样本和 4% 的任务 Rollout，速度提升约 9 倍，成本降低 3 倍。
AI.conclusion: PIHF-MCP 通过显式模拟专家调查过程，显著提升了大型语言模型在少样本条件下的策略生成效率和泛化性能，是一种高效且可解释的推理时扩展方案。
AI.translation: 预训练的大型语言模型为从少量特定任务示例中学习有用行为提供了实用的基础。我们认为，当前的提示词和上下文优化方法没有充分利用万亿参数模型的广泛知识和推理能力。当围绕人类专家如何调查失败案例进行组织时，这些能力可以使自适应过程更具样本效率、计算效率且不损失性能。我们正式提出了基于人类反馈的策略迭代（PIHF），这使得LLM代理能够执行这种隐式程序，并构建了其自动化实现 PIHF-MCP。PIHF-MCP 从临床医生对罕见病诊断的反馈初始化，提供专家程序、测试工具、审查和持久的调查记录，以开发可重用的任务策略。在通用推理基准测试（BIG-Bench Extra Hard、HoVer 和 LiveBench-Math）中，PIHF-MCP 将基线模型的性能分别提高了 16.9、22.2 和 4.7 个百分点。在匹配的基线模型下，其开发过程仅使用了先前 SOTA 上下文优化器报告的约 1/5 的标记样本和 4% 的任务 rollout，在可比或更高分数下速度快约 9 倍，成本低 3 倍。在低数据罕见病诊断设置中，先前 SOTA 提示词优化器开发的策略在每个保留队列上都落后于先前发布的 PIHF 开发的系统（平均落后 16 个百分点）。这些发现支持了一种实现更高效推理时扩展的途径：PIHF-MCP 从少数示例中开发出可重用策略，从而提高了对未见案例和跨模型的性能。由于每个策略都来自明确、记录在案的调查，该过程还使人类保持在回路中并实现所有权和学习，使其非常适合高风险决策。
AI.summary: 论文提出了 Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) 及其自动化实现 PIHF-MCP，通过模拟人类专家调查失败案例的过程，使大语言模型能够从少量示例中高效开发出可重用的任务策略，在大幅减少计算和样本成本的同时显著提升了推理性能。
AI.keywords: In-Context Learning, Policy Iteration, Large Language Models, Expert Investigation, Rare-Disease Diagnosis
AI.comments: 该论文受人类专家调查失败案例的启发，提出了一种新颖的策略迭代框架 PIHF-MCP。它在少样本学习效率和推理性能上取得了显著提升，同时保持了良好的可解释性，对高风险决策场景具有重要价值。

title: Don't Drop the BATON: Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Agentic Subtask Exploration and Transition-aware Memory
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation chains many contact-rich skills into one multi-stage task. Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) increasingly master individual skills, yet the chain still fails: errors compound beyond the policy's ability to correct, and one subtask silently constrains the next. A promising pathway freezes the VLA and puts an LLM coding agent in charge: it plans in language, moves in free space with analytic primitives, invokes the VLA only for contact-rich segments, and writes adaptation into language memory. Yet applied to long horizons, this recipe breaks twice. (1) Its competence comes from whole-task exploration at test time, whose cost is exponential in the number of stages: if one stage needs T episodes, a K-stage task needs on the order of T^K, and a failure does not reveal which stage caused it. (2) It has no representation of transitions: the VLA primitive carries an exit but no entry condition, and a subtask can succeed in a form its successor cannot use. We present BATON to address both failures. Against (1), BATON makes the subtask the unit of exploration: each subtask is explored in the cheap short-horizon regime and its solution stored in memory; a long-horizon trajectory is then composed from these solutions rather than discovered whole. Exploration cost becomes linear (KT), and each failure is attributed to one stage. Against (2), BATON equips exploration with a transition-aware memory. Within a subtask, a verifier agent governs the invocation transition: the VLA is invoked only after the wrist view confirms the scene is ready. Across subtasks, a handoff transition restores an entry state disturbed by the predecessor's residue, and a lookahead transition selects the strategy whose outcome the successor can inherit. On the RoboMemArena benchmark, BATON improves task success by 37.7% and cumulative success by 29.7% over the SoTA.

AI.title_translation: 切勿掉棒：通过代理子任务探索与过渡感知内存实现长周期机器人操作
AI.tldr: BATON通过子任务探索与过渡感知内存，解决了长周期机器人操作中的错误累积与状态不匹配问题，使任务成功率大幅提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM驱动的长周期机器人操作方法在面对多阶段任务时存在两个致命缺陷：一是全任务探索成本随阶段呈指数级增长且错误归因困难；二是缺乏对子任务间过渡状态（入口/出口条件及状态兼容性）的有效表示。
AI.method: 提出BATON框架，以子任务为单位进行低成本的短周期测试时探索，并引入过渡感知内存（包括用于调用控制的验证器代理、处理前驱残留的交接过渡以及确保后继兼容的前瞻过渡）。
AI.result: 在RoboMemArena基准测试中，BATON相比当前最优方法（SoTA），任务成功率提升了37.7%，累积成功率提升了29.7%。
AI.conclusion: BATON通过子任务级别的探索和过渡感知内存，有效解决了长周期机器人操作中错误累积和状态不兼容的痛点，显著提升了多阶段任务的执行成功率。
AI.translation: 长周期机器人操作将多个接触丰富的技能串联成一个多阶段任务。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界-动作模型（WAMs）越来越多地掌握了单个技能，但串联仍然会失败：错误累积超出了策略的纠错能力，且一个子任务会悄悄限制下一个子任务。一个有前景的途径是冻结VLA，并让一个LLM编码代理负责：它用语言规划，用解析原语在自由空间中移动，仅在接触丰富的片段中调用VLA，并将自适应写入语言内存。然而，当应用于长周期时，这个方案会出现两个问题。(1) 其能力来自于测试时的全任务探索，其成本随阶段数量呈指数级增长：如果一个阶段需要T个episode，一个K阶段的任务则需要大约T^K的量级，且一次失败无法揭示是哪个阶段引发的。(2) 它没有过渡的表示：VLA原语带有退出条件但没有进入条件，子任务可能会以其后继者无法利用的形式成功。我们提出了BATON来解决这两个失败。针对(1)，BATON使子任务成为探索的单元：每个子任务都在廉价的短周期状态下进行探索，其解决方案存储在内存中；长周期轨迹随后由这些解决方案组合而成，而不是整体发现。探索成本变为线性（KT），且每个失败可归因于单个阶段。针对(2)，BATON为探索配备了过渡感知内存。在一个子任务中，验证器代理控制调用过渡：仅当腕部视角确认场景准备就绪时才调用VLA。跨子任务时，交接过渡恢复被前驱残留扰乱的入口状态，前瞻过渡选择其结果可被后继继承的策略。在RoboMemArena基准测试中，相比当前SoTA，BATON将任务成功率提升了37.7%，累积成功率提升了29.7%。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了BATON，一种用于长周期机器人操作的新框架，通过子任务级探索将测试时复杂度从指数级降为线性级，并利用过渡感知内存解决了子任务间的状态兼容与衔接问题，大幅提升了多阶段机器人操作的成功率。
AI.keywords: 长周期机器人操作, LLM编码代理, 视觉-语言-动作模型, 子任务探索, 过渡感知内存
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种名为BATON的框架，结合了LLM编码代理与VLA模型，通过将探索单元缩短至子任务级别（将复杂度从指数级降为线性级）以及引入过渡感知内存（Transition-aware memory），有效解决了长周期机器人操作中的错误累积和过渡兼容性问题。该方法在RoboMemArena基准测试中展现出显著的性能提升。

title: Universal CKM for Environment-Aware Wireless Networks: Enabling Cross-Device and Cross-Task Channel Knowledge Transfer
summary: Channel knowledge map (CKM) is a promising technology for environment-aware sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks. However, existing CKMs are tightly coupled with wireless devices and downstream tasks, which limit their scalability and reusability in wireless networks. To address these limitations, this article proposes the concept of universal CKM (uCKM) as a foundational wireless environment prior, which aims to enable cross-device and cross-task channel knowledge transfer for environment-aware wireless networks. We first revisit the representative CKMs and discuss their limitations. Then, the uCKM-enabled new paradigm for environment-aware wireless networks is introduced, and its benefits are highlighted from the perspectives of uCKM construction and utilization phases, for which we propose the visions of ``All for uCKM'' and ``uCKM for All'', i.e., the data acquired by all devices and tasks should contribute to the construction of uCKM, while the constructed uCKM, in turn, can be utilized to support all devices and tasks. Subsequently, we discuss the main challenges of uCKM and propose potential solutions. Last, we provide simulation results to demonstrate the feasibility and performance gains brought by uCKM and outline future research directions.

title: Recirculation
summary: We describe an inference-time architectural enhancement for off-the-shelf foundation models that systematically reduces perplexity and boosts accuracy across generation and reasoning tasks. Our approach incurs essentially no additional latency during generation, though it requires serial processing in the prefill phase. Motivated by the fundamental limitation that state updates in feedforward transformers are bounded by model depth, our technique, recirculation, introduces a specific form of recurrence that allows the model to act as a dynamical system and track belief states. We distinguish this technique from chain-of-thought computation---which is better reserved for complex inferences rather than basic state tracking---as well as from popular depth-recurrence techniques (looping) and the costly training of recurrent transformers. We also propose and evaluate an adaptive variant of recirculation which requires only light tuning of hyperparameters while freezing the original model weights. Relative to the off-the-shelf baseline, adaptive recirculation achieves surprising gains on the Gemma3 family, including a consistent reduction in perplexity on a suite of datasets, a 21% increase in relative accuracy on GSM8k, and reliable improvements in accuracy on other downstream tasks. Our training-free approach succeeds by leveraging the model itself to inform architectural modifications, suggesting a route to architectural evolution guided by a trained network's properties rather than forced, arbitrary design choices.

title: Entity tracking emerges in sub-billion parameter language models and exceeds human performance in naturalistic narratives
summary: Understanding language requires tracking entities across discourse - i.e., knowing where things are and how they change, even when not explicitly stated. Whether language models perform such tracking in a human-like fashion remains unclear, in part because existing evaluations rely on artificial tasks, far removed from natural language comprehension, and lack comparisons to humans. Here, we evaluate entity tracking in both language models and humans (N = 48) using naturalistic narratives at multiple levels of complexity. In humans, we find that entity tracking degrades specifically with narrative complexity, not narrative length. In language models, we find that human-level entity tracking is already present at 410 million parameters - well below the multi-billion parameter, code-specialised models identified by prior work - and improves with scale, with contemporary models far exceeding human performance. Together, these results demonstrate that entity tracking, a core component of language understanding, emerges at model scales far smaller than previously thought.

title: The Road Taken: The Role of Optimizers at the Edge of Stability
summary: The edge of stability refers to a phenomenon in deep learning with gradient-based optimizers where the Hessian eigenvalues of the loss remain stable above a threshold that the classical descent lemma predicts to be unstable. Previous works formulate the edge of stability with respect to the maximum Hessian eigenvalue and the learning rate. However, we observe that many first-order methods, including gradient descent, significantly violate the stability bound predicted by these theories by a factor as large as $\times 21.1$. Moreover, this deviation turns out to be systematic and highly dependent on the underlying optimizer, which is not captured by previous formulations. This calls for a new formulation of the stability threshold, which we derive from the directional Hessian and the gradient-alignment score with respect to the actual update taken by the optimizer, rather than the maximum curvature mode. Our new formulation of the realized edge of stability not only removes optimizer-dependent offsets and provides more consistent predictions of the stability threshold, but also introduces new diagnostic tools that reveal the unique role of the optimizer in actively balancing between the temporal and spatial budgets in first-order optimization.

title: Scaffolding Minds: Optimizing Latent Visual Target Representations for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Latent reasoning has advanced multimodal reasoning through a two-stage training paradigm: (1) a helper image is encoded into latent tokens to teach visual chain-of-thought during a supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage, and (2) these latent tokens are further refined with reward feedback during a reinforcement learning (RL) stage. In this paper, we identify two key limitations of this framework, one in each stage. First, the SFT stage typically relies on an off-the-shelf vision encoder to encode the helper image, yielding suboptimal latent representations that may not be well aligned with the downstream reasoning task. Second, existing RL methods treat the latent component only through deterministic regularization, which constrains policy drift but does not create alternative latent trajectories for exploration. To address these limitations, we propose Scaffolding Minds. Our approach learns a dedicated scaffolding encoder that provides an optimized target in latent space, and learns both the mean and variance of the RL sampler. We further show that these two improvements are complementary, together yielding substantial gains over strong baselines. Empirically, our method improves over the strongest latent reasoning baseline by +9.5 points on FrozenLake spatial planning, with the gain widening to +19 points on the 32x32 grids, and by +5.6 points on average across nine visual-centric reasoning benchmarks.

title: Rethinking Patch Based Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Semantic Structured Partitioning
summary: Multivariate time series forecasting (MTSF) is a fundamental task in many real world applications. Existing patch based forecasting methods generally fall into three categories: fixed partitioning, multi-scale partitioning, and extendable partitioning. Fixed partitioning often breaks meaningful temporal boundaries, multi-scale partitioning may introduce redundant representations across scales, and extendable partitioning improves flexibility but still lacks an explicit mechanism for organizing semantic structure and modeling interactions among heterogeneous temporal patterns. To address these limitations, we propose SCPaT, a Transformer based framework built on semantic structured partitioning. SCPaT first decomposes input sequences into semantically consistent units through adaptive semantic unit generation, then constructs a dynamic semantic graph to model directed dependencies among these units and organize them into higher order semantic blocks. Based on these structured representations, an importance aware routing mechanism adaptively dispatches different semantic blocks to different experts for customized modeling. Extensive experiments on 12 real world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of SCPaT.

title: Dynamics-Aware Weighting for Deep Learning Forecasts of Chaotic Systems
summary: Deep learning surrogates have become powerful tools for simulating and forecasting complex dynamical systems, yet their utility remains limited by catastrophic error accumulation during long-term autoregressive rollouts. This behavior is partly tied to the nature of the underlying systems: chaotic spatiotemporal systems visit phase space unevenly, with dynamics dominated by recurrent, low-dimensional quiescent states and characterized by rare and dynamically complex regime transitions. Trained under a sample-wise uniform objective, standard neural surrogates allocate their finite capacity to the statistically more numerous low-dimensional quiescent states, systematically under-representing the transient regimes that trigger disproportionate, localized errors. Existing imbalanced-regression methods tackle this issue by reweighting samples according to target-space density. However, statistical target-space rarity does not coincide with the intrinsic dynamical rarity encoded in the recurrence geometry of the attractor. To address this, we introduce Dynamics-Aware Weighting (DAW), a data-centric objective reweighting framework. Using the local dimension $d$ from dynamical systems theory as an a priori measure of a state's dynamical complexity, DAW reshapes the loss landscape to allocate representational capacity toward the sparse, high-$d$ regimes where forecast errors are systematically large. On the chaotic KS equation, DAW consistently outperforms uniform training as well as weighting based on target-space rarity, and its randomly permuted ablation, reducing long-term autoregressive error relative to all baselines. Event-level analysis shows that DAW achieves this by suppressing the localized error amplifications incurred during sharp jumps in the local dimension $d$, which typically accompany complex physical processes such as wave-merging in the KS system.

AI.title_translation: 混沌系统深度学习预测的动力学感知加权
AI.tldr: 深度学习模型在预测混沌系统时，由于对稀有但动态复杂的瞬态机制表示不足，导致长期预测误差积累。本文提出动力学感知加权（DAW）框架，利用局部维度$d$作为状态动态复杂性的先验度量，重新分配模型容量，以减少高$d$区域的误差，从而显著提高混沌系统长期预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 深度学习代理在模拟和预测复杂动力学系统方面表现强大，但其在长期自回归展开中面临灾难性错误积累的限制。这是因为混沌时空系统以不均匀的方式访问相空间，模型通常偏向于统计上更常见的低维静态，而忽视了稀有但动态复杂的瞬态机制，这些机制会导致不成比例的局部误差。现有的不平衡回归方法未能将统计上的目标空间稀有性与吸引子的递归几何中编码的内在动力学稀有性联系起来。

AI.result: 在混沌KS方程上的实验表明，DAW持续优于均匀训练以及基于目标空间稀有性的加权方法，并且其随机置换消融实验也表现更好，相对于所有基线显著减少了长期自回归误差。事件级分析显示，DAW通过抑制局部维度$d$急剧跳跃期间发生的局部误差放大来实现这一点，这些跳跃通常伴随着波合并等复杂的物理过程。
AI.conclusion: 动力学感知加权（DAW）通过将模型容量优先分配给动力学复杂且易出错的区域，有效解决了深度学习在混沌系统长期预测中的误差积累问题，显著提高了预测准确性。

AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为动力学感知加权（DAW）的数据中心重加权框架，旨在解决深度学习模型在预测混沌系统时长期自回归误差积累的问题。现有方法未能有效处理混沌系统相空间中稀有但动力学复杂的瞬态机制。DAW利用局部维度$d$作为状态动力学复杂性的先验度量，重新调整损失函数，使模型将更多的表示能力分配给高$d$区域，即预测误差较大的稀疏动态复杂区域。实验结果表明，DAW在混沌KS方程上显著优于传统均匀训练和基于目标空间稀有性的加权方法，通过抑制局部误差放大，有效降低了长期预测误差。
AI.keywords: 深度学习预测, 混沌系统, 动力学感知加权, 局部维度, 误差积累
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的、基于动力学系统理论的损失函数加权方法，解决了深度学习在混沌系统长期预测中的关键挑战。其创新性在于将“动力学稀有性”而非传统的“统计稀有性”纳入考量，通过局部维度$d$来指导模型容量分配。这种方法不仅具有理论依据，而且在实验中也展现出显著的性能提升，特别是在处理瞬态机制导致的局部误差放大方面。该研究为深度学习在复杂系统建模中的应用提供了新的视角和工具。

title: Functional compatibility as a determinant of persistent neural learning
summary: Neural networks can acquire new capabilities while damaging existing ones, but what determines whether new learning persists remains unclear. We identify functional compatibility, the extent to which incoming learning can coexist with behaviour that must be preserved, as an experimentally manipulable causal determinant of persistence. From identical neural states, we vary compatibility while matching unrestricted learning opportunity and imposing a common retention requirement. Persistent learning increases with compatibility across independent directions, convolutional and transformer architectures, vision and text, and a ten-seed replication. Learning rules and retention constraints determine how much compatible opportunity is retained, whereas nonlinear geometry limits the matched intervention at larger update norms. Functional compatibility therefore reframes stability-plasticity from preventing forgetting to determining which new learning can coexist with existing function and persist.

AI.title_translation: 功能兼容性作为神经学习持久性的决定因素
AI.tldr: 本文发现功能兼容性（新学习与现有功能共存的能力）是决定神经网络中新学习能否持久的关键因素，并提出它重新定义了稳定性-可塑性问题。
AI.motivation: 神经网络在学习新能力时可能损害现有能力，但目前尚不清楚是什么决定了新学习能否持久。
AI.method: 从相同的神经网络状态出发，通过改变功能兼容性（同时匹配无限制的学习机会并施加共同的保留要求）来实验性地操纵和测试其对学习持久性的影响，并在不同方向、卷积和Transformer架构、视觉和文本任务以及十次重复实验中进行验证。
AI.result: 持久性学习随着功能兼容性的增加而增加，且这一现象在多种架构和任务中均成立。学习规则和保留约束决定了兼容机会的保留量，而非线性几何则限制了在更大更新范数下的匹配干预。
AI.conclusion: 功能兼容性将稳定性-可塑性问题从防止遗忘重新定义为确定哪些新学习可以与现有功能共存并持久。

AI.summary: 本文研究了神经网络中新学习持久性的决定因素，并提出了“功能兼容性”这一概念，即新学习与现有功能共存的程度。实验表明，功能兼容性是新学习持久性的一个可操纵的因果决定因素，兼容性越高，学习的持久性越强，这一发现适用于不同的神经网络架构和任务。研究还指出学习规则和保留约束影响兼容机会的保留，而非线性几何会限制干预。最终，该研究将稳定性-可塑性问题重新定义为关注新学习与现有功能的共存与持久性。
AI.keywords: 功能兼容性, 神经学习, 持久性, 稳定性-可塑性, 神经网络
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入“功能兼容性”这一新概念，为理解神经网络中的稳定性-可塑性困境提供了一个新颖且可实验验证的视角。它将关注点从单纯的“防止遗忘”转向“哪些新学习能够与现有功能共存并持久”，这对于开发更高效、更稳定的持续学习算法具有重要指导意义。其在多种架构和任务上的广泛验证增加了研究结果的普适性。

title: Asymptotically Tight Bounds for Generalized Covering Radii of Binary Primitive BCH Codes at All Higher Orders
comments: 56 pages. Revised version with a componentwise degree bound improving the sufficient field-size threshold for the known common-core support bound; full second-order results and proofs retained
summary: We study the generalized covering radii of binary primitive BCH codes, which measure how many parity-check columns suffice to span several prescribed syndromes. For the four-error-correcting family of length $2^m-1$, the second radius is exactly $11$ for $m\geq55$, and it is either $11$ or $12$ for $m\geq16$. For every fixed error parameter at least two, we give an explicit stable bound with two adjacent possible values for the second radius and an arithmetic criterion for exactness. At every higher order, we obtain explicit lower and upper bounds whose additive gap is bounded independently of the order for each fixed error parameter, once explicit field-size conditions hold. The bounds are therefore asymptotically tight as the order grows. The higher-order upper bound retains the common-core support count established by Xiong, Yip, and Zullo; our refinement reduces its sufficient field-size threshold at large order. The refinement combines componentwise mixed degrees with the ordinary degree of a multicone. The upper bounds come from constructing syndrome representations with a common set of parity-check columns.
comment: 56 pages. Revised version with a componentwise degree bound improving the sufficient field-size threshold for the known common-core support bound; full second-order results and proofs retained

title: On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and on-policy distillation (OPD) have become two widely adopted paradigms for post-training large language models. However, RLVR suffers from sparse task-level feedback, while OPD provides dense token-level guidance but ignores trajectory correctness, limiting its performance to that of the teacher. Combining them is a promising direction: OPD supplies dense supervisory signals, while RLVR provides task-level correctness. Nevertheless, existing integrations often rely on weighted combination or heuristic switching, introducing extra hyperparameters and trade-offs. We propose On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward (OPDVR), a simple yet effective method that seamlessly combines OPD and RLVR without adding any hyperparameters. We first reformulate the implicit reward of sampled-token OPD based on trajectory correctness, then apply a ReLU gating mechanism to ensure that correct trajectories receive non-negative rewards and incorrect ones receive non-positive rewards---thereby aligning the distillation signal with task success while preserving the teacher's distributional guidance. Furthermore, our modification transforms sampled-token OPD into a proper RLVR method, making it readily combinable with any policy gradient algorithm, such as GRPO. Experiments on six reasoning benchmarks show that OPDVR consistently outperforms standard OPD. Our code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/OPDVR.

AI.title_translation: 基于可验证奖励的在策略蒸馏
AI.tldr: OPDVR是一种结合了在策略蒸馏（OPD）和可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的方法，它解决了现有方法的问题，无需额外超参数，并在推理基准测试中优于标准OPD。
AI.motivation: 现有的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）存在任务级反馈稀疏的问题，而在策略蒸馏（OPD）虽然提供密集的token级指导，但忽略了轨迹的正确性，限制了其性能。结合两者是一个有前景的方向，但现有集成方法依赖于加权组合或启发式切换，引入了额外的超参数和权衡。
AI.method: 我们提出了基于可验证奖励的在策略蒸馏（OPDVR）。该方法通过重新构建采样token OPD的隐式奖励，并基于轨迹正确性进行调整。然后，应用ReLU门控机制确保正确轨迹获得非负奖励，不正确轨迹获得非正奖励，从而使蒸馏信号与任务成功对齐，同时保留教师模型的分布指导。此外，这种修改将采样token OPD转化为一种适当的RLVR方法，使其可以与任何策略梯度算法（如GRPO）结合，且无需添加任何超参数。
AI.result: 在六个推理基准测试上的实验表明，OPDVR始终优于标准的OPD。
AI.conclusion: OPDVR通过无缝结合OPD和RLVR，在不引入额外超参数的情况下，解决了现有方法的局限性，并取得了优于标准OPD的性能。它将采样token OPD转化为一种有效的RLVR方法，易于与其他策略梯度算法结合。
AI.translation: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）和在策略蒸馏（OPD）已成为后训练大型语言模型的两种广泛采用的范式。然而，RLVR面临稀疏的任务级反馈问题，而OPD虽然提供密集的token级指导，但忽略了轨迹的正确性，将其性能限制在教师模型水平。将它们结合是一个有前景的方向：OPD提供密集的监督信号，而RLVR提供任务级正确性。然而，现有的集成方法通常依赖于加权组合或启发式切换，引入了额外的超参数和权衡。我们提出了基于可验证奖励的在策略蒸馏（OPDVR），这是一种简单而有效的方法，它无缝地结合了OPD和RLVR，且不增加任何超参数。我们首先基于轨迹正确性重新构建了采样token OPD的隐式奖励，然后应用ReLU门控机制，以确保正确轨迹获得非负奖励，不正确轨迹获得非正奖励——从而使蒸馏信号与任务成功对齐，同时保留教师模型的分布指导。此外，我们的修改将采样token OPD转化为一种适当的RLVR方法，使其可以与任何策略梯度算法（如GRPO）轻松结合。在六个推理基准测试上的实验表明，OPDVR始终优于标准的OPD。我们的代码可在https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/OPDVR获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为OPDVR（基于可验证奖励的在策略蒸馏）的新方法，旨在结合在策略蒸馏（OPD）和可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的优势。针对RLVR任务级反馈稀疏和OPD忽略轨迹正确性的问题，OPDVR通过重新构建采样token OPD的隐式奖励并引入ReLU门控机制，确保蒸馏信号与任务成功对齐，同时保留教师模型的指导。该方法无需额外超参数，并将采样token OPD转化为一种可与任何策略梯度算法结合的RLVR方法。实验结果表明，OPDVR在多个推理基准上持续优于标准OPD。
AI.keywords: 在策略蒸馏, 可验证奖励, 强化学习, 大语言模型, 无超参数
AI.comments: OPDVR的创新之处在于其无需额外超参数即可有效结合OPD和RLVR。通过重新定义奖励机制并引入ReLU门控，它巧妙地解决了现有方法的局限性，实现了密集指导与任务级正确性的统一。这种方法提供了一个通用框架，可以与现有策略梯度算法结合，具有很强的实用价值和扩展性。

title: Solving Robust POMDPs with Omega-regular Objectives via Partially Observable Stochastic Games
summary: Robust POMDPs (RPOMDPs) generalize classical POMDPs to the setting where exact transition probabilities are not known -- rather, they are only known to belong to some uncertainty set of values. In this work, we study the problem of solving RPOMDPs with general omega-regular objectives, which subsume a broad class of objectives such as reachability, safety, and linear temporal logic (LTL) objectives. We show that, for (s,a)-rectangular RPOMDPs with polytopic uncertainty sets, the problem of solving RPOMDPs under omega-regular objectives can be reduced to solving partially observable stochastic games (POSGs) under omega-regular objectives. Moreover, we show for the first time that reductions can be constructed in both directions, establishing the semantic equivalence between (s,a)-rectangular RPOMDPs with polytopic uncertainty sets and POSGs. This allows us to derive a range of new computational complexity results, including both upper and lower complexity bounds, on solving RPOMDPs with different omega-regular objectives. As a corollary, we also derive new computational complexity results for RMDPs.

AI.title_translation: 通过部分可观测随机博弈解决具有Omega-正则目标的鲁棒POMDPs
AI.tldr: 本文将具有omega-正则目标的鲁棒POMDPs（RPOMDPs）的求解问题，在特定条件下，归结为求解具有omega-正则目标的部分可观测随机博弈（POSGs），并证明两者在语义上等价，从而推导出RPOMDPs新的计算复杂性结果。
AI.motivation: 经典的POMDPs假设精确的转移概率已知，而鲁棒POMDPs（RPOMDPs）则处理转移概率不确定，只知其属于某个不确定性集合的情况。本文研究如何解决具有更通用omega-正则目标的RPOMDPs，这些目标涵盖了可达性、安全性、线性时序逻辑（LTL）等多种目标。
AI.method: 对于具有多面体不确定性集合的(s,a)-矩形RPOMDPs，作者展示了将求解RPOMDPs问题归结为求解具有omega-正则目标的POSGs问题。此外，他们首次证明了这种归约可以在两个方向上构建，从而建立了(s,a)-矩形RPOMDPs与POSGs之间的语义等价性。
AI.result: 证明了(s,a)-矩形RPOMDPs与POSGs之间的语义等价性。基于此，推导出一系列新的计算复杂性结果，包括解决具有不同omega-正则目标的RPOMDPs的上下界。作为推论，还为RMDPs推导了新的计算复杂性结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过建立(s,a)-矩形RPOMDPs与POSGs之间的语义等价性，为解决具有omega-正则目标的RPOMDPs提供了新的理论框架和计算复杂性分析。
AI.translation: 鲁棒部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（RPOMDPs）将经典的POMDPs推广到转移概率不确定（仅知其属于某个不确定性集合）的场景。在这项工作中，我们研究了如何解决具有通用omega-正则目标的RPOMDPs问题，这些目标涵盖了可达性、安全性以及线性时序逻辑（LTL）目标等广泛类别。我们表明，对于具有多面体不确定性集合的(s,a)-矩形RPOMDPs，解决具有omega-正则目标的RPOMDPs问题可以归结为解决具有omega-正则目标的部分可观测随机博弈（POSGs）问题。此外，我们首次展示了这种归约可以在两个方向上构建，从而建立了(s,a)-矩形RPOMDPs与POSGs之间的语义等价性。这使我们能够推导出一系列新的计算复杂性结果，包括解决具有不同omega-正则目标的RPOMDPs的上下界。作为推论，我们还为鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（RMDPs）推导了新的计算复杂性结果。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在转移概率不确定的鲁棒部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（RPOMDPs）中，如何解决具有通用omega-正则目标的问题。作者证明，对于特定类型的RPOMDPs，该问题可以归结为解决具有omega-正则目标的部分可观测随机博弈（POSGs）。更重要的是，他们首次建立了RPOMDPs和POSGs之间的双向归约和语义等价性，从而推导出了RPOMDPs和RMDPs在不同omega-正则目标下的新计算复杂性结果，包括上下界。
AI.keywords: 鲁棒POMDPs, omega-正则目标, 部分可观测随机博弈, 语义等价, 计算复杂性
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于首次建立了(s,a)-矩形RPOMDPs与POSGs之间的语义等价性，并证明了双向归约的存在。这不仅为解决RPOMDPs提供了一个新的理论框架，也为理解其计算复杂性提供了深入见解，并可能为未来开发更有效的算法奠定基础。

title: Homo-RAG: Homology-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Cross-Species Gene Function Prediction

summary: The functional annotation of genes in non-model organisms remains a significant challenge in computational biology, with 20-70% of sequenced genes lacking characterized functions. Traditional homology-based methods are often costly and strongly dependent on high sequence similarity. This study presents Homo-RAG, a framework for large language model-based gene function prediction that integrates homology-guided multi-hop retrieval with evidence-aware ranking. The framework exploits biological relationships between zebrafish and human orthologs to guide evidence acquisition from ZFIN, UniProt, and PubMed through hybrid dense and lexical retrieval. An Evidence Confidence Score (ECS) integrates semantic relevance, entity matching, orthology information, source reliability, and literature association signals to refine the ranking of retrieved evidence. Extensive evaluation across 150 queries and 7,200 retrieved documents shows that evidence weighting parameter of lambda=0.50 improves NDCG@10 to 0.9879 and MRR to 0.99, while retrieving relevant evidence for 99.33% of queries. Furthermore, 80% of the retrieved documents are query-exclusive, indicating that evidence quality complements rather than replaces retrieval relevance. These findings establish Homo-RAG as a practical and robust framework for reliable, evidence-grounded gene function prediction in understudied organisms. The study addresses important limitations of conventional annotation pipelines while identifying opportunities for future improvements in evidence features and attribution mechanisms.

AI.title_translation: Homo-RAG: 同源性引导的检索增强生成用于跨物种基因功能预测
AI.tldr: Homo-RAG是一个基于大型语言模型的框架，通过同源性引导的多跳检索和证据感知排名，实现了可靠的跨物种基因功能预测，解决了非模式生物基因功能注释的难题。
AI.motivation: 计算生物学中非模式生物的基因功能注释仍然是一个重大挑战，20-70%的测序基因缺乏已表征的功能。传统的基于同源性的方法成本高昂，并且强烈依赖于高序列相似性，因此需要一种更有效、更可靠的方法。
AI.method: Homo-RAG是一个基于大型语言模型的基因功能预测框架，它将同源性引导的多跳检索与证据感知排名相结合。该框架利用斑马鱼和人类直系同源物之间的生物学关系，通过混合密集和词汇检索从ZFIN、UniProt和PubMed获取证据。它还引入了证据置信度评分（ECS），该评分整合了语义相关性、实体匹配、直系同源信息、来源可靠性和文献关联信号，以优化检索到的证据排名。
AI.result: 在150个查询和7,200个检索到的文档中进行的大量评估显示，证据加权参数lambda=0.50将NDCG@10提高到0.9879，MRR提高到0.99，同时为99.33%的查询检索到相关证据。此外，80%的检索文档是查询独有的，表明证据质量补充而非取代了检索相关性。
AI.conclusion: Homo-RAG是一个实用且强大的框架，能够为研究不足的生物体提供可靠的、以证据为基础的基因功能预测。该研究解决了传统注释管道的重要局限性，并为未来在证据特征和归因机制方面的改进提供了机会。

title: Comparing Corrupted Constrained Learning Problems
summary: A key result in statistics is the data processing inequality, originally proved by Blackwell (1951) and later refined by DeGroot (1962) in terms of statistical uncertainty. The latter statement claims that the Bayes risk achieved on raw data always undercuts the Bayes risk on a processed version of the same data. This seemingly contradicts empirical findings in machine learning: pre-training, representation learning, feature learning, data augmentation are techniques used to improve performance of machine learning models. We reconcile both worlds by simply accepting that machine learning problems are constrained learning problems: the model class used does not include all measurable functions. We present counterexamples showing that the classical data processing inequality fails to hold in such a setting. Hence, we formulate a generalized data processing inequality, requiring the constrained Bayes risk of a joint distribution (with respect to a loss function and a constrained model class) to lower bound the constrained Bayes risk on the stochastically modified data distribution, regardless of the choice of distribution. We show this inequality to be equivalent to a set containment condition on a specific function set induced by the loss and model class, called the superprediction set. Finally, we exploit our characterization, derive sufficient conditions for this containment and quantify the inequality-gap.

AI.title_translation: 比较损坏的约束学习问题
AI.tldr: 经典数据处理不等式在受限学习问题中不成立，本文提出广义数据处理不等式来弥合统计学与机器学习之间的矛盾，并将其等价于超预测集上的集合包含条件。
AI.motivation: 经典的统计学数据处理不等式（Bayes风险在原始数据上总是低于处理过的数据）与机器学习中通过预训练、表示学习、特征学习、数据增强等技术提高模型性能的经验发现相矛盾。本文旨在调和这一矛盾。
AI.method: 通过接受机器学习问题是约束学习问题（模型类别不包含所有可测函数），提出了一个广义数据处理不等式。该不等式要求联合分布的约束贝叶斯风险下界是随机修改数据分布上的约束贝叶斯风险。通过将其等价于由损失函数和模型类别引起的特定函数集（称为超预测集）上的集合包含条件来表征。
AI.result: 提出了反例，表明经典数据处理不等式在这种受限设置中不成立。证明了广义数据处理不等式等价于超预测集上的集合包含条件。导出了这种包含的充分条件，并量化了不等式差距。
AI.conclusion: 经典数据处理不等式在约束学习问题中不适用。通过引入广义数据处理不等式及其与超预测集包含条件的等价性，成功调和了统计学和机器学习之间的矛盾，并提供了量化不等式差距的方法。
AI.translation: 统计学中的一个关键结果是数据处理不等式，最初由Blackwell (1951) 证明，后来由DeGroot (1962) 在统计不确定性方面进行了完善。后者的陈述声称，在原始数据上实现的贝叶斯风险总是低于相同数据的处理版本上的贝叶斯风险。这似乎与机器学习中的经验发现相矛盾：预训练、表示学习、特征学习、数据增强是用于提高机器学习模型性能的技术。我们通过简单地接受机器学习问题是约束学习问题来调和这两个世界：所使用的模型类别不包括所有可测函数。我们提出了反例，表明经典数据处理不等式在这种设置中不成立。因此，我们提出了一个广义数据处理不等式，要求联合分布（关于损失函数和约束模型类别）的约束贝叶斯风险下界是随机修改数据分布上的约束贝叶斯风险，而与分布的选择无关。我们表明这个不等式等价于由损失和模型类别引起的特定函数集（称为超预测集）上的集合包含条件。最后，我们利用我们的表征，推导出这种包含的充分条件并量化不等式差距。
AI.summary: 本文旨在调和统计学中的经典数据处理不等式与机器学习实践中通过数据处理提升性能的矛盾。通过将机器学习问题视为约束学习问题，作者提出了反例证明经典数据处理不等式在此背景下失效。进而，文章提出了一个广义数据处理不等式，并证明其等价于一个由损失函数和模型类别定义的“超预测集”上的集合包含条件。研究还导出了该包含的充分条件并量化了不等式差距。
AI.keywords: 数据处理不等式, 约束学习, 贝叶斯风险, 超预测集, 机器学习
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入“约束学习问题”的概念，巧妙地解决了统计学经典理论与机器学习实践之间的表观矛盾。其创新之处在于提出了广义数据处理不等式，并提供了严谨的数学证明，将其与超预测集的集合包含条件联系起来。这对于理解和改进机器学习中的数据处理技术具有重要理论意义。

title: TacForcing: Streaming Action Generation with Execution-Time Tactile Feedback
comments: 15 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Revised text and expanded real-world experiments
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires adapting to contact states that can evolve substantially within an action horizon. However, chunk-based vision-language-action models predict complete action chunks from observations collected before execution, leaving tactile conditioning stale during execution. Existing tactile-reactive approaches typically rely on separate high-frequency controllers, which increase both architectural and training complexity. In this paper, we introduce TacForcing, a streaming action-generation framework incorporating execution-time tactile feedback. TacForcing replaces the standard action expert with a streaming expert that generates action blocks sequentially while preserving intermediate states of unfinished blocks. After each block is executed, the expert resumes generation from these states using newly acquired tactile feedback. To better align tactile conditioning with action execution, we further introduce Execution-Aware Tactile Attention (EATA), which restricts direct access to each tactile update to the next block scheduled for execution. Across six UniVTAC simulation tasks and six real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks on two robot platforms, TacForcing achieves average success rates of 65% in simulation and 66% in the real world, outperforming the strongest baselines by 6 and 15 percentage points, respectively.

title: TraceML: What Auto-Research Agents Miss in Long-Horizon ML Development
summary: Auto-research agents now run machine-learning development unattended for hours, revising data pipelines, models, and validation from their own feedback, yet on most competitions they still finish below strong human competitors. Outcome-based benchmarks record this gap but not its cause, because they grade the final submission and discard the development process behind it. We introduce TraceML, which pairs human and agent work on the same competitions under one version-level schema: 4{,}465 human Kaggle trajectories across 134 competitions, seven of which are also worked by two agent scaffolds, giving 430 paired human and 207 agent trajectories. Every code version carries its score, its timestamp, and labels for the action taken, its intent, the edit size, and the score effect. Read this way, the gap becomes concrete. Experts alternate data work, validation, model changes, and ensembling, and return to approaches they had set aside. Each agent scaffold instead collapses into a narrow loop: Codex spends its steps re-weighting ensembles and tuning submissions, MLEvolve mutates its model in place, and neither pivots at the human rate nor reopens abandoned work. A short planning prompt distilled from human practice moves the behaviors it names toward the human profile and lifts scores, but the effort profile stays agent-shaped: instruction closes only the part of the gap that reduces to instructions. We release the corpus, the schema, and the labeling models, together with an open-source toolkit that turns a run from any command-line agent into a TraceML trajectory and reads it against the human cohorts.

title: Alignment Matters Inside and Out in Equivariant Graph Flow Matching
comments: Gromov-Wasserstein, Optimal Transport, Flow Matching, Graph Generation, Equivariant Networks
summary: Graphs are invariant under node permutations, motivating permutation-equivariant architectures in generative models. In flow matching, however, symmetry also affects the source-target coupling: one must choose both which graphs to pair and which node representatives to align. We study these two forms of alignment, termed outer and inner alignment, and their effect on equivariant graph flow matching. We connect inner alignment to transport on the graph quotient space, whose Euclidean quotient metric coincides with Gromov-Monge distance, and show that quotient couplings admit aligned representative lifts while symmetrization yields equivariant flow-matching minimizers, including for categorical endpoints. In practice, we compare random augmentation, permutation-blind minibatch optimal transport, approximate Gromov-Wasserstein alignment, and combinations of inner and outer alignment. Across continuous graph and molecular generation, alignment can substantially simplify trajectories and improve few-step generation, while its benefits depend on the alignment and computational budget. Our results highlight that effective graph flow matching benefits from alignment both inside and across graph pairs.

title: ClusterAttention: A training-free speedup of bidirectional attention
comments: 13 pages, 2 figures, plus appendix. September update: Faster compensation kernel, fixed TabPFN-3 preprocessing and autocast scope (giving better accuracy and larger speedup), corrections in the error analysis and complexities, expanded comparison with similar work, revised the writing
summary: We introduce ClusterAttention, a general training-free speedup of bidirectional attention at large token counts. We point out two common assumptions in contemporary training-free methods; attention sparsity, and context that can be leveraged, such as structure in the input or multiple similar forward passes, and show when they fail. Our proposed method utilizes a fast attention-aware recursive clustering method, and compensation of excluded clusters through their mean. The clustering method gives power-of-two cluster sizes, allowing block-sparse attention to match dense attention in GPU throughput. On TabPFN-3 arXiv:2605.13986, a model where none of the assumptions hold, ClusterAttention is to our knowledge the first method to provide a substantial speedup over the default attention, while consistently keeping over 99\% of its accuracy. On the largest dataset from the TALENT benchmark suite, it makes processing of the training dataset close to 8x faster at nearly 11x attention speedup. ClusterAttention is also competitive with domain-specific methods, while avoiding any of the domain-specific engineering. On video-generation with Wan 2.1-T2V-14B arXiv:2503.20314 it produces output closer to dense attention at a larger speedup (1.8x vs 1.4x) than SVOO arXiv:2603.18636, a leading method in this domain, with both evaluated without offline calibration.

title: Performative Privacy: When Differential Privacy Maximizes Utility
summary: Privacy-preserving learning is often motivated by the idea that protecting users' data can preserve trust and thus participation, improving utility in the long term. However, this claim has not been formalized so far. In parallel, performative learning provides a framework for studying learning systems whose deployment affects the data they later observe. In this work, we bring these two perspectives together and introduce performative privacy, where data leakage reduces future participation. We study a simple model where agents repeatedly contribute data for mean estimation but may leave the system when their data is leaked. Privacy is implemented through differentially private mechanisms, creating a trade-off between estimation noise and future participation. We show, through a theoretical study of the dynamics and numerical experiments, that a finite privacy budget can outperform non-private estimation in the long term when the feedback loop between leakage and participation is sufficiently strong. This provides first evidence that differential privacy can be optimal not only as a protection mechanism, but also from the perspective of long-term utility.

title: CultureConverse: A Multilingual Multi-turn Simulation Harness for Culturally Grounded Assistance in East and Southeast Asia
summary: Current cultural evaluations for large language models (LLMs) often reduce culture to single-turn factual recall via MCQs, failing to capture a common use case: users seeking practical help over multiple turns in culturally grounded scenarios. We introduce CultureConverse, a scalable, multilingual simulation and evaluation harness for culturally grounded assistant dialogue that covers 10 East and Southeast Asian regions, 58 subgroup identities, and 7 domains. Each simulated and evaluated episode produces a scored interaction where the assistant assists the user and infers cultural constraints from partial information. The resulting CultureConverse-DS dataset contains 14,610 benchmark (evaluation) episodes and 274,295 oracle-guided (gold-mode) dialogues. In our benchmark evaluation of 18 models, GPT-5 mini achieves the highest assistance quality. Human annotation experiments suggest that our evaluation framework is a sufficient proxy for human judgment. Performance gains from fine-tuning on 27,860 high-quality CultureConverse-DS samples improve in-domain assistance and transfer out-of-domain to cultural MCQ and safety classification benchmarks. We release the harness, both splits, and judge prompts to support interactive evaluation of cultural competency.

title: The reach of a verification tool decides its value: A controlled study of verification surface, artifact quality, and cost in AI coding agents
comments: 27 pages, 13 figures, 10 tables. Submitted to IEEE Access. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21961590
summary: Modern artificial-intelligence coding agents can be equipped with tools for checking their own work e.g. a linter, a boot probe, a shell, a screenshot tool. We call this set the agent's verification surface. This study asks whether increasing only that surface, with everything else held fixed, produces a matching growth in the quality of the software the agent ships. We built a minimal coding agent whose tool list is the single controlled variable and used it to implement 1,116 web applications across six models and eight tool configurations. A condition-blind human graded every application against a frozen rubric, and automatic probes stress-tested the API-observable behaviors. Verification's cheapest benefit arrives first, which is to make sure that the application comes up. Without any tools, about one build in seven fails to launch at all and a single boot probe removes nearly all of these failures at roughly 35 percent of a full shell's token cost, while the full shell multiplies the no-tools cost by 2.35. Screenshots help most where mistakes are visible (e.g. element placement, interaction), though even there the gain over a shell is modest and does not survive correction for multiple statistical comparisons. In cases where failures can only be measured rather than seen, such as keeping scrolling smooth over a 100,000-row list, screenshots add nothing. A verification tool improves the output artifact only where its reach covers the way the application actually fails.

title: The Illusion of Replacement: Rethinking Specialized Machine Learning Models in the Foundation Model Era
summary: Specialized machine learning architectures encode structural assumptions (equivariance, permutation invariance, relational structure) that language-based foundation models lack by design. This review asks whether such assumptions can instead be acquired through language, drawing on a corpus of 186 papers published between 2016 and 2026 across nine modalities: tabular data, graphs, time series, vision, chemistry, code, knowledge graphs, point clouds, and protein structure. Methods are organized into eight representational regimes, ranging from language-only prompting to fully specialized architectures, and are assessed not only on predictive accuracy but on whether structural information is preserved by the representation and computed by the model. Language-mediated models prove competitive in extreme few-shot prediction, discretized symbolic tasks, and textually annotated knowledge graphs. No evidence of general replacement survives once structure itself is evaluated: where direct tests exist, apparent parity is traceable to information asymmetry, benchmark contamination, or computation performed outside the language model. Across independent research communities, missing structural inductive biases are reintroduced through graph modules, structure-aware tokens, or specialized attention, indicating that specialization is relocated rather than eliminated. The review closes by specifying a falsifiable controlled experiment that would measure the remaining gap directly. The derived data supporting the findings of this review are openly available in the repository at https://github.com/kiyan-rezaee/language-vs-structure.

title: Hydra: A Navigation World Action Model with Discrete Latent Planning and Continuous Flow-Matching Execution
summary: World models let robots imagine possible futures, but exploiting this capability for real-time planning is bottlenecked by a representation misalignment: generative models and planners operate on decoupled manifolds, requiring computationally expensive decoding of every candidate back to the high-dimensional observation space for evaluation. In this paper, we present Hydra, a discrete World Action Model that tackles this by establishing a unified latent manifold over visual states, physical poses, and control actions. By compressing this manifold through modality-specific Vector-Quantized bottlenecks, Hydra yields discrete vocabularies of kinodynamic intents and visual states. This enables Discrete Latent Planning (DLP), where candidates are sampled directly from the shared manifold and ranked by a Kinematic-Perceptual Cost within the discrete latent space. To bridge discrete planning with the continuous commands required for physical actuation, Hydra pairs DLP with conditional Flow Matching to map selected intents to smooth execution trajectories. Evaluated on two physical robotic platforms, Hydra outperforms state-of-the-art navigation world models in goal-directed planning, while matching or exceeding the closed-loop execution capabilities of leading reactive navigation policies.

title: Flow-JEPA: Robust Latent Dynamics for JEPA World Models via Flow Matching
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provide a powerful framework for latent world modeling and planning in a reconstruction-free manner. Although numerous JEPA-based approaches have been proposed to mitigate representation collapse, our experiments on localized, out-of-distribution visual noise reveal that performance degradation remains pronounced and unresolved. We propose Flow-JEPA (F-JEPA), a flow-based latent dynamics model that jointly generates a sequence of future latent states conditioned on the current observation and actions. A Gaussian distribution serves as the flow source, exposing the vector field to perturbed latent trajectories as it learns to transport them toward clean future representations. This formulation retains the reconstruction-free JEPA framework while switching from pointwise transition regression to stochastic trajectory-level prediction. F-JEPA raises mean success from $86\%$ to $92\%$ under clean observations and from $67\%$ to $86\%$ under noisy conditions. Further evaluations over varying perturbation severity and inference settings show that the performance advantage persists across a broad range of conditions. These results suggest that conditional flow matching provides a promising alternative to deterministic autoregressive prediction as a dynamics formulation in JEPA world models.

title: Benevolent Bias in Multi-Turn Human-Agent Dialogue
summary: Bias in human-agent interaction can manifest not only through hostile language but also as benevolent bias, whereby unequal treatment hides behind a warm, positive tone. To make it detectable, we operationalise benevolent bias along two dimensions, tone and treatment, yielding three classes: neutral support, overt bias, and benevolent bias. Building on these definitions, we construct BENEVDIAL, a class-balanced corpus of 362,880 multi-turn support dialogues spanning user and agent demographics, roles, and generators, to support controlled evaluation. We then test two detector families on it: off-the-shelf safety detectors and prompted large language model (LLM) judges. Our findings reveal a notable detection gap: off-the-shelf detectors reliably flag overt bias yet largely fail to identify benevolent bias. LLM judges improve sensitivity when guided by explicit detection criteria, but this comes at the cost of increased misclassification of neutral supportive statements as benevolent bias, a tendency that is further exacerbated by the presence of demographic context. These findings suggest that fair monitoring of human-agent dialogue must look beyond surface cues to whether the agent's treatment is disparate.

title: Review-Period Sensitivity in Multiclass Queue Scheduling
summary: Optimal control of queueing networks is typically studied under continuous-time control. In many service settings, however, managers can adjust decisions only at discrete and potentially infrequent review epochs. We study a multiclass queue scheduling problem in which server assignments can be changed only at the beginning of discrete review periods, and examine how performance depends on the review-period length. We analyze a family of associated fluid control problems parameterized by the review-period length and characterize the first- and second-order sensitivity of the value function. For the two-class case, we derive explicit expressions for these derivatives and characterize their signs. We find that for short review periods, the value function need not be monotone. Once the review period is sufficiently large, the value function becomes monotone nondecreasing and may exhibit a convex or linear region before eventually becoming concave. These results provide insights on when the value of more frequent control, or \emph{flexibility} with respect to server assignments, is higher. We further numerically examine the robustness of these observations for the original stochastic scheduling problem and show that stochasticity smooths the nonmonotonicity at smaller scales, while the qualitative sensitivity patterns remain visible and become more pronounced as the scale of the system increases.

title: JPO: Juris Policy Optimization for Structured Legal Reasoning in Criminal Judgment Prediction
summary: Criminal judgment prediction requires models to infer statutory articles, charges, and sentencing outcomes from case facts. Unlike standard classification tasks, it involves a structured reasoning process in which statutes should be matched with facts, charges should be justified by statutes, and sentencing outcomes should remain consistent with charges. Existing approaches optimize final labels, and while some have attempted to evaluate reasoning quality, their evaluations are indirect, often relying on LLM-generated rubrics that reflect model-internal preferences rather than the inherent logical structure of legal adjudication. We propose Juris Policy Optimization (JPO), a post-training framework for structured legal reasoning in Chinese criminal judgment prediction. JPO first uses teacher-generated rationales to supervise a standardized four-step reasoning process, and then applies reinforcement learning with a composite reward over legal prediction quality, reasoning structure completeness, and cross-step consistency. JPO further introduces token-level advantage reweighting and adaptive clipping for legally salient reasoning segments. Experiments on multiple open-source language models and three Chinese legal benchmarks show that JPO consistently improves both judgment prediction and reasoning quality over supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning baselines.

title: Vision Is Not Overhead: One-Pass Block Drafting for Lossless Speculative Decoding in Vision-Language Models
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates generation without changing its output, but on vision-language models (VLMs) a self-reinforcing cycle holds it back. Because an autoregressive drafter pays a sequential pass for each drafted token, it must stay small and can ill afford to attend to the image at each pass. Prior work therefore compresses or hides the image, leaving the drafter weakest on the text the image determines. We present GLANCE, a one-pass block drafter that breaks this cycle on an unmodified VLM target. Its block-diffusion head drafts a whole block in one forward pass over the target's already fused vision-language states, reading the multimodal context once, however deep the draft. The target verifies a wide candidate tree in one pass and commits exactly its greedy output. In one production engine at a fixed round budget, GLANCE decodes up to 3.05 times faster than autoregressive decoding and outpaces the production EAGLE3-VL head on average and by about 11% on grounded tasks. An entropy law explains when drafting pays, predicting the longest accepted blocks on grounded tasks, where the target's next-token entropy is lowest. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/GLANCE.
